1437386558.name: Cardiogram - HR Monitor
1437386558.description: Cardiogram is a private, real-time heart rate monitor, BPM tracker, and workout analysis app designed for iPhone, Apple Watch, and Apple Health users. Monitor, record, and analyze your heart rate during workouts, recovery, daily activity, or rest, with all data stored securely on your device. Unlike subscription fitness apps, Cardiogram works without accounts, cloud services, or data sharing, giving you complete control over your health information. Real-Time Heart Rate & BPM Tracking Track your heart rate and BPM live using Apple Watch or compatible Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) heart rate monitors. Whether you're training, running, cycling, or monitoring your daily fitness, Cardiogram delivers accurate real-time heart rate data when you need it most. Apple Health Integration & Workout Analysis Import and analyze workouts stored in Apple Health, including sessions recorded with Apple Watch and other compatible fitness apps. Cardiogram automatically keeps your workout history up to date, making it easy to review heart rate trends, training intensity, and performance over time. Recovery Heart Rate Understand how your body recovers after exercise with the 1-minute Recovery Heart Rate metric. Track your recovery across workouts and gain valuable insights into your cardiovascular fitness and training progress. Heart Rate Zones for Smarter Training Visualize workout intensity instantly with color-coded heart rate zones: Fitness Fat Burn Aerobic Anaerobic Maximum Effort See how much time you spend in each zone and optimize your workouts for endurance, fat burning, cardiovascular fitness, or peak performance. Privacy-First by Design Your health data stays private. No account required No cloud storage No tracking or data selling Data stored locally on your iPhone and Apple Health Built for users who want accurate heart rate tracking and workout analysis without compromising their privacy. Wide BLE Monitor Compatibility Connect external heart rate sensors including: Polar Garmin Wahoo CooSpo Magene Other Bluetooth heart rate monitors Ideal for runners, cyclists, gym enthusiasts, and anyone who trains with a Bluetooth heart rate monitor. Fast & Battery Efficient Cardiogram is optimized for long workouts with minimal battery usage, providing reliable heart rate monitoring and workout analysis throughout every training session. Built for Training & Everyday Health Use Cardiogram to: Monitor your heart rate in real time Track workout intensity and heart rate zones Analyze workouts from Apple Health Measure Recovery Heart Rate Review heart rate history and trends Record heart rate sessions Improve training with actionable heart rate insights Simple, accurate, private, and built to help you better understand your heart rate. Disclaimer: Cardiogram is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or prevent medical conditions. Always consult a healthcare professional regarding health concerns.

1437460714.name: Bitcoin Forecast: Now & Future
1437460714.description: BitForecast: See tomorrow’s Bitcoin moves, today: with voice forecasts BitForecast delivers transparent, explainable Bitcoin forecasts derived from on-chain data, market sentiment, and macroeconomic indicators. Its multi-layer vector architecture fuses these dimensions to infer not only short-term signals but also the overall directional flow of the market. Straightforward, Probabilistic Predictions No guesswork, no magic—just probabilistic forecasts. Unlike most crypto tools that dump complex charts and leave you guessing, BitForecast gives you a single, probability-based forecast. You see the most likely price along with possible scenarios and edge cases, all expressed with explicit probabilities—so anyone can understand the market at a glance. Now with Audio Forecasts BitForecast can read Bitcoin forecasts aloud. Tap a button and hear today’s market outlook, including likely price movements, key signals, and edge scenarios—perfect for on-the-go updates or quick market briefings without reading charts. Transparent Data and Methodology Every prediction comes with the data, indicators, and methodology behind it. You can explore why a forecast was made and how each signal contributed, ensuring complete transparency. Daily Market Briefings BitForecast delivers insights in a briefing-style format, not just numbers. Hear or read the overall market trend and current signals each day—designed for anyone, even without prior crypto knowledge. Learn, Improve, Repeat All forecasts are measured against real prices. When predictions miss the mark, we show why and incorporate the insight into future forecasts. BitForecast learns and improves continuously, getting more accurate over time. Current Market Context Core signals are updated daily, reflecting what is actually influencing the market today. No complicated settings, no noisy alerts—just clear, current insights, now also available as voice updates. Simple, Clear, Reliable BitForecast makes Bitcoin market analysis accessible for everyone. No manual research and knowledge required, no guesswork, just honest, actionable insights that you can trust—every day. Long-Term Vision We are at the starting point of time-series event prediction and long-term market analysis. BitForecast aims to introduce a new form of complete predictive system, and you can expect continuous evolution in the way forecasts are delivered—including interactive audio forecasts for a fully hands-free experience.

1437479513.name: 逃脱者：困境突围
1437479513.description: 从寒冷的城堡冻原，乘坐疾驰的火车穿过沙漠，直至最后的边界。 全力以赴从各种生存条件艰辛密室中逃脱出来。探索各具风格的密室，密室建有多层地板、屋顶、通风口和地下隧道。开发你的创造力，使用各种日用品（肥皂和袜子）或一些有趣的随手可见的餐具等物品（叉子或钢板）制造武器和工具。 【游戏玩法】： 顶级特色密室： 全力以赴从世界上生存环境最艰苦的密室中逃脱出来。你需要遵守密室的规定，做各种工作并遵循严格的日常安排；所有的一切都是在努力为你争取自由，早日逃出密室！ 建立你的装扮： 从大量的定制中选择你的角色，使其独一无二。当你策划逃脱时，时尚装扮很重要。 制定你的逃脱计划： 在监狱里，你要开发你的创造力，使用有限的工具来制作各种道具。你可以将日常用品（如肥皂和袜子）组合起来，制造新的武器和工具，以帮助你实现目标。也可以从自助餐厅拿到叉子，在房间里铺一条隧道，并通过杂志和胶带制作海报以隐藏痕迹。你将很快了解到，胶带解决一切！ 逃脱队组合： 联合最多 3 个朋友组建终极逃脱团队，并设计出最疯狂的逃脱计划！聚拢于沙发上，为你的暗中冒险做准备。通过合作，你将创建更加精细和勇敢的计划。感觉没有竞争性？你可以进入对战模式，并显示出你有能力比你的朋友更快地逃脱任何密室。如果其他一切都失败了，在密室天井上解决你的敌对目标！ 准备战斗： 《逃脱者：困境突围》引入了全新的战斗系统，使每个密室的战斗更加激动人心以及具有互动性。你可以保持攻击姿态并围绕你的目标走动，以在作战中获得上风；也可以在合适的时间格挡已减少伤害。确保你先到健身房锻炼肌肉！ 逃脱新方法： 随着密室越来越艰苦，你将不得不策划更加周密的逃脱计划。应对任何密室逃脱都有很多选择。尝试制作药物混合物来伪造自己的死亡，让太平间做剩下的工作！ 【游戏特色】： 最多4名玩家合作逃脱 玩家之间可以联机对战 超过 300 个角色装扮定制 多层密室，给你最真实的场景体验 【逃脱者：困境突围】 联系我们------ 有任何问题或建议，都可以通过以下渠道告诉我们： 客服电话：4009001565 客服邮箱：kf@east2west.cn 微信公众号：east2westgames或搜索“东品西尚” 微博：@东品游戏

1437805285.name: Pango Kumo - 天气小游戏
1437805285.description: 改变世界的小云朵！ 成为 Kumo，一朵充满魔法的小云朵！世界在等你：下雨、降雪、释放闪电，让大地重获生机。 世界灰暗又沉寂……但在你的帮助下，色彩重新回归！让树木生长，堆起雪山，用闪电击碎岩石，看着大自然在你的一举一动中发生变化。 Pango Kumo 邀请孩子们在游戏中探索天气和水循环。他们观察、尝试，并立刻看到自己行为带来的结果：下雨、下雪、蒸发、植物生长、环境变化。用一种简单直观的方式理解自然，非常适合 3 岁及以上的孩子。 PANGO 出品 15 年来，Pango 一直为全球超过 1500 万名儿童打造聪明、易上手且充满关爱的游戏体验。在 Pango Kumo 中，孩子可以探索自然，理解天气现象，在一个充满欢乐的世界里操控自然元素。 为什么家长喜欢 PANGO KUMO？ 以简单有趣的方式认识水循环 鼓励自由探索和天生的好奇心 培养精细动作能力和观察力 互动世界：雨、雪、闪电、蒸发、植被 没有压力，没有挑战，没有时间限制 每一次游戏都会变化的广阔世界 非常适合 3 岁及以上的孩子 100% 安全的儿童游戏 无内购 无广告 无外部链接 内置家长控制 符合儿童数据保护标准 PANGO 的价值观：自然、启蒙、探索 在 Pango，我们致力于创造能够激发好奇心、帮助孩子理解世界的游戏。简单、温和、令人安心的体验，让每个孩子都能按照自己的节奏成长。 需要帮助？有问题？pango@studio-pango.com 更多信息：www.studio-pango.com 下载 PANGO KUMO，让孩子与天气一起玩耍：下雨、下雪……让生命成长！

1437807952.name: Graph
1437807952.description: 函数绘图器是您可视化数学函数的强大工具，是学校、大学以及任何想要亲身体验数学的人的理想之选。 2D 和 3D 显示 在经典的 2D 视图和令人惊叹的 3D 曲面渲染之间无缝切换。绘制单变量或双变量函数，并通过缩放、平移和旋转进行交互式探索。 超过 24 种数学函数 三角函数、双曲函数、对数函数和其他函数应有尽有，包括 sin、cos、tan、ln、sqrt 等等。即使是具有嵌套结构的复杂表达式也能可靠地进行计算。 自动检测特殊点 零点、y 轴截距、交点和切点都会自动计算并在图表上高亮显示，让您一目了然地查看函数的重要属性。 每个函数的单独设置 您可以单独调整每个函数的颜色、线条粗细、分辨率和定义域。同时绘制多个函数并直接进行比较。 保存和加载场景 将您的所有工作保存为场景——包括所有函数、设置、颜色和相机位置。随时重新加载已保存的场景，无缝衔接您的工作。 数值表 随时随地查看函数值，并详细分析函数的行为。 贴心设计 彩色输入验证、集成数学键盘和现代玻璃效果设计，确保愉悦的用户体验。 亮点一览： 2D 和 3D 函数显示 超过 24 种数学函数 特殊点自动检测 可自定义颜色和显示设置 保存和加载场景 数值表 数学键盘

1437865316.trackName: 白描取字 - 专业OCR图片转文字工具
1437865316.description: 下载即可享受没有任何限制的OCR文字识别、批量识别以及翻译功能，无内购，无账号系统，无广告，拍照识别速度更快。 专业的OCR文字识别工具，纯净，只做OCR文字识别的白描版本。 使用场景----- 拍照翻译文字、图片文字提取、公司文件转录、纸质书阅读笔记摘录、截图文字内容提取、身份证识别、购物小票识别，纸质文件电子化存档等等多种场景适用。 功能亮点---- ● 竖排文字、繁体文字，都能识别 ● 多语言识别 支持中文、英语、日语、韩语、法语、德语、俄语、西班牙语等大多数语言的OCR识别；留学生说“白描用来处理上课笔记实在是太好用了”； ● 云端识别 云端OCR识别引擎，识别准确度随着自动学习越来越高，识别速度快；另外可以放心的是，图片上传经过加密处理，无需担心隐私。 ● 批量识别。 同类app里的领跑者，能一次识别50张图片，批量识别后也可以对多张原图同时进行校对。 ● 识别结果自动存为历史记录，检索方便。 ●清理纸张背景 有些书页或者纸张太薄，会透出背面的字，对识别结果造成影响，可点击识别页面的「清理背景」按钮进行优化，从而使识别结果更准确。 ●拍照翻译 拍照后直接将结果翻译在原图。 ● 识别结果翻译 支持简体中文、日语、英语、韩语、法语、西班牙语、阿拉伯语、俄语、德语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、繁体中文、粤语、文言文、泰语、希腊语、波兰语、荷兰语、保加利亚语、爱沙尼亚语、丹麦语、芬兰语、捷克语、罗马尼亚语、斯洛文尼亚语、瑞典语、匈牙利语、越南语的互译； ● 灵活选择 手指流畅顺滑，即可分块选择需要的文字，想要哪段点哪段（想查看所有文本，不需要按行点选）；识别结果可编辑且选择复制到各种app中使用，支持微信、QQ、有道云、印象笔记等软件。 ● 快速校对 在识别结果页面点击“校对”按钮进行校对，可以在不离开编辑区域的情况下方便对照着原文修改，弥补OCR技术的不完美之处。 ● 通过 iOS 12 上的捷径功能，可以自定义动作及参数，你的效率你做主； ● 识别结果自动分段，弥补了大多数识别软件无法还原原文段落的问题； 使用中遇到任何问题，欢迎发送邮件到tolecen@163.com，或者联系微博@凉子的狗狗

1438199765.name: Watchee
1438199765.description: Watchee was designed to let watch enthusiasts and collectors easily track key information related to their watches. After entering all your information with many predefined options for ease of use, you will have your watch collection virtually with you on your iPhone! STORE WATCH SPECIFIC DETAILS Movement details: type of movement, calibre, power reserve, vibrations per hour Serial number and reference number Case details, such as diameter, lug width, crown type, thickness and material Complications(up to six per watch), predefined list for quick selection Prices of purchase and sales ACCURACY MEASUREMENT Store multiple accuracy measurements for each watch Check interim result for a measurement while test is active Storing the results of each test allows you to compare whether a watch is more accurate on your wrist than in a box or on a winder, for example. WEAR RATE Track which watches you wear most often Track how many days have passed since you last wore a certain watch Track the cost per wear It can be quite interesting to see which watches are getting the most wrist time and which are mostly hiding away in the watch box Finding watch specific statistics is as easy as tapping a button each time you wear a watch BADGES Earn various badges for the watches in your collection to keep watch collection hobby exciting. As most visuals, the badges can be turned on/off as per user preferences WATCH OF THE DAY Get a random watch suggestion from your own collection on those busy mornings If you choose to go with the suggestion, automatically increment Wear Rate statistics and History Log HISTORY LOG Automatically (if enabled in the settings) logs many things happening in the App regarding watches. I.e. when the watch was added to collection or sold Tracks the status changes for watches: Keeper, In Service, Needs a strap and so on Also adds the ability to log a datestamp each time (or every 10th time) a watch is worn. History log works automatically together with wrist statistics KEEPER RATE AND SELLER RATE Watchee will suggest Keeper & Seller Rates for your watches by comparing a specific watch against all the other watches in your collection. It will compare the various attributes of your watch against the averages of those attributes across your collection WATCH STATUS Set a status for each watch in the collection There are various statuses to choose from such as: Keeper, Willing to flip, Incoming, In Service, My Next Watch, Needs a new Strap...). Statuses can be very handy for those situations when you are buying new straps for your watches or flipping the watches with friends, visiting a watchmaker etc. PDF DOCUMENTS Easily create beautiful PDF-documents describing the watches in your collection Create comprehensive sales adverts for your watches with just a tap of a button Four different documents to choose from CSV-FILES The main watch collection data can be exported to a CSV-format Exported CSV-file can be further examined with spreadsheet programs TRACK THE SERVICE HISTORY FOR EACH WATCH Service centre used Service start and end dates Service description Service price Service warranty date WARRANTY CARD Store the warranty card image for each watch SUMMARY LEVEL INFORMATION Number of watches in collection Average thickness, diameter,manufacture year of watches Number of sold watches Total cost of watches in collection Total cost of sold watches Profit from sold watches End result of user's watch deals and more... COMPREHENSIVE SETTINGS/CUSTOMIZATION OF THE APP There are 15 individual settings to comprehensively customize the various functionalities In case you need to share some information with your friends, Watchee let's you do that via email or popular messaging Apps. Watchee stores all its information on your device so it does not need internet-connection unless you wish to share some information with friends.

1438214016.name: Bloom: 10 Worlds
1438214016.description: Brian Eno and Peter Chilvers are pleased to announce Bloom: 10 Worlds – a developed, augmented and expanded new edition of 2008’s game-changing original Bloom app, which explored uncharted territory in the realm of applications and was dubbed “The First Great iPhone App” by Gizmodo. Requiring no musical or technical ability, the egalitarian and user-friendly Bloom app enabled anyone of any age to create music, simply by touching the screen. Part instrument, part composition and part artwork, Bloom’s innovative controls allowed users to create elaborate patterns and unique melodies by simply tapping the screen. A generative music player took over when Bloom was left idle, creating an infinite selection of compositions and their accompanying visualisations. Bloom: 10 Worlds is a reimagining of the original – not simply a remaster. If the original Bloom was a single, then this would be an album. The widely broadened palette of sounds and images can be experienced via 10 new ‘worlds’, each exploring a new direction for Bloom. The first world the user encounters is an echo of the original app, with circles appearing where the user taps. Each subsequent world unlocks automatically, introducing new combinations of sounds, shapes, colours and rules of behaviour. Praise for the original Bloom “The very first iPhone apps were universally dull. And then Bloom came out. It was immediately obvious that something special was happening. The app was interesting on an artistic level – one that made you reconsider the relationship between technology and music. It raised the bar for musical iPhone apps.” Gizmodo “Hypnotic and ludicrously addictive.” The Guardian “A relaxing alternative to just about anything else you can do with an iPhone.” Wired Eno began collaborating with musician / software designer Peter Chilvers on Will Wright’s computer game Spore. Their shared interest in generative music rapidly lead to the development of a prototype for Bloom in 2008. In the intervening decade, they experimented further with the field, expanding their catalogue of apps with Trope, Scape and Reflection. In that time Chilvers has also acted as an engineer and technical advisor to Eno on a number of other projects. A series of multi-speaker installations around the world laid the groundwork for 2016’s The Ship, and they premiered Bloom: Open Space, a mixed reality installation in Amsterdam in 2018. In addition to his work with Eno, Chilvers co-founded the Burning Shed label and online store, toured with Underworld’s Karl Hyde as keyboardist and musical director, and has recorded instrumental albums and collaborations with vocalist Tim Bowness.

1438243180.name: Dark Reader for Safari
1438243180.description: Dark Reader is an eye-care Safari extension that enables night mode by creating dark themes for websites on the fly. It inverts bright colors to make web pages high contrast and easier to read. Dark Reader integrates seamlessly with system dark mode. Adjust brightness and contrast to match your display and ambient lighting. Enable dark mode on every web page or give websites a sepia tone. Select from multiple color theme presets or create your own by customizing background and text colors. Enable or disable Dark Reader for specific websites, automatically sync with system dark mode, or detect already dark websites and leave them unchanged. Developed by the original creators of Dark Reader. Since 2014, we continuously evolve alongside modern web technologies to deliver fast and reliable dark mode support for people sensitive to bright light. A single purchase includes access to the macOS version (Safari browser) when using the same iCloud account. Dark Reader contains no ads and does not collect user data. Enable Dark Reader in Safari preferences and disable similar extensions to prevent conflicts. Enjoy browsing!

1438243726.name: Jazz Solo Creator
1438243726.description: Using artificial intelligence instantly create solos in the style of great jazz, swing and bebop guitar players. The music created is totally unique and is copyright free so you can use it however you want in your own creative projects. Hear each solo complete with a backing track. See the solo written in guitar tablature. The guitar tab lights up and scrolls as the music plays so that you can see each note as it plays. Select and save your favorite solos. Never run out of licks or things to practice again! Choose the chord progression for your solo (or have one automatically created) and shape your solo by adjusting phrasing, harmony, phrasing, repetition and difficulty sliders. The phrasing slider changes whether the solo is built from short melodic riffs, licks and phrases or from longer lines. The harmony slider adjusts the harmonic complexity of your solo ranging from simple chord tones and arpeggios through to exotic scales.

1438283033.name: 重叠消除
1438283033.description: 重叠消除是一款有趣的拼图游戏，游戏目的是通过移动拼板做出和盘面上一样的图形，规则是：偶数的拼板重叠时，重叠部分消失，显示背景色（黑 + 黑 = 白）。三原色玩法中，不同颜色的两块拼板重叠时，重叠部分将显示另一种颜色（红 + 绿 = 蓝）。 玩家可以在盘面任何地方做出图形，或者在覆盖在原图上。 特性： 9个关卡包，1020关 大游戏区，覆盖模式 六种主题

1438349701.name: Daily Sales - 进销存库存管理系统
1438349701.trackName: Daily Sales - 进销存库存管理系统
1438349701.description: DailySales（进销存库存管理）是一款 易于使用的进出库存管理工具，让您及时了解库存状况、销售收入、采购成本，以提升资金使用效率，使您能快速应对市场变化。 适用于批发商，零售商、微商代购、店家，卖场等商品进出货买卖人。 功能:   支持数据备份和迁移。   数据备份到此Mac设备，或迁移数据到新的Mac设备。   iCloud 同步与备份功能，与其他设备共享数据。也不会丢失数据。   自定义商品父类别 自定义商品子类别  自定义供应商 自定义客户 随时查看供应商 & 客户关联的所有订单，并做出相应的数据统计 密码保护个人数据(添加、修改、验证) 导出CSV数据(可以导出全部数据、也可以选择两个日期范围内的数据导出)，可以使用 Numbers 或者 Microsoft Excel 打开查看与编辑。 个人财务管理 自定义收入类别 & 支出类别 自定义资金账户 采购订单 & 销售订单管理 将销售订单生成JPG图片，可以保存与分享。 统计利润、库存、销售金额、采购金额 支持多种条件搜索，快速搜寻商品、交易记录，供应商，客户等 商品可添加图片 商品按类别分类显示 预设的商品，分类，规格，单位，帐户与商家可快速选取 主列表商品显示库存数量、采购价、销售价以及快捷添加订单按钮 允许输入的金额保留后两位小数点(例如: 19.99, 188.88) 自定义商品编号格式(例如: ABC_001, Product001) 自定义订单号格式(例如: ABC20181013001, Order_20181013_001) 多种统计功能: 1, 产品销售 & 采购统计 2, 供应商 & 客户订单统计 3, 个人收入 & 支出统计 4, 账户收入 & 支出统计 5, 库存 & 利润统计 我们花费了很多时间开发了DailySales。虽然不容易，但我们会不断加入新的特性，也欢迎您提供建议与意见，很感谢您的支持。 如果您对使用上有任何的问题，可以通过App中的电子邮件联系我们，我们一定会更好的服务您。

1438386246.name: 职业乒乓记分板
1438386246.description: 本app是一个非常优雅的在乒乓比赛中显示比分及发球信息的app。它比起传统的乒乓记分板而言有过之而无不及。除了拥有传统乒乓记分板的功能之外，还提供流畅的比分变化动画效果。在手机上使用本app时，比分足够大到能让双方选手看清；而当在iPad上使用本app时，甚至可以让场下观众都能看清比分。

1438389237.name: Damaged Photo Restore & Repair
1438389237.description: Repair your damaged photos, remove cuts, rips, scratches, marks, stains or other imperfections. This app is a professional tool which makes use of advanced powerful algorithms in order to bring your damaged photos back to their original condition. The way it works is really simple. You set the image you want to fix and, automatically, the app will do it for you. If you are an user who wants even better results and precision you can do the entire process manually. Has been in the Top 5 Photo and Video Apps in different countries! Damaged Photo Restore not only fixes damaged photos, it can even remove imperfections from images and hide text or objects. Main features: Removes cuts and rips from photos; Removes scratches, marks and stains; Can repair old photos which got damaged over the time; Can remove imperfections from any image; Can hide text or objects from any image; Simple and intuitive interface; Advanced users can improve their results even more through the manual edit mode; High precision mode (A magnifier shows you where you are editing); Export to camera roll; In-App tutorial; Fast and optimized for iOS 18; Please be aware that: This is a professional tool, follow the in-app explanation in order to learn how to use it correctly; The app will work on almost any photo, however in case the photo provided is affected by a high grade of damage the result will not be optimal.

1438579589.name: Blue Hour & Golden Hour
1438579589.description: Have you ever missed the perfect moment to capture a photo because the light wasn't right, or because you didn't have the information to plan your photography session? With Blue Golden Hour, you'll never miss a photography opportunity again! YOUR COMPLETE PLATFORM FOR CREATIVE PHOTOGRAPHY Blue Golden Hour is designed to help photographers of every level identify golden and blue hours—both morning and evening—to capture perfect light. But that's just the beginning. NEW: The Interactive Planner Position your photo subject on an interactive map and visualize in real-time the precise directions of sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset with exact azimuths. Explore any moment of the day with the time slider and discover exactly where you need to shoot to achieve your desired lighting effect: backlighting for dramatic rim light, front light for raking light, side light for three-dimensional effects. The app automatically suggests the ideal photographer position. ADVANCED LUNAR DATA Go beyond simple phases. Access detailed lunar information: illumination percentage, distance from Earth, automatic detection of supermoons and micromoons, exact transit time with maximum altitude above the horizon. Track the lunar cycle month by month with the dedicated interactive calendar. AUTOMATIC ALIGNMENT Find the exact times when the moon aligns behind your subject from your shooting position. An invisible ally for extraordinary astronomical compositions. SAVED PLANS Save your favorite photography plans with custom names. Easily retrieve your preferred shooting strategies and resume your work exactly where you left it. KEY FEATURES: Interactive planner with map for subject positioning Automatic photographer position calculation (three lighting effect modes) Enhanced moon: illumination %, distance, supermoons, micromoons Interactive lunar phase calendar Automatic moon-subject alignment Multiple location management and customized golden/blue hour notifications Intuitive and responsive interface Dark mode for comfort at any time of day No data connection required (weather data excluded) Saved and retrievable photography plans PRIVACY GUARANTEED No location data is saved outside the app or shared with third parties for tracking or advertising purposes. Download Blue Golden Hour today and gain access to a professional tool that transforms how you plan and execute your photography. From golden hour to lunar cycles, from the interactive planner to calculating your ideal photographer position: everything in one app. Get ready to capture unforgettable photos!

1438597800.name: OKNDrum: Optokinetic Drum
1438597800.description: Replace your bulky optokinetic drum with OKNDrum. OKNDrum is the easy-to-use alternative to a physical optokinetic drum. Our app is used to evaluate neurological, otological, and ophthalmological disorders. To use OKNDrum simply place the iPhone or iPad in front of the eyes to elicit the response. The stripe color, width, speed, and direction can be adjusted easily. OKNDrum features: 7 Scrolling Speeds Red or Black Stripe Colors Adjustable Scroll Direction Adjustable Stripe Size Easy-to-hide Menu Easy-to-follow Instructions Feel free to contact us with any questions or feedback. OKNDrum was developed with the help of medical professionals and with the help of research papers. OKNDrum IS NOT a substitute for medical support. Consult your doctor for any advice.

1438893987.name: RatshackReverb3
1438893987.description: Ratshack Reverb is a detailed model of that classic of classics, the Realistic Electronic Reverb. Now, you can have the sound of everyone's first analog delay unit, without ever having to change batteries! As anyone who has owned this unit (which is just about everyone...) knows, it was actually an analog delay, not a reverb at all, and we've done our best to exactly replicate the sound and quirks of the original. We've even modeled the distortion that occurs by running a line signal in to the mic inputs. Features » Accurate analog "bucket-brigade" style delay model. Change the delay time, and the signal pitches accordingly. » Both mic and line inputs modeled, for overdriving the delay section if desired. » XML-based cross-platform preset manager, with copy and paste. (You can even move presets between the iOS version and the desktop version with Handoff.) » Entirely vector-based resizable high-resolution user interface » Both IAA and AUv3 versions included.

1439013522.name: English Listening Master Pro
1439013522.description: English Listening Master will help you understand English better, improve your English language skills and help you learn real English spoken in everyday situations. English Listening Master is the first application of its kind to make a game out of improving your English listening skills through dictation using real English conversations in a fun, enjoyable and educational way. Learn real English and practice your English listening skills by typing the letters of the words you hear or tapping the words of the audio to form the sentences. English Listening Master is a fun and educational game for kids, seniors and English language students of all ages who want to learn English and improve their listening skills in a more entertaining way. Perfect classroom audio listening recordings don't prepare you for listening in the real world. English Listening Master uses audio from thousands of different native speakers in real settings complete with background noise to make the task more realistic, more practical, and more effective. How do you play? It’s easy. Listen to the audio, and tap or type the words you hear to form the correct sentence. With this entertaining dictation game, you will learn English and practice listening in a fun way. With three modes of difficulty to write the sentences and four levels of sentence difficulty, Listening Master is great for everyone from the elementary level right up to the most seasoned and skilled English ears. What options are there to write what you hear? Don’t worry, you can choose between three options depending on how much help you need. In Easy mode, you have the words written for you on the screen and you just have to tap the words you hear in the correct order. In Competent mode, you will only have the letters of the words, and you have to spell out each word you hear by typing the letters in the correct order. In Expert mode, you won’t have any help, and you will have to put your listening skills to the maximum test. Which one will you choose? The Levels: English Listening Master has four levels: Beginner, Competent, Professional, and Expert Beginner: Ideal for children. This level contains the easiest sentences with the fewest words to tap or spell. Competent: This is where things start to get harder. This level is great for students who are beginning their English language learning adventure. Professional: Great for students with a solid base in English who want to keep their skills up to date. Expert: Only for those with the most proficient English skills. Are you one of them? Do you have what it takes to become the next Listening Master? With Listening Master you'll improve your real English listening and conversation skills while you play and have fun testing your English. With single player and multiplayer mode, you can practice alone, challenge your friends or classmates as well as challenge other players from around the globe. Who's got the best ear for English in the class, family or among your friends? Learn English with a smile on your face with English Listening Master

1439013526.name: Proverbs & Sayings Master Pro
1439013526.description: Learn English sayings and grammar as you play Sayings Master. Sayings Master is a fun and educational game of English proverbs for students, fans, native speakers and non-native speakers of the most international language of all, English, that seek to practice and learn English in an entertaining and simple way. Learning English is now easier and more fun than ever, regardless of your level: if you have a basic level or if you are the head of the English Department at a top school, Sayings Master will help you while you have a good time. How to play? It’s easy, the game consists of putting the scrambled words in order to form a correct sentence. If you make a mistake and click the English word in the incorrect order, there is a time penalty. Once you have completed the sentence, you will receive a score based on how fast you were and your total number of errors. You can share your knowledge with other players worldwide thanks to online multiplayer mode or with your friends on GameCenter. Are you learning English and you want to improve your skills? Sayings Master will provide you with interesting insight into the folklore and popular values of the English language, while you learn new English vocabulary and grammar. Are you a pure-blooded English speaker? Prove it in Competition mode. Sayings Master is a game designed and developed completely by educators, linguists and special needs experts to help students overcome one of the major challenges when learning English, correct word order and sentence structure. With more than 1000 proverbs, Sayings Master is a challenge for everyone, from beginners to the most seasoned English language communicators. Do you want to test your knowledge of popular English sayings? Download and play now! Designed by MasterKey Games and the educators at MasterKey English (www.masterkeyenglish.com)

1439013535.name: Learn Spanish Frase Master Pro
1439013535.description: Learn Spanish and grammar by ordering the words to form correct sentences and sayings. Frase Master is a fun and educational game for kids and Spanish language students of all ages who want to learn Spanish and improve their language skills in a more entertaining way. How do you play? It’s easy. The game consists of putting the scrambled words from each level in order to form a correct sentence and learn Spanish in a fun way. (Beginner, skilled, professional, expert, sayings.) If you make a mistake and click the Spanish word in the incorrect order, there is a time penalty. Once you have completed the sentence you will receive a score based on how fast you were and your total number of errors. You can share your knowledge with other players worldwide thanks to online multiplayer mode or with your friends on GameCenter. Are you a Spanish student who wants to improve your skills? Frase Master will help you learn Spanish and organize the words in your sentences correctly. Are you a Spanish expert who wants to show off your skills? Prove it in Competition mode on GameCenter. Frase Master is the first game of its kind designed and developed completely by educators to help students eliminate the most common mistake among Spanish language learners, correct word order. With four levels from beginner to expert, Frase Master is a challenge for everyone from the Beginner to the most seasoned Spanish language communicators. These are the levels: Beginner: Ideal for children. This level contains the easiest sentences with the fewest words to unscramble. Skilled: This is where things start to get harder. This level is great for adults who are beginning their Spanish language learning adventure. Professional: Great for users with a solid base in Spanish who want to keep their skills up to date. Expert: Only for those with the most proficient Spanish skills. Are you one of them? Do you have what it takes to become the next Frase Master? Try your luck in single player mode or against friends and other players worldwide. Learn Spanish with a smile on your face.

1439038210.name: APD Colony Counter App Lite
1439038210.description: For automated counting versions, please get APD Colony App PRO* Colony counter app that can analyze agar plate images and count them manually using the touch screen. With access to the phone storage and also directly to the camera, fast and convenient colony counting can be done. Photos should be taken on a direct plane with the agar plate. Features of this app includes: 1) Customized user input. 2) Simple and button based user interface. 3) Compatibility with screenshot functions of analyzed images for publications or reports. 4) Tags in image can be customized for color and size. 5) Edit function to remove or add tags. 6) Simple direct access to phone camera. 7) Simple direct access to Image gallery for images. Benefits of using this app for publications 1) Brings greater accuracy to your colony counts. 2) Value adds to publications and reports. 3) Useful teaching tool to science students. 4) Streamlined analysis, reducing human error and subjectivity - you can now trust the values reported by trainees and less experienced staff! 5) On the go analysis with the smartphone/tablet. 6) The app costs less than the cheapest colony counter! 7) The app is self-contained, no internet access needed. To cite, please use: Wong CF, Yeo JY, Gan SKE (2016) APD Colony Counter App: Using Watershed Algorithm for improved colony counting. Nature Methods Application Notes. doi:10.1038/ an9774 This app is a personal endeavor of Mr Wong, Mr Sim, Mr Yong, and Dr Gan

1439149349.name: TODOT - 极简的待办任务清单和任务管理时间提醒
1439149349.trackName: TODOT - 极简的待办任务清单和任务管理时间提醒
1439149349.description: 一款超极简的时间待办任务管理APP，新颖独特的三段时间管理模式，界面清新，操作简单。 全新的任务模式，从三个阶段诠释任务管理，包含正在做、未开始、已完成。任务状态由自己决定，任务管理更便捷。 全新的日历模式，任务管理更直观更便捷。 支持 iOS 13 & 暗黑模式Dark Mode 支持管理任务分类 支持日期多选和备注 新的界面风格 任务池功能，不确定的任务都可以放这里。 新增iOS14小组件，更直观查看待办任务。 全新的任务壁纸，可将待办任务添加到壁纸上，只需点亮屏幕即可看到应该做的任务，超级方便。建议只设置锁屏壁纸。 今天、未来和过去，只有做好今天的事情才能成就美好的未来，才能拥有美好回忆，所以今天才是最重要的，我们要优先管理今天的任务，其次是计划未来的任务和总结过去的经验。 时间就是金钱，时间很宝贵，我们希望可以用最少的时间来进行任务管理，同时又满足任务管理的功能，希望这个APP可以提高我们生活和工作的效率。 如果你用过时间任务管理类APP，那么这款APP一定会让你赞叹，其便捷性绝对让你的效率更上一层楼。 如果你没有用过时间任务管理类APP，那么这款APP一定会让你爱上管理时间和任务，过上高效率的生活。 App功能： 三段时间管理 三阶段任务管理 日历模式管理 子任务 番茄钟，番茄工作法 搜索任务 自定义任务壁纸 右滑快速完成任务 左滑快速删除任务 右滑快速激活任务 左滑移动任务至今天 左滑复制任务 任务详情展示 快速添加任务 任务添加闹钟提醒 个人和工作分类 时间和任务模式设置 工作优先设置 任务优先级设置 安全密码 每日添加和检查提醒 Widget小组件展示，支持快速完成任务 欢迎留言联系我们，你的建议将成为下一版本的更新功能。 意见反馈请联系我：xm@awnlab.com

1439422081.name: 天气 : 天气预报 Pro
1439422081.trackName: 天气 : 天气预报 Pro
1439422081.description: 天气预报，最好的天气应用之一，是你最好的选择之一。 天气预报，随时随地提供准确的天气信息。 当地天气预报和实时降雨，风暴，冰雪报告... 通过天气信息，你可以仔细地准备你的计划，你将会在工作中取得成功并获得更好的生活。该应用程序对每个人都非常有帮助。 天气预报自动检测当前位置的天气。除了十天的未来预测，还有每小时的天气预报，天气预报中还有很多信息，包括天气状况，大气压力，相对湿度，可见距离，不同单位的降水量，露点，风速和方向。 实时温度，雨，雪，湿度，压力，风力和风向都基于这种天气应用。 特征： 每周，每天，每小时实时更新。 全球天气预报：美国，加拿大，巴西，英国，瑞典，丹麦，意大利，德国，法国，葡萄牙，西班牙，墨西哥，芬兰，挪威，俄罗斯，印度，日本，韩国，中国，澳大利亚，越南...... 所有城市的天气预报：华盛顿，纽约，加利福尼亚，旧金山，德克萨斯州，乔治亚州，佛罗里达，渥太华，夏威夷，多伦多，达拉斯，纳什维尔，堪萨斯城，伦敦，罗马，马德里，奥斯陆，巴黎，南希，第戎，布列斯特马赛雷恩兰斯夏蒙尼里昂梅斯格勒诺布尔斯特拉斯堡柏林东京新加坡香港河内胡志明市... 完整报告。显示所有天气信息：位置时间，温度，大气压力，天气状况，能见度距离，相对湿度，不同单位的降水量，露点，风速和风向... 通过GPS和网络检测位置 搜索和管理多个位置 支持的通知 实时更新小部件 今天，明天，3天后，7天后。今天的天气，明天的天气......每小时的小时天气。 天气描述：日出时间，日落时间，湿度，降水概率，可见性，风速... 实时天气地图和天气雷达动画与您的个人暴风雪和飓风跟踪：雨，雪，云，风，温度，湿度，波浪，压力，电流。 查看每日天气和每小时天气的详细信息。 管理和查看每小时和每日天气的图表 更改单位设置：温度（C / F），时间格式（12h / 24h），降水量（mm，英寸），风速（km / h，mi / h，m / s），压力（mmhg，hPa，mbar ） 使用天气应用程序并每天和每天获取天气信息。 下载天气预报和体验。您的设备中高质量的天气预报应用程序。

1439533817.name: FM Panel D-15 Test
1439533817.description: This software is the software which carries out the Farnsworth-Munsell Panel D-15 Test. The FM Panel D-15 Test is said to be able to discriminate whether the degree of misunderstanding of color vision is intensity or not. In addition to the tests, this software has following functions. color sliders. matrix tables, circle color charts. LMS Conversion, Cellophane treatment, Degree rotation, Image pixel picker.

1439714447.name: Easy Pomodoro - Pomodoro Timer
1439714447.description: Pomodoro Technique developed by Francesco Cirillo, allows you to treat time very efficiently. The technique managed to assist the people who have difficulty in working, since the 1980’s. Today, especially for the people who want to study, it is a must. With the effects all around the world, it is easy to see the impacts it does in a short amount of time. Pomodoro Timer App, allows you to use the technique with 25 minutes of working time and 5 minutes of resting time and you can change either minute whenever you want. Checking the working time constantly can break your concentration, with Pomodoro Timer you can hear the warnings between each timer. Being both easy and efficient, especially in improving studying and working performance, Pomodoro Timer App is here for you! Stay Focused, Track Your Progress, Improve Every Day Pomodoro Timer is more than just a timer — it’s a productivity companion designed to help you build better habits, reduce distractions, and improve focus through structured work and rest cycles. What’s New in the Latest Version: Brand New Interface: Clean, modern, and more intuitive than ever before. Daily Statistics: Track how many minutes you’ve worked, how many breaks you’ve taken, and how many pomodoro sessions you’ve completed each day. Weekly Productivity Chart: Visualize your weekly performance to stay motivated and consistent. Advanced Settings: Enable or disable sound and notification alerts. Customize timer colors for both work and break periods to personalize your experience. Whether you are a student preparing for exams, a remote worker handling complex projects, or someone trying to build better habits, Pomodoro Timer is the perfect tool to manage your time and energy more effectively. Why Use Pomodoro Timer? Boosts productivity with structured focus intervals Reduces burnout by encouraging regular breaks Increases awareness of how your time is spent Helps fight procrastination by turning large tasks into manageable segments Great for deep work, study sessions, writing, coding, reading, and more Customizable Timer Settings Choose your own durations for work and rest. Whether you prefer the traditional 25/5 split or something that fits your style better, the app adapts to you. Easily adjust your focus and break times, and switch up your settings anytime. Easy to Use, Minimal Distractions The interface is simple and clean, so you can focus on your tasks without unnecessary clutter or distractions. Alerts gently remind you when it’s time to switch between work and break periods — no need to constantly check the clock. Offline & Lightweight No sign-ups, no ads, no internet connection needed. Just install and start focusing right away. Perfect for: Students Remote workers Freelancers Writers Developers Anyone seeking better time management For technical assistance or other inquiries, email: support@bluesailsoftware.com

1439723850.name: 时间规划局 - 倒计时与提醒事项
1439723850.trackName: 时间规划局 - 倒计时与提醒事项
1439723850.description: 时间规划局是一款提醒事项与时间管理的App，它会时刻提醒你珍惜自己的时间，可以精确到秒。支持农历显示，支持分类管理功能，支持自定义小组件背景，支持百分比形式，支持更改百分比的精确度，让您每分每秒都能够看到时间的变化，提醒您珍惜时间。同时支持『CPU面板』，『灵动岛』，『整点报时』，『年龄计算器』，『魔法拼图』，『Live Photo』，『计时器』，『全屏时钟』，『日期计算器』，『二维码生成』等小工具。 它可以帮你制定项目计划、设置会议的提醒、 安排您的行程规划、并让您保持工作专注，还能用于记录备忘事件，帮组您更好的管理时间。 [特色] 内置70多种锁屏小组件和100多种桌面小组件； 完整支持 Apple Watch，界面清爽简洁，提供多种手表复杂功能； 可以精确到秒，时刻提醒您珍惜时间，看得到的时间变化; 支持提醒，通过推送通知提醒您即将到期的事件； 支持动态壁纸； 支持农历选择，不错过每一个农历节日； 可自定义小组件背景，自定义小组件颜色，个性化定义小组件； 支持每天每周每月每年重新计算； 内置多个小工具，包括『CPU面板』，『灵动岛』，『整点报时』，『设备面板』，『年龄计算器』，『魔法拼图』，『Live Photo』，『计时器』，『全屏时钟』，『计步器』，『日期计算器』，『二维码生成』，『节假日』，『To Do List』，『生辰』等多个小工具； 桌面小组件可以自定义背景、字体、字体颜色、透明度和模糊度； 支持事件置顶； 支持事件自动排序； 支持分类管理功能，更好的帮您管理所有事件提醒； 您可为每个事件设置背景，小而美的时间提醒应用； 支持将数据备份到iCloud的功能，再也不用担心数据会丢失； 提供各种炫酷的动画，给您不一样的心情； 可自定义推送通知铃声，让您与众不同； 支持网络搜图，为您提供更加丰富的内容； 全新清新简洁的操作界面，让操作更简洁； 支持百分比形式。 会员功能包括：所有小组件、所有小工具、所有静态壁纸和动态壁纸，100%纯净无广告和数据自动备份功能，并可以享受未来的所有会员功能。 【包月会员说明】 1.订阅周期：1个月 2.订阅价格：每月3元 3.付款：用户确认购买并付款后记入itunes账户 4.取消付款：如需取消续订，请在当前订阅到期24小时以前，手动在iTunes/Apple ID设置管理中关闭自动续订功能 5.续订：苹果iTunes账户会在到期前24小时内扣款，扣款成功后订阅周期顺延一个月 【包年会员说明】 1.订阅周期：1年 2.订阅价格：每年24元 3.付款：用户确认购买并付款后记入itunes账户 4.取消付款：如需取消续订，请在当前订阅到期24小时以前，手动在iTunes/Apple ID设置管理中关闭自动续订功能 5.续订：苹果iTunes账户会在到期前24小时内扣款，扣款成功后订阅周期顺延一年 【永久会员说明】 可无限制永久使用会员功能，所有小组件、所有小工具、所有静态壁纸和动态壁纸，100%纯净无广告和数据自动备份功能，并可以享受未来的所有会员功能。 隐私政策：https://shijianguihuaju.cn/2020/01/01/countdown-law/ 用户协议：https://shijianguihuaju.cn/2020/01/01/countdown-law/

1439731526.name: Soor ▹
1439731526.description: Soor is a beautiful, premium music player for your iPhone & iPad. Features: First feature rich 3rd party Apple Music app. Apple curated content personalised to your listening taste. Play, search, like, share and add songs from across the entire Apple Music catalogue. Intuitive, fully gesture driven user interface. Light, Dark and Black themes. Musixmatch integration. Last.fm auto-scrobbling. Widgets. Magic Mix. Release Alerts. iPad support including split-screen and slide-over. CarPlay support. Requirements: Music app is required to use Soor. App only works with Apple Music or songs you uploaded to Music.app. No other music service is supported. In case you're wondering what Soor means, pronounced Sur (Soar), it's Hindi for melody/note. For F.A.Q. and limitations visit: soor.app/faq If you have any doubts please email: support@soor.app Soor is a 3rd party Music player. Apple, the Apple logo, Apple Music, iPhone are trademarks of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries and regions. Album artworks used in screenshots above are not actual artwork image for the albums due to licensing concerns. Actual artworks in app will be shown correctly.

1439811325.name: Endlesss - Multiplayer Music
1439811325.description: Endlesss is a collaborative music studio with built in drums, synths, fx and much more. Easy to get started for the novice electronic musician with boundless opportunities for the seasoned creative. Quickly layer loops and beats to create ever evolving soundscapes. Intuitive workflow fine-tuned to keep you locked in the groove and express your musical creativity - alone or together with others. Make amazing beats & music alone or together using a unique creative workflow Dive into community jams or create your own jams and invite friends Share your creations in the community and take part in weekly charts Watch, listen and chat with featured artists and the Endlesss community Easily share your creations with the world SIMPLE AND FUN TO PLAY Simple, powerful pads, sounds and FX help you make pro-quality music instantly Create, share and remix loops in seconds - build tracks worth of content in minutes Play a growing library of sound packs & instruments GO DEEP QUICKLY Remix your own and other people's loops with powerful DJ-style performance FX Layer up vocals or real-world instruments using your mic Creatively re-sample your own and others layers with the Sampler instrument CONNECT TO YOUR PRO WORKFLOW Plug in external synths, guitars, vocal mics, drum machines or eurorack Use AUv3 plugins and effects to add your favourite sounds Use Ableton Link to sync up with other apps, DAWs and Link-enabled devices Connect your midi controller for maximum expression FEATURES 8-channel retrospective looper with intuitive interface for making loops of various sizes and optimised for speed and creativity No limit on loops or jams created - create as much as you want alone or together with your friends Multiple high quality synth, bass and drum packs to get you started FX pack with 12 core effects such as reverb, delay, distortion and low/high-pass filters Input from microphone or external instruments AUv3 plugin support with macro mapping and preset saving Extensive key / scale, tempo, time signature and quantisation settings Connect to DAWs and Link-enabled devices Export to movie or to stems for editing and processing outside Endlesss Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: https://endlesss.fm/terms

1439881811.description: Welcome to RadarOmega, the next-generation weather app that keeps you up to date with live, local radar, real-time severe weather alerts, and more. Our high-resolution weather data app operates in the US, Canada, Germany, Australia, and South Korea. RadarOmega provides unique data solutions for all types of weather data, customized to your needs and weather alert preferences. From severe weather to local radar, advanced meteorology technology provides detailed insights for full weather coverage. Track high-resolution radar data, flash flood warnings, excessive rainfall, tornado watches, and more. RadarOmega created an exclusive network of weather stations featuring live video and sensor data called cyclonePORT. RadarOmega and cyclonePORT work closely with universities, emergency managers, broadcast meteorologists, and more to provide solutions for relaying extreme weather information through weather alerts. View weather alerts for wind speeds, precipitation, extreme temperatures, severe weather, hurricanes, and tornadoes seamlessly. Users can subscribe to different packages to access additional data on satellite, MRMS, and models. Explore Alpha, Beta, or Gamma subscriptions to access data from winter to hurricane season. Download today to start viewing your customizable weather alerts. 1439971276.trackName: 晓时 - 知晓世界时间
1439971276.description: 晓时 - 轻松查看世界 7500 多个城市的时间、时区、位置以及日出日落。 支持中文简体、中文繁体以及英文城市名称，支持全球 7500 多个城市的时间显示，轻松对比不同城市的当前时间，并且可以向前以及向后查看需要的时间。 添加到首页的城市支持自定义名称，给关心的人所在的城市加一个“昵称”吧。 显示时间的同时，也显示了城市所在的时区。 添加到首页的城市都会在世界地图上显示，清楚的了解城市所在世界上的位置。 世界地图支持晨昏线的显示，清晰了解地球每个部分的日出日落。

1440259704.name: Airway Gym
1440259704.description: It helps people with breathing difficulties during sleep. Airway Gym is the result of years of research by specialists in this field. First app focused on toning the upper airway muscles. Airway Gym offers you a series of daily exercises to do with your smartphone. You can perform them at anytime you like, as an example you can do some exercises in the morning and do the remaining ones later in the day before going to bed. The App includes: Exercises: The key to recovering your health. Activity: Get to know your daily activity in detail. Progress: Monitor your progress over time with graphs. Queries: You can directly consult your personal trainer using a private chat while maintaining confidentiality of your personal contact numbers. Notifications: If you wish you can receive a notification on your mobile phone to start the exercises at your preferred time. Help: We offer a form within the App by which you can send us your suggestions or questions. The App allows you to be supervised by your personal trainer. You can also keep in touch and communicate with him/her. It does not include one though. A personal trainer can be a rehabilitator, instructor, myofunctional therapist, a physiotherapist, a speech therapist, an otolaryngologist, etc ... usually the same person who treats you. The App is utterly translated to: Spanish English German French Airway Gym is the best solution to both rest and sleep better.

1440468240.name: Car Kit: Racing
1440468240.description: Welcome to Car Kit: Racing. Design and build your own racetrack, add some cars and race them to the checkered flag! BUILD A RACETRACK It's easy to build a racetrack by dragging track squares onto your world. Add straights, corners and a start line. SCENERY Bring your racetrack to life by adding some grandstands for fans, bridges, trees, pitstops and a race control tower. RACE Press the race button and the cars will line up on the grid. After the lights go green they will race over 3 laps to see who takes the checkered flag BECOME A RACE DRIVER Race driver view allows you to take the wheel of one of the race cars and take on your opponents CAR KIT A standalone game based on the much loved Car Kit FEATURES + Snap track tiles together to create different racetracks + Add grandstands full of fans + Add cars to race + Decorate your racetrack with scenery: Bridges, trees, pitstops etc + Press the race button to race your cars, who will win? + Switch to driver view to take to the wheel and beat your opponents REVIEWS FOR CAR KIT "So far my son has spent hours building all sorts of tracks with bridges and tunnels. He likes that you can pick a car and zoom in to drive around, often creating traffic jams. Definitely would recommend." "My 8 year old grandson loves this game and spent a hour of building and rebuilding all sort of wonderful road layouts." "I love these cars and the graphics are fantastic! I love how you can customize your own roads! :D thanks for making this game!!"

1440468366.name: Pitch Shifter AUv3 Plugin
1440468366.description: This is an AUv3 compatible processor friendly stereo pitch shifter plugin which can be used as a plugin with your favourite DAW such as Cubasis, Auria, Meteor or GarageBand. This effect was designed for modifying the pitch of vocals and lead instruments such as lead guitar or keyboard lines. It allows you to pitch shift both left and right channels independently by +/- 12 semitones. We also provide fine detune options for both channels as well as level and balance controls. Please Note: There are some restrictions on this plugin which you need to take into account before purchasing. This plugin only works with sample rates of 44/48KHz and below. As with most real time pitch shifters this effect imposes a 100ms delay due to data processing constraints. This is not so noticeable on vocals or lead instruments but not useful for shifting drums or anything that snaps to a beat. Again this is pretty typical of real-time pitch shifting algorithms. This is one of a suite of AUv3 compatible plugins which will also be available from 4Pockets

1440574221.name: 더 좋은 국어사전 프로
1440574221.description: 주요 특징 >> 1. 국립국어원 정식 라이센싱 2. 최신 DB 내장 3. 하이퍼링크 + 보조검색 4. 사용자 사전 & 검색어 유지 5. 한자 음훈 정보 제공 6. 동음이의어들을 단 한 페이지에 제공 7. 가독성 개선 본 '더 좋은 표준국어대사전 프로'는 광고가 뜨지 않고 내장된 모든 편의 기능을 무제한 사용할 수 있는 국어사전입니다. 1. 국립국어원 정식 라이센싱 ▲ 국내유일 국가 편찬 국어사전 ▲ 연구기간 8년, 연구개발비 112억 = ‘표준국어대사전’의 모바일 앱 사전 공무원수험생_필독 #작가_편집자_기자_PD_사용하는사전 2. 언제나 최신 DB 내장 ▲ 인터넷이 필요 없는 앱 ▲ 1년에 4번 전체 DB 업데이트 (국립국어원 일정에 따름) 인터넷_없이도_잘만돌아감 #인터넷_없어야_일잘됨_공부잘됨 3. 하이퍼링크 + 보조검색 ▲ 관련 어휘가 하이퍼링크로 연결 ▲ 검색창 2개를 함께 사용 가능 드디어_표준국어대사전에_하이퍼링크 #보조검색창_한번쓰면_못끊음 4. 사용자 사전 & 검색어 유지 ▲ 자주 쓰는 온라인 사전들을 등록해 두고 ▲ 검색어는 단 한 번만 입력 사전에도_개취있음 #개취사전_한곳에_몰아놓고_한큐에_검색 5. 한자 음훈 정보 제공 ▲ 한자 7,310자의 음훈 정보 제공 ▲ 한자를 따로 검색하는 수고는 이제 그만 한자애송이_희소식 #사전에_한자정보_조용히_넣어둠 6. 동음이의어들을 단 한 페이지에 제공 ▲ 검색 결과가 아무리 많아도 ▲ 세로 스크롤로 한 번에 확인 페이지번호_수전증_빡침 #엄지족_맞춤서비스 7. 가독성 개선 ▲ 깔끔한 표 형식 ▲ 단순한 색 ▲ 요소 간 간격, 띄어쓰기, 자간 조정 국어사전_정보의집약_눈돌아감 #이뻐야_읽힌다

1440699369.name: 背诵助手 - 中英原文背诵利器

1440806990.name: Diamond Painting Logbook
1440806990.description: Track your diamond painting projects like never before with the completely redesigned Diamond Painting Logbook. Whether you're managing a growing stash or actively working on multiple projects, this app keeps everything organised, detailed, and easy to access—all in one place. Now rebuilt from the ground up, Version 2 introduces powerful new features, improved performance, and cloud syncing to keep your data available across your devices. Keep track of everything that matters: Project size, cost (price, shipping, discount) Drill type (Round, Square, Special) Full or partial coverage Status and lifecycle dates (Ordered, Dispatched, Received, Started, Finished) Where you purchased your kit Artist name and order/tracking numbers Full drill colour lists, including DMC, Diamond Dotz, AB, and Diamond Art Club Custom colours with assignable colours and symbols Take control of your time: Track time spent on each project Start, pause, and stop sessions directly from the project list Manage breaks alongside sessions Add notes to time sessions Get notified if you leave a session or break running View enhanced stats and set custom time ranges Stay organised and efficient: Cloud syncing keeps your data backed up and in sync Faster loading with thumbnail-based image previews Store multiple progress images per project, with notes and a selectable title image Advanced filtering and improved search (including purchase location) Track accessories alongside your projects Assign symbols to project colours for better visual tracking Smarter project management: Updated status system including Completed, Started, Not Started, Not Received, Wish List, On Hold, Gifted, Kitted Up, Sold (Not Completed), and Lost Quickly mark projects as received directly from the detail screen Prevent multiple active sessions at once to avoid tracking errors Visual indicators for active and paused sessions in lists Spin the wheel to pick your next project Connected and convenient: Integration with Piwigo, including upload queue support Open project URLs, tracking links, and FAQs without leaving the app Version 2 also includes a refreshed app icon, expanded stats, improved filtering options, and numerous bug fixes for a smoother experience. Whether you're a casual hobbyist or a dedicated collector, Diamond Painting Logbook helps you stay organised, motivated, and in control of your projects.

1441243948.description: Fluency is a simple, easy to use fluency calculator that quickly and accurately measures syllables per minute and the percentage of syllables stuttered. This tool is great for speech pathologists or parents of children with disfluency. Basic Mode (Portrait): Count syllables and stutters Advanced Mode (Landscape): Specific disfluency counting options (word, sound, and phrase repetition, block, prolongation)

1441249632.name: National Flag
1441249632.description: 探索世界，从一枚国旗开始！ 《National Flag》是一款为地理爱好者、学生及亲子家庭精心设计的全方位国家国旗百科与趣味问答App。无论你是想系统学习世界各国的地理常识，还是想通过挑战赛测试自己的记忆力，这里都能满足你！ 【核心特色功能】 1. **世界国旗大百科**： 收录全球所有国家和地区的高清国旗、国徽及核心地理数据。 包含中英文名称、首都、所属大洲等信息。 快捷检索与大洲筛选，让探索更高效。 2. **趣味猜国家挑战**： 根据随机呈现的国旗，从选项中找出正确的国家名称！ 精美卡片交互，答错即刻显示正确答案与对应国旗，帮助巩固记忆。 3. **趣味猜国旗挑战**： 屏幕给出国家名称，在四个精美的国旗卡片中做出你的选择！ 卡片交互支持展开显示国家详细信息，答题过程更富趣味与沉浸感。 4. **个人专属收藏夹**： 遇到感兴趣或容易记错的国家？一键滑动加入收藏，随时温故知新。 5. **纯净无广告体验**： 专为付费精品应用打造，没有任何弹窗、贴片广告干扰。 极简indigo主题设计，流畅的触觉反馈与微交互，让学习成为享受。 无论是在旅途中、课间休息，还是亲子互动时间，打开《National Flag》，和全世界的旗帜来一场奇妙邂逅吧！

1441335342.name: Ballistic X
1441335342.description: Ballistic-X: The Easiest Way to Calculate Shot Groups and Zero Your Rifle! Designed by shooters, for shooters, Ballistic-X offers a simple, intuitive interface allowing users to customize their experience through the Options Menu. Whether you prefer MOA/MIL or INCH/CM, the app works seamlessly with any target, including Steel. Key Features: Included: Gain access to the core functionality of Ballistic-X with a single purchase. No subscriptions required for full access to essential tools! Sync settings across multiple devices by signing in (optional, not required to use the app). Offers useful data and labeling options that aid in Load Development. The ATZ (Adjustment To Zero) feature helps you precisely adjust your turrets to bring your rifle to zero, saving you rounds and time. ATZ works dynamically at any range and supports all turret options. Simple Workflow: Take an image of your target (within the app or from your library) Designate reference size via Settings (default is 1") Mark two points on the target corresponding to the reference (for grid or steel targets) Input the distance from the target Select the caliber used Mark Point of Aim and Impacts Add overlay, label, crop, and export/share Adjust your optic according to ATZ Upgrade to the Advanced Toolkit (In-App Purchase): Unlock additional pro-level features with the Advanced Toolkit: Advanced Overlay Display Options: Mean Radius Circular Error Probable (CEP) Radial Standard Deviation (SD) Vertical SD Horizontal SD Mean Windage Mean Elevation Impact Selector Export to CSV for further data analysis Ballistic-X is a community-driven app, committed to providing the best user experience possible, along with unbeatable customer service. Join the Ballistic-X community today and elevate your shooting precision! Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://www.ballistic-x.com/privacy.html

1441342412.name: Scan Cards
1441342412.description: ScanCards App allows you to make a magic trick that gives the illusion of turning your smartphone into a card game analyzer, filling in data that seem impossible to obtain normally: A deck of cards is mixed and handed out to a spectator who is asked, out of sight (under the table) to cut the deck as much as he wants. Then the spectator will have to take three cards, one after the other, from the top or at the bottom of the deck and put them back UPSIDE DOWN in various places in the package. The deck of cards is then placed back in its case, and the smartphone is placed on its case. A "scan" button is visible on the screen. After clicking on a scanning animation appears and, 5 seconds later, the button "results" appears in turn. The screen displays the following sentence "There has three cards face down. " Then on the next screen we discover three cards, and it turns out that the three cards match those that were put face up. The magician offers to renew the experience by mixing the game so as to get cards with their faces up and cards with their faces down. The viewer does it by random cuts and then mixes the deck to get faces up and faces down. The result is an absolute chaos of cards, some with their faces up others with their faces down. The same smartphone is placed on the deck of cards. The "scan" and "results" buttons are pressed in turns and we discover a first sentence on the screen: "There are 19 cards face down". We check the cards whose faces are down and it matches. Another click on the screen will show a new sentence: "There are 9 black cards". We check and indeed it is the case. With again another click, a new sentence will show up: "All the red cards are number cards" We check and we realize that there are only cards with numbers, apart from a face who is the queen of hearts. Then, one last final,click on the screen will display"Except the queen of hearts". with the version 2 you can count the card in the hand of the spectator and read in the brain with your smartphone End of the card trick !

1441943960.name: 马来西亚语
1441943960.description: 让我们学习马来语! LET'S LEARN THE MALAY LANGUAGE! 这款APP帮助您迅速掌握马来话的语音特点! THIS APP BREAKS THEM DOWN STROKE BY STROKE ! 旋转轮 - 运用拇指很自然! SPIN THE WHEEL TO EXPLORE It's so easy and natural. 收藏夹 - 可以收藏自己喜欢的单词 ADD TO FAVORITES Save the word you like for the future use. 真人发音 REAL HUMAN VOICE Including the alphabet, words. 英文释意 ENGLISH MEANINGS All of the words have their meanings in English. 马来西亚文化简介 MALAY ARTS & CULTURE Malay cuisine and culture illustrations. 离线独立APP - 无需互联网 OFF-LINE INDEPENDENT Once downloaded, you don't need internet to use the app. All audios and pictures are integrated within. You can select the word in alphabetical order (English meanings) by clicking “words” in the menu bar. Basic everyday Malay words! Click on the "alphabet" button in the menu bar, you can get the consonants and vowels. They are explained one by one. There are over 290 million people who speak Malay. It is a major language spoken in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore. Malay is not a tonal language, does not distinguish gender (he/she/it), does not have grammatical tense (go/went/gone), It is now written using the Latin script, although an Arabic script also exists. The banknotes of Indonesia, Malaysia, Brunei and Singapore have the Malay script. Malay is the official language in these four countries. 马来语主要使用于马来西亚以及文莱、新加坡、印尼苏门达腊岛的部分地区等。马来语是马来西亚、新加坡和文莱的国语，并在4个东南亚国家或地区拥有官方语言地位。这四个国家的货币上均有马来文。 在马来西亚，大概有1,300万人是以马来语为母语，约占全国人口的55%。此外，在马来西亚还有1,000万人是以马来语作为他们的第二语言。至于在其他国家，印尼的苏门达腊也有1,000万的马来语使用人口，泰国有100万，新加坡则有40万人左右。

1442509969.name: 醒目视力表
1442509969.description: 醒目视力表是一款由专业人士设计的视力检查应用，帮助您轻松、准确地为 6 岁及以上儿童进行视力检测、记录并长期追踪视力变化。无论您是家长在家中关注孩子的视力状况，还是医疗专业人员在临床或常规筛查中使用，本应用都能提供便捷支持。及早发现近视有助于及时采取预防措施，尽早寻求医疗建议，避免假性近视发展为近视，或防止近视程度进一步加深。 为减少测试差异而设计 与可能因褪色、变形或长期使用而被记忆的纸质视力表不同，Eye Charts 提供光学精度准确的视标，并在每次测试时随机呈现。这有助于在家庭、学校、诊所或远程医疗环境中进行重复测试时，获得更有意义的结果。 支持的视力表包括： Snellen ETDRS Landolt C 翻转 E（Tumbling E） HOTV 数字 图形 所有视力表均采用 LogMAR 比例进行行间字母大小缩放，并支持多种视力记录方式，包括：分数制、LogMAR、MAR、小数制和 VAS。 灵活的测试距离设置，使其可在小房间、走廊或临时空间中准确使用。 醒目视力表显示于 iOS 和 Android 设备，自发光显示不受室内照明或天气条件影响。屏幕亮度可调，并可根据需要设置，以适应如 6 米等较长测试距离。 使用场景： 1. 医生与患者。 2. 使用镜子进行自测——站在镜子前，开启应用的镜像模式，并遮盖一只眼睛进行测试。有效测试距离为您与镜子之间距离的两倍。 3. 使用蓝牙键盘进行自测——将设备放置在几米外的桌面上，通过键盘方向键指示您能够辨认的内容。 关注趋势，而不仅是单次结果 测试结果可按个体进行记录，并通过简洁的折线图按时间进行可视化，便于识别： 视力的逐渐变化 干预后的稳定情况 这种纵向观察方式，对于家长长期监测儿童视力以及临床人员在多次随访中追踪变化都具有参考价值。 经独立评估的准确性 醒目视力表早前以 “Visual Acuity Charts” 为名发布，并在一项经同行评审的学术研究中接受了独立评估。该研究发表于《JAMA Ophthalmology》，并可通过 PubMed Central（https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7809609/）查阅。研究人员通过实际测量不同设备上的视标尺寸，对多款基于 iPhone 的视力测试应用进行了客观比较。在该对比中，Visual Acuity Charts 表现出最低的测量误差，在所评估的应用中具有较高的准确性。 近视的发现通常涉及多个步骤，其中远距离视力测试往往是第一步。视力下降可能提示近视的开始，从而为及早采取干预措施提供依据。 免责声明： 虽然本应用可在一定程度上替代纸质视力表，但不能替代医生或验光师进行的全面眼科检查，这些检查对于维护眼部健康十分重要。本应用不用于检测斜视、内斜视、外斜视、远视或散光等常见早期视力问题。请定期咨询验光师，如出现视力异常的早期迹象，请及时寻求专业医疗建议。

1442674298.description: Looking for help or the latest tips for the game Terraria? This all-in-one solution is exactly what you need: everything for the good game and improving your gaming skills. This app will be useful for both novice and experienced players. No ads! Does not require an internet connection to use, so that any relevant information is always available to you. This app is unofficial. ● Features: Achievements Biomes Crafting Enemies Guides IDs Items Mechanics NPCs Recipes Trophies Walkthrough Favorites Filters iPad & iPhone supported Search Works offline Enemies, items and etc. Full info for each enemy, item and etc.: stats, recipe, ingredients, etc. Guides Tons of useful and nice guides that will be useful for both novice and experienced players. Works offline The app does not require internet connection, meaning you can use it when you want. 1442926006.description: MiniTube player is a simple video player based on YouTube™ links, you can run videos, and playlists. The Goal of this application is to show you the video as Picture-in-Picture style just like Opera™ and Safari™ browsers, but with some added features such as: the mini-player is flying away from mouse cursor, also you can control the transparency of the player so you can read what is hidden behind it. AAQSoft team

1443085255.name: 经典计算机 - 真人语音计算器

1443517364.name: Daily Sales Pro - 进销存生意，库存管理软件
1443517364.trackName: Daily Sales Pro - 进销存生意，库存管理软件
1443517364.description: DailySalesPro（进销存库存管理）是一款易于使用的进出货库存管理和业务记账工具，让您及时了解库存状况、销售收入、采购与销售成本、销售利润，以提升资金使用效率，使您能快速应对市场变化。 适用于批发商，零售商、微商代购、店家，卖场等产品进出货买卖人。 主要功能: iCloud同步与备份功能，可以在其他设备共享数据。 将您的产品库存，生成PDF报告导出。 1个订单可以添加多件商品，并累计总金额、销售成本。 库存预警，保持库存安全。 您可以设置产品最高的库存与最低的库存。 自定义 商品父类别（添加、编辑、修改）。 自定义 商品子类别(包括分类、名称、规格、计量单位、 商品编号、备注、日期、采购价格、销售价格、库存预警、最大库存、图片等属性)。  商品子类别与 商品父类别关联，可以快速查找到不同分类的 商品。  商品编号格式可以根据您的 需要定制。 自定义供应商（添加、编辑、修改）。 自定义客户（添加、编辑、修改）。 随时查看供应商 & 客户关联的所有订单，可以通过两个日期过滤订单记录，并做出相应的小计、折扣、总金额等统计。 业务收入与业务支出管理。 自定义收入类别与支出类别（添加、编辑、修改）。 自定义资金账户，自动统计每个账户的总收入、总支出、总余额。 随时查看每个账户关联的交易历史记录，可以选择两个日期范围内的交易数据导出。 采购与销售订单 管理（添加、编辑、修改）。 添加订单时，如果商品库存数量低于库存预警，系统将会提醒您。 采购与销售订单对应多件商品，每个订单可以一次性添加多件商品，订单中的商品可以修改或从订单中删除。 每个订单可以添加折扣金额，也可以添加备注。 每个订单可以添加标题与订单编号，订单编号格式可以根据您的需要定制。 统计包括: 利润统计、业务收入、业务支出、销售收入、销售成本、销售利润、净利润、产品库存、销售总金额、采购总金额、折扣总金额等。 支持手动记账与自动记账功能！自动记账很实用，不需要记录收入与支出条目，节省您的时间。  支持条件搜索，快速搜寻商品、订单、 账户、规格、类别、交易记录，供应商，客户等。 可以按日期(全部、今天、本周、本月、本年、自定义日期)查看所有项目的历史记录。 可以按日期(全部，自定义日期) 导出不同项目的CSV数据。 密码保护个人数据(可以添加、修改、验证)。 系统预先设定的商品，分类，规格，单位， 账户与 付款成员可供快速选取使用。 允许输入的金额保留后两位小数点(例如: 19.99, 188.88)。 自定义商品编号格式(例如: ABC_001, Product001)。 自定义订单号格式(例如: ABC20181013001, Order_20181013_001)。 支持鼠标右键菜单点击排序: 按名称降序与升序 按日期降序与升序 按金额降序与升序 订单页面根据自定义日期排序  多种统计 1, 销售 & 采购的统计 2, 供应商 & 客户的订单统计 3,  类别的收入 & 支出统计 4,  账户的收入 & 支出统计 5, 商品库存 & 利润的统计 6, 账户销售&采购统计 如果您对使用上有任何的问题，可以通过App中的电子邮件联系我们，我们一定会更好的服务您。

1443533088.name: 搜韵

1443682940.name: Gap Click by Benny Greb
1443682940.description: Benny Greb, well known for his contributions to the drumming education community, shared the approach he has taken to develop his sense of groove and improve his timing on his instrument in his course "The Art and Science of Groove." Now with the Gap Click app, everyone can practice his method easily using this intuitive app! Unlike standard metronomes, which only provide time, Gap Click helps you improve your sense of time. Gap Click is more than a metronome that focuses on improving your ability to keep tempo, become more aware and comfortable with off-beat clicks, and become bulletproof and accurate with all notes of the subdivision. GAP CLICK By scrolling through the numbers of bars and patterns, you can quickly configure a "gap" of time in which the metronome drops out. When the "one" comes back around, will your playing still be in time? How long of a gap can you play through and still maintain a solid tempo? MOVING CLICK Next, you can experiment with all kinds of off-beat patterns in the Gap Bar, which moves the click from the downbeat position to a different location. Can you still play your instrument and maintain the downbeat internally even when you hear the click sound on an off-beat? Both the "click" and the "gap" portion supports various syncopated patterns, allowing you to practice in binary or ternary rhythms - with more or less safety depending on your settings. Features Ability to choose from various syncopated patterns and the number of measures for both the standard "click" and the "gap." Use the nostalgic click wheel to find the right tempo or tap to set your desired tempo from 10 to 300bpm Standard quarter-note time signatures: 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4, 6/4, 7/4 Support for VoiceOver ensures Gap Click is fully accessible to users with visual impairments Personalize See visual feedback for each note or rest that the metronome plays Accent beat 1 of each measure or turn accents off for a more significant challenge Flash the screen for a visual indication when switching between the "click" and the "gap" sections Find your favorite sound from a variety of click samples hand-picked by Benny Buy Once, Use Forever There are no In-App Purchases - a one-time purchase includes all current and future features. TESTIMONIALS What professionals are saying about GAP CLICK: "The skills you can sharpen by using this app are integral for what it takes to be a professional drummer in any genre." - Matt Halpern "When I first opened the app, it made (simple) sense, without a tutorial." - Chris Coleman "This app helps you lock in the pocket on a whole different level." - Luke Holland "The Gap Click app is something that every drummer should have in their toolbox." - Jared Falk, Drumeo What our users are saying about GAP CLICK: "If you think you have good timing, this will really put you in your place." "Gone are the days of programming gap clicks!" "I've never had so much fun being destroyed in my practice session." "This is by far the best money I've ever spent on a practice tool." ABOUT BENNY GREB Benny Greb is one of the most respected drummers in the world today. Not only has he headlined nearly every major drum festival and toured with his clinics and drum camps worldwide, but he is also recognized as a composer and bandleader in his band Moving Parts, which won him the renowned "ECHO Jazz" award - the German equivalent to The Grammys in jazz. Benny Greb published two of the most successful and critically acclaimed educational products, "The Language of Drumming" and "The Art and Science of Groove," He has helped create many signature products available to drummers today. Find him online at https://www.bennygreb.de as well as on social media.

1444256109.name: APD Colony Counter App PRO
1444256109.description: Colony counter app can analyze agar plate images and count them automatically. With access to the phone storage, and also directly to the camera, fast and convenient colony counting can be done. With advanced image processing methodology, even partially overlapping colonies can be detected. With an automated colony detection with customized tagging, users can easily add or remove tags. No need to manually count colonies or spend thousands to buy an equipment. Everything can be done now in your smartphone. Photos should be taken on a direct plane with the agar plate. Features of this app includes: 1) Automated colony detection 2) Adjustable image processing for users to optimize detection. 3) Advanced imaging filters: Thresholding. 4) Customized user input if necessary. 5) Saving of settings for image processing for future convenience. 6) Simple and button based user interface. 7) Compatibility with landscape and portrait view of multiple sized tablets and smartphones. 8) Compatibility with screenshot functions of analyzed images for publications or reports. 9) Tags in image can be customized for color and size. 10) Cropping function for images prior to analysis. 11) Edit function to remove or add tags. 12) Simple direct access to phone camera. 13) Simple direct access to local image. Benefits of using this app for publications 1) Brings greater accuracy to your colony counts. 2) Value adds to publications and reports. 3) Useful teaching tool to science students. 4) Streamlined analysis, reducing human error and subjectivity - you can now trust the values reported by trainees and less experienced staff! 5) On the go analysis with the smartphone/tablet. 6) Automated analysis - no need for bulky equipment 7) The app costs less than the cheapest colony counter! 8) The app is self-contained, no internet access needed.

1444541381.name: 屏拍 _ 减轻拍摄液晶屏幕时发生的条条纹纹
1444541381.trackName: 屏拍 _ 减轻拍摄液晶屏幕时发生的条条纹纹
1444541381.description: 想必很多朋友在拍摄屏幕类物体的时候，诸如电视、显示器、手机屏、平板电脑屏幕等等，都会有这样的困扰： 明明看着非常清晰的屏幕，但用相机拍摄出来以后照片上竟显示出一圈圈一条条的波纹，影响屏幕的色彩及清晰度之余，还显得非常不美观。 这种在拍摄过程中所出现的波纹，学名叫做摩尔纹。 摩尔纹其实是电磁波的叠加所产生的一种现象，实际上也就是不同电磁波之间发生了波形干涉现象。 屏幕拍摄不可少，摩尔纹却无处不在，而我们又不能阻止电磁波的出现，这似乎是一个非常矛盾而又令人纠结的事情。 此时我们发出感叹，究竟如何是好？大家是不是觉得摩尔纹就像是洪水猛兽，躲都躲不掉呢？ 我们当然不能抱以这种悲观的心态，因为问题的出现就是为了让我们去解决。 于是“屏拍”相机，作为摩尔纹的克星横空问世了。 使用方法： 在相机页面点击想要聚焦的地方。 左右移动快门按钮上部的滑轮，来减轻摩尔纹。 按下快门。 聚焦与曝光分离功能： 点击聚焦框右下的“+”按钮，可以分离聚焦和曝光的图像，能够独立地进行聚焦和曝光的调整。 设置功能： 防止摩尔纹： 在相等距离下，保持调整过的滑轮值。 经典相机： 自动调焦自动调整曝光值，或聚焦在点击点，并以点击点的亮度调整曝光。 快速预览照片： 拍摄后即刻显示照片预览。 照片手指缩放： 可以用两根手指扩大或缩小拍摄对象。 低光自动调亮： 在黑暗处可以拍摄比通常更明亮的照片。

1444541962.description: 让我们学习菲律宾语! LET'S LEARN THE TAGALOG LANGUAGE! 这款APP帮助您迅速掌握菲律宾语的语音特点! THIS APP BREAKS THEM DOWN STROKE BY STROKE ! 旋转轮 - 运用拇指很自然! SPIN THE WHEEL TO EXPLORE It's so easy and natural. 收藏夹 - 可以收藏自己喜欢的单词 ADD TO FAVORITES Save the word you like for the future use. 真人发音 标注了简便音标，清晰准确。 REAL HUMAN VOICE Including the alphabet, words. 英文释义 ENGLISH MEANINGS All of the words have their meanings in English. 菲律宾文化简介 FILIPINO ARTS & CULTURE Cuisine and culture illustrations. 离线独立APP - 无需互联网 OFF-LINE INDEPENDENT Once downloaded, you don't need internet to use the app. All audios and pictures are integrated within. You can select the word in alphabetical order (English meanings) by clicking “words” in the menu bar. Basic everyday Tagalog words! Click on the "alphabet" button in the menu bar, you can get the consonants and vowels. There are over 70 million people who speak Tagalog as their first or second language. Its standardized form is called Filipino, one of two official languages of the Philippines. English is the other one. Why to learn Tagalog? Learn something new Communicate with native Filipinos Travel to the Philippines Experience all kinds of water activities ( swimming with whale sharks). Navigate the subteranean river, one of the new Seven Wonders of Nature. Discover the world's most diverse coral reefs Invest in one of the world's fastest growing economies Work in the Philippines Live in the Philippines Eat all the tropical fruits your heart desires Taste rice of different colors Retire in the Philippines where you can have $5 massages everyday. Learning Tagalog will bring you closer to a world full of beauty! 菲律宾语又称塔加洛语、他加洛语或他加禄语，在语言分类上属于南岛语系，主要被使用于菲律宾，也广泛运用于马来西亚沙巴州、印度尼西亚北部地区和新加坡。菲律宾宪法于1987年定其为国语。在菲律宾将近170种的本土语言中，菲律宾语是唯一具有官方语言地位的一个语言。在总数为7633余万的菲律宾人当中，有2148余万是以菲律宾语作为母语的。此外，还有将近5000万的人民，把菲律宾语作为第二语言。

1444555016.name: PDF Projector
1444555016.description: Projects PDF slideshows onto an external screen. If you have an Apple Watch, you can also use it as a remote control. This app is useful if you write presentations using LaTeX Beamer, or LibreOffice Impress, or some other application that exports to PDF. Simply open your PDF in the app and connect an external display (e.g., via VGA, HDMI, USB-C, or AirPlay). Your slides will be displayed full-screen on the external display, while the app provides additional navigation controls on your iPad or iPhone. You can navigate on your iPad or iPhone by tapping and swiping, or using the buttons on the toolbar, or scrolling through the thumbnails, or using an external keyboard. When in landscape mode, you will also see a preview of the next page (which you can turn on/off using the button on the upper toolbar). You can browse and open any of your iCloud documents, or you can share PDFs from your favourite app to open in PDF Projector. WATCH REMOTE: If you have an Apple Watch, you can use this as a remote control. Simply open a PDF document in the iPhone app and connect it to an external display, and then start the Watch app to use the remote control. If you talk a lot between slides, try adding the "Next Page" complication to your clock face (requires watchOS 7). This will let you step through the slides without having to keep reopening the app. You can also configure Settings / General / Wake Screen (on any watchOS version) to keep the app on screen for longer while you present your talk.

1444555016.summaryDescription: Projects PDF slideshows onto an external screen. If you have an Apple Watch, you can also use it as a remote control. This app is useful if you write presentations using LaTeX Beamer, or LibreOffice Impress, or some other application that exports to PDF. Simply open your PDF in the app and connect an external display (e.g., via VGA, HDMI, USB-C, or AirPlay). Your slides will be displayed full-screen on the external display, while the app provides additional navigation controls on your iPad or iPhone. You can navigate on your iPad or iPhone by tapping and swiping, or using the buttons on the toolbar, or scrolling through the thumbnails, or using an external keyboard. When in landscape mode, you will also see a preview of the next page (which you can turn on/off using the button on the upper toolbar). You can browse and open any of your iCloud documents, or you can share PDFs from your favourite app to open in PDF Projector. This will let you step through the slides without having to keep reopening the app. You can also configure Settings / General / Wake Screen (on any watchOS version) to keep the app on screen for longer while you present your talk.

Or if you want to add stunning date and time stamp on photos stored in phone gallery, you can customize that too by simply choosing the best template from our application. What makes this app different? You can add ‘Today’s Date (Current Date and Time)’ or the DateTime when that picture was captured! Get a bunch of mind-boggling templates. Set of ‘Stamp Colors’ to make your pictures more stunning! It furnishes a facility to watermark your pictures at the moment. With this date time stamper app, bring your photos to life and don’t just let that valuable moment go with time. You can also create your own DateTime pics colors by combining others! ii) Stamp Position Don't let the watermark settle at the same place! Top Bottom iii) Templates With the above features, here is the special one which shall do a makeover when you add date stamp to photos. A) Custom Time Format Yeah, you’ve heard it right! Now, in this timestamp camera app, you can pick a time format as the way that you want and add time stamp on photos. 12 hours format 24 hours format B) Custom Date Format Select the format for the date stamp on photo: dd/mm/yyyy mm/dd/yyyy yyyy/mm/dd How to use this date and time stamp app? 1) Once you get this ‘Photo Stamper’ app into your mobile, you’ll see the home screen. 2) Select the appropriate ‘Font Color & Font Position for timestamp’. 3) You will find all the features mentioned above where you’ll be able to set toggle for ‘App Name Watermark’ or ‘Date and Time Format’! 4) Click on the ‘Stamp Template’ option and choose the one which you like the most! 5) Do you want to DateTime pics that you capture? Then click on the ‘Camera’ icon otherwise you can select the image from your ‘Phone Gallery’! That’s easy as pie! Isn’t it? So, install Moment Stamp application and start adding a Date Time stamp on photos NOW! And see the stunning difference between the images you capture simply and those images which you capture with our customized date stamp camera. Would you like to see how your pictures will look? 1444818142.name: Map Chart Mosaic
1444818142.description: Offline maps for iPhone, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Garmin or Amazfit smartwatch: topographic maps, satellite images, GRIB weather forecast maps and road maps with cycle and hiking trails. Nautical charts are currently only for USA and Canada available. Please watch the video and read the FAQ: http://www.MapChartMosaic.com/ Switch seamlessly between maps from different sources to get detailed information about a location. Map views are automatically stored in an offline cache on your phone, so that you can view them later without an internet connection. Download offline maps to Apple Watch or Fitbit smart watch and view them without connection to your phone. Add map markers and travel routes to the offline maps (e.g. your current car parking location). Create map travel routes. Record your GPS Track. Share map marker, route and track data as GPX files. Get GPS travel info: speed, course, odometer, route ETA (estimated time of arrival)... Get GRIB weather forecast maps via Internet download, Email or Iridium Go satellite connection. You can display the maps also on the Fitbit smart watch. But please don't expect the same maps app performance on the Fitbit as on a phone. The Fitbit is very slow and has very limited space. The Fitbit phone app "Sync" step, shown in the video, is very important. Don't skip it and make sure that the watch app Map Chart is closed during the Sync. DISCLAIMER Do NOT use the app for navigation or any other purpose that may result in personal injury or property damage. Use it at your own risk.

1445294581.name: HintApp - Cue Cards & Notes
1445294581.description: Prepare your speech or presentation in advance! Hintapp is an app for creating text cards for your speech. It could be a speech for your friends, presentation at work or at school. Create speech notes on your Mac, iPhone or iPad. You can save your notes in iCloud. Then use your cue cards during the presentation on your iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad or Mac. You can create cards in different colours. Monitor timer during the speech to be on time. Simple and elegant UI will help you focus on the presentation. Check app settings (iOS Settings -> Hintapp) to adjust Hintapp for your needs. Write the whole speech as a set of small cards and use it like a teleprompter. Or write just short hints to help you focus on most important ideas. Hintapp will help you create perfect cue cards: Apple Watch support Desktop app for macOS iCloud storage support Export/import to/from file Large contrast font makes it easy to read text from a distance Edit cards on iPhone, iPad or Mac Easy gesture control Minimalistic design Timer to help you keep track of time Coloured cards You can enable web links and text selection in presentation mode (turn it on in the iOS settings for the app) Dark mode support
