1471797248.name: 华夏万象 - 领略神州大地
1471797248.trackName: 华夏万象 - 领略神州大地
1471797248.description: 入围 App Store 2019 年度优秀 App 盘点 App Store 首页多次推荐 「AppSo」、「少数派」重点推荐 「华夏万象」App 是一款介绍中国各省份历史、地理、文化等方面的教育科普类应用，通过精美的图片和生动的文字，图文并茂地向观众展现充满魅力的华夏大地。除此之外，每一个省份的结尾还有精美的摄影图集作为补充，可以领略各地的名胜风光以及人文风情，并且所有图片供个人免费下载使用。 人都说，读万卷书和行万里路应该相辅相成。作为一个喜欢历史，喜欢名山大川和各地的人文风情的年轻人，不满足于只停留在书面上，有一种力量驱使我的脚步，引领我亲身前往这些熟悉又陌生的地方看一看。我花了近一年半的时间走遍了中国，在这期间上溯祖国山川河流，下访各地百姓生活。跳脱出书本让我对自己的国家有了更加深刻的认识，了解得越深，就愈发喜爱这片土地上留下的东西。 然而一直以来，都没有一个系统性介绍中国各地地理、人文、历史的 App，即使已经有了不少优秀的文章，但不是因为过于分散沉没于浩瀚的互联网中，就是篇幅过长或枯燥乏味让人无力下咽。为了唤起人们对自己生活的这片土地的热爱，我决定开发这款应用。 诚然，一款小小的应用不足以承载中华大地几千年积淀而成的文化底蕴的庞大体量，App 中也只能尽可能多地展现具有代表性的事物，做到抛砖引玉，点到为止。若能唤起人们热爱自然、探寻历史、传承优良习俗的意识，并为之付诸行动，便算是达到了这款应用本来的目的，这样也就足够了。 希望这款 App 能唤起人们对中华优良传统文化的重视以及对大自然的热爱。走进大自然，走进传统文化，对自己生活的这片土地有更加深刻的认识。

1471848710.name: 元素周期表 - 化学 2026

1471873887.description: Check all forms of 9,100+ Hebrew words in a fast and straightforward mobile tool: verb conjugation tables and forms of nouns, adjectives, numerals, prepositions, etc. Ad-free. 1472069819.name: Aquarium Timelapse
1472069819.description: Fact: Corals don't grow before your eyes. Frankly, nothing in our aquarium grows that fast except for our chaeto... because you bought one of those fancy refugium lights after a BRStv binge that you're still trying to justify the cost... #allmymoneygoestochaeto By the maker of the Aquarium Camera App. Tested by over 250 reef aquarists on the Reef2Reef forums! Telling others about the new frags you bought from World Wide Corals (who graciously supplied the screenshots for this app) and how nicely they have started encrusting since you started that zeovit system is great, but what if you could SHOW them how fast they were growing? That's what this app is all about: Proving how your maintenance is helping spur better growth, getting your likes up on your social media channels, owning your next aquarium club meetup, and having the coolest plant and coral growth log of all time!! Start by taking pictures of your corals, plants, snails, crabs, starfish, and full sections of your tank. Every few days take another picture using the same orientation. I've created an easy to use the overlay tool to line up your shot from the previous photo. Once you have enough photos, hit play and watch your plants and corals grow before your eyes! When it's time to post progress, with a touch of a button a time-lapse video will be created for you to save to your device library and to share on your favorite aquarium social media channels. Features Create any number of aquarium photo collections Easily add new photos over time using the in-app camera Show/Hide an overlay of your last photo so that each new photo lines up precisely with the last one you took Add and toggle targets on the images to line up your shot perfect every time Toggle text overlays for the date each photo was taken Toggle slide order to keep track of looping shots Easily export videos to your device library at different frame rates and qualities Easily share square videos to your social media channels All photos automatically get placed in an album on your device Thanks for checking out this app! Proceeds for these apps go back into making more apps we all wish we had to help maintain our tanks. I'd love your feedback if you have time to go to our website and fill out the form, as I continue to support this and my other apps for aquarium lovers into the foreseeable future.

1472787544.name: 钟琴
1472787544.description: 编钟是中国古代重要的打击乐器有近两千年的历史，为了便于演奏选出11个音色（C调），可采用挂式敲击或11音钢舌鼓两种演奏模式。 所有虚拟乐器均可在GarageBand（库乐队）或Logic pro等mac宿主软件里当作“真实乐器及软音源”使用。 通过Lightning或音频线连接mac电脑，使用Lightning连接请在“音频midi设置”里选择启用设备。 在宿主软件中选择轨道类型为“音频—使用麦克风或线路输入录音” 打开监听按钮，调整合适音量 到此就可以把虚拟乐器作为软音源使用。

1473063860.name: Condukt: MIDI Controller
1473063860.description: Turn your iPhone, iPad or Mac into a customizable MIDI controller. Plug in your synth, pick parameters by name, and start playing in seconds. Condukt connects to any class-compliant USB MIDI device. No adapters. No manual CC programming. Just plug in and go. PLUG AND PLAY Connect your synth via USB-C. Condukt recognizes it instantly. Pick parameters from a list, filter cutoff, oscillator pitch, envelope attack, and you're controlling it. No more digging through manuals for CC numbers. RUNS IN YOUR AUv3 HOST (NEW) Load Condukt as an Audio Unit inside AUM, Loopy Pro, Logic Pro for iPad, Cubasis or Drambo. It follows host transport and tempo, so every sequencer starts on the host's downbeat. Run as many instances as you like, each with its own board, clock and patch cables, and your host project saves and restores all of it. SEVEN SEQUENCERS Conduktor, Phrase, Drum, Arpeggiator, Turing Machine, Cartesian and Painter. Draw chords with a finger or Pencil, program a XOX drum grid with polyrhythmic track pages, or let a Turing Machine find the pattern for you. One clock runs them all. POWERED BY midi.guide Condukt uses the midi.guide open-source database with MIDI definitions for hundreds of synths, drum machines, and effects. Community-maintained and constantly growing. BUILD YOUR OWN BOARDS Create custom control surfaces tailored to your workflow. Sequencers, faders, crossfaders, recall buttons: arrange them however you want. Save multiple boards for different setups. DO WHAT YOUR HARDWARE CAN'T Add multiple LFOs to synths that only have one Shape any parameter with the new Step Modulator Control the same parameter across multiple tracks with a single fader Instant snapshot recall for live performance Sophisticated generative sequencers MULTI-DEVICE CONTROL One board can control multiple synths simultaneously. A single "Filter" fader can adjust cutoff on your Minifreak, Digitakt, and Moog at the same time. PERFORMANCE LAYOUTS Switch between layouts on the fly. Page 1 for sound design. 1473078157.trackName: 文字卡片 - 人人都是生活艺术家
1473078157.description: ■「最美应用」「Price Tag」等媒体推荐 ■ 支持简体中文、繁体中文、英文、日文等多个国家语言版本 ■ 制定专属于你的卡片 基本功能简介： 文字 多达44款字体供你使用。 卡片样式 5种基本样式+6种专业模板任你挑选。 多种卡片比例任你调节。 图片 可调节图片形状、亮度、比例、透明度、边距等多种调整细节。 拥有海量无版权素材库，免去你无图可用的烦恼。 背景 不仅可用纯色样式，还可以使用图片做背景。 并多达6种背景样式调整方案。 专业 专业模板下，你可自由调整图片位置和单个图片样式，并拥有以上所有功能。 让你的卡片多样起来，制定专属于你的卡片 官方联系方式 QQ群：271478684 微博：文字卡片App 欢迎你们联系，反馈与建议，让「文字卡片」越发成熟起来。 我是一个刚出生不久的孩子 时常喜欢一个人呆呆地望着窗外 听风声 听雨声 听鸟鸣 听大自然的喘息 品大自然的艺术 渐渐地 两周过后 我变得成熟 变得有趣 我把艺术当作生命中的一部分 于是我更加喜欢窗外的瞬息万变 一次偶然的机会 我终于能够走出窗外 离开这一席之地 寻找我真正的归处 不知不觉 我早已成为这个大自然的一部分 我热爱着 眷恋着 门口苹果树上的果子熟了 我爬上去看了看 于是，2019 年 8 月 3 日，苹果应用商店 App Store 又多了一个鲜活的果子，那就是我，我叫 『文字卡片』。 『文字卡片』可以将文字记录在不同样式的图片或贴纸上，产生一种独特的艺术效果。 「这里是你的卡片编辑器 请查收」---------- 树上有只虫子 我们成为了朋友 你有一段文字，想用图片把它们装饰成明信片； 你喜欢写诗； 你想要把一段很喜欢的文字分享给我； 你希望用一些文字记录自己的心情和状态； 你说你一直在寻找， 我说「我正是」。 「文字卡片 记录心情和故事」---------- 我怀着满腔热血， 倾听着你的任何快乐或悲伤， 无论你记录什么， 是一句话，或是很长的倾诉， 我都能胜任，我都能容纳它们， 成为你回忆的故事。 「为你打造」---------- 我闯荡于窗外 且享受于窗外 我生为艺术 且逝为艺术 我 为你而生 我 为你打造 我是『文字卡片』，一个为你打造的卡片编辑器，我拥有别致出色的用户体验，和全新的分享方式。 希望你能喜欢我。

1473122747.description: AUDIO AND TEXT based app to learn ultrasound - Intended only for use by individuals who are qualified in the use of medical ultrasound or are students of medical ultrasound. Ultrasound examination with cases, images of pathological manifestation, ultrasound report and conclusive finding. It gives guide on how to write the ultrasound report, commenting on the pathological finding, and conclusive finding of the ultrasound images. App's Features : 1. Ultrasound guide in audio form. Ability to mark as favorite, repeat, shuffle and more. 2. Ultrasound examination cases with images 3. Ultrasound quiz (It is short and sweet, out of 10-Marks. Check your result at the end of the quiz). 4. Fetal Ultrasound Image Gallery. Collection of prenatal ultrasound images. Use the arrows to click through the image gallery. It includes transvaginal ultrasound images and fetal echocardiogram images. Fetal imaging is referred to by many names, including pregnancy sonograms, pregnancy ultrasound, endovaginal ultrasound, obstetric ultrasound, OB ultrasound, baby ultrasound, prenatal ultrasound. 1473129606.name: Farhaven AR
1473129606.description: Join the adventure of a lifetime with four friends from the land of Farhaven! Ruka, Diso, Oops, and Muun need your smarts, muscle, inventory, and a little magic to bring back peace and unity to their world and ours. You are one of the main characters in the story! Stuck indoors? Want to play outside? Farhaven is the game for you. You choose where to play! REQUIRED TO PLAY: ARKit-compatible Apple iPhone, iPad, or iPod Touch. Camera permissions for Apple ARKit to see your world. Audio volume to hear character dialog and gameplay directions. Use a pair of headphones if needed. Enough artificial or natural lighting wherever you choose to play. A fixed location whenever playing—either indoors or outside. Unfortunately, the game cannot be played while driving, flying, taking public transportation, or riding horseback due to Apple ARKit requirements.

1473272203.name: TOUR DU MONT-BLANC
1473272203.description: “环勃朗峰”（TMB）是位于阿尔卑斯山的一条中距离路线。该路线穿越法国、意大利和瑞士。 整条路线都有充足的路标，提供有防护的山间避难所，其中含有所有必需品。 建议提前预定，并且切记，八月底的耐力赛路线与此相同，在此期间不允许预约避难所。 勃朗峰群山和冰川的景色十分宜人。 Digital Hiking Guide是**HIKEORAMA**推出的长距离路线助手产品。 它将你路上所需的一切信息集于一个单独的应用中。地图、气象和路上所有点的信息都能查到。这一切都是以尽可能易用的方式呈现的。 它可以显示出你在路线上的位置，并帮助你更好地决策。 概览: 住宿 34 信用卡 4 公共交通 16 厕所 16 困难区段 2 垃圾 20 天然躲避处 2 宿营 4 宿营点 81 小屋 5 小溪 70 屋顶 6 山口 4 旅游咨询处 5 旅行用品 5 标语牌 138 水源 52 电气连接 3 电话信号 9 联系 39 自动取款机 3 药店 3 邮电局 4 野餐区 8 顶峰 1 食品店 11 餐厅 29

1473595660.name: ice sudoku
1473595660.description: 【高效性能，题库丰富】 ice sudoku 采用高效随机数算法，通过多线程并发技术以高效利用Apple A系列处理器，可快速生成5种（新手、简单、中等、困难、顶尖）不同难度的数独， 提供涵盖SE 1.2~11.9的全方位题库，并支持搜索与随机检索。 (1) 新手、简单、中等、困难、顶尖数独专项技巧题：各999道 (2) 较高算法水平冰数独数独(SE 8.3-SE 9.2) ：999道 (3) 巅峰算法水平冰彗星数独(SE 8.8-SE 10.5)：999道 (4) 超一流难度数独(SE 10.5+) ：100道以上 【极致逻辑，进阶挑战】 具备完备的逻辑分析系统，支持任何数独的分步求解，帮你梳理每一步的逻辑推理。 拥有丰富的针对性训练数独库，助力成为数独高手。 独家挑战模式，检验水平、竞速挑战，解锁专属图标，让数独不再枯燥。 【隐私保护，离线畅玩】 开发者承诺不会从ice sudoku中收集任何数据，更无需网络连接即可畅享全部功能，无广告，无内购，充分保护你的隐私安全。 【高度自由，随心定制】 支持自由圈改涂画，尤其适合有Pencil的iPad。 支持数独自定义，哪里有数字由你来决定，更有模板可生成轴对称数独。 存档系统完备，更可以导出81位数独串，方便管理你的数独库与自由分享。 【功能丰富，简洁直观】 界面设计简洁明了，并持续完善，iOS 13及以上设备支持数独扫一扫识别。 自动填充候选数、错误保护、高亮显示候选数、候选数背景色调整、快速填入，更多便捷功能等你来探索。 【持续更新，支持反馈】 无论你是可以从容求解各类数独的大师，还是刚刚入门的数独小白，在这里都可以找到适合你的题目。 如果你有更好的建议，欢迎与我们的联系，让我们可以听到你的声音！ ice sudoku官方网站: https://github.com/tropicalwzc/ice_sudoku.github.io

1473724946.name: 唐诗里
1473724946.description: “窗前明月光” 牙牙学语第一句背诵的是唐诗， “方块字，米字格” 读书识字第一眼看到的是汉字， 唐诗，汉语中最美好的词语之一。 古人寄情于唐诗，今人以设计再次表达唐诗， 传承古人情怀与文化风采。 当“唐诗”遇上“设计”“数字化”又会产生什么样的碰撞呢？ 一切答案尽在《唐诗里》... [设计] 1.极简设计，展现唐诗古籍风韵 2.米字格与竖排句，从右往左，再现古人的阅读体验 3.智能识别唐诗意境，多种配图自动匹配 [功能] 1.每天首页推荐一篇唐诗，点滴积累，学无止境 2.《唐诗三百首》《全唐诗五万篇》离线数据库支持，无需联网本地畅读 3.全目录搜索，快速找到你心中那一句最美唐诗 4.丰富的主题风格切换：4种配色，4种字体 5.支持壁纸生成，支持唐诗图片分享 6.支持繁简体切换，支持普通话和粤语朗读 7.飞花令玩法，答题记唐诗，祝大家榜上有名 最后，小外甥快两岁了，准备个唐诗应用，可以读书识字学起来啦！

1473729922.name: DWG Viewer 2D - For DWG to PDF
1473729922.trackName: DWG Viewer 2D - For DWG to PDF
1473729922.description: DWG Viewer 2D is a tool for quickly viewing 2D CAD files stored locally and iCloud, and supports all versions of DWG and DXF, as well as quickly converting .dwg and .dxf files to PDF. Languages for CAD: Latin, Arabic, Cyrillic, Greek, Turkish, Hebrew, Baltic, Vietnamese, Thai, Japanese, simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese, Korean. Main features: 1. Drag to change the position of the view. 2. Zoom the view: Zoom in and out by clicking on the zoom button. Roll the mouse to zoom in and out of the view. Zoom Extents: zoom the view to the maximum extent. Zoom Window: zoom the selected view to the window. 3. Rotate the view: Rotate the view 90 degrees counterclockwise, Rotate the view 180 degrees counterclockwise, Rotate the view 90 degrees clockwise. 4. Switch the background color of the view. 5. Export .dwg and .dxf files as PDF. 6. Supports viewing local and iCloud files directly. We regularly update the product, if you have any questions or suggestions, please send a message to the mailbox(moonlight_beauty@yeah.net), or leave a message on our website. If you are enjoying the app, please consider leaving a review or rating.

1473824566.name: Key Finder - Musical Scales
1473824566.description: Find out what possible scale you are in in your current song production of chord idea! With 1056 different scales from the well-known C major to to exotic ones like D egyptian you will find the scale you are looking for - guaranteed. Can be used to: Find the right Auto-Tune/Pitch-Correction Key for your current production Get inspired in what scale you could work with your current chord or progression Explore and Learn new scales Take an interesting look at all types of exotic scales from all over the world Your personal scale dictionary How does it work? ** The app stores over 1000 different musical scales that are known from all over the world. Simply highlight keys on the keyboard and Scale Finder will show you in what scales your selection would fit in.

1473875023.name: SUP Tracker: Paddle GPS
1473875023.description: Track every stand up paddleboarding session with GPS, Apple Watch stroke detection, weather scoring, HealthKit sync, widgets, and gear stats. Pay once. No subscription. Track your distance, duration, speed, route, calories, heart rate, strokes, weather conditions, equipment, photos, and progress over time. 1473946290.name: Universe Size Comparison
1473946290.description: Universe Size Comparison is a unique 3D astronomical app that will make you understand the real dimensions of the universe and how small we are. Have you ever wondered how big the Sun is compared to Earth? Or what is the largest planet between Mars and Earth? Do you want to find out the dimensions of some of the most famous stars in the sky like Rigel and Betelgeuse in comparison to our Sun? Do you want to compare everything with the hypergiant star VY Canis Majoris? Universe Size Comparison is the right app for you. The app offers two modes: Tour Mode and Free Mode. Tour mode will guide you on a spectacular journey where you will see planets and stars compared in full scale. All accompanied by simple and clear explanations regardless of the level of knowledge of the subject. The Free mode will allow you to compare two celestial bodies of your choice in scale. You will also find out more information on the bodies you are comparing thanks to an elegant user interface designed to offer the maximum user experience.

1474243671.name: Readable
1474243671.description: Readable helps you turn difficult-to-read text in images into clear, selectable text. Use Readable to: Extract text from screenshots and shared images. Save clippings in a history list for later reading. Adjust reading size for comfort. Open extracted text in a clean, focused detail view. Share-sheet workflow: Install the "Make Readable" extension once. Share an image or compatible content to Readable. Readable extracts text and saves a clipping. Subscription: Readable offers a 3-day free trial, then an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Subscription supports ongoing maintenance and reliability. Existing users from earlier versions may be granted a lifetime grandfathered entitlement. Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in Account Settings on the App Store. For terms of use see: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

1474339665.name: QUARTET Vocab & Kanji
1474339665.description: With this app you can practice vocabulary and kanji introduced in the textbook “QUARTET Intermediate Japanese across the Four Language Skills”. Using the app, you can practice the words and kanji anytime and anywhere! Number of words: 256 Number of kanji: 327 ＜Vocabulary＞ Word Dictionary: You can look up the words that you need to memorize. Each word has two different example sentences; one from the textbook and one that is not from the textbook. You can listen to native pronunciation by tapping on the example sentences. Additionally, tapping on any of the kanji that are introduced in the textbook, you will be brought to that kanji page of the kanji dictionary. Word Flash: You can learn words from English to Japanese, or vice-versa by using the flash cards. If you put a check mark on the words you have already memorized, the words will not appear again for more efficient learning of other words. Word Q: You can practice the words you memorized through quizzes. ＜Kanji＞ Kanji Dictionary: Readings and meanings of kanji are introduced. Also, the stroke order of each kanji are animated. Kanji Reading Q: You can take a quiz to practice the reading of kanji you have learned. Kanji Writing Q: You can actually practice writing the kanji by hand. If you want to learn to write well, you can practice writing the kanji by tracing over the kanji pattern. ＜Other＞ Vocabulary List: You can search for all words. When you tap on a word, you will be brought to the dictionary page for that word. Review Q: Words and kanji readings can be reviewed in a game with time limits. Settings: You can mute the sound. You can also check the version of the app and credits information. This app is based on the vocabulary and kanji from the textbook “QUARTET Intermediate Japanese across the Four Language Skills”. 中級日本語の教科書「カルテットVol.1」の単語と漢字が練習できるアプリです。このアプリで、いつでもどこでも単語と漢字の練習が可能になりました！（収録単語・漢字数：２５６語・３２７漢字） アプリには以下の機能があります。 ＜単語＞ ・単語辞書：わからない単語を調べることができます。教科書にはない例文もあり、タッチすることでネイティブが発音した音声を聞くことが可能です。また、「カルテット」で勉強する漢字が使われている単語は、その漢字をタッチすることで、漢字辞書のページに移動します。 ・単語Flash：フラッシュカードを使うように、日本語・英語、どちらからでも単語を覚えることができます。覚えた単語にチェックを入れると、その単語はそれ以降出なくなるので、効率的に勉強が可能です。 ・単語Q：単語Flashで覚えた単語を、クイズ形式で練習できます。 ＜漢字＞ ・漢字辞書：漢字の読み方や意味が書いてあり、書き順をアニメーションで確認することもできます。 ・漢字読みQ：覚えた漢字の読みをクイズ形式で練習できます。 ・漢字書きQ：実際に手で書いて漢字の練習ができます。上手に書きたい人のために、お手本をなぞって書く練習もできます。 ＜その他＞ ・単語リスト：全ての単語を検索することができます。単語をタッチすると、その単語の単語辞書のページに移動します。 ・ふくしゅうQ：単語と漢字の読みが制限時間のあるゲームで復習できます。 ・SETTINGS：音の有無を設定したり、バージョンやクレジットを確認できます。 ○本アプリは、『４技能でひろがる中級日本語カルテットI』に準拠しています。

1474944185.name: TB Reverb
1474944185.description: ToneBoosters Reverb is a studio-quality, professional reverberation AUv3 plug-in with an unrivalled workflow, unlimited creative use and a gorgeous, functional user interface. With its close to a hundred adjustable parameters, the integrated LFO for parameter modulation, integrated compression and gating, and its shimmer reverb module it is by far the most flexible and configurable reverb on iOS. The ToneBoosters Reverb app captures the microphone input and processes the signals in real time. To use it as a plug-in, use an AUv3-compatible host app such as Steinberg Cubasis, Apple Garageband, Audio Evolution Mobile Studio, Auria, AUM, or others. ToneBoosters Reverb will appear in the list of Audio Unit extensions for effect plug-ins. Key features: Studio-grade reverberation including early reflections The same professional sound as the acclaimed desktop version Full control over room size, width, density, depth, mass Integrated spectrum analyser showing direct and reverb simultaneously Integrated equalizer to shape the reverberation character Ability to modify reverberation time across frequency Compression, ducking and gating for dynamic reverberation effects Flexible, beat-synced LFO that can modulate almost everything! Dual pitch-shift shimmer module for out-of-this-world reverberation Reverb freeze option Random parameter option to change the core reverb sound on the spot Eco mode for lower CPU load on complex projects Program manager with shared programs between stand-alone, IAA and AUv3 instances Undo/redo, and A/B comparison Color themes for the user interface Max screen support in Garageband Optimised for iPad and compatible with iPhone and iPod Touch Compatibility Please note that given the large flexibility and number of parameters that can be modified with this reverb, the use of an Apple pencil or stylus is highly recommended for smaller devices such as iPhone and iPod touch. What you should know: Licenses acquired for this platform are not compatible with other platforms. Audio Unit (AUv3) extensions require an iPad mini 2, iPad 4 or later models.

1475070902.name: 灵棋经
1475070902.description: 灵棋占法源于汉代，为张良、东方朔，乃至刘伯温的掌中利器，以手中十二枚棋子，便可决千里之事。后世以其法神妙，将其收于《正统道藏》。 但灵棋又并非专属于高人隐士，至于今日，现代人也可将此作为自己的决策辅助工具。 因为将灵棋占法实现数字化之后，已非常容易上手，甚至无须占卜基础。首先起课方式简单便捷，卦象卦辞直白易懂，心诚必应，自占决疑，不必求于他人，自己便能对事情的吉凶了然，从而择善而行。 另外，若是对《周易》有所向往的朋友，也大可由灵棋入手，因《易》本卜筮之书，立三才以通八卦，而灵棋所立象辞，皆本于《易》。因此，自观玩《灵棋经》之象辞，由简入繁，自下升高，无异于《易》学入门之极好阶梯。但凡因事而占，因占而断，比之诵读经文，当更有一番天地。 最后，须说明使用摇动方式起课，并非只是为了模拟摇动棋子的起课过程，还有着更为深层次的考量。简言之，即避免使用计算机的「伪随机数」系统，而使用与物理世界相关联的加速器来取数，以生成更为灵动准确的占验效果。所谓「心诚必应」，即指此而言。

1475228251.name: 智永真草千字文+AR
1475228251.description: 智永（约510－约610），王羲之七世孙，王羲之第五子徽之之后。出家为僧，居山阴（今浙江绍兴）永欣寺。 据载他曾临写真草千字文八百本，分施浙东诸寺。有墨蹟本传世，于唐时流入日本。楷草并列的方式，无疑方便学习者识草认字。此本楷法谨严，一丝不苟，草书字字分立，运笔精熟，可谓温润秀劲兼而有之。 我们为每个字制作了演示动画，共2000个。根据“明”字，修复了“月”字的楷书。根据碑拓版修复了“家给千兵”四个字的草书。 单字临写时，线条宽度会由手指速度、加速度和压力决定。请耐心练习。同时可以切换真书、草书，更方便。 AR临帖模式：对准任意大小适中的正方框（如米字格），即可识别方框并把帖上的字显示在方框中，并在下方显示半透明的描红。可以用毛笔直接在下方书写，或把字双钩到纸上。 We have brush writing demos for each and every characters, totally 2000 in number. Fixed 5 missing characters according to its own content or other versions of the script. When you writing in in the single character scene, finger speed、acceleration and pressure can determine the stroke width of the virtual brush. Please be patient to practice. The AR mode: it can detect a shape of square, and display the character in it, together with a transparent red image below for the user to actually write upon. Single tap 单点动作:单字临习, 词句注释和临习演示页面。 Double tap 双点动作:单列放大页面。 每字演示书写过程。 可导出书写结果。

1475309518.name: MetaLog
1475309518.description: Are you a meticulous film photographer that prefers to record settings/locations for the film photos that you take? Are you looking for a simple and easy to use app for tracking and logging that information? Are you tired of the buggy, crash-prone, or convoluted photo logging apps currently available? I happen to be all of those things. Which is why I developed MetaLog. MetaLog is a simple yet powerful data logging utility for photographers who want to quickly record photo metadata for photo cataloging or EXIF tagging during post-processing. In addition to keeping track of the settings for each photo, MetaLog can also act as an equipment inventory for your gear. Feature Highlights: See all of your added film rolls at a glance, including the number of frames added to each roll, as well as load/unload dates to show which rolls are still in use. Quickly log settings for each photo including date, lens, aperture, shutter speed, exposure compensation, as well as location coordinates, accessories, and notes about the shot. Intelligent pre-fill and filtering for dates, locations, and equipment, making adding new frames a snap. Easily manage multiple rolls loaded into multiple cameras simultaneously. Pinpoint photo locations with a simple and familiar pinch-and-zoom map interface. Export all logged data as convenient CSV files. Gear pages can record camera and lens models as well as serial numbers, allowing for a complete gear inventory that's handy for tracking and insurance.

1475381991.name: PET核心词-闯关速练疯狂刷题

1475393250.name: Archixcam
1475393250.description: Take a photo as if you were shooting a video. That’s exactly Interval Shooting. Archixcam allows you to take photos using Interval Shooting. Surely you will be surprised, love it, and never let it go! Just as I did that. Absolutely unique camera app like never before. Archixcam is a camera app developed mainly for shooting the architecture. It will help you to take stunning and perfect photos of the architecture. When you find an impressive building, you can start shooting right away. In addition, it is easy to shoot with just one hand and is simply intuitive. Shoot whenever and wherever you want. Because we always carry a smartphone, we need to be able to shoot whenever and wherever we want. For this purpose, the app has been simplified by carefully selecting the necessary features. Treasure every encounter, for it will never recur. You can’t shoot again at that moment. Keep the photos you have taken for the time being so that you don’t regret it. You might encounter a photo that you never thought of. Focus on shooting. Imagine taking 10 photos while adjusting composition, framing, etc. Usually you need to tap the shutter button 10 times. Interval Shooting is a way to do this with just one tap. Since it automatically shoots at regular intervals, you can continue to shoot with a focus on tilt and alignment. Repeat to get a better one. Beautiful and accurate composition such as horizontal, vertical, diagonal, and symmetry is not easy to shoot with a single shot. Rather than aiming to shoot only one best shot, repeat shooting until you are satisfied and find your favorite one. And even more features. Large shutter button — When shooting, you should keep looking at the subject, not the shutter button. For this reason, the shutter button has been enlarged to reduce erroneous operations. Grids — There are several types of grids that can be combined freely. It is a necessity for accurate composition. Frames — Although the captured image is full resolution, you can shoot while checking the target frame when shooting. Level — Want to know device tilt? Level will help you. Luminance — Remove the color from the camera preview to check the brightness balance. Of course, the picture taken is full color. HEIF — As the number of shots increases, you may be concerned about the available storage space on your device. Save in HEIF format and use storage efficiently. (Supported devices only) This app does not support iPad and iPod touch.

1475400264.name: Geomancy Sand Edition
1475400264.description: Geomancy, a divination method, helps you find the way and make important decisions. Geomancy, from Ancient Greek geōmanteía translates literally to "foresight by earth"; it is a translation of the Arabic term ‛ilm al-raml, or the "science of the sand". Earlier Greek renditions of this word borrowed the word raml ("sand") directly, rendering it as rhamplion or rabolion. Other Arabic names for Geomancy include khatt al-raml and darb al-raml. As an ancient method based on understanding the conditions, people, and things that surround you, it can be used to act properly in otherwise hard-to-decide situations or to better understand things and happenings that can otherwise drive a person crazy. This app will do its best to let you peek into your positions and opportunities regarding geomantic readings you provide while concentrated on a specific matter, subject or situation. Remember, the purpose of Geomancy is to give advice, shed new light on misty occasions and help you make decisions, not to tell you the future. Used properly, Geomancy can be your very reliable guide in everyday life or during important turnovers.

1475410615.name: Otsimo | School and Classroom
1475410615.description: Are you looking for an award-winning special education app that gives an early intervention tool to individuals diagnosed with learning disorders, attention deficit, autism, down syndrome, aspergers, and other special needs for your classroom? We are here for you. Otsimo | School and Classroom is mainly for schools, teachers, BCBA, BcABA’s and ABA therapists. Otsimo | School and Classroom is a complete curricular education platform, delivered as a single application. It is designed for the teachers for special needs for their special education efforts. Improve your students' skills with a lot of educational games in different categories. Created under the guidance of psychologists and special education teachers; assistive games in the app aim to teach fundamental education about core skills such as daily life objects, words, alphabet, numbers, emotions, colors, animals, and vehicles through assistive matching, drawing, choosing, ordering and sound games. “Otsimo | School and Classroom is making us nearly 50% more efficient, saving at least 70 administrative hours every year, and has improved kids’ learning performance up to 90%” M.Isik - Headmaster of Special Education Center Key features of the app: Access a complete research-based 70+ educational games with more than 1000+ materials including AAC. IEP supported curriculum and documentation. Customizable for each student in your classroom. In-depth insights to track the progress of the students. Daily and weekly report cards of each student. Export reports to spreadsheets or any other format.(XLS, CSV, PDF). This feature is quite handy for IEP reports. Cross-device support. If you bought Otsimo School for an another device, you can use seamlessly. No Wi-Fi necessary Each activity is adaptive and delivers exercises that are at the exact level of difficulty appropriate for your student at any given point in time. Otsimo | School and Classroom consists of two separate platforms dedicated to games and settings. Student section includes ad-free educational games which are shaped individually to the user's mental development. The settings section is the platform where you have full access to the user's education program, can review user's progress, check the reports and configure difficulty settings. For students having a speech problem, Otsimo | School and Classroom has AAC which often is used in speech therapy, autism communication or special education schools. Since Otsimo games are designed according to ABA therapy, Otsimo can be used with inner peace by individuals / children having autism spectrum disorder (ASD), down syndrome, asperger syndrome, attention deficit, cerebral palsy, rett syndrome, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, motor neuron disease (MND), speech impediments, and aphasia. Research-based Otsimo based on ABA techniques of visual-visual and auditory-visual conditional discrimination and Pivotal Response Treatment that targets development of a response to multiple cues. Otsimo games are developed according to the Applied Behavior Analysis - ABA therapy which is the most widely known and trusted early intensive behavioral therapy technique for helping individuals who have learning disorders and attention deficit problems. Comprehensive support We’re there for you every step of the way. Help articles in the app are there whenever you need them. New to Otsimo? Our website has background resources in the blog section. You can also connect directly with our teacher community on our Facebook group. If you have any questions, our support team is available 7 days a week and is happy to help. For more information:Privacy Policy & Terms of Use - https://otsimo.com/legal/privacy-en.html

1475431246.name: The Icelandic App - Lessons
1475431246.description: Embark on a captivating journey through the Icelandic language with our app. Structured to guide you from the basics to more complex topics, each lesson unfolds progressively, allowing you to build a solid foundation while advancing at your own pace. Our carefully designed multiple-choice quizzes not only reinforce your learning at every step but also challenge you to apply what you've learned in crafting sentences. As you navigate through the lessons, you'll encounter an array of topics, from essential vocabulary and grammar to intricate sentence structures. The quizzes evolve in difficulty, ensuring that you're continuously engaged and improving. Whether you're a beginner eager to learn the fundamentals or an advanced learner looking to refine your skills, our app offers a comprehensive and enjoyable learning experience. Stay motivated as you track your progress through each lesson, with new content regularly added to keep your learning journey fresh and exciting. Join us and transform your Icelandic language skills, one quiz at a time. Your adventure into the rich tapestry of the Icelandic language starts here.

1475438302.description: Music notation is made simple with this shorthand system which puts chords into numbers 1 though 7 and streamlines the page into a simple and clean format. Forget about pencil, erasers and photocopy! This app combines technology with tried and tested methods; allowing users to create song charts with the ease and speed of pen and paper. For over 60 years, the Nashville Number System has been the standard for musicians in live performance, recording sessions, and teaching environments. The published book has become required reading in many of the most prestigious music schools, including Belmont, ETSU, Lee and Liberty University, while also being required reading for anyone when they get their first gig in music city. This innovative app brings the must-read instructional book by Chas Williams, with well over 50,000 copies sold, into our digital age by seamlessly allowing charts to be written on your digital device! Please give feedback of a 5 star review, or contact us directly. If you’re not happy with the app, we will issue a full refund of your purchase price (in exchange for not writing a bad review) and insure your issues are reviewed and fixed. You can keep your version and be notified when an update has been made. Thank you for your business. My name is Leland and I’m on the development team along with Chas. My personal email is nashvillenumbers1@gmail.com so you can contact me with issues or great musical stories! Chart Everything My Friends!!!

1475643220.name: Proloquo2Go
1475643220.description: Tap images. Type words. Speak. Proloquo2Go is an easy to use communication app for people who cannot speak or need help being understood. Featuring natural sounding voices, including real children’s voices, Proloquo2Go is a simple yet powerful AAC (augmentative and alternative communication) tool. The app is fully customizable and can be utilized to build language skills and grow with a person’s communication, supporting both beginning and advanced communicators. Parents, therapists, teachers and users around the world recognize Proloquo2Go as the gold standard in AAC solutions. The app is used by people with autism, Down syndrome, cerebral palsy, Angelman syndrome, and others with speech difficulties. The app is available in English, Spanish, French, and Dutch and supports bilingual use, so you can switch languages on the fly. Proloquo2Go in action: Learn and grow Studies show that just 200-400 words make up 80% of what we say. Known as core words, they act as the basis of Proloquo2Go’s research-based Crescendo™ vocabulary. Users can grow from single words to full sentences in the same app. Crescendo puts core words in consistent locations for easy access and motor-planning. The vocabulary works with AAC best practices like modeling (where you use an AAC system to talk with the user) to develop language skills. Crescendo offers no limit on language development with a 10,000+ fringe word vocabulary and customizable vocabulary levels. Finally, with Progressive Language, words are gradually revealed step-by-step, helping users learn words and their location as their communication expands. Easy editing Customizing Proloquo2Go is a breeze! Quickly and easily add new words. Use the app’s built-in library of 25,000 symbols or use your own photos by taking pictures within the app or selecting them from your photo library. For users with fine-motor challenges and vision impairments, Proloquo2Go offers options like 23 pre-programmed grid sizes and accessibility settings which support switch scanning and Apple’s VoiceOver screen reader. Everything from appearance to access is customizable so you can make it your own. Type and speak Besides tapping images, Proloquo2Go also lets you type what you want to say. The app includes a Grid Keyboard arranged alphabetically for people learning to type. For more experienced typists, Proloquo2Go includes a Typing View with a QWERTY keyboard and word prediction that offers suggestions based on what you are typing. Hello! ¡Hola! Bonjour! Hallo! Proloquo2Go lets you select a language and region for the Crescendo vocabulary. Two languages can be used at the same time, allowing seamless bilingual speech. Over 100 included downloadable natural-sounding adult and children’s voices rounds out your choices to use the app your way. A helping hand AssistiveWare is here for you every step of the way. Help articles in Proloquo2Go are there whenever you need them. New to AAC? Our website has easy to understand articles in the Learn AAC section, and the AssistiveWare Core Word Classroom includes activities for teaching communication effectively. You can also connect directly with our community of parents, professionals, and users on our Facebook groups. If you have any questions, our support team is available 7 days a week and is always happy to help. All of these online resources can be accessed by going to the AssistiveWare website. Note: Discounts are available through Apple’s Educational Volume Purchase Program – 50% off on 20 licenses or more. Joan Bruno’s Gateway to Language & Learning© vocabulary is available as an in-app purchase (English only).

1476046123.name: WatchFlower
1476046123.description: WatchFlower is a plant monitoring application that reads and plots data from compatible Bluetooth sensors like Xiaomi 'Flower Care' or Parrot 'Flower Power'. WatchFlower also works great with a couple of Bluetooth thermometers and air quality monitoring sensors! WatchFlower is an open source software. By buying it here, you support its development! It doesn't track your application usage, doesn't require an account, your GPS position, nor any other personal data! The application is available in English, Chinese, Danish, Dutch, Frisian, French, German, Norwegian, Spanish and Russian. Application developed by Emeric Grange. Visual design by Chris Díaz. New features: WatchFlower now has a plant database with over 3400 entries! Supported sensors: Xiaomi "Flower Care" / VegTrug "Grow Care Home" Xiaomi "Flower Care Max" / VegTrug "Grow Care Garden" Xiaomi "RoPot" / VegTrug "Grow Care Pot" Works with both international and Chinese versions. Tuya "Flower Care" Parrot "Flower Power" Parrot "Pot" Automatic watering is not yet supported. Xiaomi "Digital Hygrometer Clock" Xiaomi "Digital Hygrometer Alarm" Supports automatic time setting and switching temperature units. Xiaomi "Digital Hygrometer" Xiaomi "Digital Hygrometer 2" Xiaomi "BLE Temperature and Humidity sensor" (with LCD screen) ClearGrass "Digital Bluetooth Thermometer and Hygrometer" (with EInk screen) ClearGrass "Temp & RH Monitor" (with LCD screen) Qingping "Temp & RH Monitor Lite" (with LCD screen) SensorBlue "ThermoBeacon" (LCD and keychain) Qingping "Air Monitor Lite" Honeywell HCHO detector VSON "Air Box" WP6003 Follow development, post bug reports and suggest new features on the GitHub page (https://github.com/emericg/WatchFlower) or contact me directly by email (emeric.grange@gmail.com). This project is NOT associated with Xiaomi, Parrot, or any sensor manufacturer.

1476149504.name: Violin Note Finder
1476149504.description: Violin Note Finder is a tool that will help you with sight reading. It will give you the insight to find notes on the whole fingerboard of your instrument. This app was built by a small team of professional music teachers from the Netherlands. The functionality is very straightforward: You can tap on a staff to see where on the violin a certain note can be played. You will see this both on an overview picture of a violin in the middle of the screen, and on a picture of an enlarged position of the violin. You can select which position to be enlarged by using red arrows. If you tap on this enlarged position, the corresponding note will appear on the staff, and you will see on the overview picture where that same note also can be played. The left hand finger numbers are shown just above the enlarged position. Both by tapping on the staff and on the enlarged fretboard, you will hear te corresponding tone, and the name of the note will appear on the left side of the staff. Lastly, you can set the notes on the staff to be sharp or flat, or back to natural.

1476193562.name: 小键盘 · 开启花样聊天模式
1476193562.trackName: 小键盘 · 开启花样聊天模式
1476193562.description: 小键盘是一款简单，轻量的输入法应用。旨在提高人们日常生活中的文字输入的效率。 【功能介绍】 文字流：文字流是小键盘最核心的功能。创造文字流的初衷是我们希望能够提供一种灵活的方式来进行文本处理，它可以自定义不同的文本处理规则，还支持自动发送。 我们内置了许多常用的文字流，比如：“引用回复”，“聊天刷屏”，“朋友圈不折叠”，“竖排文本” 等，甚至还可以把一段文字加密成 emoji。有创意，就有无限的可能。 我们也会在微博上不定期分享一些有意思的文字流，可以关注我们的微博：@PicoApp，也欢迎给我们投稿！ 快捷短语：将常用的文字内容存放在快捷短语里，简单点击就可以直接发送，减少了相同信息（例如：常用的家庭地址，邮箱等信息）的重复输入。 分词：分词工具可以把一段话拆分成单个词汇、短句。当你复制了一大段文字，却只想输入其中一部分时，可以使用这个工具。 特殊符号：花样修饰你的文字内容。我们内置了许多不太常见的特殊符号，如果你在系统键盘上找不到某个符号时，可以到小键盘中查找。(你甚至可以在里面找到小动物) 计算器：边聊边算很方便。聊天时打开小键盘的计算器，不用离开聊天界面就可以直接进行简单数学计算，还可以输出完整的公式。 通讯录：快捷分享通讯录信息。我们在获得你的“通讯录权限”授权之后，你可以从键盘上的“通讯录工具”内直接分享某个人的联系方式，而不再需要到通讯录App中查找再复制。关于你通讯录内的所有数据我们都不会做任何的保存或上传，所以不用担心隐私泄漏的问题。 【联系我们】 如果你在使用中遇到了问题，或者有什么想法，可以通过下面的方式联系我们 邮件：hello.pico.app@gmail.com 微博：@PicoApp

1476267616.name: iProTV for iPtv & m3u content
1476267616.description: iProTv let you play your playlist saved in an M3U/ M3U8 format or using xtream codes in your iPhone/iPad or Apple tv with only one purchase ! Supports xtream codes API and m3u remote files. Download your favorite movies and tv shows for offline use. Open any media in VLC application so you can use chromecast with you TV. You can the native player (if possible), this will bring support for Airplay and PiP (Picture in Picture). Live channels * Multi-view: Now you can watch up to 4 live channels simultaneously. You can save the multiview so next time you open up to 4 channels in one click ;) Support for replay/catch-up (you need to add your provider as xtream codes and your provider have to have replays) Record live channels ! You can download your recorded channels using a browser (Mac, PC, Tablettes ..) You can choose between a grid view or list view with EPG and live preview. EPG: you can access the EPG by using haptic/force touch on the channel icon. Closed caption supported. Synchronisation * Every time you add a playlist in one of your devices, it will be added in the others :) Start watching a movie on your iPad, continue watching it on your Apple tv : progress time is synced for every profile over all your devices! You have up to 6 profiles so everyone in your family have his own favorites, continue watching, categories, hidden categories and more ! Categories * You can create custom categorie(s) and add live channels/movies/series in it which will be synced over all your devices and linked to your profile. You can hide categorie(s) (channels/movies/series): you can hide all the categories you are not using. Media * You can go to next/previews channel right from your player. Movies and Series have a dedicated view to display informations such poster image, actors .. Series have dedicated section to display episodes with title and screenshot. Next episode button : you can go directly to the next episode using the "Next episode" button displayed at the end of the episode. Audio tracks support. Subtitles support. Widget * You can have access to your favourites and continue watching right on your home screen (iOS and iPadOS 14 only). Other features * Support for dark/light mode. Support for split mode on Ipad. Fast parsing playlist. Gorgeous UI for iPhones/iPads and Apple TVs. Connect HDMI cable or use mirroring feature to watch your media on full screen on your TV. Your privacy is important this is why i choose to use Apple's iCloud servers to save and sync your data. Note : This application does not contain any playlist/media and I don't provide such content. Note : To have synced content, all devices have to be connected to the same iCloud account.

1476276270.trackName: 推送助手 - 极简待办
1476276270.description: 提醒助手是一款可以使用应用内置声音效果的同时面向普通用户和开发者的通知类应用. 你可以通过简单的时间选择和添加提醒内容就能成功创建一个提醒 提醒助手界面简洁, 只展示最重要的内容和时间部分, 没有多余的琐碎功能 对于开发者, 你只需要根据系统内的文档来进行接口调用就可以在 app 内收到你的自定义推送消息 常用场景包含: 服务器预警通知等 如果你有更好的想法和建议可以通过联系我或直接在 App Store 的评论区留言. Email: lazyzhang@qq.com The reminder assistant is a notification application that can be used for both regular users and developers while using the built-in sound effects. You can successfully create a reminder by simply selecting times and adding content. Remind the assistant interface is simple, only show the most important content and time part, no extra trivial function For developers, you only need to make an interface call based on the documentation in the system to receive your custom push message in the app. Common scenarios include: server warning notifications, etc. If you have better ideas and suggestions, you can contact me by email or directly in the comments section of the App Store. Email: lazyzhang@qq.com

1476509317.description: 《每日英语 听力学习版》，专为英语学习者打造，精听细读，助你更好学英语。 【资源丰富，每日更新】 各类考试：初高中、大学四六级、考研、雅思托福、GRE等备考听力材料； 经典教材：走遍美国、赖世雄、新东方等丰富教材； 兴趣学习：有声读物、名人演讲、公开课、少儿英语、影视英语等丰富资源。 【功能强大，操作简便】 划词搜索：与《欧路词典》无缝集成，长按查词，即指即译； 播放调节：8档语速调节、4种循环模式，单句精听、听写、测验，满足不同阶段的需求； 收藏下载：支持批量下载，离线随时收听； 听力上传：支持听众上传自己的资源，我们为您制作同步高亮字幕； 跟读打分：跟读后可查看单词的发音是否准确，纠正发音问题。 【特色模块，辅助学习】 精听党：名著原声朗读，精编版讲义讲解，配套习题测试。 配音秀：提供原声听力材料的配音，秀出你的发音； 听力挑战：加入听力训练计划，日积月累提高英语。 【VIP订阅服务说明】 订阅服务：VIP连续包月（1个月）、VIP连续包半年（6个月）、每日外刊连续包月（1个月） 订阅价格：以iAP申请信息为准，例如VIP包月服务为18元/月；VIP包半年服务为68元/6个月；每日外刊服务为63元/月 付款：用户确认购买并付款后计入iTunes账户 苹果iTunes账户会在到期前24小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺延一个订阅周期 如需取消订阅，请手动打开苹果手机“设置”-->进入“iTunes Store与App Store”-->点击“Apple ID”，选择“查看Apple ID”，进入“账户设置”页面，点击“订阅”，选择听力VIP取消订阅即可。如未在订阅期结束的至少24小时前关闭订阅，此订阅将自动续订。 自动续费规则：https://www.eudic.net/v4/en/home/service 隐私协议：https://www.eudic.net/v4/home/privacy

1476649036.name: 帕斯卡契约
1476649036.description: 2022年8月19日 最新追加内容「皇座之舞」现已推出！ 执念的亡魂再一次被召唤到索拉斯，背负所有德慕格的意志，重新踏上充满血腥的复仇之路。 德慕格的领袖伊琳娜将在本模式中作为可操作角色登场。以快节奏的双刀轮舞，通过截然不同的方式体验索拉斯大陆的挑战。 2020年8月20日 资料片「遗忘之潮」现已发售！ 追加新剧情、新场景、新可操作角色。 和杰洛尔德一起，去探索被诅咒的伊西索亚吧！ ■ 设备支持： iOS 9 及以上系统 iPhone6S 及以上的 iPhone 机型 拥有 2G 及以上内存的 iPad 机型 ■ 游戏简介 《帕斯卡契约》是一款幻想风格的动作角色扮演游戏，由TIPSWORKS工作室开发，拥有超高品质的画面表现，将带来移动平台前所未有的感官体验。 世界被黑雾笼罩，光明微渺而神秘，人们在其中迷失狂乱……而这一切背后的秘密至今无人知晓。玩家将操作多名角色，体验深邃的故事，探索多样的地图，遭遇超乎想象的敌人，在史诗级的配乐中面对史诗级的BOSS，迎接史诗级的死亡与真相！ ■ 游戏特色 20小时以上的游戏内容，让人难忘的冒险 4名可操作角色，4种特色鲜明的战斗体验 几十种敌人，丰富且有深度的ACT战斗 众多NPC和隐藏支线 极具探索感的立体地图 电影化的演出与叙事，全程语音 极富渲染力的配乐，由世界著名交响乐团倾情演奏 使用MFi认证手柄游玩，操作体验更佳 ■ 故事背景 上古时代，一场天灾导致太阳沉入海底，失去光明的大陆突然被名为“污秽”的黑雾所笼罩。与此同时被后人尊为神明的“巨像”第一次行走于大地之上，散发着星火一般的光，驱散着黑雾也为人类带来了唯一的希望。 千百年之后，人类早已习惯同巨像相伴而行，穿行于黑雾之中苟延残喘。然而一场神秘的瘟疫，导致巨像相继陨落。被教会放逐的先驱者泰伦斯，发现这场瘟疫似乎与多年前离开自己的妻子——特蕾莎，有着某种联系。为了追查瘟疫的源头，同时也为了寻回失踪多年的妻子，泰伦斯开始了一场极尽悲苦的救赎之旅。 ■ 官方社群 官方QQ群： 820237970 微信公众号：帕斯卡契约 官方贴吧：帕斯卡契约 官方微博：帕斯卡契约 BiliBili官方账号：帕斯卡契约

1476932307.description: Pixel Studio是为艺术家和游戏开发者开发的全新像素画板，简洁、快速且便携。无论您是初学者还是专业人士，随时随地都可以创作令人赞叹的像素艺术！提供图层支持、动画和其他有用的工具——创造您自己的酷炫工程所需要的全部。将音乐添加到您的动画中并将视频导出到MP4。使用Google Drive再不同设备甚至不同平台间同步作品。加入Pixel Network™——我们全新的像素艺术社区！不用怀疑——试试看就会发现您选择了最好用的像素艺术工具！全球下载量超过两百万，支持23种语言！ 主要功能： 极其简洁、直观、操作友好 跨平台，可通过Google Drive在移动端和桌面端同步 使用图层创作高级像素作品 制作逐帧动画 将动画保存为GIF或精灵序列图（sprite sheets） 与朋友或Pixel Network™社区分享作品 创建自定义调色板，使用内建调色板或从Lospec下载 支持RGBA和HSV模式的高级拾色器 通过手势和虚拟摇杆轻松缩放或平移视图 在手机上使用竖屏模式，在平板和PC上使用横屏模式 自定义工具栏和诸多其他设定 我们支持 Apple Pencil！ 支持全部的流行格式：PNG、JPG、GIF、PSP（Pixel Studio项目）、ASE（Aseprite格式） 自动保存及备份——不再丢失作品！ 还有大量工具和功能等您发现！ 更多功能： 绘制基本形状的“形状工具” 渐变工具 内建画笔和自定义画笔 储存图像图案的精灵库 用于无缝纹理的“平铺模式” 笔刷平铺模式 对称绘图（X、Y、X+Y） 使用指针精确绘图的Dot Pen工具 自带多种字体的文本工具 用于阴影或高光的“抖动笔” 使用Fast RotSprite算法的像素画旋转 用于高级动画的“洋葱皮”工具 将图案应用到图像上 从图像上抓取图案 像素完美的预览小窗 无限画布尺寸 画布尺寸调整及旋转 可自定义的背景色 可自定义的网格 多线程图像处理、 支持JASC调色板（PAL）格式 You can support us by purchasing PRO (it's one-time purchase): No ads Google Drive sync (cross-platform) Dark Theme 256-color palettes Tile mode for making seamless textures Extended max project size Unlimited color adjustment (Hue, Saturation, Lightness) Unlimited export to MP4 Extended storage in Pixel Network 系统需求： 大型项目或动画需要2GB以上内存 性能足够的CPU（安兔兔跑分100,000以上） 由lorddkno、Redshrike、Calciumtrice、Buch、Tomoe Mami创作的实例图根据CC BY 3.0许可使用。 Privacy Policy: https://github.com/hippogamesunity/PixelStudioHub/wiki/Privacy-Policy Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

1476985427.description: 葫芦丝，又称“葫芦箫”，是中国云南少数民族乐器，音色轻柔细腻，圆润质朴，采样采用桶音做G（5）的指法。此虚拟乐器可在GarageBand（库乐队）或Logic pro等mac宿主软件里当作“真实乐器”使用。 所有虚拟乐器均可在GarageBand（库乐队）或Logic pro等mac宿主软件里当作“真实乐器及软音源”使用。 通过Lightning或音频线连接mac电脑，使用Lightning连接请在“音频midi设置”里选择启用设备。 在宿主软件中选择轨道类型为“音频—使用麦克风或线路输入录音” 打开监听按钮，调整合适音量 到此就可以把虚拟乐器作为软音源使用。 乐器的演奏视频可以来B站观看：https://space.bilibili.com/42860533

1477240784.name: 生理和病理学

1477266080.description: The easiest live-streaming camera you will ever use! Turn your phone into a professional live-streaming NDI camera and start streaming high-quality, low-latency video and audio with the touch of a button. NDI Camera is the official NDI app that makes your phone seamlessly capable of sending video into popular platforms like MS Teams, Skype, Zoom, and many more. For professionals, it's the ideal tool to bring mobile phones as a source into your live production system. More flexibility and additional perspectives: introduce new camera angles and add vantage points to your coverage to bring completely new dimensions to your live broadcasts, webcasts, and presentations. Note: Requires support for NDI 4 or newer. Download NDI Camera and start streaming from your phone to your network today!

1477446992.name: 108 Bows Counter
1477446992.description: 108 bows is an iPhone app that counts the number of bowing and help you manage 108 bows workout. ◉ Good for 108 bows practitioner, 108 bows exercise ◉ Bow count You can automatically count the number of bows when bowing with an iPhone that has a working proximity sensor. You can count the number of bows by touching the screen on an iPhone that does not have a working proximity sensor. ◉ Voice guidance Every time you bow, you count your voice. ◉ Ambient sound You can hear the sound of the wind chime so you can concentrate while bowing. ◉ View results after completion After completion, you can check the results such as the number of bowing, elapsed time, and average time per bowing. ◉ Share results via messenger or SNS Share result to your friends with images ◉ Manual input Even if you didn't count with the app, you can manually record the date and count. ◉ Calendar view You can check the exercise day at a glance on the calendar. Can be used as a training calendar or exercise calendar. ◉ View Stats You can see statistics such as the number of days you exercise, the total number of bowing, and the time, and you can check the number of bowing by day in a bar graph. ◉ Apple Health Time, calories consumed, number of times, etc. are stored in Apple Health using Apple Health Kit. ◉ Dark Mode Support Dark mode is supported for iOS 13 and later. You can reduce the battery consumption by changing to dark mode only when bowing in the light mode. ◉ User Suggestions If you have any inconvenience or ideas during use, please send it through Settings> App Info> Suggestions in the app. Terms of use: http://waneelab.com/terms-of-service/

1477585388.name: 格鲁吉亚语
1477585388.description: 让我们学习格鲁吉亚语! LET'S LEARN THE GEORGIAN LANGUAGE ! 这款APP帮助您迅速掌握格鲁吉亚语的语音以及书写特点! THIS APP BREAKS THEM DOWN STROKE BY STROKE ! 旋转轮 操作直观, 只需拇指, 既直观又简单和自然。 SPIN THE WHEEL TO EXPLORE It's so easy and natural. 收藏夹 - 可以收藏自己喜欢的单词 ADD TO FAVORITES Save the word you like for the future use. 真人发音 标注了简便音标，清晰准确。 REAL HUMAN VOICE Including the alphabet, words. 英文释意 ENGLISH MEANINGS All of the words have their meanings in English. 格鲁吉亚文化简介 GEORGIAN ARTS & CULTURE People and culture illustrations. 离线独立APP - 无需互联网 OFF-LINE INDEPENDENT Once downloaded, you don't need internet to use the app. All audios and pictures are integrated within. You can select the word in alphabetical order (English meanings) by clicking “words” in the menu bar. Basic everyday Georgian words! Click on the "alphabet" button in the menu bar, you can get the sound elements of the Georgian language. There are 3.7 million people who speak Georgian. It is spoken mainly in Georgia, where it is the official language, and also in Russia, Ukraine, Turkey, Azerbaijan and Iran. The Georgian writing system dates back to 5th century. This app gives you a taste of Georgian! 格鲁吉亚语是高加索语言的一种，是格鲁吉亚的官方语言，在格鲁吉亚有三百九十万人（总人口83%）作为第一语言，另外在伊朗、土耳其、俄罗斯和美国等地，有20万人使用。格鲁吉亚语是高加索语系中最重要的语言。最早的格鲁吉亚语书写可以追溯到公元5世纪。

This app gives you a taste of Georgian! 格鲁吉亚语是高加索语言的一种，是格鲁吉亚的官方语言，在格鲁吉亚有三百九十万人（总人口83%）作为第一语言，另外在伊朗、土耳其、俄罗斯和美国等地，有20万人使用。格鲁吉亚语是高加索语系中最重要的语言。最早的格鲁吉亚语书写可以追溯到公元5世纪。

1477944755.description: Export your Apple Health data to CSV or GPX - back it up, open it in Excel or Google Sheets, or analyze it with AI. HealthExport Remote syncs in the background and works with Claude, Codex, and any LLM through an open-source CLI. End-to-end encrypted - we never see your data. Key Features: Manual Exports: Export your health data to CSV, PDF or GPX files manually in the app while tailoring the configuration to your needs (desired data types, time period, aggregation, etc.) Automated Exports: Health data export can be automated using Apple Shortcuts for seamless integration into your daily routines. HealthExport Remote: Access your health data remotely from your computer through a secure and customizable web dashboard. Synchronization with the web app happens effortlessly without the need to open the app on your phone. Your data is end-to-end encrypted for ultimate privacy. Your privacy is our priority - we don't collect or share your health data with anyone. Categories of Health Data: Aggregation based types - Export can be aggregated by minutes, hours, days, months, or years Record based types - Export contains all entries from the Health app Workouts and Workout Routes Aggregated data types: Activity: Apple Watch stand hours Distance cycling Distance downhill snow sports Distance swimming Distance walking / running Exercise time Flights Climbed Stand time Step count Swimming stroke count Energy: Active energy burned Basal energy burned Heart rate: Heart rate Resting heart rate Walking heart rate Nutrition: Caffeine Calcium Carbohydrates Alcoholic beverages Body fat percentage Body mass Body mass index Body temperature Handwashing Height Lean body mass Mindfulness Medications Oxygen saturation Physical effort Respiratory rate State of Low heart rate Heart rate Heart rate variability (SDNN) Resting heart rate Walking heart rate Reproductive health: Basal body temperature Cervical mucus quality Intermenstrual bleeding Menstrual flow Ovulation test result Pregnancy test Progesterone test Sexual activity Running: Ground contact time Power Speed Stride length Vertical oscillation Sleep: Time asleep Time awake Time core Time deep Time in bed Time REM HealthExport Remote lets you visualize your health data on a customizable dashboard accessible from a browser on your computer. You can also perform remote CSV exports on the website. Health data is automatically synced to the service multiple times per day in the background, so there is no need for opening the app on your phone anymore. The data is end to end encrypted between your phone and your browser. HealthExport Remote requires a subscription payment due to monthly fees associated with running the service. Remote Service EULA: https://healthexport.app/terms/remote.html

1477959945.name: EōN by Jean-Michel Jarre
1477959945.description: EōN为听者与音乐之间建立起一种全新的关系，让人沉浸在永无止境的听觉与视觉感受中，就像是一张永无止境音乐专辑。 EōN像一架音乐永动机， 它由法国电子乐先锋音乐家让·米歇尔·雅尔 （Jean-Michel Jarre）创作，并永恒不断地重新演绎，不断变化的音乐，同时还伴随着不停演变发展的未来视效画面。 点开EōN， 您将开启了你的视觉与听觉的双重体验，这种音乐体验会在时间中无限延长，永无止境。因为每次点开程序，演化出的音乐和视效画面都将是永不重复。 您可以无限量畅享音乐，唯一的极限，是您手机电池的持续能力。 它的独特魅力在于，安装成功后，EōN程序便可独立运行，无需上网，没有空间和时间限制。 雅尔这样形容EōN “ EōN 是古希腊的一个神明，他的名字代表了无限的时间，随意和永恒。” 我给这款应用起名叫EōN， 因为它完美的体现了这款音乐内涵与魅力；永无止境的音乐和视效，给每一个使用者带来独一无二的视听感受，而且永不重复。EōN在每一台设备上的每一次启动，都是听觉和视觉的享受，为您演奏出持续延展的音乐，呈现出不断变化的画面。EōN是一部永无止境的作品，在您的指尖上活跃、生长。 就像人生，EōN带来的每一个瞬间， 都是不可被重复的。 这也是创作 “氧气” 之后，又一次最令我兴奋的创作之一。节奏，音效， 速度，旋律和质感不断演化， 给每个听众带来一份专属音乐，一直是我的心愿。今天，这个心愿终于实现了。EōN是献给每个人的一场没有终点的旅行，每个人都能体会独特的感受。 对于视效画面， 我很清楚自己的想法，鲜活流动，才能贴合我的音乐。我很幸运， 在东京的索尼计算机科学实验室 （Sony Computer Science Laboratories) 认识了Alexis André 和他独特的视效风格。他和索尼一起，开发了一种全新的算法，从而实现了这种不断演化的图形画面，与音乐一起， 带来永不重复的组合。 EōN的音乐算法和音频引擎，在我们共同定义好系统规则后，由BLEASS 的Alexis Zbik 和 Vianney Apreleff 设计制作。 设计和作曲 ： Jean-Michel Jarre 数字图像设计 ： Alexis André, Sony Computer Science Laboratories, Inc. (Sony CSL) 音乐算法和音频引擎设计：BLEASS ：Alexis Zbik 和 Vianney Apreleff 出品 Aero Productions 服务协议详见http://jeanmicheljarre.com/eon/terms-of-use

1478063939.name: vCard Editor
1478063939.description: vCard Editor is the application for viewing and editing vCard files. When you receive a vCard via Email or AirDrop etc, you can send it to vCard Editor instead of iOS Contacts app, and check and modify it, then export it to your Contacts or save it in the iCloud Drive as a file. Also you can use vCard Editor not only for viewing and editing vCard but also for a private AddressBook. And using embedded vCard Extention, you can export a contact to merge it to the other vCard file.

1478106935.name: 非常英雄救世奇缘
1478106935.description: 《非常英雄救世奇缘》手游是一款由完美世界游戏发行，并由旗下工作室研发的2D横版动作冒险类游戏。故事背景取材自中国第一部长篇神魔小说——《西游记》片段，手绘奇幻画风配合搞笑的情节，希望能给大家带来颠覆传统的游戏体验。 自开天辟地以来，真经一直维系着天地万物的平衡。但是世间的恶念不断攀升，最终打破了这种平衡，经卷被破坏，碎片散落各处。凡是接触到经卷碎片的生灵皆因为获得经卷的神力而变得强大无比，而这些原来弱小生灵心存的一点点恶念，也因为力量的强大而变得更加危险。天地间顿时混乱不堪………师徒四人接受了观音大师交给的使命，将散落的经卷碎片重新收集。 游戏通过格斗、解谜、收集、跑酷、平台跳跃等丰富玩法，展现了师徒四人一路斩妖除魔的奇幻旅程。在游戏过程中您需要合理运用师徒四人的攻击特性和各种法宝来进行战斗，与妖怪斗智斗勇，完成取经重任。 继登录Steam和各主机平台之后，《非常英雄救世奇缘》手游登场！ =主要特色=- 手绘奇幻特点尽显 场景在设计上，根据Boss性格的不同设计了不同的风格，蓝色阴郁的白骨洞，百眼魔君的黄花观，奇幻童话的阴曹地府，以及一片红火的火焰山，关卡设计上的丰富细节与层次感，使得场景的质感与设计思想都展现的恰到好处。 师徒四人自由切换 性格各异的师徒四人各有专属技能，大圣的金箍棒可以变长搭桥、老猪的身体可以变大成气球、沙僧的钢拳可以击碎巨石、三藏的佛光弹珠可以在关卡内弹射，玩家可以在战斗和非战斗情况下任意对登场的师徒四人进行切换，根据师徒四人的特性进行解谜和闯关。 动作表现行云流水 大圣的金箍棒的劈砍、冲刺，老猪的肥大身体的肉弹攻击有如浩克，沙僧拳拳到肉的拍、拨、推、挑近身技，而师傅三藏的出尘飘移与佛光的聚、散、离、合，则有一种面对妖魔鬼怪处事不惊的泰然自若。 玩法多样关关不同 从躲避障碍、烧脑解谜再到考验玩家反应速度的追逐玩法，不仅要对下落的巨石、炽热的熔岩、剧烈的狂风进行闪躲外，还需要运用筋斗云、芭蕉扇等经典道具进行通关，此外风格地府场景中，Q萌的射击玩法也为游戏增添了更多的乐趣，爽快、快乐、紧张、刺激……无处不在。 针对移动平台优化 对移动平台设备进行了特别优化，让大家在手机上也可以享受到更流畅的游戏体验。此外还针对游戏在手机上的操作难度，关卡游戏时间等进行了调整和优化，针对iOS14的新特性也在开展对手柄的适配工作。 = 部分媒体评分 =- = Nintendo Insider 9/10 =- = Nintendo Life 8/10 =- = IGN Spain 8.8/10 =- = Playstation Universe 9/10 =- = GameScore 8.5/10 =- = ZonaRed 9/10 =- = Hardcore Gamer 9/10 =- = GameReactor UK 8/10 =- = NplusX 9/10 =- = 3D Juegos 9/10 =-

1478486812.name: 楚辞-有声典藏版
1478486812.description: 我们收录了楚辞的全文并且整理了注释，译文，赏析，让你轻松体验文化之美。你也可以打开原声朗读功能，聆听文化。在使用过程中无需打开网络，也不会有任何广告干扰。 楚辞是屈原创作的一种新诗体，并且也是中国文学史上第一部浪漫主义诗歌总集。 “楚辞”的名称，西汉初期已有之，至刘向乃编辑成集。东汉王逸作章句。原收战国楚人屈原 、宋玉及汉代淮南小山、东方朔、王褒、刘向等人辞赋共十六篇。后王逸增入己作《九思》，成十七篇。全书以屈原作品为主，其余各篇也是承袭屈赋的形式。以其运用楚地（注：即今湖南、湖北一带）的文学样式、方言声韵和风土物产等，具有浓厚的地方色彩，故名《楚辞》，对后世诗歌产生深远影响。

1478742346.name: jigNOTES
1478742346.description: Talk only to your apple Watch, take short NOTES, see immediately all what you say texted onto your apple watch. Like remembering quick few words (like what you need on groceries), tag licence plates, names, ideas dictate anything into your apple watch. each note gets a matching or an unique random emoji to visualise the text as more rememberable the emojis come out of a preselectable good distinguishable set selectable Business/Game mode with different emojis and colors designed for your apple Watch, (no iPhone needed after installation) all apple watch generation/series are supported programmed in pure swift (recommended programming language by apple) 2 apple country languages supported no internet access needed for more than 2 languages (secure) runs on iOS 12.4 to iOS 14.5 and watchOS 4 to the watchOS 7.4 needs less memory, is very fast even on the first apple watch conserves battery power, no background activities to drain power intuitive emoji driven interface, no manual instructions to learn, it has a built in workflow, perfect even for kids for learning or for seniors to remember things color of the start button is customizable best for short notes, few words, about one page long, exceeding length will be automatically adjusted to conserve space all apple watch complications are supported for fast and easy access Instant jumpstart via any complications is also selectable, for superfast note no login needed, data remains always in the device, allows fast start to use no data collected, no login needed

1479012191.name: 为狐狸和绵羊快乐涂色
1479012191.trackName: 为狐狸和绵羊快乐涂色
1479012191.description: 发挥灵感，不让光阴虚度! 在合理，孩子们可以通过绘画发挥灵感，表现自我。我们的应用程序提供数不胜数的画笔、颜色和款式可供选择，孩子们永不会感到厌倦。小的错误很容易消除，从而把挫折感降到最低。 放松 当使用这一容易上手的应用涂色时，生活的烦恼也一扫而光。即便是孩子们，有时也需要忘掉每天的压力，而我们提供由Christian Maier作词作曲的舒缓音乐，让孩子的身心得到充分放松。 分享您的作品 您可以直接在应用程序中保存和发送。 亮点 使用方便。专门针对4岁以上的孩子作了优化。 由Karoline Pietrowski绘制，画面超可爱。 不需要连接因特网或无线网 - 随心所欲，尽情发挥！ 应用中没有付费项目。 关于 Fox & Sheep： 我们是来自柏林的儿童 App 工作室，为 2-8 岁的儿童开发高品质的游戏。 同样身为父母，我们带着对我们产品的热情和心血工作着。我们为我们的 App 选择全世界顶尖的插画师和动画师，为了能开发最美的 App 呈献给孩子们，以及带给我们和你们的孩子更丰富多彩的生活。

1479040615.description: 羊角包 - 宝宝一周营养餐编排工具 还在为宝宝一周吃什么发愁吗，羊角包可以帮助您，零压力做个高效妈妈。 可以灵活编排宝宝的一周营养餐，每天吃什么不用临时抱佛脚。自由添加、更换，选择最适合宝宝的餐食 真不知道做什么？菜品推荐功能根据已有的食谱和你的要求随时给你推荐适合宝宝的食物 营养分析功能， 自动检测一周的编排是否合理。根据宝宝不同的年龄段，提出膳食平衡的建议 买菜日到了，可以添加买菜清单，买了、没买一目了然 幼儿园、学校、周末模式，轻松根据宝宝情况进行编排 我们的使用条款请参考：https://docs.qq.com/doc/p/e783247068c467764785ea7b6d28615c92c89bdd

1479571640.description: XPics是一款令人惊叹的图片处理软件。功能包括:长图拼接、批量裁剪图片、滤镜、九宫格、分图、留白、二维码制作、白板、隐私相册、节日头像等功能。 【特点】 支持iPhone & iPad； 【长图拼接】24张原图拼接，原图画质输出，支持横竖两个方向，一键自动拼接; 【图片批量裁剪】批量裁剪图片，自定义裁剪区域，可移动、可拉伸裁剪区域；； 【九宫格】将多张图片以网格形式拼接为一张图片; 【留白】为图片留白； 【滤镜】14款精挑细选的优质滤镜； 【分图】将一张图片等比例切割为多张图； 【自由拼图】多张图片自由拼接； 【时间轴】多张图片组合成故事墙； 【二维码制作】将文字生成为二维码图片； 【白板】图片涂鸦； 【隐私相册】存放私密照片、视频； JPics作者出品，原图画质输出；无广告，无内购； PS:后续版本会上线更多功能，敬请期待 （分割线）-------- 如果大家喜欢用XPics，请花费几分钟时间评价一下。 反馈公众号：杰克的独白 如果喜欢可以把 XPics 介绍给你的朋友做为支持

1479572902.description: Neongraf受科幻，霓虹灯黑和赛博朋克的启发，可以帮助您通过照片或视频捕捉夜晚的美丽。 ● 滤镜预设 梦幻般的美学，动感的灯光和生动的调色板，是将照片和视频传输到高科技世界的基本元素。 Neongraf提供了30种出色的赛博朋克风格预设，这些预设适当地结合了这些元素。 ● 调节工具 您可以改变曝光，对比度，温度，色调和清晰度，增强阴影和高光，添加星光效果, 晕影和色差等等。 ● 图层效果 您可以通过组合提供的叠加层来创建自己的外观。 图层物包括散景灯，VHS故障和粒状纹理。

1479923124.name: Simple Sleep Timer for Babies
1479923124.description: 照顾宝宝时，记录睡眠应该只需轻点一下，而不是增加一项复杂任务。宝宝睡眠计时器专为 Apple Watch 打造，即使双手正忙着抱宝宝，也能直接在手腕上开始或结束睡眠记录。 重要信息，一眼看清 查看宝宝目前正在睡觉还是清醒，以及当前状态持续了多久 查看今天的睡眠总时长，以及最近的睡眠和清醒记录 通过简洁的 7 天图表了解每日平均睡眠和最长连续睡眠 浏览完整历史记录，并随时删除误记的单条记录 表盘上随时可见 将宝宝睡眠添加到支持的 Apple Watch 表盘复杂功能位置或智能叠放中，无需打开 App，也能快速查看宝宝当前状态和持续时间。 使用 Siri 让 Siri 开始记录睡眠、标记宝宝已经醒来，或查询当前睡眠状态。喂奶、哄睡或深夜醒来时，都能免动手快速操作。 为疲惫的父母而设计 大尺寸按钮、清晰配色、动态字体和旁白支持，让不同尺寸的 Apple Watch 和辅助功能设置都易于使用。界面支持英语、简体中文、繁体中文、法语、德语、日语和韩语。 隐私优先 睡眠历史仅保存在你的 Apple Watch 本地。无需账户，没有广告，也不会由外部服务器收集宝宝的作息数据。你可以随时在“关于”中重置所有数据。 宝宝睡眠计时器专注做好一件事：以最简单的方式帮助你了解宝宝的睡眠。

1479976538.description: 此应用程序使用有关您当前底盘设置，冷热轮胎压力，轮胎温度，角落行为，天气和赛道状况的数据，将为您提供有关如何调整底盘以解决任何设置问题的建议。对于每个建议，您都会找到有关调整的说明。每个解释都包含更易理解的图片 该应用程序适用于所有类型的卡丁车和所有卡丁车类。它对经验丰富或新手司机很有用。对于有经验的人来说，它将是关于机箱设置有什么问题的第二个意见，对于新手来说，它会告诉他们机箱调整和机箱设置的秘密 该应用程序包含四个选项卡，下面将对其进行描述 底盘：在此选项卡上，您可以输入有关卡丁车底盘，轮胎，位置，天气，发动机，变速箱，驱动器和压载物配置的数据。 例如： 前后高度 前后轮毂长度 前轮毂垫片 前后扭杆 脚趾/脚趾外出 阿克曼 Camber Caster 前后保险杠状态 后轴刚性 后轴承 sidepods州 第4扭杆 座位的支柱 Rain Meister 座位类型 座位大小 座位 轮胎类型 车轮材料 司机重量 压载位置和重量 和更多... 历史记录：此选项卡包含推车底盘所有设置的历史记录。如果您在机箱中设置了某些内容或更改了天气，赛道，条件 - 新设置数据将自动保存在历史记录中 分析：此选项卡包含三种类型的机箱行为分析 驾驶分析：你必须告知驾驶员如何感受角落里卡丁车的行为。在“拐角处的行为”部分中，您必须输入有关驾驶员对卡丁车底盘行为的感受的信息（例如，在拐角处进入转向不足）。这些是应用程序用于计算建议的最重要信息。您还应输入有关赛道的信息，顺时针或逆时针，当前天气预报（可通过互联网自动检测天气）。计算时考虑了所有要素 压力分析：您必须告知每个轮胎的热和冷压力，车轮（铝或镁），目标轮胎温度，当前天气和赛道条件 温度分析：您必须在此屏幕中设置每个轮胎补丁内侧，中间和外侧的热轮胎温度，车轮（铝或镁），目标轮胎温度，当前天气和赛道条件的信息 温度：您可以在此屏幕中设置有关工作表面内部，中部和外部的热轮胎温度的信息 然后单击“分析”按钮，应用程序将显示一些建议，说明您可以采取哪些调整来解决您可能遇到的机箱设置中的任何问题。将显示包含调整详细信息的屏幕。例如：“Insrease front track width”或“修改轮胎压力”（你应该调整多少压力）或改变你的驾驶风格 工具：在此选项卡上，您可以找到有用的卡丁车实用程序。燃油计算器，用于完美的燃油混合。重量和平衡，以获得完美的卡丁车重量分布。化油器设置的空气密度和密度高度（JETTING）。以及更多 该应用程序允许您使用不同的测量单位：温度为ºCyºF，压力为PSI和BAR，重量为lb和kg，长度为毫米和英寸，mb，hPa，mmHg，大气压为inHg，高度为米和英尺，加仑，盎司，毫升和升的体积。

1480037666.name: Spring Reverb
1480037666.description: Spring Reverb models the sound and character of popular spring reverbs found in guitar amplifiers, popularized by Surf, Garage and Rockabilly music. Spring takes this a step further by allowing manipulation of physical parameters not normally available in a real spring tank. The results vary from faithful recreations of real springs to distinctive new sounds that push the physical boundaries of reverb. Guitarists love the revered surfer vibe but all creative musicians will find that Spring makes any synthesizer, drum, or vocal stand out in a mix. This vintage reverb sound originally derived from the reflections of sound waves traveling through springs has been given an overhaul for the 21st century and beyond. Eventide Spring contains two different sized ‘spring tanks’ along with the ability to morph between one and three springs. Easily program The Ribbon to seamlessly transition between any two settings in real-time! The added tube-amp-style tremolo can be routed before or after the spring resulting in an unrivaled ability to craft your own unique reverb sound. Alter the intensity by changing the tremolo depth and adjust the tremolo rate in Hz, or note value when tempo-synced to your project. Features: Artist presets by Matt Lange, Nick Hook, and Nu-Trix. Tempo Sync reverb decay to your DAW. Craft original sounds by changing the number of springs and damping frequency. Alter overall resonance by selecting the size of the spring tank. Tube-amp-style tremolo that can be routed pre- or post-reverb. Create chorus-like effects by altering Modulation Level. The Ribbon controller allows for dynamic modification of several knobs at once to easily morph between settings. Programmable Hotswitch provides the ability to jump instantly to an alternate sound at the push of a button. Available as an Audio Units AUv3 plug-in and Standalone App.

This app teaches Python deep learning deeply and its libraries like Numpy, Scipy, Pandas, Matplotlib; frameworks like Theano, TensorFlow, Keras. 1480150563.name: TB Barricade
1480150563.description: ToneBoosters Barricade is a studio-quality, professional, true-peak limiter and peak compressor AUv3 plug-in with a gorgeous interface and integrated ITU / EBU compliant loudness measurement. The ToneBoosters Barricade app captures the microphone input and processes the signals in real time. To use it as a plug-in, use an AUv3-compatible host app such as Steinberg Cubasis, Apple Garageband, Audio Evolution Mobile Studio, Auria, AUM, or others. ToneBoosters Barricade will appear in the list of Audio Unit extensions for effect plug-ins. Key features: Studio-grade, transparent peak limiting The same professional sound as the acclaimed desktop version ITU and EBU-compliant true-peak limiting option Integrated ITU and EBU compliant loudness meter Input modeller for analog circuitry simulation and saturation Accurate metering of input and output levels, as well as attenuation Simultaneous peak, peak hold, and RMS metering Fully automatic, content dependent or manual tuning of limiter behaviour Undo/redo, and A/B comparison Color themes for the user interface Max screen support in Garageband Optimised for iPad and compatible with iPhone and iPod Touch What you should know: Licenses acquired for this platform are not compatible with other platforms. Audio Unit (AUv3) extensions require an iPad mini 2, iPad 4 or later models.

1480799870.name: Learn to Code in React Js
1480799870.trackName: Learn to Code in React Js
1480799870.description: Learn React — a hands‑on React tutorial and React course that helps you master ReactJS and front-end JavaScript development with practice, projects and an AI tutor. This app will make you a complete job ready React developer with weeks. With it's consice & to the point lectures, you will learn react in the most enjoyable way. You will learn basics to advanced react concepts step by step and by building real world react.js projects. And not just that, along side react, you will learn other react frameworks and libraries that you can use with react and build something amazing. You will also learn how to develop mobile applications with react. So If you are a new react developer and thinking of learning React.js and starting a full time react developer career then this app is going to be your best friend. What is React btw? React is the most popular Library and React developers are high in demand right now and so many other opportunities are available for React Developers. You can develop Native Mobile apps with React. So this is the best time to learn React and become a High Demand Developer. This app contains all the major topics of React with Excellent Code Examples and projects. All the topics contain code examples so you can get a better understanding of what's going on. We are constantly updating this app with every new major React js release and adding more code snippets, Examples, and Projects. Why this React course works Interactive lessons: clear, bite-sized React tutorials that teach React fundamentals and advanced techniques. Hands‑on projects: build real apps (todo app, weather dashboard, e‑commerce example) to apply React knowledge. AI Tutor & code help: ask the in-app AI Tutor to explain concepts, debug code or get tips on React hooks, state management and React Router. Quizzes & checks: knowledge checks and short quizzes to reinforce learning and retention. Practical code snippets: copyable examples for ReactJS, hooks (useState, useEffect), Redux and API integration. What you’ll learn Core React basics and JSX React hooks (useState, useEffect, custom hooks) State management patterns and Redux React Router & navigation Data fetching and APIs Forms and validation, accessibility and performance optimization Testing, deployment and real-world app structure Perfect for beginners and experienced developers Whether you’re learning React for the first time or leveling up with advanced React patterns, this React tutorial gives structured lessons, hands-on projects and guided practice to build real React applications. Get results fast Short lessons for focused learning Track progress and milestones Practice with real projects, then build your portfolio Use the AI tutor for instant explanations and debugging So if you like our effort please rate this app or comment below if you want to give us any suggestions or ideas. Thanks

1481127656.name: METAR Plot
1481127656.description: METAR Plot for Apple Watch displays station models (plots) as well as raw METARs for most airports worldwide, using current METAR data. The app features two stations lists: nearby and user-defined. While the entire station database can be used offline (to add station or lookup nearby station), an internet connection is required to load METAR data. Data is updated automatically. Preferences can be set for type of flight rules and units (visibility, temperature, and pressure). Options for observation time in LT or UTC as well as sort order of user list. The app works completely independent from your iPhone and includes complications for watch faces with rectangular and circular types.

1481221097.name: 河洛理数
1481221097.description: 相传河洛之法创自陈抟、卲雍，以生时干支入河图洛书，推其天地阴阳之数以起卦，数统先天，而卦运后天，起运推卦，以至于年月日，则一生之气数卦运，丝毫毕现。然此可谓命术之中，至为正大者，其以卦推命，并非欲限人之命运于一卦之内，而是于卦象之中，示人以当往之地、当行之事、当断之机、当明之理也。此则贵如千金，故先贤有知此法者，常订本年本月之卦象于房内，日夜观省，浅可以决事，深则能修德。此与近世子平八字之术大为不同，近世子平能断人之生旺兴衰，却不能予人掌握自身命运之法，四柱八字之下，大运流年之中，常人令人觉自身命运皆已生定，不作努力之想。而张口问命，也只欲知眼前运势如何，告之旺则喜，衰则哀，不知运势之来，其根源全然在己，五行甲子，不过载运之器尔。故河洛卦象可贵之处，正在于此，虽河洛之法亦重气数，但其总归，只在于卦。历久以来，人只知算卦，却不知用卦，若知用卦，则福德之基，全在于此。 故今将河洛之法制成掌中之软件，生时生地一定，便可起卦，而先天后天，大运流年，以及月日之卦象皆可方便观之。而古之卦辞，或与人之命运不甚相合，因此将自为其观象得辞，渐次更新，使人观辞便可解象，纵然不通卦象之人，也能因卦而知所当行之事，当明之理，人生正途，不过如此。 本款App起课简便，输入地点便可自动解析地理信息，并推算真太阳时以定四柱，亦可自行判断处理夏令时，全球范围皆可通用。如起课不以真太阳时定时刻，则万难应验。以北京与成都而言，二者相差十三度有余，虽同用一标准北京时间，但实际往往北京已入辰时，而成都尤在卯时，两者时间实际相差三刻有余，故必以真太阳时起课方有准。

1481738048.name: Pro Altimeter for Watch
1481738048.description: Pro Altimeter for Watch is the newest Watch app from Hunter Research, developer of the popular outdoors app Theodolite. Pro Altimeter uses the high-fidelity barometric pressure sensor in the Apple Watch to measure and compute altitude. Although this is a Watch app, it has the same features, capabilities, and accuracy as the Pro Altimeter app for iPhone and iPad, just in a smaller form factor on your wrist! Pro Altimeter has a dead simple interface. Barometric altitude and GPS altitude are displayed in large easy to read numbers, with available units of feet or meters, and realtime accuracy estimates from the hardware. At bottom are calibration and settings buttons. The display offers highly-readable color schemes of luminescent green on black, white on black, and midnight red on black. Proper calibration is necessary to measure altitude from barometric pressure (this is why a pilot "dials in" the cockpit altimeter before taking off). Pro Altimeter offers numerous methods for calibration -- choose the easiest and most convenient: 1. Use GPS altitude. This method correlates the measured local barometric pressure with the altitude measured by GPS. This method can be used when your device has a clear line of sight to the sky and a reliable GPS fix with good accuracy that you trust. 2. Manually enter altitude in feet or meters. This method correlates the measured local barometric pressure with known altitude from landmarks, elevation benchmarks, trail markers, topo maps, land surveys, etc. 3. Manually enter pressure. If you have a weather station, weather report, or METAR report with equivalent sea level pressure for a nearby location, this can be used to correlate local barometric pressure to altitude. Pressure can be entered with units of inches Hg, kPa, or mb. 4. Check local airports. With the tap of a button, Pro Altimeter will locate the five closest airports within 100 miles (160km) of your present location anywhere in the world, and pull in METAR data. From that list of five, pick the airport of your choice and Pro Altimeter will import pressure data for calibration. Once calibrated, Pro Altimeter keeps track of the time since its last calibration. Because weather and local barometric pressure change over time, the app will warn you when 6 hours have elapsed since the last calibration by flashing the "CAL" button. You should calibrate as frequently as practical -- for example, on a hike, calibrate whenever you pass a trail marker or elevation benchmark, or hourly. But at a minimum, calibrate at least every 6 hours or whenever weather changes in your area. Pro Altimeter runs on all Apple Watch models running watchOS 9.6 or later.

1481813196.name: Ensemble Friends
1481813196.description: 实现大家想要变成高手的愿望。 “Ensemble Friends”是在iPhone和iPad上启动的“支援合奏app。 ENSEMBLE FRIENDS FEATURES: 节拍器[Simple] 演奏的时候也很容易地操作！ 慢板急板都可以。适应各种各样的速度。 除了4/4拍子、6/8拍子以外，19/16拍子等所有拍子都没问题。 应对8个小节以下的变拍子。 不同的节奏同时能放音，并且，能调节个别音量。 节拍器[Advanced] 瞬息万变的曲子也没问题！高功能节拍器模式。 根据实际的乐曲能设定拍子和速度的变化。 与别的设备能分享拍子、速度的设定。声部练习的时候也很有用！ 键盘 具有能确认纯率和弦的键盘 提供练习乐器时最好的音色。 提供移调功能，移调乐器的练习也没问题。 提供纯律、自然七度模式。为了学习和弦最适合的支援工具。 ●主要规格 节拍器（共同） 速度：每分20～280 拍子：分子：1～20，分母：2/4/8/16 同时发音节奏：强拍/4分音符/8分音符/16分音符 连音符选择：1拍3连音符/2拍3连音符 节拍器 [Simple] 設定可能拍子数：1〜8 节拍器 [Advanced] 设定可能小节数：1～999小节 每一个小节的设定可能拍子数：1～8 app里储存拍子组合数：20组 键盘 音色数：4种（长笛/单簧管/小号/小提琴） 移调：-7～+7（半音） app里表示键盘音域：C1～C8（共85个） 音乐会A：427.5〜452.9赫兹（-50.0〜50.0分） 律式：平均律/纯律（大调）/纯律（小调） 自然7度：开/关（只在选择纯律时生效） 持续功能：开/关 MIDI input: on/off

1481853033.name: Strongbox Pro
1481853033.description: Strongbox 是一款用于安全存储所有密码并由一个主密码保护的应用程序。支持开源的 Password Safe 和 KeePass 格式。 功能 *** 面容 ID 或 触控 ID 解锁，方便、安全、快捷。 PIN 码解锁与 Duress PIN 选项，为那些棘手的情况。 YubiKey 保护 - 用硬件令牌保护您的数据库。 安全 - 由经过时间检验的军事级加密技术保护。 私密性 - 为您的敏感文件、照片和视频提供隔离的应用程序内附件查看器。 审计您的密码 - 自动检查您数据库的弱密码，包括 "Have I Been Pwned?" 检查。 云支持，所以你可以使用 iCloud、Dropbox、OneDrive、Google Drive、WebDAV 或 SFTP 安全地访问您的云，即使您处于离线状态。使用内建的文件应用程序，以获得许多其他存储选项，或仅在您的本地设备上安全地存储它们。由您选择您的存储方式。 通过深度搜索，即时、强大地搜索您的整套密码和隐私。自动完成新条目，并自动生成安全密码。 兼容 - 通过文件应用程序、电子邮件、CSV、iTunes 文件共享或使用云存储导入/导出。 符合标准 - 使用经过时间检验的 Password Safe 和 KeePass 格式，所以你可以导入任何现有的密码保险箱。 功能丰富 令人难以置信的可配置密码生成，包括 Diceware(XKCD) 和常规密码。 定时自动清除剪贴板。 输入历史。 KeePass 字段偏好、标签、自定义图标和收藏夹图标 (包括自动搜索和下载)。 双因素验证码 (TOTP) - 二维码、Steam 和手动。 Strongbox 是免费增值应用 ***。 这意味着 Strongbox 是免费的，但如果你喜欢，也有增强的专业功能。如果你愿意，你可以选择 90 天免费试用所有的专业功能，没有任何账单，但大多数人认为免费版完全足够。 Strongbox 为 Pro 版提供应用内购买服务 (包括自动续订和一次性付款)。 也有直接/预付 (即非应用内购买) 的选项，详情请见 Strongbox 网站。 订阅可自动续订，并可循环计费。可随时取消。 订阅的时间段为每月、每三个月或每年，由用户自行决定。 用户还可以选择购买 "终身" 的 Pro 版应用。 付款将在确认购买时从 iTunes 账户中扣除。 除非在当期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动更新功能，否则订阅将自动更新。 账户将在当期结束前 24 小时内进行续费，并确定续费费用。 用户可对订阅进行管理，购买后可进入用户的账户设置中关闭自动续费功能。 如果有提供免费试用期，其任何未使用部分将在用户购买订阅后被收回。 Strongbox 的隐私政策可以在这里找到: https://strongboxsafe.com/privacy-policy/ Strongbox 的使用条款可以在这里找到: https://strongboxsafe.com/terms/

1481960751.name: Shapecraft
1481960751.description: Shapecraft is a game about finding the final form. Join the pieces together and craft new shapes in this calm and beautiful puzzler. Your goal is simple - put the blocks into the right places. Join the slices to reveal a new shape, but remember to light up all the little dots! Putting pieces together is one thing, but finding the right combination is a challenge. This calm and peaceful puzzle game will help you relax and focus. The atmospheric music and colorful backgrounds will let you clear your head. You need your mind in shape to find the solution. No need to hurry - you have all the time in the world. Enjoy! Thank you so much for playing and supporting our games! Want to share feedback, suggest a new feature or found a bug? 1482172285.name: LineupMovie for Baseball
1482172285.description: This is a lineup creation app for baseball and softball. Let's create a lineup of your team and your favorite professional team and share it on social media. ◉ Easily create an animated lineup ◉ Share as image or movie ◉ Display players using uniform image, photo image, 3 seconds video or live photo ◉ Can create all-star team or best nine using multiple teams ◉ Other Features ＊ Can set designated hitters up to 10 players per lineup ＊ Support short fielder or right center fielder and left center fielder for softball ＊ Can set substitutes ＊ Multiple background themes ＊ Create uniform image with multiple types and free colors ＊ Can add multiple uniform images for each team. ＊ Can make backup data ＊ Unlimited teams and players can be added ＊ Unlimited lineups can be added ＊ Can duplicate lineup

1482725385.name: Fractal Bits
1482725385.description: Fractal Bits is a drum synth with over four billion unique sounds created by fractal algorithms. Each set of 12 drums corresponds to a code of 8 characters (you can save/copy/paste it as plain text). Features: Audio Unit Extension (AUv3), Audiobus; search for new sounds with three buttons: next random set, edit code, previous set; three types of keyboards for live drumming: on-screen buttons, PC keyboard, MIDI input; several processing parameters + control via MIDI; real-time audio recording to WAV (32-bit); export to: WAV (one file or a set), SunVox (samples + effects in one file), text clipboard; the LCK button freezes individual drums - they will not change during the search for new sets; Wi-Fi export/import. Double clicking on a parameter opens a window for setting the exact value. If you enable the Hold option, the notes will play endlessly, without reacting to key release (noteOff) events; turning the note on again works like turning it off; there are two ways to enable this option: 1) using the Hold parameter in the "MIDI Mapping" window; 2) by pressing the HOLD button, which appears in place of LCK while playing the musical keyboard: press HOLD, release the desired notes - then the released notes will continue to play.
