1501873314.name: Health App to Strava Sync
1501873314.description: Upload your data from Apple Health to Strava in seconds. After syncing, you can view your fitness data on the Strava app or in your Strava.com account. Apple Health to Strava Sync can sync up to 6 fields. You can customize the app to only sync the fields you want. If there are other fields you'd like us to support, please contact us at support@bickster.com - we'd love to hear your feedback! Running Cycling Walking Swimming Elliptical Weight Training Apple Health to Strava Sync will not overwrite any data you currently have in Strava Before using the app, please read the instructions to make sure everything is set up correctly for a seamless transfer of data After reading the instructions, please contact support if you have any issues. We would love to help you. Reach us at support@bickster.com or http://www.myfitnesssync.com/support Syncing your Apple Health app everyday with Health App to Strava Sync allows you to use the Strava app and your account at strava.com to view your fitness data. Select from multiple sources like your iPhone, Apple Watch, Garmin watches and other fitness devices, or other walking, running, and workout apps that sync with your iPhone and Apple Health. The app will try to sync your Apple Health data to Strava in the background multiple times per day. Auto-sync may take a few days to work, as iOS controls this process based on user behavior. For privacy reasons, iOS will not run an auto-sync if your phone is locked - this can cause auto-sync delays. Your Apple Watch does not stay up-to-the-minute in sync with Apple Health on your phone. This can cause the data on your Strava dashboard to be slightly out of sync with your Apple Watch. If you need your Strava dashboard to be exactly in sync with your Apple Watch please launch the Apple Activity app on your phone before syncing with our app. Launching the Activity app forces your Apple Watch to sync with your phone. Launching the Activity app before syncing with our app is not required because by the end of the day your Apple Watch will be in sync with Apple Health and all of your data will be synced to your Strava account. We want hear from you!! If encounter any issues or would like to request a new feature please email support@bickster.com or click the "App Support" button in the App Store. HOW DOES IT WORK Data is synced using 3 easy steps. 1. In the Health App to Strava Sync app, sign into Strava.com using your account credentials. 2. Pick the fitness fields you want to sync with your Strava account. 3. Click the "Sync Now" button to start syncing your Apple Health data with your Strava account DISCLAIMER: We are not affiliated with the mentioned companies in any way. We only developed and tested our App with their platforms. Strava is a trademark of Strava Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. Please Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life. Our tests have shown that our app only uses 1% or less of your battery while running in the background.

1502685866.name: Fastest 3D Camera
1502685866.description: The fastest method for 3D photography. Excellent UI design with just one touch on the camera screen. This is a system that creates parallax between the image at touchdown and the image at touchup. (Touchdown-> Move the camera a little sideways-> Touchup-> Stop shooting) Anaglyph support. Anyone can see 3D photos using red and blue glasses. In addition, this app supports autostereoscopic vision. You can see either the parallel method or the intersection method. [About Anaglyph] If you have strong strabismus, use red / blue glasses to view in anaglyph mode. Red and blue glasses can be easily made with cellophane sold at hundred-yen shops. Those who can perform autostereoscopic viewing can also enjoy stereoscopic viewing by turning off the anaglyph mode. [About autostereoscopic vision] This is a method of viewing the image of the left eye and the image of the right eye with the naked eye while feeling the three-dimensional image in three dimensions. There are two methods for autostereoscopic viewing: the parallel method and the cross method. The parallel method is a method in which the left image is viewed with the left eye and the right image is viewed with the right eye. The cross method is a method of viewing the left image with the right eye and the right image with the left eye. You can easily find out how to practice the parallel method and dating method by searching the web. Stereoscopic vision is said to improve the ability to focus with both eyes and help restore vision. It is thought to promote the movement of the eye muscles and visual field, thereby activating the brain. [Settings] Anaglyph mode: ON / OFF Stereoscopic Image Layout: [1] [2] / [2] [1] Please switch appropriately according to the parallel method or the cross method. Storage resolution: 20-100% of original resolution [output] Save to camera roll: 3D photo 3D photo sharing: AirDrop, LINE, Facebook, Dropbox, Instagram, ...

1502803776.name: Memmoread - TOEIC® Reading
1502803776.description: คลังข้อสอบ Toeic Reading รวบรวมข้อสอบโทอิคพาร์ทอ่าน และข้อสอบแบบควิซ มาไว้ที่เดี่ยวและแบ่งย่อยเป็นควิซสั้นๆ และข้อสอบจริง 100 ข้อ พร้อมเฉลยภาษาไทยแบบละเอียด อีกทั้งมีเฉลยข้อสอบเป็น VDO คอร์สเรียนตะลุยโจทย์ เพื่อให้ผู้ใช้ฝึกทำข้อสอบ Toeic Reading ได้ทุกที่ ทุกเวลา เพิ่มความสะดวกในการฝึกฝนการทำข้อสอบ พร้อมเฉลยในทุกๆ ควิซ Memmoread Toeic Reading Practice แอพนี้รวบรวม Toeic Reading Test ที่เหมือนข้อสอบจริง มาแบ่งย่อยให้เป็นพาร์ทต่างๆ ตามแบบฉบับของข้อสอบโทอิต แอพนี้เน้นที่ข้อสอบที่เป็นบทความ จึงได้รวบรวมข้อสอบโทอิคไว้ได้แก่ Toeic Reading Test Part 5: Incomplete sentences Toeic Reading Test Part 6: Text Completion Toeic Reading Test Part 7: Paragraphs ข้อสอบโทอิคภายในแอพเป็นรูปแบบใหม่ที่ใช้สอบ Toeic ในประเทศไทยแบบใหม่ ซึ่งรูปแบบใหม่นี้จะเริ่มใช้สอบตั้งแต่ปี 2020 เป็นต้นไป รายละเอียดของการเปลี่ยนแปลงของข้อสอบ Toeic และสิ่งใหม่ที่สามารถพบเจอได้ภายในแอพนี้ ส่ิงที่เหมือนเดิมของโทอิคพาร์ทอ่านที่เป็นบทความ คือ ยังประกอบด้วยพาร์ทหลัก คือ Toeic Reading Test Part 6: Text Completion และ Toeic Reading Test Part 7: Paragraphs ซึ่งสิ่งใหม่ที่ผู้ใช้จะได้พบในการสอบโทอิคการอ่านแบบใหม่คือ เพิ่มข้อแบบให้เลือกประโยคลงไปเติมในบทความ (พารท์ 6) เพิ่มบทความแบบ 3 บทความให้อ่านเชื่อมโยงกัน จากปกติที่สูงสุดแค่ 2 ส่วน (พาร์ท 7) คุณสามารถพบเจอกับข้อสอบแบบใหม่ได้ภายได้แอพนี้ เทคนิคการทำข้อสอบโทอิค Toeic Reading Test Part 6: Text Completion Toeic รูปแบบเดิม: จะเป็นโจทย์แบบให้เลือกเติมคำ โดยเป็นคำศัพท์สั้นๆ Toeic รูปแบบใหม่: ยังคงเป็นการเติมช่องว่าง แต่จะมีบางข้อที่ให้เติมเป็นประโยค แทนการเติมคำ แนวการตอบ: จากที่แต่ก่อนเราสามารถดูแค่ประโยคนั้นๆ เพื่อหาคำตอบได้ สำหรับโจทย์ที่ให้เติมเป็นประโยคแบบนี้ ต้องอ่านประโยครอบๆ เพิ่มเติมด้วยว่ากำลังพูดถึงอะไร และเนื้อหาเป็นไปในทิศทางไหน เพื่อเลือกประโยคให้เหมาะสมที่สุด Toeic Reading Test Part 7: Paragraphs Toeic รูปแบบเดิม: เป็นใบประกาศ โฆษณา หรืออีเมลตอบโต้ Toeic รูปแบบใหม่: เพิ่มรูปแบบ chat log หรือหน้าต่างแชทเข้ามาด้วย ให้อ่านแล้วตอบคำถาม โจทย์บางชุดสำหรับ Reading Comprehension จะให้ข้อมูลมา 3 ส่วน เพื่อให้อ่านเชื่อมโยงกัน แล้วตอบคำถาม (จากของเก่าที่มากสุดมีแค่ 2 ส่วน) โดยทั้ง 3 ส่วนอาจจะเป็นข้อมูลจากหน้าเว็บ, อีเมล, และใบประกาศ แนวการตอบ: ถึงรูปแบบจะเปลี่ยนไป แต่การทำโจทย์ยังคล้ายเดิม คือถามถึงประโยคนึงจากการแชท เพราะงั้นเราต้องลองย้อนอ่านดูว่าเขากำลังพูดถึงเรื่องอะไรอยู่ เพื่อดูว่ามีความเกี่ยวข้องกับประโยคที่เขาถามยังไง หรือกรณีข้อสอบสามบทความ เราจะต้องอ่านโจทย์ และเช็คข้อมูลจาก 2 หรือทั้ง 3 ส่วนเพื่อหาคำตอบ Trademark Disclaimer: TOEIC is a registered trademark of Educational Testing Service (ETS) in the United States and other countries. This app is not endorsed or approved by ETS.

1502818559.name: ACNH Travel Guide
1502818559.description: ACNH Travel Guide is the ultimate companion app for Animal Crossing: New Horizons. It provides you with all the information you need while playing the game, and lets you track your progress as well. This is the most complete companion app you will find. ACNH Travel Guide includes bugs, fish, DIY Recipes, furniture, clothing, fossils, sea creatures, flowers, villagers, wallpapers and floorings, art, songs, shells, tools, reactions, events, and even fruits. You can also use the app to keep a track of your daily tasks, turnip prices, and visitors. The app is very easy and fast to use, with no ads, no locked features, and no subscriptions. The app contains all items added in the recent 3.0 update. You can change the names of all the items in the app to Chinese and 9 other languages. All information you'll ever need on your island adventure: Detailed information on fish, bugs and sea creatures, so you know exactly when they are available, for how much they sell, and much more Browse all DIY recipes, see what they sell for and the materials needed Check detailed info on entire catalog, including all furniture and clothing and all their variations See all the information on all the villagers in the game, including their personality, birthday, and best gifts for them Other items you find in the app include art, flowers, fruit, reactions, posters & photos, wallpapers & floors, Nook Miles islands, and more Handy tools: Keep a list of daily tasks to make sure you never forget to talk to your favorite village, plant a money tree, and more Track your turnip prices and see them visualized on a graph See a full list of all flower colors, including information on how to get hybrid flower colors A lost item guide so you can easily bring those back to their rightful owner Easily interpret Katrina's fortune readings for your daily luck and friendship statuses The Home tab, all the information you need at one place: Quick search through all items in the app Track and share your progress on the critters you've caught, the DIY Recipes you've unlocked, and all other items in the app Quickly see what's available to catch right now and this month, and which critters are new this month or will leave soon This week's visitors A graph of your current turnip prices throughout the week Upcoming events and villager birthdays The current zodiac sign (for when there's a meteor shower happening) A notepad to take notes while playing Fully customizable to your own needs and preferences: The names of all items can be shown in English, German, Spanish, Italian, French, Dutch, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Russian. Keep track of multiple islands all in this one app, and easily switch between them Supports both Northern and Southern Hemisphere Supports changing the time in the app for time travelers Supports all the iOS features you're looking for: This is a fully native app, that's fast and feels right at home on iOS Dark Mode is supported for all those nightly play sessions A lot of Home Screen Widgets, for your progress, currently available critters, random items, and more All your data is synced and backed up to iCloud All data is available offline, so you can use the app even while you're on the go The data in the app is updated regularly and downloaded automatically in the background Search for all items in the app right from your homescreen Export and share all lists as text, image, or CSV Support for accessibility features such as VoiceOver Built with love by an Animal Crossing player just like you No ads, no locked features, no subscriptions. Pay once and use the full app forever, without any limitations. No (privacy-invading) data collection, and a privacy policy you'll actually understand Every adventurer needs a Travel Guide, and this is just the one for all New Horizons players. This is a third-party app and not affiliated with Nintendo Co. Ltd.

1502851960.name: Calendar Timeline
1502851960.description: With the Calendar Timeline App for watchOS you'll get a nice overview of the calendar entries within the next seven days – also reminder for today and earlier are supported in one single app. The app comes with a set of complications – also with a nice big complication for Modular Duo and Infograph Modular watch faces. In this complication you'll see all events and reminder of the day and got the next one display above. HUGE Update: Now you can choose your favorite style! Fixed timeline: Fixed timespan from 6 am to 12 am Dynamic timeline: The timeline shows the timespan from first to last event of the day with 1 hour padding each side Dynamic timeline with actual time: Like dynamic but with the actual time marker (if before first or past last event) Moving timeline: You will see a 4 hour timespan for the future and the timeline is moving through the day (only style where the next day do not get shown when after 6 pm and past the last event) Also you can choose if you like the full big image on your watch face or like the next event text and actual date on top of the timeline. You can switch on text in timeline which (mostly) fully displays your event text. Even add you favorite tint color. With these settings you can configure your own style on your own watch face! IMPORTANT NOTE ** The big graph complication / widget only runs with Apple Watch Series 4 and higher (high detail watch faces like Modular Duo, Infograph Modular or Infograph Compact watch faces). MDM (company) managed devices may do not provide calendar data even when granted access since watchOS only apps cannot read MDM profiles. Since watchOS 10 the Complication maybe need some time to refresh to new settings due to Apples refresh policy. CANNOT RE-DOWNLOAD THE APP? ** For watchOS only apps you need to open AppStore on your watch itself and search for calendar timeline to re-download the app. Sorry for that, but that's Apples flow for watchOS only apps.

1503080791.name: scan my T3SLA
1503080791.description: This app requires some hardware to work: OBDLink MX+, vLinker FS bluetooth, or S3XY Commander An OBD2 adapter cable to connect to your car's canbus (the OBD2 port has no data in it) Information and links are integrated in the app and in our home page, scanmytesla.com This app connects to your car's CAN-bus, and can read lots of interesting and entertaining information such as temperatures, motor torque, battery power and capacity, and much much more. This app is not affiliated with Tesla Inc. Most CANBUS packets decoded by Jason Hughes (skie.net) Battery cell info decoded by Jack Rickard (evtv.me) DC/AC Charge counters publicized by "DB 2" HVAC controls by Marc Olivier Chouinard (teslalog.com) Trip recording system idea by Marc Olivier Chouinard (teslalog.com) Model 3 decoding community led by Josh Wardell on https://teslaownersonline.com/threads/diagnostic-port-and-data-access.7502/ Disclaimer This software is not affiliated with Tesla Inc. Information shown in this app was not meant for the public and may be inaccurate, subject to change or disappear as the car gets software updates. This information is presented for entertainment purposes, and for learning more about how your car works. 1503104440.name: 我的照片素描&素描相机&铅笔手绘

1503171504.description: "拼音学习 - Pinyin learning"帮助您使用拼音快速掌握中文发音和中文词意。 "拼音学习 - Pinyin learning"是专业的汉语拼音学习平台，本APP提供中文转拼音,中文使用场景学习,汉字学习,学习声母,学习韵母,学习整体认读音节,学习单韵母声调,学习复韵母声调,学习鼻韵母声调,学习整体认读音节声调几大模块，可以循序渐进的帮助您逐步掌握中文的基本发音和汉字认识。 "拼音学习 - Pinyin learning" 特性 中文转拼音 支持给简体中文或者繁体中文标注拼音，方便您学习中文的正确发音，您可以把黏贴或者输入的文字转换成语音播放。 中文使用场景学习 包括了数十种对话场景的中英文对照，帮助你快速学习中文的各种对话场景，是您快速入门中文的途径。 汉字学习 包括了数千个常用中文的发音，掌握了这些汉字你可以知道他们的正确发音。 学习声母，学习韵母，学习整体认读音节，学习单韵母声调，学习复韵母声调，学习鼻韵母声调，学习整体认读音节声调 包括了学习汉语拼音的各种发音练习（拼音的发音类似英语里的音标），熟悉他你可以知道每个汉字如何拼读，是你掌握汉字发音的必学技能 "拼音学习 - Pinyin learning" 亮点 每个汉字或者拼音字母都支持点击发音，您可以点击他完成发音练习。 支持几乎全球所有语言文字直接播放语音（当然包括中英文混合），您可以把黏贴或者输入的文字转换成语音播放 支持拼音颜色、文字颜色、以及背景颜色设置，方便生成个性化界面 支持单独调整拼音或者文字大小，保护视力 支持一键生成图片且自动复制生成的拼音和文本内容，方便黏贴到其他地方

1504218030.trackName: 电波表校时 - 专业电波表授时对时工具
1504218030.description: 电波表校时 App 能模拟全球6座电波基站的信号。无论你在世界任何角落都能随时使用电波表校时 App 来发波校准钟表时间。 首创“跃局波”，让 2、3、4、5 局电波表不受信号区域的限制，能在中国接收中国标准时间。 我们精心设计了 App 的界面，简化了操作流程，使用方便优雅。 功能亮点： 完美模拟全球6局电波信号 通过我们研究的模拟技术，我们实现了WWVB（美国），MSF（英国），DCF77（德国），BPC（中国），JJY40（日本），JJY60（日本）的电波信号。 跃局波 让你电波表不受信号区域的限制！即使是 2 局电波表，也能在全世界任何地方使用跃局波功能接收电波信号，完成校时。 支持各类电波表和时钟 2局，3局，4局，5局，6局电波表或者时钟，都可以校准。 教程指导 我们内置了一份快速教程，方便你快速上手。我们还提供了多个案例教程和在线视频教程。 无任何广告 我们认为广告是十分讨厌的东西，所以我们没有增加任何广告在我们精心设计的界面上。 支持iPhone和iPad 在iPhone的基础上，我们为iPad重新设计了软件界面。 使用过程中有任何问题可通过App内的反馈功能与我们联络。 或发邮件至 astronstudioapp@gmail.com

1504273365.name: Rückbildung nach der Geburt
1504273365.description: Die Rückbildungsgymnastik-App für zuhause! Die Workouts sind genau auf deine Bedürfnisse im Mama-Baby-Alltag abgestimmt: Du kannst sie zu Hause in deiner gewohnten Umgebung durchführen - was gerade im Wochenbett ideal ist. Sie sind sanft und effektiv und sie bauen aufeinander auf. Und wenn es mal schnell gehen muss, gibt es Rückbildungsgymnastik-Kurzprogramme! Von Übungen für das Frühwochenbett bis hin zum Programm für Fortgeschrittene ist dies ein Rückbildung-Komplettpaket, was dich ab der Geburt bis zu einem Jahr danach begleitet und fit macht - in deinen eigenen vier Wänden! Rückbildungsgymnastik ist Erholung für dich und Stärkung für Mamas Körper. Der hat nämlich Höchstleistungen vollbracht. Deine Belohnung dafür hältst du in deinen Armen: dein Baby. Nun musst auch du schnell wieder fit werden und zu Kräften kommen. Deshalb starte am besten gleich mit der Rückbildungsgymnastik und dem Bockenbodentraining. Beckenboden und Bauch brauchen besonders sanfte, effektive Übungen. Beine, Po und Arme sollen wieder straff werden, der Rücken von Verspannungen gelöst und im Anschluss gestärkt werden. All dies schaffst du mit diesen aufeinander aufbauenden Workouts von Hebamme Katharina Hübner (geb. Werner). Sie hat die perfekte Rückbildungsgymnastik und das Beckenbodentraining für frischgebackene Mamas entwickelt. Mit dem sanften Rückbildungsprogramm kannst du direkt nach der Geburt beginnen - du fängst mit kleinen Übungen im Frühwochenbett an, um deinen Beckenboden zu erspüren und zu aktivieren und z.B. auch deinen Kreislauf erst mal wieder in Schwung zu bekommen! Die Workouts bauen Schritt für Schritt aufeinander auf. Ab 8 Wochen nach der Geburt kannst du dann das erste große Rückbildungsgymnastik-Workout machen und schon bald wirst du zur fortgeschrittenen Rübi-Mami! Diese App beinhaltet eine ausführliche Einleitung, damit du die Funktion deines Beckenbodens verstehst, ein Programm für das Frühwochenbett, ein Programm für das Spätwochenbett (10 Tage nach der Geburt), Rückbildungsgymnastik ab 8 Wochen nach der Geburt, Rückbildungsgymnastik für Fortgeschrittene, Kurzprogramm 8 Wochen nach der Geburt, Kurzprogramm für Fortgeschrittene sowie Haltungstipps für den Alltag, die Rückenschmerzen vorbeugen. Insgesamt sind das 116 Minuten Rückbildungsgymnastik und Beckenbodentraining für dein Wohlbefinden und deine Fitness, damit DU dich als Frau nach der Geburt super fühlst und gleichzeitig zuhause bei deinem Baby sein kannst. Du bekommst mehr Kraft für den Alltag mit deinem Baby! Und wenn es Mama gut geht, dann strahlt auch das Baby und ist viel ausgeglichener und ruhiger. Und keine Angst: Wenn du kurz nach der Geburt noch nicht starten kannst, fang einfach später an - beginne trotzdem mit der ersten Einheit und steigere dich dann langsam. Beginne, wenn DU bereit bist! LEBENSLAGER ZUGRIFF AUF DEINE INHALTE: Vier Rückbildungsgymnastik-Workouts 2 Kurzprogramme Tipps für eine bessere Haltung im Alltag - So schonst du deinen Rücken Umfangreiche Einführung (Beckenboden-Basics: Erklärungen, Videos, Übungen) VORTEILE DEINER APP: Videos in Echtzeit auf deinem Smartphone oder Tablet Streame die Videos auf deinen TV via AppleTV Rückbildungsgymnastik geeignet für jedes Fitness-Level lebenslanger Zugriff auf alle Inhalte geschlossene FB-Gruppe zum Mami-Austausch überall durchführbar, keine Geräte oder Hilfsmittel nötig, kein Equipment Hast du Fragen zur Nutzung der App? Schreib uns an: info@meine-rueckbildung.de

Sie sind sanft und effektiv und sie bauen aufeinander auf. Und wenn es mal schnell gehen muss, gibt es Rückbildungsgymnastik-Kurzprogramme! Von Übungen für das Frühwochenbett bis hin zum Programm für Fortgeschrittene ist dies ein Rückbildung-Komplettpaket, was dich ab der Geburt bis zu einem Jahr danach begleitet und fit macht - in deinen eigenen vier Wänden! Rückbildungsgymnastik ist Erholung für dich und Stärkung für Mamas Körper. Der hat nämlich Höchstleistungen vollbracht. Deine Belohnung dafür hältst du in deinen Armen: dein Baby. Nun musst auch du schnell wieder fit werden und zu Kräften kommen. Deshalb starte am besten gleich mit der Rückbildungsgymnastik und dem Bockenbodentraining. Beckenboden und Bauch brauchen besonders sanfte, effektive Übungen. Beine, Po und Arme sollen wieder straff werden, der Rücken von Verspannungen gelöst und im Anschluss gestärkt werden. All dies schaffst du mit diesen aufeinander aufbauenden Workouts von Hebamme Katharina Hübner (geb. Werner). Sie hat die perfekte Rückbildungsgymnastik und das Beckenbodentraining für frischgebackene Mamas entwickelt. Mit dem sanften Rückbildungsprogramm kannst du direkt nach der Geburt beginnen - du fängst mit kleinen Übungen im Frühwochenbett an, um deinen Beckenboden zu erspüren und zu aktivieren und z.B. auch deinen Kreislauf erst mal wieder in Schwung zu bekommen! Die Workouts bauen Schritt für Schritt aufeinander auf. Ab 8 Wochen nach der Geburt kannst du dann das erste große Rückbildungsgymnastik-Workout machen und schon bald wirst du zur fortgeschrittenen Rübi-Mami! Diese App beinhaltet eine ausführliche Einleitung, damit du die Funktion deines Beckenbodens verstehst, ein Programm für das Frühwochenbett, ein Programm für das Spätwochenbett (10 Tage nach der Geburt), Rückbildungsgymnastik ab 8 Wochen nach der Geburt, Rückbildungsgymnastik für Fortgeschrittene, Kurzprogramm 8 Wochen nach der Geburt, Kurzprogramm für Fortgeschrittene sowie Haltungstipps für den Alltag, die Rückenschmerzen vorbeugen. Insgesamt sind das 116 Minuten Rückbildungsgymnastik und Beckenbodentraining für dein Wohlbefinden und deine Fitness, damit DU dich als Frau nach der Geburt super fühlst und gleichzeitig zuhause bei deinem Baby sein kannst. Du bekommst mehr Kraft für den Alltag mit deinem Baby! Und wenn es Mama gut geht, dann strahlt auch das Baby und ist viel ausgeglichener und ruhiger. Und keine Angst: Wenn du kurz nach der Geburt noch nicht starten kannst, fang einfach später an - beginne trotzdem mit der ersten Einheit und steigere dich dann langsam. Beginne, wenn DU bereit bist! LEBENSLAGER ZUGRIFF AUF DEINE INHALTE: Vier Rückbildungsgymnastik-Workouts 2 Kurzprogramme Tipps für eine bessere Haltung im Alltag - So schonst du deinen Rücken Umfangreiche Einführung (Beckenboden-Basics: Erklärungen, Videos, Übungen) VORTEILE DEINER APP: Videos in Echtzeit auf deinem Smartphone oder Tablet Streame die Videos auf deinen TV via AppleTV Rückbildungsgymnastik geeignet für jedes Fitness-Level lebenslanger Zugriff auf alle Inhalte geschlossene FB-Gruppe zum Mami-Austausch überall durchführbar, keine Geräte oder Hilfsmittel nötig, kein Equipment Hast du Fragen zur Nutzung der App? Schreib uns an: info@meine-rueckbildung.de

1504455407.name: LiebesKlee - Synastry
1504455407.description: LiebeKlee, the partnership horoscope with the exact calculation of the synastry. With the help of two natal charts, we enable you to gain new perspectives on everyday relationships and character traits based on astrological expertise. As in a personal astrological consultation, the partnership or friendship is analyzed. How compatible am I with my partner? How do we, as a couple, deal with difficult situations? Why do other people interact with me as they do? What does our love look like in the relationship? Why do I keep falling out with my family over the same things, over and over again? LiebesKlee aims to address these and many other questions concerning social relationships and interactions with each other. With the support of seven languages (German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Turkish), the app offers the opportunity to discover the full range of astrological craft at reasonable prices. Our relationship app LiebesKlee offers you all these insights and many more. You will find detailed analyses of all possible pair constellations. It doesn't have to be just about romantic relationships or friendships, as in our everyday lives, we encounter a wide variety of social relationships every day. LiebesKlee helps you to break down individual character traits and as a result, benefit from a better understanding of your partner - in all different kinds of situations in life. You will find out where the hurdles lie in your relationship and where it may take off. The analyses are simple and quick, as well as safe and detailed. On the path through the zodiac sings and houses, new angular relationships emerge frequently. These relationships are called aspects. Like everywhere else, there are positive aspects that promote each other and negative aspects that disturb each other or lead to tension and conflict. Every horoscope, and therefore every comparison of different horoscopes, has different aspects. LiebesKlee, the astrology app, has the power to replace a personal, astrological consultation! For an exemplary analysis free of charge, please enter a date before 1935 to give you an impression of the constellation of your ancestors.

1504543503.name: FastRemind
1504543503.description: FastRemind is an easy way to create reminders in seconds. Just open the app and type what and when you want to be reminded in natural language. FastRemind will understand at what time you want to set the reminder and adds it to your existing Apple Reminders, which syncs to all your other devices. Type for example "Do laundry tomorrow 10 am" and it will create a reminder "Do laundry" for tomorrow at 10 am. You can also type things like "Call mom in 10 min" or "Buy water in 5 days". FastRemind is also available for the Mac, where it is directly accessible from the menu bar. Making it even faster to create new reminders. The Mac version is free, if you've already purchased the iOS version.

1504638613.name: HRV4Biofeedback
1504638613.description: Improve self-regulation and better cope with stress using HRV4Biofeedback, the camera-based Heart Rate Variability (HRV) Biofeedback app APP FEATURES: camera-based biofeedback measurement showing real-time heart rate spot check measurements at rest frequency power spectrum biofeedback score to quantify the effectiveness of the practice in terms of deep breathing and duration resonant frequency analysis to determine the optimal breathing rate for your sessions semi-real time HRV analysis alternative manual breathing rate configuration between 4.5 and 8.5 breaths / minute subjective annotations, including up to 5 personalized questions current streak explore correlations between subjective annotations and biofeedback data Integration with HealthKit (you can write heart rate, HRV and Mindful minutes) weekly and monthly summaries support for Bluetooth sensors background nature sounds vibration to guide you through the practice WHAT'S BIOFEEDBACK? Heart Rate Variability (HRV) Biofeedback is a technique that can directly affect physiological and psychological factors through deep breathing exercises and is an ideal strategy to help us self-regulate and better cope with stressful situations​ Practically speaking, HRV Biofeedback consists of providing an individual with real-time feedback on instantaneous heart rate and respiration changes while being instructed to breathe at low frequencies You can learn more about the psychological and physiological benefits of deep breathing and HRV Biofeedback, at HRV4Biofeedback.com HOW CAN I BENEFIT FROM BIOFEEDBACK? Life can be demanding, from both a physical and psychological point of view ​Our health and performance can be affected by how we are able to effectively cope with stressful situations and deal with anxiety, or in broader terms, our ability to emotionally self-regulate is key The goal of HRV Biofeedback is to improve self-regulation, therefore impacting positively our health and performance LEARN MORE: App features: https://www.hrv4biofeedback.com/faq.html An introduction to biofeedback: https://www.hrv4biofeedback.com/blog/a-primer-on-heart-rate-variability-biofeedback How to use the camera measurement: https://www.hrv4biofeedback.com/blog/guidelines-and-best-practices-for-camera-based-measurements Supported devices for the camera measurement: iPhones 8 and onwards HRV4Biofeedback requires to register an account with your email address, so that your data can be backed up safely and retrieved in case anything happens (app issue, changing phone, etc.) The validation of the camera-based heart rate measurement is available here: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/315059917_Comparison_of_Heart_Rate_Variability_Recording_With_Smart_Phone_Photoplethysmographic_Polar_H7_Chest_Strap_and_Electrocardiogram_Methods

1505065609.name: Love, Manuela
1505065609.description: Love, Manuela is a baking app created by Norwegian baker Manuela Kjeilen, known as @passionforbaking. For more than a decade, Manuela has shared her love of baking with people around the world. She has published nine baking books, hosted her own baking show on TV in Sweden, and inspires more than 1.6 million followers on Instagram with her cakes, recipes, and beautiful baking ideas. Inside the Love, Manuela app, you get instant access to more than 470 baking recipes, all written in English, with high-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe from beginning to end. One-time purchase. No subscription. New recipes are included when they are added. For Manuela, taste always comes first. Beautiful cakes are lovely, but the most important thing is that every bite tastes delicious. Her recipes are created to let the flavors shine, with soft textures, creamy fillings, balanced sweetness, and desserts that taste just as good as they look. From everyday treats to celebration cakes, the recipes are made for home baking. Inside the app, you will find sponge cakes in many variations, ganaches in delicious flavors like strawberry, latte, and banana milkshake, lots of Scandinavian-style cakes, light fillings, cheesecakes, ice creams, sweet dough, frostings, cookies, cupcakes, and so much more. The app is made to feel like a growing digital baking book that you can return to again and again. It is easy to navigate, with clear recipe categories, improved search and filtering, and helpful tags so you can quickly find what you are looking for. A few more categories have also been added to make browsing even easier. Each recipe opens with a large photo and a short introduction, followed by clear directions, recipe notes, a place where you can write your own notes, and step-by-step photos that guide you through the recipe. Whether you are baking a cake, preparing a filling, whipping a frosting, or making cookies, the app is designed to help you feel confident in every step. New Cake Mode helps keep your screen awake while you read and follow a recipe, so you do not have to keep touching your phone or tablet while your hands are busy baking. The app has also been refined with improved UI, a smoother overall user experience, and an improved password reset flow. Love, Manuela is not a subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $12.99, converted to your local currency by the App Store or Google Play. You get access to all recipes inside the app instantly, and when new recipes are added in the future, they are included at no extra cost. Your purchase is connected to the store account you buy it with, either App Store or Google Play. You can restore your purchase anytime using the same store account. What you get inside the app: More than 470 baking recipes Recipes written in English only Clear and easy-to-follow instructions High-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe Easy recipe categories Improved search and filtering Helpful tags to find recipes faster A place to write your own notes inside each recipe Recipe notes and tips from Manuela Cake Mode to keep your screen awake while baking Access to new recipes when they are added One-time purchase on this platform No subscription This is not a baking video app. The Love, Manuela app is focused on written recipes, high-quality photos, clear directions, recipe notes, and step-by-step pictures for every recipe. It is created for bakers who love to read, follow, save, and return to recipes whenever they want. The Love, Manuela app has more than 75,000 registered users worldwide, and Manuela’s recipes are loved by home bakers, cake lovers, professional bakers, and bakeries around the world. If you love soft cakes, sponge cakes, ganache, creamy frostings, light fillings, cupcakes, cookies, Scandinavian-style baking, sweet dough, cheesecakes, ice creams, and homemade desserts that taste as good as they look, you are going to love the Love, Manuela app. Happy baking! XO, Love, Manuela

1505115635.name: Hieroglyph Pro
1505115635.description: Read and understand Ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs with a professional-grade dictionary and translation tool used by students, researchers, and Egyptologists. This powerful App is simply the best interactive, most complete, self contained dictionary and translator between English and Ancient Egyptian! Our dictionary is vetted against modern professional references, including the popular online Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae, and standard references including Hannig, and the Worterbuch. Hieroglyphics Pro has been developed and evolved in consultation with professional Egyptologists. This app explains what the ancient symbols mean, how they may have been pronounced and how they formed words and phrases. The App contains: 4124 hieroglyphic signs 223,111 words, phrases, titles, epithets, and locations used in Ancient Egypt. The Horus, Birth, and Throne names of all the known Pharaohs and Queens of Egypt. Our dictionary has almost triple the content of any other smartphone dictionary/translation apps. Hieroglyphics Pro has several modes: Beginner mode simplifies the App with a minimal set of 200 glyphs for easy searching and an easy pronunciation guide. Student mode show the standard Middle Egyptian Gardiner set of about 700 glyphs, organized by shape, and standard transliteration. Pro mode uses all 1,071 glyphs in Gardiner's classic categories plus more than 3000 additional signs used in the dictionary. A unique, powerful feature of Hieroglyphics Pro is the ability to find glyphs by how often they are used in inscriptions. This makes adding common signs to a phrase or word a snap! Egyptian words and phrases in the dictionary are drawn graphically in quadrat groups, in the artistic style of the ancient inscriptions. The App offers 6 ways to enter Hieroglyphs for translation: Graphically from Gardiner groupings, or in Beginner Mode, plus Gardiner's/Manley's Groupings by shape A unique feature allows finding glyphs sorted by their frequency of use! Direct keyboard text entry of Gardiner codes (i.e., A1, D21, Aa2) Typing in phonetic shortcuts as defined by the MdC (i.e., Htp, nTr, r, etc.) By transliteration symbol from the Phonetic shortcuts table Searching for keywords in a glyph's description or determinative words Text entries of Gardiner Codes and MdC can now be edited with a cursor and finger swiping, just like other text editing apps! Very quick and convenient! Egyptians wrote Right to Left, Left to Right, and Top to Bottom. The App allows you to enter Left to Right, and then view the Glyphs in reverse direction if you wish. HieroglyphPro allows you to add/store/transmit their own custom words to the dictionary. Hieroglyph Pro is the first and only mobile App to introduce Hieratic (a style of cursive, handwritten Egyptian) glyphs, and illustrate how they evolved over the centuries. Hieroglyphics Pro is a modern iOS 26 App, back compatible back to iOS 16, Dark Mode and all. It contains help files and links to both on-line references and to printed books for advanced study. The app and its dictionary data are entirely self-contained. No internet or cell phone required. The new optional link to the Thesaurus-Linguae-Aegyptiae (TLA) academic database does, however, require wifi or cell connection. When you have found the translation your were seeking, with a tap it is copied on to the clipboard and can be pasted into another App, an Email, message, etc. Hieroglyph Pro is a one-time purchase! No ads! No subscriptions!

1505140281.name: Spectra - Music Visualizer
1505140281.description: Enjoy music at a deeper level with realtime visualization! Spectra is a lightweight music & audio visualizer app that allows you to select and visualize audio in realtime, right on your phone or mac. Want to export your visualization? We have you covered. Simply click the "Create Video" button from within the app. No longer do you need expensive software to create those beautiful animations you've seen on the internet. Want to customize the background image or put a logo in the center? We made that available as well. In fact, you can customize just about all aspects of the visualizer. You can even import audio files from apps like iMessage or Mail using the share sheet. We want to keep improving the app so If you have any suggestions, be sure to leave a review and tell us what feature you're missing! The features: Amazing, 60fps realtime visualization for any audio file or iTunes music (not Apple Music) song Video exporting of your audio visualization (4k at 60fps) Custom background image Background presets Background effects Custom logo image Visualizer customization Particle customization Video export settings Video animation options Presets More to come!!! Here's how it works: The sound we hear is made up of many frequencies. The visualizer decomposes the audio input into its frequencies and displays the lower frequencies at the top/left of the audio spectrum and the higher frequencies at the bottom/right of the spectrum. This can create some cool-looking shapes that all correspond to the currently-playing audio track! Whether you're a producer that wants to see the frequency range of their song, an audiophile, or someone who wants to take a deeper look into their music, this app is definitely for you.

1505268848.description: 【アプリの説明】 全127問（図表読み取り問題）を収録した本格的なGAB非言語対策アプリです。 出題傾向を分析して質の高い問題を用意しています。 最初からきっちり学習したい方にも、ピンポイントで学習したい方にも最適なアプリとなっています。 効率的な試験対策をサポートするため、学習・テスト・ノート・分析・設定の5つのモードを備えています。 【各モードの説明】 ■ 学習モード 問題の分野別に学習が行えます。 各問題には正解・不正解・未学習といったステータスが表示され、それらのステータスから算出される分野別の達成率をプログレスバーで簡単に確認できます。 各問題のステータスによる分類機能により、不正解もしくは未学習の問題だけに絞って解くといった効率的な学習機能も搭載しております。 また、後で見直したい問題を自分でピックアップしてノートに保存しておくこともできます。 ■ テストモード 制限時間を設けて集中して問題に取り組めるモードです。 問題数が12問の簡易模擬テスト(2パターン)とランダム出題が用意されています。 また、計算力を鍛えるための四則計算モードも用意されています。 ■ ノートモード 学習モード・テストモードで保存しておいた問題を見直すモードです。 ■ 分析モード 各問題のステータスから算出される分野別の達成率と正答率をグラフで一目で確認でき、学習の進捗把握に大いに役立ちます。 ■ 設定モード 目に優しいナイトモード設定を選択できます。 チュートリアルを見直して使い方をもう一度確認することもできます。 【プライバシーポリシー】 https://www.moakly.com/privacypolicy 【利用規約】 https://www.moakly.com/terms

1505326753.name: 台股ETF折溢價查詢 捐贈版
1505326753.trackName: 台股ETF折溢價查詢 捐贈版
1505326753.description: 捐贈版和免費版的差別 ● 沒有廣告 ● 無限的功能點數 ● 增加自選股折溢價自動更新功能 如何將免費版的資料匯入捐贈版？ 使用免費版的自選股備份功能匯出自選股，匯出成功後，複製備份ID，再到捐贈版的自選股備份功能匯入自選股，貼上剛複製的備份ID後，按下確定即可恢復自選股資料。 您知道ETF的價格有分為淨值和市價嗎？ 您知道淨值和市價可能會產生溢價讓您一進場就買貴了嗎？ 快使用【台股ETF折溢價查詢】，讓您的ETF不買貴。 提供 元大、富邦、國泰、復華、群益、台新、兆豐、街口、第一、統一、中信、凱基、永豐、富蘭克林華美、大華銀、野村、玉山、聯邦、華南、安聯、聯博、摩根、貝萊德、元富、永昌所發行ETF和ETN的折溢價查詢 ETF折溢價簡單說明 ETF是掛牌在交易所的，跟一般的股票交易方式一樣，也就是說投資人並不是用淨值來交易ETF，而是隨時都會變動的市價。今天淨值100元的ETF，如果投資人買進力道高於賣出力道，就可能會願意用高於淨值的價格買進，例如101元，這就是溢價，相反的，也有可能投資人不願意用這個高的價格買進，於是只能成交在99元，這就是折價。 短期中ETF市價和淨值，可能會因投資人對ETF所追蹤的標的物熱度產生較大的折溢價。 但長期來說，ETF市價和淨值會趨於一致。 所以短期中如果某檔ETF已經溢價很多 代表投資人已經對未來的利多先做了反應 這時是否要馬上進場追買 就要把溢價部分也納入考慮了喔！ 除了折溢價外 還提供下列各項功能 ● ETF基本資料 ● ETF成分股資訊 ● ETF成分股產業分佈資訊 ● ETF三大法人買賣超資訊 ● ETF日成交量資訊 ● ETF歷年股價資訊(以歷年股價推算合理價) ● ETF歷年股利資訊 ● ETF歷年殖利率資訊 ● ETF歷年填權息資訊 ● ETF歷史績效資訊 ● ETF殖利率排行榜 ● ETF現金股利排行榜 ● ETF歷史績效排行榜 ● ETF成交量排行榜 ● ETF市值排行榜

1505731669.name: Sasol eBirds Southern Africa
1505731669.description: Take this handy app on your bird-watching trips for quick access to bird calls and assistance with bird ID. Now featuring AI-powered Bird Call ID, a supportive tool to help you ID bird calls in the wild. NEW: Bird Call ID Record a live bird call and receive a suggested species identification powered by AI. Available via optional in-app subscription. HOW WILL THIS APP HELP YOU? Covers all 1000 bird species Use the Bird Call ID feature to identify birds by their calls (subscription feature) Updated information with fresh input from new contributing authors All species text in English AND Afrikaans Over 1100 bird calls covering 885 species Quick-Play bird calls right from the menu More than 3600 photographs Improved Location data functionality Expanded Smart Search filters – search by bill type, bird size, colour, patterns and features, tail shape, habitat and more. Compare more species with "similar species" plates New seabirds and raptor illustrations with fine attention to detail Distribution maps updated with latest known ranges Expanded life list functionality UPDATE PLAN: This app will be updated regularly over the coming years. These updates will aim to improve on the content, features and functionality in the app, and they will be free to the customer. We value the input from customers, and urge you to email us at apps@penguinrandomhouse.co.za with any recommendations or features you’d like to see. THE AUTHORS Ian Sinclair is one of Africa’s foremost field birders and has authored or co-authored over 20 bird books. Phil Hockey (1956–2013), former Director of the Fitz Institute at UCT, was a recognised authority on the biology of southern African birds. Warwick Tarboton is a well-known bird expert and writer who has produced a number of well-received books. Peter Ryan is Director of the Fitz Institute at UCT and has authored several books on the region’s birds. Niall Perrins is a dedicated birder, photographer and bird guide. Dominic Rollinson holds a PhD in seabird conservation and works as a bird guide. JOIN OUR GROWING COMMUNITY If you’ve got a few comments or great suggestions to share, we’d love to hear from you at www.mydigitalearth.com ADDITIONAL NOTES Uninstalling/reinstalling the app will result in the loss of your list. We recommend that you keep a backup from the application (My List > Export). Got questions? Check out the Sasol eBirds FAQ for answers to the most common queries: https://www.sasolbirds.co.za/faq.php

1506065573.name: Piano Motifs
1506065573.description: Let the musical muses of Piano Motifs inspire your device to generate some original and beautiful motifs (short melodies). Selected as the Favorite MIDI Generator App two years in a row by the iOS Music Production community! Please note that Piano Motifs is not an AI app. All motifs are algorithmically generated using music theory. Check out the music that Piano Motifs can generate at: https://soundcloud.com/azul-3d For Piano Motifs demos and tutorials: https://www.youtube.com/@azul3dapps Create original, catchy and inspiring MIDI loops at the touch of a button. No musical knowledge or skill is necessary to create completely new and original music. Piano Motifs is the simplest way to generate your own music. There are no preset melodies. Melodies are generated algorithmically. The melodic possibilities are endless. Set the music tempo or select the key, scale, time signature, octave range, number of bars, melody constraints, melody note frequency and accompaniment style for your motif. Option to generate Swing rhythm for the melody, either Shuffle or Hard Swing. Program your own chord progressions and let Piano Motifs generate an accompaniment and melody for them. Generation of a 3rd track with the option of it being a sustained chord per bar, sustained chord per multiple bars or a drone tone. Ideal for strings, choirs or pads. Arrange your motifs to create longer musical pieces. Choose from 28 different kinds of accompaniment styles. Define your arpeggio accompaniments. Choose from 13 different kinds of melody constraints. Major, Minor, Lydian, Mixolydian, Dorian, Phrygian, Harmonic Minor and Phrygian Dominant scales supported. Loop your motifs Save your motifs as MIDI files so you can edit them or add more instrumentation to them on your favorite Digital Audio Workstation (DAW). When exporting a MIDI file, export with a third MIDI track with a sustained chord per bar, sustained chord per multiple bars or a drone tone (Ideal for synth pads, strings or chorus). Share audio or MIDI through iMessages, e-mail, Whatsapp or AirDrop. Save audio, MIDI or .motif file to your device's file system. AUv3 MIDI Plug-In In-App Purchase: Incorporate Piano Motifs seemlessly in your workflow by instantiating it once or multiple times in an app that can host AUv3 MIDI Plug-Ins, for example: AUM, AudioBus 3, ApeMatrix, Drambo or EG Nodes. Please note that Piano Motifs as an AUv3 MIDI Plug-In will not play any sound by itself, it generates MIDI that can be routed to other apps and effects instantiated in a host. IMPORTANT: GarageBand does not support MIDI only Plug-ins, so the AUv3 will not work in GarageBand. AUv3 MIDI Plug-In features include: Ability to play Piano Motifs in sync and out of sync with the host. State saving functionality. Independent programmable MIDI channels for melody, accompaniment, optional third track, and optional melody harmony track. Interactive octave shifting for melody and accompaniment. Controllable Melody and Accompaniment Velocity parameters. Start Delay and BPM multiple with respect to the Host in Sync mode. MIDI Out In-App Purchase: Play the music generated by Piano Motifs on your favorite synthesizer, DAW, a connect/route/mix app like AUM, or any app that has Virtual MIDI Destination (MIDI In) capabilities. IMPORTANT: Before purchasing please be aware that Piano Motifs DOES NOT OFFER Ableton Link functionality. MIDI Out In-App Purchase features include: Programmable delay for the start of a motif Independent programmable MIDI channels for melody, accompaniment and an optional third track Piano Motifs chooses a music key from many different scales and an accompaniment from a varied set of accompaniments. Piano Motifs then uses its musical theory algorithms to overlay a melody in the chosen key and accompaniment. Piano Motifs are short, they go from around 16 seconds to around 30 seconds.

1506136759.name: Perspective Vision
1506136759.description: The dynamic depth is amazing. It is an app that can add 'Perspective effect' to videos and photos. The size of the perspective effect can be adjusted freely by intuitive operation by touching the screen. The effects are applied independently in the horizontal and vertical directions, and they can be combined. It can also be used to correct warp in videos and photos taken with a wide-angle lens. It supports not only videos and photos stored on your smartphone, but also cameras. Uninteresting, monotonous videos and photos are fun and freshly reborn. [Material] Camera shooting: video, photo Camera Roll: Load video and photos [Settings] Effect direction switch: horizontal / vertical Storage resolution: 20 to 100% of the original resolution [Touch operation] The effect changes depending on the touch position on the screen image. When the effect direction is horizontal, the effect is determined by the left and right touch positions. When the effect direction is vertical, the effect is determined by the upper and lower touch positions. 1506390344.name: Panstation 2
1506390344.description: Finally available for iOS!. To create Panstation, we started with a loose model of the venerable Drawmer M500's panning engine, then added the counting features from the Audio & Design PanScan (probably the most famous vintage autopanner, and the "secret weapon" of many well-known producers.) The result is an autopanner plug-in that is second to none in both feature set and sound. Built for both iPhones and iPads, Panstation is available as an AudioUnit V3 (with sidechain input in hosts that have that capabilty) and Standalone with Inter-App Audio. The AUv3 requires a host such as AUM, Cubasis, GarageBand, or BeatMaker Pro 3 (etc.) to be used. Features Four different panning laws, including an exact 1:1 clone of the M500 pan law. Ten panning waveforms, including all the waveforms present in the M500. Free-run, MIDI tempo sync, MIDI note trigger, MIDI note number, and CC control of panning. Audio trigger counting feature from the A&D PanScan. Relative phase control of each side, for tremolo and stereo widening effects. Vector-based reactive UI. Share presets between the AUv3 and Standalone, or between the iOS versions and the desktop versions. Manual available on the Audio Damage site.

1506461202.name: bVNC Pro - VNC Screen Sharing
1506461202.description: Thank you for supporting my work and GPL open-source software by buying bVNC Pro! If you are unhappy, please don't give us a bad review, instead, request a refund and get in touch by email support _at_ morpheusly _dot_ com: https://support.apple.com/en-ca/118223 Need an RDP app to control Windows, Ubuntu 22.04+ or XRDP remotely? https://apps.apple.com/app/ardp-pro/id1620745523 Need a SPICE or Proxmox or oVirt client for controlling virtual machines remotely? https://apps.apple.com/app/aspice-pro/id1560593107 If bVNC doesn't work for you or you're unhappy, please do not ask for help in a review but do post your question in the forum: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/bvnc-ardp-aspice-opaque-remote-desktop-clients If you have a feature request, or you found a bug, please open an issue at: https://github.com/iiordanov/remote-desktop-clients/issues Instructions for Mac OS X: Plain VNC (Remote Desktop for Mac OS X): http://iiordanov.blogspot.ca/2012/04/how-to-connect-to-mac-os-x-using-bvnc.html Secure VNC over SSH: http://iiordanov.blogspot.ca/2012/04/tunneling-vnc-over-ssh-to-mac-os-x.html Instructions for Windows: Plain VNC: http://iiordanov.blogspot.ca/2012/04/how-to-install-and-connect-to-tightvnc.html Secure VNC over VeNCrypt: https://groups.google.com/d/msg/bvnc-ardp-aspice-opaque-remote-desktop-clients/lINJkYJbN-U/3Q3oHWjjDQAJ Secure VNC over SSH: http://iiordanov.blogspot.ca/2012/04/tunneling-vnc-over-ssh-to-windows.html Instructions for Ubuntu 20.04 and earlier Linux Plain VNC not tunneled over SSH: https://help.ubuntu.com/stable/ubuntu-help/sharing-desktop.html.en http://www.howtoforge.com/configure-remote-access-to-your-ubuntu-desktop If your business is looking for fixes and features, please get in touch by email at support _at_ morpheusly.com bVNC is a secure, open source VNC client. Its features include: Controls Windows, Mac, Linux, BSD with VNC server installed PiKVM compatible External keyboard support External mouse support Magic Trackpad support Multi-language support Supports Mac OS X built-in remote desktop server (ARD) and Mac OS X authentication! Windows, Mac, Linux, BSD, or any other OS with a VNC server installed Multi-touch control over the remote mouse. One finger tap left-clicks, two-finger tap right-clicks, and three-finger tap middle-clicks Right and middle-drag and drop if you don't lift the first finger that tapped Scrolling with a two-finger gesture Pinch-zoom Dynamic resolution changes, allowing you to reconfigure your desktop while connected, and control over virtual machines from BIOS to OS All device orientations Full desktop visibility even with soft keyboard extended SSH tunneling, AnonTLS and VeNCrypt for secure connections (does not support RealVNC encryption). High-grade encryption superior to RDP using SSH and VeNCrypt (x509 certificates and SSL), preventing man-in-the-middle attacks Tight and CopyRect encodings for quick updates SSH public/private (pubkey)- Supports most VNC servers including TightVNC, UltraVNC, TigerVNC, (and RealVNC Enterprise only, when configured appropriately) Clipboard integration for copy/pasting from your device Some of the planned features to look forward to: AutoX session discovery/creation similar to NX client Ability to reduce the color depth over slow links Importing encrypted/unencrypted RSA keys in PEM format View-only mode On-device help on available input modes in the Menu when connected GPL source code here: https://gitlab.com/iiordanov/remote-desktop-clients-ios

1506620807.trackName: 麻将AI小番 - 胡牌分析
1506620807.description: 麻将AI助你打麻将入门到精通。 麻将规则全国各地不一，天南地北的朋友聚在一块打麻将，以谁的规则为准不好定？拿出【小番】，AI麻将必备神器，使用统一规则（支持日本麻将、国标麻将等规则）自动算番最方便啦。【小番】新版本增加智能麻将AI帮助你提高打牌技巧，还有很多好玩的麻将内容在【小番麻友圈】里，快来跟麻友们交流吧。 听说还有几个月又又又又要过年了，还没学会各种麻将高级技巧和玩法的你得提前准备学习学习，提高下麻将水平啦。 小番 - 帮助你快速提高麻将技巧，使用它可以 - 【学习麻将规则】了解各种牌面组成，花龙，组合龙，清龙等等等等，让你不再仅限于懂胡混一色，碰碰胡啦； 【麻将标准算番】可以按照国标规则，日本麻将规则等进行自动算番，跟你学习掌握的国标规则相互校验，也可以在打麻将时作为统一的算番器，妈妈再也不会担心我算少番啦； 【相机智能识别】你还可以方便快捷的通过AI人工智能识别的方式快速完成一副完整手牌的自动识别，只需要打开摄像机，对准14张手牌即可快捷识别。 【高级麻将AI】帮你分析当前局面打出哪张牌胜率最大，听牌时都听了几门几张。 【小番麻友圈】最好玩的麻将圈子，平时不打牌的时候麻友们都在这里交流，提高麻将技巧，分析麻将欢乐。 【小番计分榜】免扑克牌算分，朋友间打麻将计分更方便。 后续更多好玩功能，尽请期待。 【自动订阅说明】 1. 服务名称：解锁全部功能 2. 价格：优惠期间第一周免费试用，连续包季产品为9元/季度（推广期优惠价），日均仅0.1元。 3. 订阅服务可随时在App Store订阅中取消。 【服务条款与用户隐私协议】 https://mahjong.chat/privacy_policy.html 任何问题欢迎联系 - 微信群：添加 zerttrez 备注小番入群

1506655090.name: 63 Advanced Blues Guitar Licks
1506655090.description: FEATURES: ● 63 advanced blues licks. These challenging licks are not for beginners! ● Licks in 4 categories: Fast, chordal, jazz blues and diminished. ● Each lick has audio (played slow and fast) and a full transcription in guitar tablature (tab). ● Option to change each lick to all 12 keys. ● Track your progress by marking which licks are your favourites. ● No ads or in app purchasing! LICK CATEGORIES: Fast licks - Speedy, technical runs that can excitement to any blues solo. Chordal licks - These licks are based on blues chord shapes and can be added to both solos and rhythm guitar parts. Jazz blues licks - Sophisticated licks to add some jazzy flair to your playing. Diminished licks - Add some tension to your solos with these ear-catching diminished licks.

1506699351.name: 六筒陶笛 PRO
1506699351.description: 本APP为专业版，无广告，请放心下载。 六筒陶笛是一款非常容易上手的陶笛乐器，简单练习下就可以演奏出一首曲子。 【 指法 】指法和真实六孔陶笛相似，上手起来非常简单。 【 音域 】音域支持三个八度，可以覆盖绝大部分的曲子。 【 调性 】根音（也即调性）可以更换，一个APP相当于一套陶笛。 【 音量 】完全不用怕扰民，任何时候都可以练习与演奏。 希望大家能喜欢，给予我们好评与支持。谢谢！ 网友评价： 基本音阶1234567和六孔陶笛一样，高八度音和低八度音用上面两孔很容易演奏出来！ 音域突破六孔陶笛和十二孔陶笛的限制，达到三个八度，什么歌曲都能演奏出来了！ 而且指法超简单，再也不用变换指法了，一共37个根音，比一套7个陶笛全的多得多， 从此一个APP包打天下8-）

1506705379.name: KAKU² - 有趣的形状游戏
1506705379.description: 你为什么不尝试一下不寻常的“形状游戏”呢？ KAKU² 操纵人物创造出各种形状， 您可以通过附加零件来制作物体、动物等来创建图片。您还可以用图片玩拼图等形状游戏。 [ 创造 ] 首先，创建形状的图片。 点击屏幕以增加形状， 用手指移动形状并将其带到所需的位置。就这样！ 您可以移动形状、删除或添加它们， 因为无论怎么操作它都会变成彩色图案， 您只需观看即可享受它。 此外，由于您可以在形状中添加事物和图案， 请尝试动物、车辆等各种表现方式。 [ 游戏 ] 谜 - 图片中的形状将会散开。 将形状放回原位以完成图片。 因为你可以玩你创建的原始图片， 谜题模式和难度级别是无穷无尽的。 找我 - 在完成的图片中找到随机指定的形状。 没有时间限制，可以慢慢玩， 我正在记录时间，所以可以争取最好的成绩。 颜色 - 由于人物可以移动， 移动以使具有相同颜色的形状彼此相邻。 如果移动的形状上附着的形状颜色有 3 个或以上相同颜色，则该颜色的形状将会消失。 当您移动形状时，会添加一个新形状，因此 让我们在擦除形状的同时擦除所有形状并清除！ 这样就不会有“正确或错误”的东西可以制作，例如积木或玩粘土 此 KAKU² 没有正确答案。 触摸和移动，编辑和组合， 制作您自己的图片并享受！

1507240653.name: Clean Camera for Stream Feed
1507240653.description: Clean Camera provides manual controls for your camera. You can set the exposure, focus, shutter speed, and ISO setting. In addition, Clean Camera provides a clean interface though the hide button. Pressing this button hides the camera controls making the display ideal for mirroring. You can use the clean feed with AirPlay to your Airplay receiver, such as an Apple TV or a software receiver. The clean feed can also be used from the Airplay receiver to stream to services or OBS. Features: Clean interface option Screen lock prevention Auto and manual camera settings Auto and manual focus

1507281523.name: GAB対策 言語
1507281523.description: 【アプリの説明】 本アプリでは、お手持ちのスマートフォン・タブレットでお手軽に本格的なGAB言語の対策を行えます。 【アプリの特徴】 特徴１：本番に近いテスト環境 GABテストにも登場するプログレスバーを再現し、一目でテスト回答ペースを把握することができます。加えて質の高い問題を用意しているため、より本番に近いテスト環境で勉強をすることができます。 特徴２：豊富な問題数 本アプリでは、GABの長文読解問題について合計156問収録しています(39個の文章、一文章に4個の設問) 。 特徴３：サポート機能の充実 ・一文演習機能 本番形式で本格的に対策するモードだけでなく、手軽に一文章で演習するモードも用意しています。 ・文字サイズの調整 文章の文字を読みやすいサイズにご調整いただけます。 ・解いた問題を保存して復習できるノート機能 間違えた問題を保存して復習する、といったことが可能です。（最大30問保存可能） ・テスト制限時間のON/OFF 時間制限を意識せずに、時間を掛けて問題を解くこともできます。 ・5種類のカラーテーマを用意 夜間の勉強時はナイトモードにするなど、お好みのテーマを選択可能です。 【プライバシーポリシー】 https://www.moakly.com/privacypolicy 【利用規約】 https://www.moakly.com/terms

1507339788.name: 字习 Pro
1507339788.description: 「字习 Pro」真实模拟了中国毛笔 + 宣纸的书写效果，专注于将毛笔书法国粹带进数字时代。 中国书法是一门古老的汉字的书写艺术，从甲骨文演变而为大篆、小篆、隶书，至魏晋的草书、楷书、行书等，书法一直散发着艺术的魅力。中国书法是一种很独特的视觉艺术，而我们这种世界上独有的文化之美是可以借助数字技术让更多人随时体验和感受到的！ 基于 WebGPU (wgpu-rs) 的笔刷引擎实现了毛笔独特的表现力，您可以使用他随时随地体验中国书法的挥毫泼墨，创作毛笔书法作品。 特色： 一款中国传统书法的毛笔书写工具 充满水墨特色的创作工具 真实模拟毛笔洇染与飞白（基于运笔速度的快慢及 Pencil 的压力感应） 自由调整画笔大小 专有的春节写福创作 自由创作、撤销、重写 欣赏（重放书写过程） 保存作品到作品集 支持 iPad Pro 为了体验更畅快的书法效果，建议在 iPhone6s & iPad Air2 以上的设备中使用。

1507540450.name: FAC Phazer
1507540450.description: Inspired by famous phaser units from guitarist and keyboardist world Unique sonic character combined with a large amount of control Adjustable LFO; diverse waveforms and synchronizable to host tempo Versatile: External modulation (parameters), Step mode, and more Unique Butterfly Meter: Shows LFO modulation and output level Suitable for all musical genres and instruments Stereo, adjustable phase modulation distance between both channels Includes various presets for inspiration Advanced Responsive Design, portrait and landscape views Universal Purchase: AUv3 for iOS (iPad/iPhone), macOS and Vision Pro FAC Phazer will satisfy most fans of phasing effects, seducing them with its rich sonic palette and elegant interface. To achieve the classic phase effect, the original signal is blended with a slightly out-of-phase copy of itself. Altering the timing difference between the two signals produces the swooshing sound characteristic of phasing. Most phaser units available on the market are built around this circuit topology, each with its own specificities and limitations. Guitar pedals provide a great sonic signature out of the box and are a great source of inspiration, but we often overlook the impressive built-in effects sections of some hardware synthesizers. FAC Phazer combines the best of both worlds into a single plugin, offering access to all parameters involved in crafting the phasing effect. The design and development were inspired by both pedals and built-in phaser effects found in hardware synthesizers. This led to the creation of four unique characters: Classic, Midori, Step, and Tirus. All parameters can be applied to each of these characters, allowing you to create new, exciting, and outstanding sounds. The presets Slow, Moderate, and Jumpy Phase Pedal or also Fleur d’Oranger bring the classic pedals sound signature within your reach. If you're seeking more modern characteristics, the Step Sound I preset offers a splendid stepping mode, while the Midori Phase Shift II preset emphasizes the feedback in a unique way. On the other hand, the Tirus Anthem preset is an excellent starting point for exploring phasing effects produced with built-in synthesizer effects. An important aspect that strongly contributes to the variety of the sonic palette provided by the plugin is the modulation options. The LFO can run in free mode, be synchronized to the host tempo, or be defined by external automation parameters. The documentation is available at fredantoncorvest.com/FAC_Phazer.html

1507712667.name: Days in Canada
1507712667.description: Are you planning to be a Permanent Resident in Canada and apply for Citizenship someday? If so, this is the app for you! "Days in Canada" will help you manage your trips to/from Canada and also your status changes. From this information we calculate how long you've been in the country and give you the estimate date that you will be able to apply for Canadian citizenship. Additionally, you will get a notification when the day finally comes! All information is saved on iCloud and synced to your devices, so you can manage it from your iPhone, iPad and even from your Mac. We have tested and compared many results to the official Physical Presence Calculator so we believe "Days in Canada" is very reliable. When it's time to apply, you still need to use the official calculator to generate the application documents, but since you'll have all the information in hand, that process will be much easier! If, by any chance, you find out that the results in the app are not the same as the official calculator, please let us know so we can improve the algorithm to others ;) (the email address is in the bottom of the "Privacy Policy" link below) Features resume: Manage your trips Keep track of how many days you've been in Canada and your citizenship application date Get a notification when it's time to apply Sync your data to iCloud Supported on iPhone, iPad and Mac In English, French, Portuguese and Spanish Currently it doesn't support management of "time serving a sentence for an offence in Canada". Known issues: For a few event timelines, the application day can vary from the official physical presence calculator by 1 day. If you find any bugs or have any suggestions, feel free to contact me by email (the address is in the bottom of the "Privacy Policy" link below)

1508623861.name: ATA Thyrosim
1508623861.description: The app was developed and well-validated from real normal and hypothyroid human data and it features a simple and intuitive user interface, designed to promote understanding of the basic physiology of this complex endocrine system – by laypersons as well as by clinicians and clinical educators and researchers. THYROSIM is particularly useful for understanding and safely exploring effects of perturbing the real system, in various ways – without the need for any real human or animal experimentation. The DIRECTIONS and EXAMPLE explain and illustrate normal physiological conditions. Users can then conduct simulated ‘‘what-if’’ experiments, to challenge the simulation model with abnormal conditions – as explained on the app interface pages. For example, users can simulate hypothyroidism (when the thyroid hormone level in blood is too low) or thyroid hormone malabsorption from the gut. Patients with hypothyroidism can visualize the effects of thyroid hormone replacement therapy, promoting adherence to their doctor’s dosing prescriptions, and also understand better why they should take thyroid hormone replacement drugs without food – facilitating understanding of impaired absorption of the drug in the presence of food. Thyroid cancer patients (any layperson) can visualize the effects of partial or complete surgical removal of the thyroid gland (thyroidectomy) on blood hormone levels, and thereby understand why they need individualized hormone replacement therapy, and so on. Physicians and laypersons can use THYROSIM as a patient education tool. Scientists can use THYROSIM for clinical research purposes. Clinical and pharmacology educators can use THYROSIM to teach medical and pharmacology students basic thyroid hormone physiology and pathophysiology, complete with easy to understand graphical renditions of the results of “what-if” experimentation with the simulator. Trainees and other students can benefit from use of THYROSIM as a means to deepen and test their understanding the complexities of the “pituitary-thyroid axis”, the primary organ interactions regulating blood thyroid hormone levels by feedback control. The THYROSIM model has been the basis for several important clinical study applications for well over a decade, with details published in the medical journals Thyroid and Frontiers in Endocrinology. Disclaimer: This tool is for simulation and visualization and does not establish a standard of care. Treatment decisions must be made based on the independent judgment of health care providers and each patient’s individual circumstances. This tool is not intended to take the place of physician judgment in diagnosing and treatment of particular patients. The American Thyroid Association® considers use of this resource to be voluntary. Please see the following publication reference for information on the background and process behind the mobile app: Predicting Optimal Combination LT4 + LT3 Therapy for Hypothyroidism Based on Residual Thyroid Function https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fendo.2019.00746/full

The THYROSIM model has been the basis for several important clinical study applications for well over a decade, with details published in the medical journals Thyroid and Frontiers in Endocrinology. 1508720931.description: 1 Meditation App and 100% FREE (no ads and no subscription)** Guided MEDITATION ** Whether you have 2 minutes or 2 hours in your day, Soothing Pod can fit into any schedule and is easy to use, no matter your experience with meditation. And with a new 10-minute meditation every day, there’s no shortage of mindfulness to melt your worries away. In our mission to make relaxation and mindfulness available to all, we also created meditations for kids as a way to introduce them to the practice of mindfulness. SLEEP STORIES ** Enjoy various soothing sleep stories from classic fairy tales like Cinderella, be whisked away to the Garden of Europe, or enjoy a story of a romantic getaway to a private island. With our vast library of sleep stories, the choice is yours. We also provide sleep stories created especially for kids, such as an adventure to the African safari, whale watching in California and many more. Relaxing Music & Sleep Sounds** From instrumental piano, guitar, smooth jazz, classical music and meditative tunes, our beautiful music is created to accompany you to sleep and help you relax NATURE SOUNDS Soothe your eyes as well as your ears with beautifully shot cinemagraphs and videos accompanying every soundscape. Escape to lush forests, flower fields, waterfalls, gentle streams and the most beautiful mountains and lakes. Enjoy hundreds of sounds that will let you escape, relax and lull you to sleep. SPECIAL FEATURES Toggle easily between Adult and Kids mode to help your young ones drift off to sleep. Customize each meditation and sleep story -- choose between male and female narrators and adjust the volume of music and sound effects according to your preference. Sleep timer -- you can set a sleep timer so our relaxing scenes will continue playing to accompany you to sleep. When the timer ends, the scene will gently fade out. Read the terms and conditions here: http://www.miinu.com/tos.php Read the privacy policy here: http://www.miinu.com/privacy.php We hope you enjoy resting and relaxing with Soothing Pod. With gratitude, The Soothing Pod Team

1508994911.trackName: 加密相册 - 保护重要私密照片/视频
1508994911.description: iPhone里有羞羞的照片如何加密？看这里！ 互联网时代保护个人隐私是非常重要的. 在将手机中的照片同步到云服务器之前或将手机借给别人暂时使用时,请务必将手机中的重要照片加密! 加密相册App使用指纹id,人脸识别,数字密码等方式对加密后的照片进行保护, 并且APP并不访问网络, 所有加密相关的数据都是保存在手机的相册中. 功能特点: 方便的加密/解密手机相簿中的照片 支持导出解密后的照片至其他APP, 例如facebook, DropBox, 或是手机自带的APP "文件"等. 方便管理加密后的照片 保存在手机相册中的加密照片可以方便的同步到网盘或iCloud服务之类的云存储设施, 仅在手机上可以看到解密后的照片.

1509037022.name: 我的目标 - iTarget
1509037022.description: 每个人都要有目标，目标是人生的指路灯。当你迷惑时，它能带你走出困境；当你动力不足时，它能激励你继续努力；当你遇到挫折时，它能给你力量站起来。 应用设计简单, 界面优美, 侧重核心功能----目标打卡。另有精美的目标详情内容、标签分类、定时提醒、日历记录等实用功能。数据存储均在本地, 不经过任何服务器, 隐私泄露0风险。 小技巧: 打卡页的列表项可长按呼出快捷菜单 目标页的列表项可长按呼出快捷菜单 打卡记录页的列表项可长按呼出快捷菜单 标签管理的已创建标签可长按拖动到右下角删除 目标设置带图片的详情内容, 会随机选择一张作为封面图 查看目标的详情, 可对详情内容喜欢的图片长按, 可保存图片, 或者设为封面 应用有四个模块 打卡 对进行中的目标打卡(长按列表项可呼出快捷菜单) 打卡记录 日历查看记录 查看全部记录(列表和地图) 补加附言(长按列表项) 目标 查看目标列表 修改目标状态(长按列表项) 设置 标签管理 目标回收站 设置打卡方式 目标回收再设置 其它 目标的四种状态, 可根据自身的需求变更目标的状态: 未开始 进行中 暂停(进行中的目标暂时停止, 可在需要的时候恢复) 结束(目标已经结束, 不再能修改) 目标的优先级分3个, 均为使用 ! 表示, 低(!)、中(!!)、高(!!!) 目标的详情内容可随意图文混排 文字可设置不同的字号、颜色、段落对齐 图片可任意添加 详情内容长而复杂, 也不影响流畅 在使用的过程中, 如有疑问、建议、反馈, 欢迎来联系, 我会尽快回复。 邮箱: 875766917@qq.com 博客: https://blog.skytoup.com QQ交流群: 963500538

1509161616.name: 风帆纪元
1509161616.description: →App Store上线连续一周在中国大陆、中国港澳台区域 iPhone 付费榜排行第二，iPad 付费榜排行第一。 →入选2025年中国大陆区域App Store独立游戏周合集并获Today推荐以及App Store游戏首页推荐。 →多次入选中国港澳台区域 App Store“编辑爱游戏”“游戏上架推荐”“新春畅玩游戏” 等多个推荐位，玩家反馈良好。 →Steam 上线连续一周热销榜排行第一，中国区新品销售榜单第一，全球热销榜第八。 童年偷偷躲在屏幕前，为《大航海时代》里发现新大陆而欢呼雀跃的日子，你还记得吗？那些在像素港口与商人斗智斗勇、在海战中热血拼杀的珍贵记忆，是多少人心中永不褪色的航海梦！怀揣着对经典的敬意，作为一款超拟真大世界航海经营冒险单机手游，《风帆纪元》即将同步面向国内玩家开启航海征程！复刻记忆中的航海魂，融入颠覆性创新玩法，带你重走儿时向往的航海之路，这一次，换你亲自书写震撼世界的海上传奇！ 四国船长主角！谁能主宰海洋？ 四个来自不同国度的船长，怀揣着截然不同的野心与秘密！是手握战刀，将整片海洋踏在脚下的铁血霸主？还是凭借智慧与谋略，掌控全球商路的商业帝王？每一个选择，都将彻底改写大航海时代的历史！你，准备好以谁的身份，在这片惊涛骇浪中留下自己的印记了吗？ 30+传奇伙伴！组队制霸五湖四海！ 牛津学者的智慧、传奇海盗的疯狂、犹太商贾的狡黠……30+身怀绝技的传奇伙伴，正等待与你组队！和他们一起破解古老航海密码，突袭神秘宝藏岛屿，开辟隐秘商路！这里没有独行侠，只有并肩作战的王者之师，你，会是那个让他们甘心追随的领袖吗？ 真实海域！每一次航行都充满未知 1:1复刻15世纪地球海域，每一阵风、每一场雨、每一次海浪的咆哮都暗藏杀机！前一秒还风和日丽，下一秒暴风雨就能将你的船只撕成碎片；平静的海面下，随时可能窜出海盗的舰队！但这又如何？动动手指操控帆舵，征服这片桀骜不驯的海洋，建立属于你的海上霸业！你，有这个胆量吗？ 日式美学！每一帧都美到窒息 吉田明彦风格的古典幻想画风，搭配复古光影滤镜，直接将中世纪航海绘本搬进手机！哥特式港口在血色残阳中宛如恶魔城堡，东方楼阁在粼粼波光中若隐若现！阳光洒在海面，金箔般的光芒随船而动——这里的每一处风景，都值得你向全世界炫耀！你，不想成为这片绝美海洋的主人吗？ 史诗剧情！你就是历史的主角 从哥伦布发现新大陆到郑和下西洋，真实历史事件与奇幻冒险完美融合！和历史名人并肩作战，亲历改变世界的伟大时刻！开放世界+网状任务，你的每一个决定，都将推动历史的车轮滚滚向前！你，难道不想成为那个被历史铭记的航海英雄吗？ 现在！立刻！启航！这片充满宝藏与危险、荣耀与挑战的海洋，正在向你发出最后的邀请！是龟缩在现实的角落，继续做一个旁观者？还是登上《风帆纪元》的战船，成为15世纪的海上传奇？答案，就在你的手中！ 90年代的《大航海时代》是我们童年难忘的情怀与回忆，我们在《风帆纪元》中倾注了从“大航海”中获得的热情与梦想，希望通过《风帆纪元》致敬经典，并在这里为玩家们绘制出一个跌宕起伏的“航海新旅程”。茨威格的《人类群星闪耀时》中描述道：大量看似平凡的事件在历史长河中按部就班地流动着，但在某个瞬间，那些事件汇聚在一起，就像避雷针的顶端汇聚了整个电场，决定了整个历史的走向。 ——我们正为了呈现出这样的体验而努力着。 【超多福利活动资讯更新】欢迎各位航海家追踪官方社群： →抖音/快手/B站/微博/小红书：@风帆纪元手游 如遇到任何困难、对游戏有任何反馈或是想找到志同道合的航海家，欢迎加入我们官方QQ群： →QQ群号：961211065

1509174775.name: Vistax - Pro Camera
1509174775.description: Vistax combines pro-level manual controls with creative tools like film simulations and Zen mode, all in a privacy-first camera app with zero tracking. Pro-Level Control: Manual Mode: Full control over shutter speed, ISO, white balance, and focus ProRAW/DNG: RAW capture for maximum post-processing flexibility Non-Destructive Edits: Apply colour filters or image formats while preserving your original, saved as an iOS photo edit or a separate file Creative Expression: Zen Mode: A distraction-free, minimalist interface focused solely on composition Film Simulations: A vast library including iconic Fuji-X emulations. Bring your own custom .cube LUTs Camera Presets: Save and recall your favourite camera settings with a single tap Exposure Tools: Shutter priority, ISO priority, full auto, and manual exposure modes Automatic exposure bracketing: up to 5 brackets, -5/+5 EV Exposure compensation, live histogram, and zebra over-exposure warning Full Feature Set: iOS Widget: Quick access to presets from your home or lock screen Camera Control: Launch Vistax or take shots with the hardware Camera Control (iPhone 16 & 17 Pro & Pro Max) High-Resolution Capture: Stunning 48MP images (*) Portrait Mode: Professional portraits with depth effects (*) iOS Deep Fusion and Smart HDR (*) Focus peaking and manual focus Manual and auto white balance Capture in HEIC / JPEG / RAW+JPEG / RAW+HEIC / RAW / ProRAW (DNG) Wide Gamut: Vibrant, accurate colours across supported displays Composition Aids: Rule of thirds, golden triangles, and fine mesh grids Rangefinder Mode: See beyond the frame with rangefinder-style framing lines Shutter Timer: 3s and 10s delays Privacy-First Vistax contains zero tracking or third-party SDKs (*) Compatibility Notes Some features depend on your device's hardware: Camera Control: iPhone 16 Pro (& Max), 17 Pro (& Max) 48MP capture: iPhone 14 Pro (& Max) and later Pro models. Not available in manual, semi-auto, or portrait modes ProRAW: iPhone 12 Pro (& Max) and later Pro models RAW: Most iPhones from 6S onwards, iPad Pro (varies by model) Portrait mode: iPhone 7 Plus and later, iPad Pro Smart HDR / Deep Fusion: iPhone 11 and later Ultra Wide lens may not support RAW or manual focus/exposure modes on some devices

1510565629.description: A-Zippr 是一款简单、快速且功能强大的实用工具，可打开 zip、RAR 和其他压缩包（如 7z、SIT 和 TAR），以及 70 多种不同的文件格式，并将它们压缩为 8 种常用的压缩包格式。 它是手工制作的，是在 Mac 上归档和解压缩文件的最可定制的方式。 ■ 即时压缩和解压缩文件。 ■ 提取前预览文件细节。 ■ 使用强大的 256 位 AES 加密保护文件。 ■ 只解压您选择的文件，而无需解压整个压缩包。 ■ 压缩或提取完成后发出通知。 ≈ 归档和解压缩（EASY） ≈ ◉ 将文件拖放到压缩或解压缩位置 ◉ 调整文件大小，以便更快地共享和减少存储空间。 ◉ 提取主要文件格式，如 Zip、RAR、TAR、LHA、7Z、JAR 和其他 70 多种格式 ◉ 当文件拖放到浮动拖放窗口时，会自动识别是压缩还是解压缩 ◉ 将浮动下拉窗口设置为屏幕的任意角落。 ◉ 使用不同方法压缩文件，如快速、更快、正常、慢速和最慢。 ≈ 文件加密：（SECURE） ≈ ◉ 对机密文件进行密码保护，并应用强大的 AES 加密。 ◉ 防止未经授权访问电子邮件附件。 ◉ 加密压缩文件夹中的单个文件。 ≈ 预览文件：(SAFE) ≈ ◉ 快速查看框架，可在解压缩前预览文件（甚至不会像其他应用程序那样放在临时文件中） ◉ 从归档文件夹中解压单个文件。 ◉在解压缩前单独获取详细的文件信息。 ◉ 从预览中添加或删除文件。 ◉ 预览文件的本地用户体验 现在，你拥有的所有压缩文件都能用 Unarchiver 自动打开，你将永远忘记 "未知格式 "提示和解压缩错误。有了 Mac 版 RAR 解压程序，你就可以节省大量处理压缩文件的时间。 如果你有任何问题或建议，请发送电子邮件至 support@appyogi.com。 支持的文件格式 ◈ 存档： zip, rar, tar, 7z, gzip, bzip2, iso, lzip ◈ 解压缩： zip, z01, rar, 7z, tar, lha, zipz, sit, sitx, hqx, bin, macbin, as, gz, gzip, tgz, tar,gz, bz2, bzip2, bz, tbz2, tbz, xz, txz, iso, cdi, nrg, mdf, gtar, z, taz, tar. z、lzma、xar、xip、ace、pak、spk、zoo、lbr、lqr、lzr、pma、cab、rpm、deb、alz、dd、cpt、pit、now、sea、exe、msi、cpio、 cpgz, pax, warc, ha, adf, adz, dms, f, lzx, dcs, pkd, xms, zom, pp, nsa, sar, jar, cbz, cbr, nds, pkg, a, swf, lz, tlz ※ 隐私政策： https://appyogi.com/legal/privacy/ ※ 使用条款： https://appyogi.com/legal/terms/

1511092361.name: 有效值计算器
1511092361.description: 应该如何计算有效值（RMS）？ 100V有效值的幅度是多少？ 在这种情况下，您在每次检查计算公式时都具有计算有效值的经验吗？ 这个程序可以快速转换交流波形的有效值和幅度。 转换单位有4种：有效值（RMS），平均值，峰值(Peak)和峰峰值(Peak to Peak)。 通过输入交流波形的幅度或有效值并选择输入值的单位，将显示转换为4种单位的值。 English--- How should the effective value be calculated? What is the amplitude of the effective value of 100V? In such a case, do you have any experience of calculating the effective value while checking the calculation formula every time? This app can quickly convert the effective value and amplitude of AC waveforms. There are 4 types of conversion units: rms value, average value, amplitude, and Peak to Peak Amplitude. By inputting the amplitude or effective value of the AC waveform and selecting the unit of the input value, the value converted into 4 types of units will be displayed.

1511139245.name: ABRSM Piano Scales Trainer
1511139245.description: Be smart about how you practise scales with the OFFICIAL ABRSM Piano Scales Trainer. Piano Scales Trainer is your all-in-one companion for practising Scales. The app covers all scales requirements at Grades 1-5 from the NEW syllabus requirements (2021 onwards). What does Piano Scales Trainer include? An extensive set of resources to help you practise your scales and learn the requirements for your grade: Practice Area Notation for every scale, including suggested fingering. Example performances of every scale, for you to compare your own playing against. A built-in metronome to help you see how close you are to exam tempo. Start slow and gradually build up the speed! A unique backing track for every scale. Test Area In need of a quick warm-up, or fancy practising exam-style? The Test area selects a series of scales from the requirements for you to perform. Use the record function, reflect critically and rate your performance. Practice Meter The more you use Piano Scales Trainer, the smarter it gets. Head on over to the Practice Meter to see at a glance which scales you’re doing well at, and which ones need more practice.

1511149985.name: WOOTT
1511149985.description: WOOTT is an Audio Unit plugin (AUv3 audio effect) inspired by the infamous OTT sound. WOOTT uses a triple band dynamics algorithm with simultaneous downwards AND upwards compression, and adds a dedicated limiter to each band. So what's all that techno mumbojumbo good for? 1. First, it slams all the loud, dominant aspects of your sound 2. Next it blows up all the subtle quiet bits that were hiding below As a result, it's perfect for: Blowing up average sounds to massive proportions Giving an aggressive sharp edge to synthesizer filters Bringing out subtle details and movement that would otherwise get lost in the mix (in a hamfisted way, though) Dusting off old breakbeat samples and loops Hyping specific aspects of your synth lines Making generally boring things more interesting WOOTT features: AUv3 audio unit effect plugin Universal (all iPads and iPhones supported + MacOS M & Intel) Runs in all your favorite AUv3 plugin hosts: Cubasis, AUM, Beatmaker 3, Nanostudio 2, Garageband, etc. Multi-output (requires compatible host) for post-processing the individual bands Low-resource, so stack as many of them as you like - "[WO]OTT all the things!" Downwards *and* upwards compressors (a rare feature on conventional dynamics plugins) Smart soft limiter per band, adapts to its own band's specific settings Mono switch makes low-band signal monaural for an extra tight bass Note: this is not a subtle effect. If subtle and minimal are what you're after, this is not the droid you're looking for :-)

1511185471.name: Steve and Maggie Food App
1511185471.description: Have fun catapulting everything into Steve and Maggie’s shopping trolley before the shop closes! Practice your listening skills along with hand to eye co-ordination in this crazy trip to the supermarket! The ‘Steve and Maggie’ YouTube channel is known around the world as a trusted resource for children, with around 8 million subscribers (including localised channels in a number of languages). This app brings an interactive version of these much loved characters onto your mobile device for all to enjoy. Your child will need to follow instructions, identify several common food items, and race against the clock to reach the reward page before the lights go out. Can they do better than you when playing the difficult level? Be warned though... the difficult level is difficult!

1511426609.name: Stream For OBS
1511426609.description: This application works with OBS Studio via USB connection only. You can use full matrix picture from iPhone device camera. You can switch front/rear camera. For hide/show switch button, tap once on the screen. When you connect your iPhone to the OBS Studio application, you can see iPhone as external video camera. Just add video source to the scene and choose your iphone as source of video. Start StreamOBS application and you will see full screen video from the iPhone camera device. In most of other cases, you need crop picture, cause capture cameras screen has a lot of info, such as "record button" / "flash button " / "switch camera button" / "tracking square for face" and other... As a fact, you need crop image to receive video inside OBS Studio. So, you will see only part of you video at last... This application hides all unneeded elements from the screen, and you can capture video from the full whole matrix. Stream you video to youtube, twitch and other platforms with OBS Studio and your iPhone as a main camera device. User Agreement: https://serve.center/streamobs/agreement Policy: https://serve.center/streamobs/policy Sample use with OBS on MacOSX: https://youtu.be/5L1m5U4S894?t=104 Works with USB connection only on MacOSX You can rotate screen from Portrait to Landscape mode uses transform function of OBS.

1511746522.name: SoundSpecs
1511746522.description: SoundSpecs is the ultimate technical reference guide for audio engineers. It provides all the technical information you need for thousands of microphones, loudspeakers and amplifiers, all from manufacturer-provided documentation. With an easily-accessible favourites list, the information you need most-often is ready for you when you need it! And now with multi-tasking support on iPad, you can compare equipment side-by-side to help you make decisions in the field. All data is stored offline, so whether you're in a field or a theatre basement SoundSpecs has you covered.
