1531647131.name: 英语自然拼读法第4级 - English Phonics
1531647131.trackName: 英语自然拼读法第4级 - English Phonics
1531647131.description: 专为亚洲孩子量身定制！一套好教易学的自然拼读启蒙课程！ 英语自然拼读法通过直接学习26个字母及字母组合在单词中的发音规则，建立字母及字母组合与发音的感知，使学习者达到“见词能读、听音能写”的神奇效果。 课程从初学英语的亚洲孩子的角度设计编写，遵循由易到难、由浅入深、由一般到特殊的规律，完整、系统、科学地教授了自然拼读法，并结合多样、实用、有创意的游戏活动和歌曲歌谣，让孩子循序渐进、轻松快乐地掌握并运用英语读写的基本技能。 课程令人耳目一新的设计风格，生动可爱的卡通形象令孩子们爱不释手。画面简洁大方，充满童趣。课程设置科学性强，循序渐进。 配合大量趣味练习，从各方面加强学生对自然拼读的深层掌握，提升应用能力。让孩子们在兴趣浓厚的学习氛围中不知不觉的实现“见词能读，听音能写，快乐阅读”。 该课程既可以作为单项语音课学习，还可以配合其它常规课同步使用。迅速建立字母与发音之间的直接音感，奠定学生听音、认词、辩音、读词、拼写的良好基础，在短期内提高英语阅读和拼写能力。 突出特色： ■体系科学、脉络清晰，遵循了由易到难、由简单到复杂、由普遍到特殊、由形象到抽象的学习和认知规律，保证最佳学习效果！ ■以全语言教学法输入大量真实、准确的英语情境并展开阅读实践，让孩子在做中学、在学中用。 ■将视觉词（sight words)、音素意识（phonemic awareness)、自然拼读（phonics)三大模块整合学习，并辅以互动游戏，让学生轻松学。 全套4个级别，分别为26个字母，短元音，长元音，字母组合音，适合5-10岁儿童学习。能显著促进综合英语课程的学习。 本应用配套该系列的第4级别课程。 学习效果 ＊ 见词能读，听音能写。帮助孩子掌握科学的拼词技巧，让孩子记单词不再费力。小学阶段英语词汇的见词能读率达到85%以上。 ＊ 能进行初级阶段的阅读，能阅读200字以内的短文，诵读歌谣，并具备初步的写作意识。 教材特点 ＊ 4 Levels，适合5-10岁儿童学习。级别减少，容量加大，更方便培训学校进行课程设置； ＊ 多媒体互动教学，方便学生进行家庭学习；真正实现“见词能读，听音能写，快乐阅读”！ ＊ 生动有趣的游戏和活动，奠定学生听音、拼写，记词，阅读的良好基础，在短期内提高拼写和阅读技能，全面发展学生听说读写能力。 ＊ 可与任何综合教程搭配使用，是培训机构的招生利器！ 主单元： 每个主单元由7部分构成: Let's Learn\Sound Power（新知识学习）：有趣的歌谣或故事导入新字母或字母组合发音及单词； Word Power（新知识学习）：学生通过生动的图片来学习新单词和发音； Sound Power\Listening Power（巩固复习）：通过听力训练来强化目标字母或字母组合发音、相关单词； Writing Power（巩固复习）：通过书写训练帮助学生强化所学的目标字母或字母组合，单词和发音； Let's Play\Reading Power（巩固复习）：涂色，贴画，阅读等多种活动巩固单元知识； Story Time（复习提高）：故事里包含了自然拼音目标词汇，常用词汇，着重培养学生阅读能力，全面训练学生听说读写； Let's Check（复习提高）：形式多样的练习活动起到复习和扩展的作用。 复习单元： 4个复习单元分别是1-5单元的复习单元和复习故事单元，6-10单元的复习单元和复习故事单元。 活动单元： 2个活动单元分别由游戏和活动组成。 第4级目录： Unit01 L-blends bl pl cl gl Unit02 R-blends dr tr cr fr Unit03 S-blends sm sn sw st Unit04 Ending Blends ng nk ck nt Unit05 Digraphs ch sh Review 1 Unit01-05 Unit06 Digraphs th ph wh Unit07 Digraphs au aw Unit08 Digraphs long oo short oo Unit09 Diphthongs oi oy Unit10 Diphthongs ou ow Review 2 Unit06-10 Activity 1 - The Board Game Activity 2 - Complete the Words

1531679862.name: GENKI Vocab for 3rd Ed.
1531679862.description: Learn elementary Japanese words at your own pace! GENKI Vocab for 3rd Ed. is an app that enables users to learn more than 1,200 words essential for beginners. This is the official iPhone app for the 3rd edition of GENKI: An Integrated Course in Elementary Japanese, a best-selling series of Japanese learning materials boasting more than 3.5 million copies sold worldwide. Advantages ◆Users can view the words and listen to the recordings as they like, enabling them to study at their own pace. ◆By repeating a process of memorization and self-checking, learners can firmly master important beginning-level vocabulary. ◆Words already memorized are progressively removed from the study set, so users can concentrate on just the words that challenge them, making for a more efficient approach to learning. This app will not play audio if your device is in Silent mode (Vibrate mode). To hear the audio, please turn Silent mode off. Study methods and functions This app has three main modes: Study, Check, and List. ◇ "Study" allows users to view the words, their meanings, and the example sentences over and over, so they can take their time learning. ・Audio recordings of all words and example sentences are provided with natural pronunciations by native speakers of Japanese. ・Fun illustrations help users to better retain the words studied. ・Users can bookmark the words they like. The bookmarked words are compiled in the Bookmark list in "List." ◇ “Check” helps learners to track their mastery. ・Users check their understanding of the vocabulary studied and sort the words into those mastered and those not yet retained. ・The words already mastered are taken out of the study set, leaving behind just those that still need to be worked on. ◇ “List” displays a list of all words covered by the app so that users can see their progress and review the vocabulary. ・The list can be arranged in any of three orderings: lesson order, a-i-u-e-o order, and alphabetical order. The words bookmarked in the Study mode are also listed in the Bookmark list. ・Checkmarks are automatically placed next to words that have been mastered. ・The Study view of words can be displayed from the list entries, enabling quick review. ○This app is based on the vocabulary from the third edition of GENKI. ○Ads: The app does not display any ads that might interfere with learning.

1532036167.name: B777 Flight Deck
1532036167.description: This app provides a fully functional buttons/switches and systems responses to them. The following flight deck systems and panels are included in this app: Control Display Unit (CDU); All FMS pages. Display Select Panel (DSP) and Multifunction Display (MFD). Electronic Flight Instrument System (EFIS) and Navigation Display (ND) Mode Control Panel (MCP) and Primary Flight Display (PFD) The following overhead panels: HYD, FUEL,FUEL JETTISON, AIR COND, BLD AIR, ANTI-ICE, PRESSURIZATION, ELECTRICAL, LIGHTING and the synoptic display reaction to the buttons and switches. Electronic Checklists (ECL): Normal and Non-Normal Performance results and graphs Real pictures with high resolution taken in the 777 cockpit for every panel providing it with very realistic and clear view when zooming. Please pay attention to the following to avoid any misunderstanding before purchase (refund can be obtained via app store if this app is not what you were looking for!): This is not a gaming app, it is an educational app. The aircraft does NOT simulate any movement. It considers the aircraft being still on ground with engines running. Some aircraft systems (such as CDU, HYDRAULIC system auto logic ... etc) will respond as it would in a real pre-flight scenario. ECL pages are not interactive (except for FUEL IMBALANCE page). All COMM pages are also available (not interactive) There is only ONE route flight plan (from OMDB - OOMS). The intention is to simulate how all the waypoints respond with the ND and with the other pages of the CDU. It is not the intention of this app to fly them or do any kind of approach or landing The performance calculations and predictions of the FMS such as (predicted Flight Level, time, fuel, ECON, EO SPD, weight ....etc) are estimate and may not represent accurate values. Graphs examples are provided to show how FMS generates these performance data. These graphs are based on a training model aircraft and may not represent actual model values FMS Navigation data (VOR, Fixes, AIRPORTS ...etc) that are allowed for entry are shown as a note next the relevant FMS page. EICAS messages in the upper display unit are currently unresponsive in this app version. "B777 Flight Deck" is a one time payment app (No annual subscription is required). With any improvement made, a new updated version will be released for free. This app is mostly suitable for either new joiners to B777 or even experienced commercial pilots who are currently grounded and would like to brush up on their knowledge. It can be used alongside your Boeing FCOM / QRH to see how each system will actually respond. Nevertheless, it is important to note that, due to updates and downgrades as well as airlines customization and various procedures, each airline's FMS, ECL and other systems may differ from the others. As a result, this app is to be used as secondary in precedence to all operational references and it does not substitute for proper certified training.

Electronic Flight Instrument System (EFIS) and Navigation Display (ND) Mode Control Panel (MCP) and Primary Flight Display (PFD) The following overhead panels: HYD, FUEL,FUEL JETTISON, AIR COND, BLD AIR, ANTI-ICE, PRESSURIZATION, ELECTRICAL, LIGHTING and the synoptic display reaction to the buttons and switches. Electronic Checklists (ECL): Normal and Non-Normal Performance results and graphs Real pictures with high resolution taken in the 777 cockpit for every panel providing it with very realistic and clear view when zooming. Please pay attention to the following to avoid any misunderstanding before purchase (refund can be obtained via app store if this app is not what you were looking for!): This is not a gaming app, it is an educational app. The aircraft does NOT simulate any movement. It considers the aircraft being still on ground with engines running. Some aircraft systems (such as CDU, HYDRAULIC system auto logic ... etc) will respond as it would in a real pre-flight scenario. ECL pages are not interactive (except for FUEL IMBALANCE page). All COMM pages are also available (not interactive) There is only ONE route flight plan (from OMDB - OOMS). The intention is to simulate how all the waypoints respond with the ND and with the other pages of the CDU. It is not the intention of this app to fly them or do any kind of approach or landing The performance calculations and predictions of the FMS such as (predicted Flight Level, time, fuel, ECON, EO SPD, weight ....etc) are estimate and may not represent accurate values. Graphs examples are provided to show how FMS generates these performance data. These graphs are based on a training model aircraft and may not represent actual model values FMS Navigation data (VOR, Fixes, AIRPORTS ...etc) that are allowed for entry are shown as a note next the relevant FMS page. EICAS messages in the upper display unit are currently unresponsive in this app version. "B777 Flight Deck" is a one time payment app (No annual subscription is required). This app is mostly suitable for either new joiners to B777 or even experienced commercial pilots who are currently grounded and would like to brush up on their knowledge. It can be used alongside your Boeing FCOM / QRH to see how each system will actually respond. Nevertheless, it is important to note that, due to updates and downgrades as well as airlines customization and various procedures, each airline's FMS, ECL and other systems may differ from the others. 1532586661.name: 腦珠算全教程(進階)
1532586661.description: 「腦珠算全教程(進階)」集中講解珠心算的乘法與除法, 內容劃分為兩個部分, 分別是互動教程與雙手運珠解題示範器, 配合乘除法專門的選項讓學習更得心應手。 豐富互動圖文解說: 介面設計簡單且好學易懂,與其純粹單憑以文字作說明, 各個概念均備有詳盡的圖解圖表作比較與說明, 消除言語上的誤解及障礙, 更有效解地解釋艱深理論, 簡化繁複過程, 深入淺出各個複雜的重點。同時, 每個課堂均以大量例子覆蓋, 而每個例子都設有逐步詳盡的示範, 讓自學變得毫無難度。 雙手撥珠示範器: 撥珠示範器讓我們輸入一個數字或一道算式, 系統將會自動地在算盤上逐步進行撥珠及運算的示範並詳述說明, 我們更可以隨時暫停當前步驟並仔細觀察說明, 或更換別的題目或數字進行新一輪的示範。 模擬算盤: 配合模擬算盤以便我們可以在任何時間開始進行運算, 課堂內建的模擬算盤讓大家可以隨時跟隨課堂, 在算盤上同時練習雙手運珠的方法。大家既可以按照頁面的圖解步驟同步運算, 也可先行嘗試運算一次, 然後再與對應的示範步驟互相核對。 內容特式: 著手各類中階珠心算技術與課題 雙手運珠法促進右腦提升 小數至多位數乘法的圖文講解 學習最棒的運算技巧 - 乘法一口清 全面分析各類除法估商法的細節 實戰商過大或商過小的調商技巧 解題示範器加設乘除法的專屬選項 更多詳盡介紹 https://www.hamsterforce.com/MentalAbacusTC.html

1532588789.name: Photo Widget — The Best One
1532588789.description: Put photos on your home screen using widgets. It also works great with StandBy. Create as many photo widgets as you like with one or more photos per widget. If you choose more than one photo, it will change photos on a time interval (which can be customized in the settings). Each widget can have separate photos. You can also show photos from an album in your photo library. ■ Features Widgets with a single photo. Widgets with multiple photos that change on an interval (slideshow). Widgets showing photos from an album in your photo library (slideshow). Three widget sizes. Import photos from the photo library or the file system. Tapping a widget can either show a larger preview of the photo, open a URL, or run a shortcut. The “Album” widget has a setting to show a random photo only from the most recent `n` photos in the album, where `n` is the number you choose. ■ How it works First, decide whether you want to select the individual photos to show (1) or just choose an existing album from your photo library (2). 1. Add photos to the app which you can later choose from in a widget. Then add the “Photo Widget” widget with the “Photos” type and edit the widget to pick the photos to show. 2. Add the “Photo Widget” widget with the “Album” type and edit it to choose the album. ■ Limitation If you make two or more widgets of the same size where all of them are set to show all the photos or the same album, they will show photos in the same order. This is a limitation in the iOS widget system. You can work around this by giving the widgets unique names in the widget configuration. ■ Tip If you have a widget that cycles between photos and you want to force it to skip to the next photo, long-press the widget, select “Edit Widget”, and then close the edit view. The widget should now have a new photo. ■ FAQ 〉 How do I add a widget to the home screen? When on the home screen, long-press on the background (not on any icons), press the top-left “+” button, and select “Photo Widget”. 〉 How do I edit a widget? When on the home screen, long-press on the widget, and select “Edit Widget”. 〉 Why can I only add 100 photos to the app? This is because of a technical limitation in the iOS widget system. Hopefully, it can be increased in the future. It should be enough for most users though. If you use the “Album” widget, there’s no limit to the number of photos. 〉 How can I hide the name of the app shown below the widget? This is not possible. App developers have no way to hide it. 〉 How is this different from the built-in “Photos” widget? The built-in widget only shows photos from “Memories” and “Featured Photos” in your photo library. There is no way to customize it or pick the photos to be shown. 〉 Can I show an animated GIF in a widget? This is not possible.

1532704238.trackName: Lang Offline: 旅行短语手册

1532775654.name: Save Locations with Photos
1532775654.description: Save important places with photos, notes and custom pins. Use offline maps, measure distances, view GPS coordinates, quickly find or share saved locations, and open any saved pin in Apple Maps or Google Maps to navigate to it. Save Locations in Seconds Found a place you want to remember? Drop a pin on the map and Save My Pins keeps the location ready whenever you need it again. Use saved pins for travel destinations, parking locations, restaurants, meeting points, hotels, outdoor locations or anything else worth keeping. Add Photos to Your Map Pins A coordinate alone doesn't always tell the whole story. Save My Pins lets you attach photos and notes to saved locations so you can remember what was there and why you saved it. Your map becomes a visual collection of places rather than a list of anonymous coordinates. Access Maps Offline Internet access isn't guaranteed everywhere. Download offline map areas before traveling so important map information remains available when mobile coverage is weak or unavailable. It's especially useful while traveling, exploring remote areas or managing locations where reliable internet isn't available. View GPS Coordinates Need more detailed location information? Save My Pins displays latitude and longitude together with useful GPS information such as altitude and location accuracy. You can save the location as a pin and return to it later. Measure Distance Between Locations Use the built-in distance measurement tool to connect multiple map points and calculate distances. It's useful for checking how far places are from each other or planning movement between several locations. Organize Saved Places Give locations meaningful names and organize them using different pin styles. You can keep different types of places visually separated and quickly search your collection when you need a particular saved location. Keep Your Places With You From a photo-worthy location to somewhere you simply need to find again, Save My Pins gives you one place to store and organize the locations that matter to you.

1532827079.name: Brain Tool Kit
1532827079.description: Brain Tool Kit: Visual, Vestibular & Cognitive Training for Neuroperformance Brain Tool Kit is an interactive digital training platform designed to support sport vision performance, concussion rehabilitation, vestibular rehabilitation, and cognitive-motor training. It is many apps all in one easy to use place. Using customizable visual stimuli, eye movement exercises, memory challenges, and cognitive tasks, Brain Tool Kit helps practitioners and users train the systems involved in attention, visual processing, reaction speed, working memory, and sensorimotor integration. Features include: Visual & Vestibular Training Gaze fixation and gaze stability exercises Smooth pursuits Saccades and anti-saccades Optokinetic (OPK) stimulation Hemifield stimulation Eye movement combinations and progression-based exercises Cognitive & Neuroperformance Training Interactive Stroop tasks requiring responses to incongruent visual information Random letter and shape tasks for attention, processing speed, and verbal fluency training Memory tasks including recall and working memory challenges Customizable colour, speed, duration, and difficulty settings Brain Tool Kit allows practitioners to customize activities based on individual goals and use the app as part of structured rehabilitation, sports performance as well as many other neuroperformance areas. Designed for use alongside professional guidance, Brain Tool Kit can support: Concussion recovery programs Vestibular rehabilitation Vision therapy programs Sports vision and neuroperformance training Cognitive-motor rehabilitation Brain Tool Kit targets key performance systems including: Attention and concentration Processing speed Working memory Visual processing Eye movement control Cognitive flexibility Balance and sensorimotor integration Assessment modules include: Balance Reaction time Subjective visual vertical Symptom scale To be interpreted by clinician or used for general information. No diagnostic information is provided. Whether used for rehabilitation or performance enhancement, Brain Tool Kit is an easy to use tool with lots of functionality. PLEASE NOTE: The minimum requirement for app installation is iOS 15

1533389969.name: NeuralCam Night Video
1533389969.description: Night mode video and Time-lapse! Shoot brighter and clearer night videos with the power of NeuralCam’s AI Video Engine. Using proprietary AI denoising, frame boosting and brightening technology NeuralCam NightVideo is the only dedicated video night mode camera app for iPhones. MULTIPLE CAPTURE SETTINGS: Time-lapse - a Night Time-lapse mode, for devices that don’t have one built in. This mode doesn’t record sound and can handle even the lowest light situations, which combined with a faster playback, it generates a specific night mode time-lapse look. Night - the default mode for shooting night videos. It uses a slightly longer exposure time, that combined with our denoising and frame interpolation algorithms generates a bright, clean and smooth night video. This is the mode to use for most night scenes. Dusk - This mode is designed for semi-low light and indoor shots. It is similar to Day mode, shot at a high frame rate to maintain sharp subjects in high movement situations, but it also includes a bit of additional brightening. Day - Is targeted at lower light day shots, or scenes with high dynamic range where the results of the default iPhone camera start to get too noisy. This mode contains no brightening, but because of the use of our AI denoising algorithm resulting videos have a cleaner, more pleasant look. It’s especially useful when used with the ultra wide camera, in the case of which noise can appear even in medium-lit indoor situations. GENTLE LIGHT- each of the modes can be combined with the “gentle light” feature, where the app turns on the flashlight, but at one of the lowest levels in order to keep the resulting video still natural and avoid “blinding” people. Gentle Light can be used in totally dark scenes with subjects that are close enough to be illuminated. CUSTOM BRIGHTENING - allows changing the brightness level to generate night videos with different look and feel. ON-DEVICE PROCESSING - all this processing runs in real-time on the iPhone, making full use of the NeuralEngine's power. This means that none of your videos leave the device and we can provide the same instant video capturing experience you’re used to with your default camera. Supported devices and settings: iPhone XS/XR and newer (A12 chip or newer, with Neural Engine) - 4 recording modes, using all Neural Engine-based solutions. iPhone 6s to iPhone 8 Plus (A11 chip or older, without Neural Engine) - NightMode TimeLapse mode fully supported. All other modes will have varied frame rate and performance, based on the iPhone model. Terms of Use: https://neural.cam/terms.html

1533598189.name: HealthGlance - Complications
1533598189.description: If app does not show on your Watch after purchase, please read troubleshooting steps at the end of this description. Health Glance is a standalone Watch app that provides customisable health data complications, with support for multiple different complications. You can also view health data in the app, without using complications. Support most data types from HealthKit (i.e. data that you can also see in the Health app on your iPhone) Add multiple complication configurations, and set any of them as a complication, support for multiple different complications at the same time Support for all watch faces and complication slots Summary of all configured data when you open the app Set goals, complications can show difference from goal, or percentage completed Configure period for data. E.g. 7 day average Weight, Step Count from last 24 hours, Yesterday walking distance. All data types have many period types to choose from Configure unit Set custom icon, from a selection of more than 100 icons Complication second line can show icon, unit, or can be hidden Set colors, separately for value and icon (only for multicolor watch faces) Option to hide unit Complications update every 20 minutes, if it's not enough you can open the app any time to see the most up-to-date data Standalone watch app means there is no iPhone app, you can configure everything on your watch Privacy: The application only stores data needed for your complications, and stores this data locally, on your watch. The app never connects to the internet or any 3rd party service. Troubleshooting: Application doesn't show on Watch after purchase: Please go to the App Store on your Watch (not iPhone) and find the app here either by searching the name, or by going to Account (at the bottom), Purchased, and download the app from here. Application/complication shows 0 for some data: a) There is no data in Health for that type and period. b) You didn't authorise HealthKit access on the first launch. On your iPhone go to Health app > Account > Privacy > Apps > Health Glance. c) New data added on your iPhone takes couple minutes to sync with your watch.

You can also view health data in the app, without using complications. Support most data types from HealthKit (i.e. data that you can also see in the Health app on your iPhone) Add multiple complication configurations, and set any of them as a complication, support for multiple different complications at the same time Support for all watch faces and complication slots Summary of all configured data when you open the app Set goals, complications can show difference from goal, or percentage completed Configure period for data. E.g. 7 day average Weight, Step Count from last 24 hours, Yesterday walking distance. All data types have many period types to choose from Configure unit Set custom icon, from a selection of more than 100 icons Complication second line can show icon, unit, or can be hidden Set colors, separately for value and icon (only for multicolor watch faces) Option to hide unit Complications update every 20 minutes, if it's not enough you can open the app any time to see the most up-to-date data Standalone watch app means there is no iPhone app, you can configure everything on your watch Privacy: The application only stores data needed for your complications, and stores this data locally, on your watch. The app never connects to the internet or any 3rd party service. Troubleshooting: Application doesn't show on Watch after purchase: Please go to the App Store on your Watch (not iPhone) and find the app here either by searching the name, or by going to Account (at the bottom), Purchased, and download the app from here. Application/complication shows 0 for some data: a) There is no data in Health for that type and period. b) You didn't authorise HealthKit access on the first launch. On your iPhone go to Health app > Account > Privacy > Apps > Health Glance. c) New data added on your iPhone takes couple minutes to sync with your watch.

1533747123.name: Numbers Flash Cards 1-25
1533747123.description: Help your child learn to count with Numbers Flash Cards — the simplest and most distraction-free way to master numbers from 0 to 25. This app turns classic counting flashcards into a beautiful, digital experience designed for preschoolers, kindergarten, and early learners. Each card shows a number symbol (0–25) and the word spelled out. Tap the speaker icon to hear the number spoken aloud in English—perfect for number recognition, number-word matching, and early math readiness. Whether you're a parent teaching your toddler to learn numbers, or a teacher looking for quiet, interactive math flashcards—this app is built for you. App Features: Swipe through number flash cards in ascending order (0–25) Toggle shuffle mode for randomized number practice Tap the speaker to hear numbers read aloud in English No ads, no in-app purchases, no pop-ups — ever One-time lifetime purchase (no subscriptions or upgrades) Built for ages 3 and up — ideal for preschool, pre-K, and kindergarten Clear visuals of numbers and words for better number-word connection This is the simplest way to help your child or student learn to count, recognize numbers and words, and prepare for early math skills — right on your iPhone or iPad.

1533754947.name: Paint By Number Creator
1533754947.description: 你最爱的照片，值得比相册里匆匆一眼更有意义。Paint By Number Creator 把它变成经典的数字填色作品——自己画、送给家人，或打印成一份手作心意。 打开一张图，选择想要的色彩细腻程度，看着色块与数字浮现。想要更快？用快速模式。想要更精致？切换精确转换。在屏幕上填色——一次填满或逐块点选——也可导出带色卡的清晰 PDF，用真实颜料在纸上完成。 大家喜欢它的理由 让回忆、萌宠与肖像变成带编号的艺术 自由选择 2–64 种颜色与 A4、A3 或 A2 纸张 快速模式迅速出图，精确模式精雕细琢 在原图、彩色填充与编号轮廓间随时切换 趣味玩法：一次完成整幅，或一块一块点选填色 用 RAL、RGB、HEX 或 Pantone FHI 标注更易找色 导出带色卡的 PDF、打印，或保存 JPEG 预览 作品保存在项目库，随时接着画 无论是周末放松、课堂手作，还是一份特别的纪念，Paint By Number Creator 都让创作变得轻松，让完成变得更有成就感。

1533808328.name: Journal Mate
1533808328.description: Stop losing handwritten pages in Photos, screenshots in chats, GIFs in camera rolls, videos in albums, and PDFs in random folders. Journal Mate gives paper journals, receipts, screenshots, GIFs, videos, Live Photos, and saved documents one clean place to live, so you can find what you need later without digging through albums, apps, and messengers. Capture and organize your library your way: Scan paper pages on the go Import photos, videos, Live Photos, screenshots, GIFs, and PDFs from other apps Search GIFs and save them directly into your journals Group pages into journals you can search, pin, archive, and revisit fast When your library grows, Journal Mate helps you stay in control: Search journals by title and notes Keep favorites close and move older journals to Archive Reorder pages with drag and drop Use the free Share Extension to send content into Journal Mate from other apps Sync your library through iCloud across your Apple devices Export a backup when you want an extra layer of safety Journal Mate is private by default. Your library stays tied to your device and iCloud account, and the app does not rely on third-party tracking. Journal Mate Pro unlocks unlimited journals and pages, photo editing, Apple Intelligence metadata tools, and premium widgets. On supported devices, Pro can suggest titles, summaries, and tags from your saved pages. Whether you are saving handwritten notebooks, family keepsakes, receipts, study notes, videos, or screenshots worth keeping, Journal Mate helps you keep everything together and easy to find. Terms of Use: https://journalmate.app/en/legal/terms/

1533938029.name: DNS Security Pro
1533938029.description: DNS 安全性通过使用 DNS over HTTPS (DoH) 和 DNS over TLS (DoT) 加密 DNS 查询来帮助保护您的隐私。当您访问网站时，HTTPS 会对您的连接内容进行加密，但传统的 DNS 查找可能仍会在不加密的情况下发送。这些 DNS 请求将域名转换为 IP 地址，未加密的查询可能会将浏览活动暴露给窃听、跟踪或操纵。 DNS 安全性通过帮助您使用加密的 DNS 提供商来弥补这一隐私差距。借助 DoH 和 DoT，您的 DNS 查询将受到保护，免遭拦截和篡改，从而降低被攻击的风险

1534513553.name: 健康笔记-新生活从记录开始
1534513553.trackName: 健康笔记-新生活从记录开始
1534513553.description: 健康笔记适合需要长期记录体重、血压、血糖、心率、体温、用药和体检结果的人。你可以为自己或家人建立一份私有、可持续整理的健康档案，把分散在日常测量、复查、就医过程中的数据，慢慢沉淀成一份长期可保存、随时可回看的记录。 这款 App 最初来自开发者自己（一名慢性病患者）的长期健康记录需求。无论是慢性病场景下的持续观察，还是一段时间内的数据对比、病历整理与用药跟踪，健康笔记都更强调“长期积累”和“自己真正看得懂”，而不是推送资讯、营销提醒或泛化的健康建议。 你可以按自己的方式决定想记录什么。每一项指标的类型、单位与记录方式都可以自定义：一份血压记录里可以同时写收缩压、舒张压和心率；一份血糖日志里可以并列空腹、餐后数值和当天用药；一份症状观察里也可以把体温、选项状态和文字说明放在一起。系统“健康”App 没有预设、但你确实在意的项目，都可以整理成适合自己的长期记录。 除了手动记录，你也可以把“健康”App 中的部分历史数据导入到指定笔记，作为长期整理的起点；也可以基于一份已经整理好的笔记复制模板结构，继续为自己或家人建立新的档案。健康 App 导入目前仅限 iPhone，为一次性历史补录，不包含化验单等文档类数据。 你的数据保存在设备与 iCloud 中，不经过第三方服务器，可在 iPhone、iPad 与 Mac 之间同步。需要时，还可以导出为 CSV、Excel 等常见格式，无论是自己备份、归档，还是与家人或医生分享，数据始终由你自己掌控。 健康笔记只专注做一件事：把长期的健康数据认真整理好、保存好。它不提供诊疗建议，也不试图替代任何慢病管理平台，而是帮助你建立一份真正属于自己的长期健康档案。

1534541160.description: "Immerse yourself in the intricate world of the human reproductive system with the 'Human Reproductive System' app. This interactive tool offers labeled 3D models and comprehensive descriptions, making learning and understanding a breeze." "Unveil the secrets of reproduction with the 'Human Reproductive System' app! Experience comprehensive anatomy education through interactive 3D models, audio guides, and seamless zooming. Perfect for medical students, educators, and healthcare enthusiasts. Features: 1. Control 3D models with clear labels and detailed part information. 2. Audio guides for a comprehensive understanding of the reproductive system. 3. Explore rotational models from different angles. 4. Enhance anatomy knowledge through immersive learning. 5. Zoom in and identify structures with ease using tap and pinch gestures.

1534560396.name: List生词本
1534560396.description: List生词本，分组归纳不会的词汇，把生词变熟词，致力于打造极简的生词词库。 内置本地高清发音引擎，支持全离线朗读，无需联网。iOS26系统下，支持全离线翻译。 内容结构是：文件夹 - 组 - 单词。 功能特性： 「查询保存」：快速查询，保存生词，分组学习； 「文件夹管理」：不同文件夹下，有多个组，每个组内有多个单词； 「双语/单语」：快速切换双语/单语模式，方便自测自查； 「iPad分屏」：利用分屏功能，边听边写； 「词典查询」：内置英汉/英英词典和在线词典，支持“用户自行添加在线词典”，iOS26系统下，支持离线翻译； 「英式/美式」：支持英式/美式发音+音标，内置本地高清发音引擎，支持全离线朗读； 「iCloud同步」：iPad/iPhone记录同步，学习进度不丢失； 「拼词模式」：从五个卡片中点选正确的字母，拼成完整的单词，同时还支持键盘输入。iPad上，还支持Pencil手写输入； 「听写模式」：可重复可间隔可循环可自动，英汉双语音频播放； 「英英模式」，通过英语释义、同义词和例句，加强记忆，扩展词汇量； 「滚动模式」：列表样式，自动循环滚动播放； 「定时关闭」：听写模式和拼词模式，支持多次循环后关闭，或固定时长后关闭； 「音频混合」：支持其他音频app混音，边听歌边记单词； 「调整顺序」：支持调整初始的排列，改变单词顺序； 「批量导入」：支持从「List背单词」App 或 外部文件 导入； 「文字大小」：支持跟随系统文字大小变化； 「批量导出」：支持导出到「List背单词」App的自定义词库； 「PDF导出」：支持文件夹、组、单词表导出PDF文件。 List生词本，支持快速查询，保存生词，通过单语模式、听写模式和拼词模式等，进行不断记忆和复习，为英语学习打好坚实的基础。 常规操作 --- 1.快速查询 2.新建组，修改组名，删除组，调整组顺序 3.保存生词，修改释义，删除，复制，换组，换文件夹 4.文件夹操作 英语口音支持 --- 美国，英国，澳大利亚，爱尔兰，南非，在线美式发音，在线英式发音，离线真人语音 排序方式 --- 1.初始排序 2.按字母升序排序 3.随机打乱顺序 4.不会的词排在前面 单词显示设置 --- 双语显示，只显示英文，只显示中文 1. 只显示中文时，向左滑动单词行，可以看到英文单词； 2. 只显示英文时，向左滑动单词行，可以看到中文释义。 单词行点击设置 --- 1. 默认设置，点击单词行，有发音，蓝色标记颜色加深，‘不会程度’增加一； 2. 点击单词行的左半部分，只有发音，右半部分，保留默认设置； 3. 点击单词行的右半部分，只有发音，左半部分，保留默认设置； 4. 点击单词行，只有发音，蓝色标记颜色不加深，‘不会程度’不增加一。 音标显示设置 --- 隐藏音标，英式音标，美式音标 iCloud同步 --- 支持iCloud同步词库 显示模式 --- 白天模式，夜间模式，纯黑模式，纸张模式，iOS 13 /iPad OS 13 支持显示模式跟随系统，在线词典页面支持深色外观 词典设置 --- 1.长按单词行，复制单词到剪切板，默认不开启； 2.长按单词行，使用词典查询更多释义和例子，包括查询关闭、内置词典和多种在线词典； 3.在线词典，支持调整顺序。 拼词模式 --- 1.从五个卡片中点选正确的字母，拼成完整的单词； 2.随机打乱； 3.快速定位； 4.支持键盘输入； 5.在iPad上，支持Pencil手写输入。 听写模式 --- 1.调整播放单词重复次数； 2.调整单词间隔时间； 3.设置是否自动播放下一个； 4.内容显示设置； 5.支持后台播放音频； 6.支持播放中文释义； 7.随机播放； 8.快速定位。 滚动模式 --- 1.列表样式，自动循环滚动播放； 2.更方便的释义编辑、不会程度标记和词典查询等操作。 批量导入 --- 1.从「List背单词」App批量导入词汇； 2.从「List工具箱」App批量导入查询词汇； 3.从外部文件批量导入词汇。 PDF导出 --- 1.支持所有组一起导出PDF文件； 2.支持单个组导出PDF文件； 3.支持单个组，批量勾选词汇来导出PDF文件。 其他 --- 若对使用产生任何疑问，请联系shawn736_ios@163.com App icons by icons8 The Preview background photo by Joey Kyber on Unsplash 具体信息请参考网址https://github.com/shawn736ios/ListNewWord-Technical-support Technical Credits & Privacy Built with sherpa-onnx (Apache 2.0) and Piper speech models. Voice synthesis is performed locally on your device. No data is collected or uploaded, supporting offline use and user privacy.

1534835771.name: 牛津英语 English File -Elementary
1534835771.description: English File 系列教程独特、生动、有趣，素以“让学生开口说英文”的特色为人所知。 本系列初级着重发音训练、词汇、语法，可帮助学生打好英文基础；中级、中高级则着重会话、阅读、听力及写作练习，可使学生快速达到学习目的。 本系列含丰富的教学资源，包括辅助教材以及完整的学习计划，可以让学生用起来得心应手。 系列特色： 1）课程编排均衡，涵盖语法、词汇、发音及技能； 2）戏剧、访谈及纪录片视频帮助学生学习自然地道的英语； 3）iTutor,iChecker 和 iTools 实现个性化学习及辅助教学； 4）发音应用程序让学生随时随地练习口语。 第4版新增： 基于English File教师反馈，更新了文本内容、话题、听力材料； 每个偶数单元加入了视听活动，比如纪录片或戏剧片段，使课堂气氛更活跃； 在线练习中包含发音视频，学员可在此观看正确、地道的英文发音视频，参与到Rob和Jenny的短剧中。 English File 4th Edition，适用于中学，本应用配套Elementary级别。 建议使用年级： Beginner级别--与小学衔接，Elementary--初一，Pre-Intermediate--初二，Pre-Intermediate--初三，Intermediate Plus--初高中衔接，Upper Intermediate--高一，Advanced--高二 。 Elementary 级别课本目录： A Welcome to the class B One world C What's your email? 1535585090.name: RFK Edition 8
1535585090.description: The release of Australian Tropical Rainforest Plants Edition 8 (RFK 8) represents another significant milestone in the development of this information system for identifying and learning about plants in Australian tropical rainforests. Each edition of the system since 1971 has made significant advances in the coverage of plant groups, the numbers of species included, the effectiveness of the identification system, and in the utilisation of current technology. As always, the aim of this new edition is to enable as many people as possible to simply and accurately identify and learn about plants in Australia’s tropical rainforests. What is new? The main goal for Edition 8 of Australian Tropical Rainforest Plants was to move to a mobile application platform that is available both online and downloadable to electronic devices. The coverage of the key includes the rainforests of the whole of the Australian tropics. A second goal was to continue adding taxa from regions already covered that had not been included in previous editions primarily due to lack of specimens for coding, and to update the nomenclature and distribution information for all taxa as required. Australian Tropical Rainforest Plants Edition 8 includes 2762 taxa in 176 families and 48 new name changes. All flowering plant species are included - trees, shrubs, vines, forbs, grasses and sedges, epiphytes, palms and pandans – except most orchids which are treated in a separate key (see below), and a few other species for which specimens suitable for coding features are lacking. All rainforest orchids are included in a dedicated orchid module (Australian Tropical Rainforest Orchids) now also delivered online. The need for a separate module was due to the unique morphology of the Orchidaceae family and the distinct set of features required for effective identification to species level. Nine species of orchid have been included within RFK8, mainly terrestrial species that reach more than one metre in height, or climbers. Similarly, the ferns are currently under development as a separate module, Ferns of Northern Australia. Again, the unique morphology, terminology and features required for effective identification of ferns have dictated that a stand-alone module be developed. The number of images in the key continues to increase, now numbering over 14,000. Most of images were gathered by CSIRO staff as part of this long-running research project. Significant numbers of new images have been provided by various photographers listed in the Acknowledgements section, most notably Garry Sankowsky, Steve Pearson, John Dowe and Russell Barrett. All donors of images for this project are gratefully acknowledged.

1535585090.summaryDescription: The release of Australian Tropical Rainforest Plants Edition 8 (RFK 8) represents another significant milestone in the development of this information system for identifying and learning about plants in Australian tropical rainforests. Each edition of the system since 1971 has made significant advances in the coverage of plant groups, the numbers of species included, the effectiveness of the identification system, and in the utilisation of current technology. As always, the aim of this new edition is to enable as many people as possible to simply and accurately identify and learn about plants in Australia’s tropical rainforests. What is new? The main goal for Edition 8 of Australian Tropical Rainforest Plants was to move to a mobile application platform that is available both online and downloadable to electronic devices. The coverage of the key includes the rainforests of the whole of the Australian tropics. A second goal was to continue adding taxa from regions already covered that had not been included in previous editions primarily due to lack of specimens for coding, and to update the nomenclature and distribution information for all taxa as required. Australian Tropical Rainforest Plants Edition 8 includes 2762 taxa in 176 families and 48 new name changes. All flowering plant species are included - trees, shrubs, vines, forbs, grasses and sedges, epiphytes, palms and pandans – except most orchids which are treated in a separate key (see below), and a few other species for which specimens suitable for coding features are lacking. All rainforest orchids are included in a dedicated orchid module (Australian Tropical Rainforest Orchids) now also delivered online. The need for a separate module was due to the unique morphology of the Orchidaceae family and the distinct set of features required for effective identification to species level. Nine species of orchid have been included within RFK8, mainly terrestrial species that reach more than one metre in height, or climbers. Similarly, the ferns are currently under development as a separate module, Ferns of Northern Australia. Again, the unique morphology, terminology and features required for effective identification of ferns have dictated that a stand-alone module be developed. The number of images in the key continues to increase, now numbering over 14,000. Most of images were gathered by CSIRO staff as part of this long-running research project. Significant numbers of new images have been provided by various photographers listed in the Acknowledgements section, most notably Garry Sankowsky, Steve Pearson, John Dowe and Russell Barrett. All donors of images for this project are gratefully acknowledged.

1536075498.name: 诗色 -古诗词中的中国传统色
1536075498.trackName: 诗色 -古诗词中的中国传统色
1536075498.description: 从胭脂到天青，从粉红到黛绿，每一个颜色的背后都凝结着古人的智慧，体现着古人对自然的热爱。 胭脂、牙白、朱青、水绿、艾青、黛蓝，这些各式各样的颜色词语来源于生活，又高于生活，充满诗意。 “云髻不饶荷叶绿，罗裙未减石榴红。” “枝上绽梅肥自坠，庭中新绿色逾深。” “香墨弯弯画，燕脂淡淡匀。揉蓝衫子杏黄裙。独倚玉阑无语、点檀唇。” “天未晓，人犹寂。有几多心事，露清月白。” 透过这些脍炙人口的诗词，我们仿佛看到荡漾在古人衣食住行里的情绿红白。 中国古典诗词，是文学艺术的瑰宝，蕴藏着品味不尽的佳句与意境。 本应用将近160种中国传统色与近900首中国诗词融合，诗色交相辉映，供您欣赏。 中国元素无处不在，根植在每个人心中：民俗事象、宗教图腾、特色建筑、民族服饰，上至三皇五帝，下到宋元明清，大到故宫长城，小至窗棂门钉……中国元素，是中国乃至全人类的一笔宝贵财富，深深吸引着我们。在本应用里，您可以为精心制作的折扇、毛笔、线装书、脸谱（四川变脸）、汉服、纸鸢、阴阳、剪纸、灯笼、中国结等中国元素进行上色。 主要功能 1. 中国传统色列表，提供颜色RGB及HEX值，以供设计参考 2. 在传统色中阅读古代诗词，支持分享多种截图方式 3. 中国元素自定义颜色，支持分享截图 4. 五色朝代，展示各朝代的五色属性 5. 支持iOS 14小组件：日期小组件（自定义颜色、公历/农历自由切换）与诗词小组件 6. 支持Apple Watch，显示颜色列表、中国元素列表、	公历/农历日期等 中国传统色列表 粉红、妃色、桃红、海棠红、石榴红、樱桃红、银红、大红、绛紫、绯红、胭脂、朱红、丹、彤、茜色、火红、赫赤、嫣红、炎、赤、绾、枣红、檀、殷红、酡红、酡颜 鹅黄、鸭黄、樱草色、杏黄、杏红、橘黄、橙黄、橘红、姜黄、缃色、橙色、茶色、驼色、昏黄、栗色、棕色、棕绿、棕黑、棕红、棕黄、赭、赭色、琥珀、褐色、枯黄、黄栌、秋色、秋香色 嫩绿、柳黄、柳绿、竹青、葱黄、葱绿、葱青、葱倩、青葱、油绿、绿沈、碧色、碧绿、青碧、翡翠色、草绿、青色、青翠、青白、鸭卵青、蟹壳青、鸦青、绿色、豆绿、豆青、石青、玉色、缥、艾绿、松柏绿、松花绿、松花色 蓝、靛青、靛蓝、碧蓝、蔚蓝、宝蓝、蓝灰色、藏青、藏蓝、黛、黛绿、黛蓝、黛紫、紫色、紫酱、酱紫、紫檀、绀紫、紫棠、青莲、群青、雪青、丁香色、藕色、藕荷色 苍色、苍翠、苍黄、苍青、苍黑、苍白 水色、水红、水绿、水蓝、淡青、湖蓝、湖绿 精白、象牙白、雪白、月白、缟、素、荼白、霜色、花白、鱼肚白、莹白、灰色、牙色、铅白 玄色、玄青、乌色、乌黑、漆黑、墨色、墨灰、黑色、缁色、煤黑、黧、黎、黝、黝黑、黯 赤金、金色、银白、老银、乌金、铜绿 如有任何疑惑或建议，请通过邮箱与我联系：oraclebone@163.com

1536241513.name: iTuner Lite
1536241513.description: iTuner 是一款为 iPhone 与 Apple Watch 设计的简洁、精准调音器。 演奏一个音符，即可看到当前音名、频率以及音分偏差。根据提示判断音高偏高或偏低，然后拧紧或放松琴弦，直到音高回到中心。 在 Apple Watch 上，iTuner 提供更专注的调音体验，并加入适合真实练习场景的实用设置：A4 校准、输入灵敏度、调准容差、音分显示和触感反馈。内置快速指南和乐器参考音，方便你快速查看吉他、贝斯、小提琴、尤克里里等常见定弦。 iTuner 适用于多种可以持续发声的乐器，包括吉他、贝斯、小提琴、中提琴、大提琴、尤克里里、曼陀林、班卓琴、木管、铜管、钢琴、定音鼓等。 麦克风音频仅用于实时音高检测。iTuner 不会录音、保存或上传你的声音。 无论是在家练习、乐队排练，还是演出前快速调音，iTuner 都能在手腕和手机上提供清爽可靠的调音体验。

1536314751.name: 书之道
1536314751.description: 【书之道】是一款在手机和平板电脑上进行书法练习和书法创作的应用。 只要打开APP，就能自由挥毫，感受书法的独特魅力。 学习书法，传扬中华民族传统文化！ ◉独家算法，运笔如飞，自由挥毫，确保流畅 ◉支持3D Touch、Apple Pencil、iPhone系列、iPad系列硬件 ◉APP包含：行书，楷书，草书的尖豪笔头，隶书，篆书的圆毫笔头，以及方体，圆体，中空，金属艺术字创作风格 ◉极小，微小，小，中，大，特大，极大：7种粗细不同的笔尖设计，切换自由 ◉巧妙变化书写速度，能够创作虚实相生，气势贯通的章法 ◉支持米字格，田字格，竖线字帖，宣纸背景设置 ◉随时随地分享您的创作给好友，或者保存到相册，支持AirDrop传送到其他手机和电脑 ◉支持滑动调节粗细，起笔落点的大小，书写速度 ◉16种书法字体模型，适合各种字帖临摹 ◉您可以调整字帖的透明度和字体颜色 ◉以下是最新增加的字帖： ・中文常用汉字2175字，日文常用汉字2135字的临摹字帖 ・碑文字帖：兰亭序，多宝塔碑，九成宫醴泉铭 ・经文字帖：般若波罗蜜多心经，金刚般若波罗蜜经 ・古诗词字帖：精选唐诗306首 ・日本和歌集：万叶集・原文，万叶集・训读，各20卷 ・习字库：日本小学1年级到6年级的教育词汇，假名五十音 ・习字库：日本汉字检定10级到1级范围 ・习字库：280组人气词组 感谢您关注我们的应用。 期待您的点评和宝贵意见，我们会长期坚持对应用的维护和更新，大家可以放心使用。 作者本人也是书法爱好者，欢迎大家邮件微信联系交流。

1536419545.name: 9/11 Memorial Audio Guide
1536419545.description: The National September 11 Memorial & Museum is a place to remember and honor the people killed as a result of the four coordinated terrorist attacks on September 11, 2001, and the World Trade Center bombing on February 26, 1993. The 9/11 Memorial is located at the site of the former World Trade Center complex and occupies approximately half of the 16-acre site. The 9/11 Memorial audio tour, narrated by Anthoula Katsimatides, a New Yorker whose brother, John, was killed on 9/11, highlights several victims honored at the Memorial and their lives before 9/11. The tour leads listeners around the North Pool, down to the South Pool and back up to the entrance of the 9/11 Memorial Museum. The tour also stops at the Survivor Tree and the 9/11 Memorial Glade. Features of the 9/11 Memorial App: Map-based tours for easy navigation Universally-designed Transcripts available on every stop Images with audio descriptions Customizable font sizes and color modes VoiceOver compatible on all iOS devices

1536755427.name: BLEASS Saturator
1536755427.description: BLEASS Saturator 是一个创意饱和和失真工具箱，可以让你在你的音频上盖上你的权威。烤你的低音，压碎你的鼓，让你的主旋律从混音中爆炸出来，所有这些都可以在插件色彩丰富且直观的界面中轻松完成。 驱动模块将模拟风格的过驱动引入你的信号，从轻微的加热到真正的烤制。模块内置的均衡器允许你精确控制饱和度的音调特性。 波形塑形器使用第二波形来失真你的音频。这取决于所使用的波形塑形算法——BLEASS Saturator 有九种可供选择。算法对产生的失真特性有显著影响。通过其清晰的可视化和对波形塑形算法关键参数的详细但直观的控制，波形塑形器模块提供了近乎无限的音色和失真选择。 BLEASS Saturator 的位模块模拟了模拟到数字转换的失真特性。我们都熟悉当采样率和位深度足够高时产生的完美音质，但将这些值降低可以创造出美妙的失真和故障，这些都是本质上数字的。通过选择在波形塑形器模块前或后应用位模块，提供了进一步的创意可能性。 内置的 LFO 可以路由到插件的任何参数，并且可以同步到主机的节拍和节奏。这使你能够探索那些用传统饱和器难以实现的不断变化、移动和节奏化的失真。 轻柔的设置可以创造出令人愉悦的温暖和模糊的结果，但尽管其占用空间小且 CPU 使用量低，BLEASS Saturator 却有力量像一吨砖一样打击你的音频！

1536762482.name: Spirit Talker ®
1536762482.description: As seen on: Haunted Finders, The Paranormal Files, Twin Paranormal, WWE, Scarlett & Shotzi, Bad Cat Paranormal, Exploring Harley, Ghost Club Paranormal, Barrier Beyond, Tommy Amongst the Tombstones, Hauntings with Hodge, Jasko, Omar Gosh, Paranormal XP, What Goes Bump in the Night, Exploring with Josh, Ghostly Travels with Zac, Kelsi Davies, Moxleys Paranormal World, Hunting the Dead, TylerReynolds TV, PollyFox Paranormal, Paranormal Discovery, Sam and Colby, WhatThe? Paranormal, F.D.L Paranormal and many many more. Beware of FAKE copies, this is the Original Spirit Talker App. Spirit Talker ® works in a similar way to the world famous Ovilus device, but it is based on my own research and theories. It produces words and speech based on what the sensors in your phone are detecting. The theory behind this app is that spirits might be able to manipulate the device sensors to communicate with you. Spirit Talker ® is a modern form of ITC (Instrumental Trans Communication) and is very simple to use. Just click the green ON button and begin asking your questions. When a response is detected by the app the words will show visually in the text box along with audible speech. Nothing is chosen randomly, everything produced is based on the values from the sensors. When you have finished your session just click stop. You can also look back at the responses you received during your session by clicking on the folder button (this only works when the scanner is "Stopped"). You can also look back at the responses you received during your session by clicking on the folder button (this only works when the scanner is "Stopped"). The sensors that the app uses are: Magnetometer (EMF) Accelerometer Gyroscope Orientation Barometer Compass The EMF Meter only works if your device has a Magnetometer Sensor. If not then the EMF Meter won't be displayed. Please check the compatibility of your phone / tablet. When you have finished your session, turn off the scanner to save the words to the file. Moving your phone quickly or putting it near electronic equipment will manipulate the sensors and make it produce a result, please do not do this! Languages in the app are: English, Latin, French, German, Chinese (Text or Symbols), Danish, Portuguese, Romanian, Turkish, Croatian, Polish, Finnish, Swedish, Hungarian, Greek, Czech, Dutch, Italian, Spanish Korean and Icelandic. There are a lot of misconceptions being spread about how Spirit Talker works, please have a read here: https://spottedghosts.com/spirit-talker-common-misconceptions/ IMPORTANT INFO App Voice ** The voice uses the "Spoken Content" voice on your device, “Settings” -> “Accessibility” -> “Spoken Content” Sensor Permissions ** Since the iOS 17 update, this app now needs to have the "Motion and Fitness" permission to be granted so that it can access certain sensors that it needs in order to work. If you don't grant this permission, the app will not be able to work. Disclaimer ** Use at your own risk. We cannot be held personally responsible for you or any outcome (paranormal or otherwise) from using this app! The paranormal is not a proven science and is considered theoretical. Accordingly, words or phrases generated are not intended as requests or instructions, and should not be used to make legal, financial, medical or other decisions. Words/phrases generated do not represent the official position of the developer. Refer to our website for a full list of terms and conditions http://www.spottedghosts.com Beware of FAKE copies, this is the ORIGINAL Spirit Talker App.

1536924873.name: WT1 Wavetable Groovebox Synth
1536924873.description: WT1 Wavetable Groovebox is a fast, hands-on groovebox built for instant music creation. Inspired by modular synth layouts, WT1 presents everything on a single “sound easel” interface — no menus, no digging. Just direct control and immediate sonic feedback. Create full ideas in seconds with three powerful synth engines: Super Saw – wide, rich, stacked tones Wavetable – evolving, textured movement Vector – morph between sounds in real time Each synth includes its own step sequencer for notes and amplitude, plus dedicated effects: Reverb Chorus Delay Everything runs in parallel, so you can build layered grooves quickly and intuitively. Perfect for sketching ideas, generating textures, or just getting lost in sound design. For less than the price of a coffee, WT1 is a compact playground for melodic experimentation. Features 3 independent synth engines (Super Saw, Wavetable, Vector) 3 step sequencers (note + amplitude control) 3 effect chains (reverb, chorus, delay) Scale locking for musical sequencing 6 LFOs for modulation and movement Immediate, all-on-one-screen workflow

1537057699.name: Solo - Fretboard Visualization
1537057699.description: Solo is the ultimate practice App for mastering fretboard visualization, designed by world renowned guitarists Tom Quayle and David Beebee. Four powerful fretboard trainers allow you to work intuitively on each aspect of the visualization process; learning note names, memorising interval shapes, outlining chord changes, and practicing scales. Solo asks you to find intervallic functions against one root note, chord symbol or scale at a time, listens to the notes you play, and doesn’t move on until you’ve correctly found each note by its intervallic function in the specified order. Practice with Solo and finally learn your note names, master interval shapes, confidently play through chord changes and break out of scale boxes with intervallic functions. Start transforming your playing and confidence on the fretboard today! NOTE TRAINER The Note Trainer is perfect for beginner and intermediate players getting to grips with note names on the neck - the foundation of solid fretboard knowledge. Solo shows you random root notes to find and listens, waiting for you to get it correct. Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass. Optional practice suggestions offer challenging ways to limit and test yourself. Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session. INTERVAL TRAINER The Interval Trainer will help players at all levels work on interval shapes with intervallic functions - the key to unlocking true freedom on the fretboard. Choose any combination of intervallic functions to practice. Create custom interval groups or choose the intervals for ANY chord type or scale. The Interval Trainer will randomise your chosen intervals and ask you to find them against either a fixed or random root note. Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams, showing you where all of the interval shapes are across the neck, and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass. Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session. CHANGES TRAINER In the Changes Trainer you find intervallic functions, using single notes to outline different chord types or sets of chord changes, a key skill for learning to improvise through chord changes. Practice outlining intervallic functions through over 100 common chord progressions and single chord exercises. 50 intervallic function levels. Go from simple chord tones to complex melodic structures and scales. Solo intelligently maps out the correct intervals over each chord and listens for you to play each intervallic function in the specified order. Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself. Transpose the key of any progression or exercise. Choose to randomly transpose the progression (or single chord exercise) each time it repeats. Work on voice leading chord tones through single note lines. SCALE TRAINER The Scale Trainer contains a vast array of scales and powerful workout options, allowing you to finally break out of the box and develop a much deeper understanding of how scales are constructed on the fretboard. Practice finding scales on the fretboard using intervallic functions. Over 50+ Scales and modes. Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself. Melodic sequence options let you focus on starting from any chord tone within the scale. Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.

1537782938.name: 墨墨记忆卡｜考研考公考证外语学习闪卡
1537782938.trackName: 墨墨记忆卡｜考研考公考证外语学习闪卡
1537782938.description: 墨墨记忆卡 可以帮助你科学高效地规划需要记忆的知识，对抗遗忘。 可以把知识编辑成卡片，目前支持文字、图片、声音。 可以把自己的知识卡片分享给朋友，也可以搜索他人的卡片进行学习。 可以把知识卡片加入记忆规划，墨墨记忆卡 会为你安排合适的时间进行复习。 可以查看自己的记忆数据：遗忘曲线、记忆持久度、每日学习情况。 可以每日签到，见证自己的坚持和成长。 墨墨科技多年以来一直专注于记忆领域的探索，基于对 1300+ 亿条用户记忆行为数据的研究和统计，绘制了 3000+ 万条不同用户的遗忘曲线，协助用户高效规划自己的记忆。

1537956680.name: Museo dell'Opera del Duomo
1537956680.description: collaborazione con l’Opera della Primaziale Pisana: storia, racconti, curiosità, eventi e informazioni utili. Scarica l’app e otterrai: informazioni utili per la tua visita (orari, come arrivare, contatti, ecc.) l’audiotour del Museo L’audiotour contiene: Il tour del museo con 55 punti di ascolto per un totale di circa 92 minuti di audio Una mappa interattiva Contenuti in italiano, inglese, francese, tedesco e spagnolo L’accesso ai contenuti in modalità offline, per non consumare traffico internet o, se non vuoi occupare spazio nel tuo telefono A bit of us D’Uva è un laboratorio di interpretazione digitale che offre contenuti multimediali per raccontare il patrimonio attraverso audioguide, videoguide, totem multimediali, applicazioni mobile e piattaforme web. Un laboratorio dove ci si diverte, si sperimenta, si discute e si cerca di migliorare ogni giorno. Il nostro obiettivo? Creare relazioni più profonde tra i musei e i visitatori. Insieme formiamo un gruppo affiatato e multidisciplinare di sviluppatori, designer, creativi, curiosi della tecnologia, operatori audio e video, architetti, storici dell’arte, narratori e tecnici che amano i musei, le chiese, le città d’arte e le attrazioni turistiche. I nostri progetti sono basati sulle capacità di coinvolgimento dei media digitali e sono sviluppati per trasformare l’interazione in esperienza e aggiungere valore ed emozioni al percorso audio e videoguidato.

1538268059.trackName: 开心果节拍器 - 节拍器 纯净无广告
1538268059.description: 首款支持Apple Watch的节拍器！！！ Mac、iPhone、iPad多平台的完美体验！！！ =============================================== 中央音乐学院导师推荐！！！ 可以装在兜里的节拍器！！！ 抖音快手老罗推荐五星！！！ 尤克里里吉他卡林巴伴侣！！！ =============================================== 无论你是一名职业的音乐人，乐队主力，或是正在业余学习一门乐器，在你和音乐交流的过程中，肯定离不开一种叫做“节拍器”的小玩意儿。 传统节拍器多少还是有点笨重，你总不能走哪里都带着个节拍器吧？现在都0202年了，我们应该有更好的选择，于是，我强烈推荐喜欢音乐的你，来体验一下这款节拍器软件。 首先，我们没有广告！！！ 没有广告！！！ 没有广告！！！ 重要的是，比起传统节拍器，我们可以更加灵活的设置BPM，支持80种拍子！！！常见的3/4,4/4可以有，不常见的8/8,8/16也有！！！ 精选20种节拍声效，可实现400种组合节拍效果，节拍、伴奏、暖场、修禅、助眠都可以用~！ 最酷的是，我们提供了Apple Watch版本，戴上手腕上的节拍器！酷不酷！！？ 另外我们还支持更换主题颜色，给个性的你更加个性的选择！ 现在位于世界各地的音乐学校的学生与教师都在使用我们的节拍器。 如果您来自一家正在使用或愿意使用我们的应用的教育机构，请发送邮件给我们至support@aben.io。 从1.1.0版本开始，该应用可以免费下载并使用节拍器功能。对于乐谱功能，将有10次免费体验机会。免费体验次数用完之后，您可以使用订阅服务继续使用乐谱功能，或者继续免费 的使用机器拍功能。 Privacy Policy https://metronome.aben.io/privacy-policy/ Terms of Service https://metronome.aben.io/terms/

1538291171.name: Newtify Watch
1538291171.description: Receive notification from any service that you use directly on your Apple Watch. Newtify Watch is the first independent notification app on the market, so no need of your iPhone! To send notifications you need the token of the app that you can read on the screen of your Watch as QR Code or as text and the message that you want to send, that's it. In the message, you can add also a link to a multimedia content (image, audio or video) that will be played directly on the Watch. To send the message the syntax is as simple as to browse a web page like: https://newtify.scumm.it/api?token=YOURTOKEN&title=My First Message&body=Hey look how nice is Newtify Watch&url=https://anywebsite/anyimage.jpg Additional details can be found on https://newtify.scumm.it/details

1538331995.description: 快速计算价格增值税！将增值税添加到您的价格中，或根据现有价格计算逆税计算。在夜间进行计算时，使用易于阅读的大文本查看结果，并激活暗模式。 新：支持Apple Watch-不用手机！在Apple Watch上访问此增值税计算器，以进行快速增值税计算。 特征： 支持所有国家/地区的所有增值税率。 使用税率选择器％的任何税率计算增值税 将增值税添加到您的价格中或执行反向增值税计算 支持iOS 13黑暗模式进行深夜计算 轻按按钮时会出现肝反馈和声音。 用法： 使用百分比按钮选择正确的增值税率，然后只需输入您的价格，然后点击加号或减号按钮即可获取增值税计算。就像普通的计算器一样，您可以按C钮重新开始或按任意数字以添加新的金额。 对于Apple Watch，请使用加号+或-减号按钮来计算增值税。 因此，如果您是企业主，企业家，旅行者，消费者，或者只是想知道您要支付或收取的增值税，那么这是适用于您的应用程序的增值税计算器。现在就下载。

1538781007.name: MusiKraken
1538781007.description: MusiKraken is a modular MIDI Controller Construction Kit, empowering you to fully harness the capabilities of your mobile device's hardware. Winner of a 2022 MIDI Innovation Award! Make music using device sensors like Touch, Motion Sensors, Camera (face, hand, body and color tracking, including TrueDepth and LiDAR support) and Microphone, or connected devices like Game Controllers, Apple Watch or AirPods. Choose from several types of modules in the editor and connect the ports to create your own personal MIDI controller setup. Route the MIDI signals through effect modules to control multiple instruments simultaneously or invent creative new MIDI controller combinations. MusiKraken supports sending and receiving MIDI data over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or via Core MIDI (for example by using Inter-Device Audio and MIDI (IDAM)). And it can host Audio Unit (AUv3) instrument plugins. Or send the sensor data via OSC. MusiKraken is also one of the first apps to officially support MIDI 2.0! You already own a very powerful device with all kinds of sensors and connection possibilities. With this app you can use these sensors as inputs, combine them with all kinds of MIDI effects and send the resulting MIDI events to your computer, synthesizer, any other MIDI-capable app or Audio Unit to to create your own, expressive MIDI controller setup. Your device for example has a multitouch screen. Use this with the Keyboard module to slide on the keys to control multiple musical parameters simultaneously. Using MPE, MIDI 2.0 or the Chord Splitter also allows you to control these parameters separately per key. Newer devices also support tracking the finger radius (or pressure on older devices), which adds another dimension of control. Multitouch is also used by the Chords Pad to play the chords of a selected scale, or the Touchpad, which allows you control values via touch gestures. Another unique input sensor is the camera: MusiKraken supports tracking your hands in front of the camera, your body pose, your face or objects with specific colors. This way you can for example use your iOS device as a Theremin, jump or dance around in front of the camera to generate notes or control audio parameters, use your mouth to control the sound of a virtual trumpet, or any other combination. If your device has a TrueDepth or LiDAR sensor, you can also use the distances as input values. Your device also has motion sensors: Accelerometer, Gyroscope and Magnetometer. They can be either used separately, or combined to get the current rotation of the device in three dimensions. Use this to generate sounds or control parameters while shaking or tilting your device. Your device also has a microphone, and MusiKraken can detect the pitch or amplitude of the signal. Your iOS device also allows you to connect to external devices. MusiKraken for example supports Game Controllers (trigger events on button or thumbstick changes, motion sensors, haptics and light on supported Game Controllers), Apple Watch (motion sensors, digital crown, touch, heart rate) or the motion sensors within AirPods. The real power comes once you start combining the sensors with the effect modules. There are effects that can be used to change or filter the MIDI events. Some effects allow you to combine multiple input sources into new output values. Or splits chords into separate notes so that they can be sent to different channels. Important: Please note that some of the modules only work on iOS devices with specific hardware: ARKit Face Tracking and the TrueDepth module need a TrueDepth front camera, and Hand and Body Pose Tracking needs at least iOS 14, and might be too slow on older devices. HealthKit is used in the app to access Apple Watch data like heart beat or motion sensors. The app only uses sensor data to generate MIDI events.

1538966480.name: Stromno
1538966480.description: Stromno app allows you easily broadcast your heart rate data from Apple Watch and show it on live stream. Login with a short code and BPM value will be shown in your personal widget/overlay. Stromno was created for live streamers to show real-time heart rate on Twitch, YouTube. It is easy to set up Stromno heart rate widget in 1 minute. You can customize the widget and get a unique URL for OBS(Twitch Studio, XSplit, Streamlabs OBS) on the website. Multiple designs available to fit your stream layout. The App integrates with Apple Health app. Visit stromno.com to create an account, get login code, design your widget/overlay. How to use: get the Apple Watch app create an account on stromno.com get a short login code on the site Dashboard open the Watch app, login, start streaming change the widget on the website copy your heart rate widget URL and use it as a Browser source (in OBS, Twitch Studio, XSplit, Streamlabs OBS) enjoy more fun and interactivity on your live stream on Twitch or YouTube

1539977373.name: iCircuit 3D
1539977373.description: iCircuit 3D gives you an endless virtual workbench to design, build, and test electronics projects in 3D. It combines the robust real-time, always-on simulation engine of iCircuit with modern 3D rendering and physics on iOS and macOS. Do not let the availability of physical parts limit your creativity. Choose from an expansive library of 150+ physically and electronically simulated parts and over 1,000 reference boards to plan layouts, wire circuits, test ideas, and iterate fast. It also includes the full standard component library from the original iCircuit, so you can switch between realistic parts and symbolic circuit elements whenever you want. When powered, LEDs light up realistically, DC motors spin, and speakers make noise. Watch current flow along your simulated wires. See pinouts and color codes directly on components. Tap any part to view live values like voltage and current, then change parameters instantly. If you miswire something or overstress a component, magic smoke will billow from the point of failure so you can quickly diagnose and fix the problem. Add reference photos to the environment, import your own 3D models to mount projects onto, or use Blocks to build enclosures, panels, and simple structures. FEATURES Tons of resistors, capacitors, and LEDs Multiple breadboards and wiring elements Diodes, BJTs, MOSFETs DC power supplies Waveform generators (AC, square, sawtooth) Batteries (AA, AAA, 18650, coin cells, and more) Switches (SPST, SPDT) Buzzers and speakers DC motors and servos Programmable Arduino elements The full symbolic iCircuit library (standard components included) 1,000+ reference circuit boards for layout planning (not fully simulated) Import board layouts from Eagle (imported layouts are for wiring/layout reference and do not simulate) Import custom 3D models to attach your projects to, and simulate their behavior on the workbench Import images for reference or documentation and place them as physical photographs HOW IT WORKS Add parts to the 3D workbench and they land on the table with gravity. Drag parts around, then draw wires between ports to connect them. When a circuit is completed, it starts simulating immediately. Wires stay connected as you move parts, so you can build tidy panels and enclosures, or leave parts scattered like a real bench. iCircuit 3D was designed for fun and exploration, with plenty more to discover as you build. I hope you enjoy this new take on circuit software.

1540174159.description: Organizing online tasks, or tasks in general, can be challenging, as keeping track of deadlines can sometimes be a struggle. To help you manage this, “I’ll Do It Later” comes in handy. While it can’t complete your tasks for you, it can certainly help you organize them. 1540482954.name: Jetting Vortex ROK GP Kart
1540482954.description: This app provides, using temperature, altitude, humidity, atmospheric pressure and your engine configuration, a recommendation about optimal carburetor configuration (jetting) and spark plug to use for karting Vortex ROK engines (ROK MINI, ROK GP JUNIOR, ROK GP SENIOR), which use a Dellorto VHSH 30 and PHBG 18 carburetor. This app can obtain automatically the position and altitude to get the temperature, pressure and humidity from the nearest weather station through the internet. Internal barometer is used on supported devices for better precision. Application can run without GPS, WiFi and internet, in this case the user has to enter weather data manually. Two different tuning modes: "By regulations" and "Freestyle"! In first mode, the following values are given: main jet, spark plug, spark plug gap, needle type and position (including intermediate positions with washer), air screw position, optimal water temperature, gear oil recommendation In second mode (Freestyle), the following values are given: main jet, spark plug, emulsion tube, needle, needle type and position (including intermediate positions with washer), throttle valve size, idle jet (outer pilot jet), idle emulsifier (inner pilot jet), air screw position Fine tuning for all these values History of all your carburetor configs Graphic display of fuel mix quality (Air/Flow Ratio or Lambda) Selectable fuel type (gasoline with or without ethanol, Racing fuels available, for example: VP C12, VP 110, VP MRX02, Sunoco) Adjustable fuel/oil ratio Adjustable floats height Mix wizard to get the perfect mix ratio (fuel calculator) Carburetor ice warning Possibility of use automatic weather data or a portable weather station If you don't want to share your location, you can manually select any place in the world, the carburetor setups will be adapted for this place let you use different measure units: ºC y ºF for temperatures, meter and feet for altitude, liters, ml, gallons, oz for fuel, and mb, hPa, mmHg, inHg for pressures The application contains four tabs, which are described next: Results: In this tab two carburetor configs are shown ('By regulation' and 'Freestyle'). These data are calculated depending on the weather conditions and the engine and track configuration given in the next tabs. Also this tab lets do a fine tuning adjustment for all values for each carburetor setup to adapt to the concrete engine. Also the air density, density altitude, relative air density, SAE - dyno correction factor, station pressure, SAE- relative horsepower, volumetric content of oxygen, oxygen pressure are shown too. You can also see in a graphic form the calculated ratio of air and fuel (lambda). History: This tab contains the history of all carburetor configs. This tab also contains your favorite carburetor configs. Engine: You can configure in this screen the information about the engine, that is, engine model, spark plug manufacturer, float type and height, fuel type, oil mix ratio and type of the track Weather: In this tab, you can set the values for current temperature, pressure, altitude and humidity. Also this tab allows to use the GPS to get the current position and altitude, and connect to an external service (you can choose one weather data source from several possible) to get the weather conditions of the nearest weather station (temperature, pressure and humidity). In addition, this application can work with a pressure sensor built into the iPhone. You can see if it is available on your device and turn it on or off. Also, on this tab, you can enable alerts about possible carburetor icing. If you have any doubt about using this App, please, contact us. We answer every question, and we take care of all comments from our users to try to improve our software
1540482954.fullDescription: This app provides, using temperature, altitude, humidity, atmospheric pressure and your engine configuration, a recommendation about optimal carburetor configuration (jetting) and spark plug to use for karting Vortex ROK engines (ROK MINI, ROK GP JUNIOR, ROK GP SENIOR), which use a Dellorto VHSH 30 and PHBG 18 carburetor. This app can obtain automatically the position and altitude to get the temperature, pressure and humidity from the nearest weather station through the internet. Internal barometer is used on supported devices for better precision. Application can run without GPS, WiFi and internet, in this case the user has to enter weather data manually. Two different tuning modes: "By regulations" and "Freestyle"! In first mode, the following values are given: main jet, spark plug, spark plug gap, needle type and position (including intermediate positions with washer), air screw position, optimal water temperature, gear oil recommendation In second mode (Freestyle), the following values are given: main jet, spark plug, emulsion tube, needle, needle type and position (including intermediate positions with washer), throttle valve size, idle jet (outer pilot jet), idle emulsifier (inner pilot jet), air screw position Fine tuning for all these values History of all your carburetor configs Graphic display of fuel mix quality (Air/Flow Ratio or Lambda) Selectable fuel type (gasoline with or without ethanol, Racing fuels available, for example: VP C12, VP 110, VP MRX02, Sunoco) Adjustable fuel/oil ratio Adjustable floats height Mix wizard to get the perfect mix ratio (fuel calculator) Carburetor ice warning Possibility of use automatic weather data or a portable weather station If you don't want to share your location, you can manually select any place in the world, the carburetor setups will be adapted for this place let you use different measure units: ºC y ºF for temperatures, meter and feet for altitude, liters, ml, gallons, oz for fuel, and mb, hPa, mmHg, inHg for pressures The application contains four tabs, which are described next: Results: In this tab two carburetor configs are shown ('By regulation' and 'Freestyle'). These data are calculated depending on the weather conditions and the engine and track configuration given in the next tabs. Also this tab lets do a fine tuning adjustment for all values for each carburetor setup to adapt to the concrete engine. Also the air density, density altitude, relative air density, SAE - dyno correction factor, station pressure, SAE- relative horsepower, volumetric content of oxygen, oxygen pressure are shown too. You can also see in a graphic form the calculated ratio of air and fuel (lambda). History: This tab contains the history of all carburetor configs. This tab also contains your favorite carburetor configs. Engine: You can configure in this screen the information about the engine, that is, engine model, spark plug manufacturer, float type and height, fuel type, oil mix ratio and type of the track Weather: In this tab, you can set the values for current temperature, pressure, altitude and humidity. Also this tab allows to use the GPS to get the current position and altitude, and connect to an external service (you can choose one weather data source from several possible) to get the weather conditions of the nearest weather station (temperature, pressure and humidity). In addition, this application can work with a pressure sensor built into the iPhone. You can see if it is available on your device and turn it on or off. Also, on this tab, you can enable alerts about possible carburetor icing. If you have any doubt about using this App, please, contact us. We answer every question, and we take care of all comments from our users to try to improve our software

1540505030.name: INR Diary
1540505030.description: INR Diary assists in following up your anticoagulation programme. Insert the daily dose of your blood thinner medication (Warfarin, Coumadin, Marcoumar, Sintrom, Marevan, Falithrom, ...) for a certain period of time. You can add one dose at a time or multiple doses in bulk, according to a dose scheme. Doses can be expressed as an amount of pills or in milligrams. The app will remind you to take your daily dose at a personally configurable time. Tap on your daily dose to confirm you've taken the blood thinner medication. The timestamp of confirmation is stored in the app. That way, you'll never forget if and at what time you've taken your medication. The app can also record the INR measurements of your blood and visualizes the evolution of your INR in time. The app also reminds you when a new INR measurement is planned. Dose and INR data can be exported or imported for backup purposes, or if you want to discuss this with your medical expert.

1540779621.name: AU3FX:Space
1540779621.description: High quality real time reverb AudioUnit effect, for everything between small rooms, resonators, and infinitely large spaces. This app is part of the AU3FX series, a collection of simple and powerful audio unit effect plugins. High quality 32-bit DSP engine. A multitude of parameters to tweak to get a wide range of sounds. Built-in resonant filters. Comes with several bundled presets. Use multiple instances at the same time. Save/load session state in host. External access and control of all parameters from host. User presets shared across hosts (on iOS 13 and later).

1541081686.name: English German Sentences
1541081686.description: This application provides English - German sentence dictionary. This application is designed to help you learn bilingual English - German sentences with spaced repetition flashcards. Spaced repetition learning is proven to improve your ability to learn and retain information. ● Spaced repetition flashcards Use flashcards to learn bilingual sentences Put a card into ignore list or master list Tap a flashcard to see its detailed information Mark a card as "hard", "good", "easy" Hard flashcards are shown more frequently, good and easy flashcards are shown less frequently over time in order to exploit the psychological spacing effect. Schedule: view flashcards scheduled on a date Statistics: showing your progress ● English - German sentences Over 301344 sentences including daily conversations, academic sentences, etc. German translations by German speakers English audio by English speakers German audio by German speakers Built-in dictionary: Long-press a word to look it up Bookmark feature Voice search Search feature: search English sentences or search German sentences Learn 10 entries daily Share, copy sentences ● Lists Create custom lists Add sentences into a list Review a list ● Notes Write notes for each sentence Review your notes

button, one degree of correction is added or subtracted respectively and the second plane of osteotomy emerges and printed in screen real offering real time simulation of the wedge osteotomy in an instant to comprehend in real time what parameters are affected and modify favourably the correction angle. 1541572641.name: Sight Words Flash Cards
1541572641.description: Help your child or student learn to read with Sight Words Flash Cards - a simple, no-distraction app featuring the Dolch and Fry sight word lists. Sight words are the most frequently used words in English, and mastering them is the key to early reading success. This app includes all Dolch and Fry lists, plus a variety curated list - perfect for preschool, kindergarten, and early elementary. Use the app to teach reading fluency, word recognition, and sight word memory. Tap to hear the word aloud. Swipe through the flashcards in order or shuffle for variety. Designed for Parents and Teachers: Covers Dolch Sight Words (Pre-Primer to Grade 3, plus nouns) Includes Fry Sight Words (1,000 words across 10 levels) Easy flashcard format for home or classroom Multi-list selector for age-appropriate word sets One-tap audio in English for every word Shuffle or alphabetical order options Clean interface — no ads, no popups, no subscriptions For Kids Ages 3+: Perfect for: Preschool and kindergarten learners First to third grade students Homeschoolers and special education ESL (English as a Second Language) learners No ads. No in-app purchases. No distractions. Just simple, effective reading flashcards to help children become confident readers. Why spend more on paper flashcards when you can have all the top sight word sets in your pocket - forever?

1541587241.name: VBAN Talkie
1541587241.description: VB-AUDIO Software / VBAN-Talkie allows to send your voice (Audio Input) to any VBAN Receptor and in the mean time, listen to a VBAN Streams, turning your mobile device in High Quality Wireless Microphone or Headset. Typically connected to Voicemeeter, the VBAN Talkie will offer outstanding local network intercom functions... VBAN protocol is made to transport audio in native PCM format (16 kHz to 48 kHz - 8 to 24 Bits) on any local network (LAN or WLAN). VBAN Stream can be managed and mixed by Voicemeeter Application, the Virtual Audio Device Mixer (www.voicemeeter.com) HELP: How to send VBAN Stream to Mobile Devices: https://forum.vb-audio.com/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=443 Additional Features: ON / OFF Button. Mute / PTT button (Push To Talk). Compressor (with Auto make up). Gate Knob (for noisy environments). 3 Bands Equalizer (Bass, Medium, Treble). General Gain (for input device only). VBAN Stream Name and Target IP-Address field. VBAN Output Stream Samplerate Selector (16 kHz to 48 kHz). VBAN Output Stream Format Selector (mono or stereo, 8, 12, 16 or 24 bits). Other functions in menu: Display mobile device IP-Address. Setup VBAN Protocol UDP port. Setup Network Quality (to optimize latency). Setup VBAN incoming stream (optional). Delay (0 - 500ms) to synchronize several devices.

1541682236.description: This application allows you to generate a completely secure "access token" which will then be used for all exchanges between your different applications and the manufacturer's API in order to access the data. It will be necessary to copy it manually in order to use it in one or more applications, in particular in our VIA applications: My Battery Health and T4U. available now for : Tesla BMW Nissan Renault

1542042948.description: A highly tweakable stereo delay AudioUnit effect, suitable for everything from clean digital delays to filthy dub echoes, flangers and broken cassette tapes. This app is part of the AU3FX series, a collection of simple and powerful audio unit effect plugins. High quality 32-bit DSP engine. A multitude of parameters to tweak to get a wide range of sounds. Tape simulation (noise and warble). Filters in the delay loop for typical dub sound. Stereo delay, stereo detune, ping-pong delay. Sinewave and random dual LFO for flangers and other modulations. Comes with several bundled presets. Use multiple instances at the same time. Save/load session state in host. External access and control of all parameters from host. User presets shared across hosts (on iOS 13 and later).
