1542825691.name: VTines Live
1542825691.description: The VTines instrument is based on real samples of a 1978 Fender Rhodes© Mark1 fully restored with clean pickups and tines, new grommets, new hammer tips, etc, so it is the best an electric piano can sound. Our model gives you access to a 100% continuous response, a very small sized library (90Mb), common FX and adjustable bell and release volumes. It also ensures that the staccatos and releases that make up for half of the realism sound perfect, not like a fadeout, not too loud, just perfect. The second concentric knobs control Treble and Bass, just like on a real suitcase Rhodes. We measured this carefully and made sure the ranges and frequencies matched the original. The vibrato has two controls, the depth and the speed. We carefully measured the output of the preamp and copied the real output of each channel. We also added a tempo link as it can be very useful. We also extended the original range as this is a common mod on real Rhodes. We measured the output of the preamp of a Rhodes© suitcase and created an exact replica of the stereo panning of the Vibrato. We just added the possibility to sync it to your tempo and also extended the speed range just like some real mods do. There are two very common FX accessible on the front panel: reverb and drive. You can also engage the AMP simulation from the front panel. The VTines combines samples and modeling techniques to accurately reproduce the sound of the original instrument. This allows the VTines to weight only 90Mb, to really sound like a Fender Rhodes with all of its imperfections and to have a fully continuous response. The « Live » version of our instruments has been especially thought for Live performance usage. CPU and RAM footprints have been optimized, so that our model can run on IOS devices. We paid a particular attention to making it easy to connect and use with external MIDI keyboards, and/or within you favorite AUv3 host Sampling and modeling hybrid of a Mark1 Fender Rhodes© Full continuous velocity Perfect staccatos and release samples 7 high quality presets Bass and treble EQ adjusted to the frequencies and ranges of the original preamp Precise modeling of the original Vibrato effect (can be synched to the host tempo) Very detailed Rhodes© AMP simulation Reverberation and Drive FX Adjustable pedal volume, release volume and bell amount Adjustable MIDI response, input sources and channels Adjustable MIDI CCs to control knobs and switches Standalone app and AUv3 plug-in Low download and installation size (less than 90 Mb) Reasonably low RAM and CPU footprint

1543163106.name: 末剑二
1543163106.description: “剑随指动，心剑合一” 唐末，天下战乱频发，兵荒马乱，烽鼓不息。 战争中死去生灵的怨念积聚，形成魔气反噬，天下各地出现尸骨复生，活物疯丧的惊悚事迹。 是时，皇帝听取西域高僧进谏，于九州地脉之上建镇妖塔以镇魔障。 然而好景不长，不久时日地脉震裂，镇妖塔崩坏，魔障溢出之势却更甚从前...... 镇妖塔隐藏着怎样的秘密？塔端为何藏着一名少女？ 妖塔再次封印之后，白衣少年踏上旅途——攀越苍穹的远古天梯，深入地底的黄泉鬼都，追溯崩裂的魔镇妖塔......他有什么目的？一切谜底将会在游戏中揭开。 妖风凛冽，剑气亦然。 【单指御剑，独创玩法】 单指操控剑技，回合斩妖除魔。 以武器操作为核心的独创玩法，多种剑技风格切换，体验剑仙般御剑斩妖！新颖的创新回合游戏机制，操作与策略并存，带来惊心动魄的攻防节奏！ 【牛鬼蛇神，剑技宝器】 国风怪力乱神，琳琅法宝剑技。 取材于中国传统神怪传说的场景与怪物设计，各具特色风格，压迫十足的boss战！随意拆卸搭配的剑技树与法宝，带来风格多样的战斗体验！ 【泼墨国风，绕梁律吕】 缥缈水墨入画，余音不绝绕梁。 极具国风特色的水墨画面风格，山水云雾缥缈，高楼错综林立，仿佛置身于那个曾经极盛却也日渐衰败的时代。 国风乐器实录的游戏音乐，银铃脆响般的古韵音效，锦瑟玉笛，连珠落盘，如身临其境般的音韵体验。 ——剑的传说，由你谱写——

1543359328.name: iDaily · 2020 年度别册
1543359328.description: iDaily 一年一度的「年度别册」再一次重磅登场! 每一天，我们从全球超过 50000 张图片中选出10个最能够拓展视野、打动人心的视觉记录。一年 365 天，你所看到的「iDaily · 2020 年度别册」即是这 1500 万张图片中最出色的 5000 个画面，5000 个瞬间。 我们试图从这些照片中找到人类对世界的定义，呈现超越时空的价值，为未来者讲述我们所身处此刻的文明。 年终岁末，iDaily 用 5000 张全球最卓越的记录图片，与你一同重温这颗星球上人类文明的 2020 年。 =特别亮点= 1.超越极限的视觉体验：3000px 超高清晰图片 2.时间轴：365 天，纵览全球事件 3.背景阅读：维基百科、权威媒体 4.分类 & 地图：11 个领域类别，六大洲、南北极、外太空浏览 5.点赞收藏：表达你的关注和态度 6.护眼模式：支持 iOS 13 Dark Mode 5.分享是美德：通过微博、邮件与朋友们分享你的感受 这颗星球上发生的每一件事情，与你的距离都不会超过 20,000 公里。 iDaily 年终巨献，iDaily Media 每日科技荣誉出品。 关于程序内提供的「按年订阅」功能： 您可以在程序内使用 iTunes 自动续订功能获取会员专属功能，我们提供「按年订阅」套餐。 确认购买后，将会从您的 iTunes 帐户中收取费用。您可以在每个周期结束至少 24 小时前取消下个周期的订阅，每个周期结束 24 小时内将会自动续订，已订阅的周期将无法取消。 隐私保护政策：https://clover.ly/privacy 用户使用协议：https://m.icity.ly/tos

1543512958.name: Stress Relief Training+
1543512958.description: Imagine this. If you see a picture of a "cake" and a "cockroach" in front of you, which one do you think your eye will go to? Probably most people would go for the "cockroach". Your eyes are drawn to the "cockroach" because of your negative thinking. We humans have lived on hunting for a long time. When we saw a nut which is eatable and a lion which is potentially a life-threatening animal at the same time, we would pay attention to the lion because if we noticed the nut only, the lion would attack and kill us. Our brain tends to give the highest priority to "living as long as possible". In other words, human beings have survived by naturally turning their eyes to negative things. It may be very important to think negatively in your daily life. The creation of feelings of worry and anxiety is essential to life. It is because of these emotions that one can prepare, work hard, and accomplish something. However, in modern times, becoming too negative has created a new problem. In today's modern civilization, we no longer have to face the threat to our lives in our daily lives as we did in the hunting era. In the days of plenty, negative thinking is no longer needed as it was in the hunting era. Today, becoming too much negative has posed a problem, causing people to carry more stress than necessary and developing anxiety and depression. In other words, the evolution of the human brain has not caught up with the evolution of civilization. Repeatedly playing this game will help you to successfully divert your attention from negative emotions.

1543660502.name: ClipKeyboard - 快捷短语一键输入
1543660502.trackName: ClipKeyboard - 快捷短语一键输入
1543660502.description: 别再一遍遍打同样的话。存一次，之后点一下就输入。 把常用的账号、地址、自我介绍、邮件模板存成短语。在微信、邮件、Safari，任何能打字的地方切到剪贴键盘，点一下，内容就填进输入框。 能做什么 短语：存好的内容原样输入，一点就好。 模板：每次会变的地方留成空位，用的时候从存过的值里挑一个填上。 组合：几个值放在同一个键上，按顺序依次输入，或者用箭头轮换着用。 加密短语：护照号、卡号用 Face ID 锁起来，需要的时候才打开。 智能剪贴板：复制过的内容自动归类，邮箱、电话、地址、卡号、IBAN 都认得出来，之后一秒就能找到。 iCloud 备份：换手机也不会丢，图片短语也一起带走。 关于隐私 你写的内容只保存在你自己的设备上。开启 iCloud 备份时，会以加密状态存进你自己的 iCloud。我们不收集短语的内容，也不使用任何第三方分析工具。 请先知道这一点 这是一个用来取用存好短语的键盘，不是拼音输入法。它不替代你平时打字的键盘。需要填入常用内容时切过来点一下，填完再切回去。 免费与 Pro 免费版可以存 10 个短语、3 个模板、3 个组合、50 条剪贴板记录和 5 个图片短语。Pro 是一次性买断，不是订阅：解除所有上限，另外提供 iCloud 备份和生物识别锁，还有 7 天免费试用。 支持 iPhone、iPad、Mac 和 Vision Pro。界面提供简体中文、繁体中文、韩语和英语。

1543684531.name: QZ - qdomyos-zwift
1543684531.description: QZ is not affiliated with or endorsed by any subscription service or maker of exercise equipment. ** Have you got a bike (echelon, flywheel, proform, i-console yesoul, decathlon, domyos, keiser, ...) or a Domyos (Decathlon) / Horizon / Proform treadmill and you want to join to zwift? This app allows you to give a second life to your machine! Also ellipticals and rowers machinery are supported now! Simply connect your smartphone to the treadmill/bike and zwift/peloton/fulgaz/rouvy will recognize it! Also this app allow you to use HealthKit to read your heart rate direct from your Apple Watch or any Heart Rate Bluetooth Belt. This metric will also be saved in your workout! Compatible machineries: all the Echelon bikes (please check the firmware compatibility https://robertoviola.cloud/2025/07/22/how-i-built-qz-and-how-echelon-is-now-breaking-it/ ) all the Domyos bikes all the Domyos treadmills all the Domyos elliptical machinery Smart Row Rower Echelon Rower (please check the firmware compatibility https://robertoviola.cloud/2025/07/22/how-i-built-qz-and-how-echelon-is-now-breaking-it/ ) Concept Rower 2 Yesoul S3 (M3 is currently on testing, if you have one, contact me) Sportstech bikes Inspire bikes Schwinn IC4 and Bowflex C6 Toorx bikes and spinbikes Fassi treadmills all the Proform bikes without a tablet builtin Proform treadmills Flywheel bike (the calibration tool is here https://ptx2.net/apps/flytest/ ) JK Fitness treadmill Toorx treadmills Sole elliptical Chrono bike NPECable and much more! ask me by email about the compatibility If you want you can join the Swag Bag auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase in order to help me in the development of the app! an auto-renewable subscription 1 month ($1.99) Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. 1543843478.name: Web AU
1543843478.description: Web AU brings a real web browser into your DAW workflow, keeping reference material, tutorials, documentation, support pages, videos, and downloads close to the tools you are already using, with powerful new preset snapshots for saving and reopening complete browser setups. Built for musicians, producers, and power users working in compatible AUv3 hosts, Web AU delivers a focused browsing experience with modern essentials: Preset snapshots for saving and reopening browser setups from Preset Browser Multi-tab browsing Complete bookmark management Browser history iCloud sync for presets, bookmarks, and browsing history Mobile or desktop browsing modes Built-in ad blocking and privacy controls Safe Browsing warnings Device permission controls for Photos, Camera, and Microphone Local file loading and media playback on iPhone and iPad Web AU is designed to keep the web available without pulling you out of your creative environment. Open multiple pages, move quickly between tabs, save the sites you actually use, and save full browser setups as presets so you can return to the same working context later without rebuilding it tab by tab. Preset snapshots give Web AU a stronger workflow advantage inside music production sessions. Use them to capture a group of pages, references, and browsing state for a specific task, then reopen that setup later from Preset Browser. This makes it easier to keep recurring research, manuals, tutorials, support pages, and work-specific browsing layouts ready when you need them. Privacy and control are built in. You can enable ad blocking, manage Safe Browsing warnings, switch between mobile and desktop user agents, view and clear saved website data to manage storage use, review device-permission status from inside the app’s settings experience, and back up or restore bookmarks when needed. Presets, bookmarks, and browsing history can stay in step across your devices through iCloud. Web AU also includes sync status details in Settings, along with manual sync controls when you want to check or refresh sync while the browser is open. Web AU is built for compatible AUv3 host workflows, including setups running on Apple silicon Macs. Whether you need synth manuals, plug-in documentation, patch notes, support articles, YouTube tutorials, download pages, or quick searches while you work, Web AU keeps that material close without turning your session into window-management overload, and presets make it much faster to return to the exact kind of browser setup you use most. In accordance with copyright laws, Web AU does NOT permit the downloading, recording, or capturing of content. All online playback operates independently of audio recording capabilities.

1544190466.name: 避难所：生存
1544190466.description: 《避难所：生存》是一款核辐射下的末日生存游戏。在游戏中你将扮演主人公泰德，需要在被核弹袭击的前60秒，合理储备你的物资，营救你的家人至避难所。在游戏中你需要做出一些困难的决定，例如合理分配食物和处理变异蟑螂的袭击等等。 在游戏中你可以坚持多少天？每个人是否都能活下来？当食物耗尽时，又该何去何从？要知道无论你捡到什么，无论你救了谁，都将对你的生存起到至关重要的作用。在游戏中每一个生存故事都是不同的，每天都会有出乎意料的事情发生，所以你需要定量配给食物和水，充分利用你的供给，甚至冒险进入荒地...话不多说，祝你好运！

1544325236.name: Schlap AUv3
1544325236.description: Schlap is a characterful, colourful and aggressive sounding program-dependent AUv3, IAA & standalone compressor. It takes inspiration from hardware RMS compressors of the past and evolves them into a modern setting. If you want your tracks to be energetic, in-your-face and bold, make ‘em ‘Schlap’. The compressor uses a program-dependent attack and release influenced by old hardware which makes the compression sound characterful and dynamic. The RMS detection means that Schlap detects the average loudness of a signal, resulting in sudden short peaks being uncompressed so that they can attack hard and sound heavy hitting. Also inherently in RMS detection, there is a slight delay in compression which allows the initial, early transients to sneak through uncompressed so they keep their punch. You’ve got a safe, controlled track you think you’re happy with, but you have to ask yourself… ‘Does it Schlap?’ Schlap is both a stand-alone application as well as an AUv3 plugin, meaning it works within iOS and iPadOS hosts such as GarageBand.

1544475311.name: MKSensation Xtreme
1544475311.description: The MKSensation Xtreme builds on our renowned MKSensation plugin, delivering the most accurate sampled representation of the classic MKS-20 piano module. Rooted in gospel music, the MKS-20 has been a staple in countless gospel albums, often stacked alongside JV-Series, Motifs, and other vintage racks for a rich, dynamic sound. Traditionally, musicians relied on complex MIDI setups to blend and control layers in real-time. MKSensation Xtreme replaces decades of hardware, offering the same powerful layering and live performance flexibility in a single app. With the power of modern iPads and M1 chips, MKSensation Xtreme provides the equivalent of eight Pure Synth Platinums. Each of the eight sound slots features independent AMP, Filter, Control, LFO, and effects, plus 8-insert effect slots (with up to five effects per slot), along with Global and Master effects. All effect buses are easily controlled via red faders, and, as with all our apps, full MIDI learn functionality is included. Designed for live performance, the app not only delivers our signature sounds but also allows you to host your own AUv3 instruments and effects. You can seamlessly integrate external sounds, run them through our filters, AMP, LFO, and modulation, and enjoy the ultimate flexibility—whether using MKSensation Xtreme’s sounds or purely its powerful hosting capabilities. iPad Version vs Desktop The iPad version is identical to the desktop version as far as features, synthesis, and functionality. The only difference is in sound: We removed the second version of the MKS sounds, so that there is only one main version of the MKS soundest, instead of two different versions on the desktop. The quality is the same. Rooted in gospel music, the MKS-20 has been a staple in countless gospel albums, often stacked alongside JV-Series, Motifs, and other vintage racks for a rich, dynamic sound. All effect buses are easily controlled via red faders, and, as with all our apps, full MIDI learn functionality is included. 1544552106.name: Search by Image for Safari
1544552106.description: Search by Image is a powerful browser extension for Safari that makes effortless reverse image searches possible, and comes with support for more than 30 search engines, such as Google, Bing, Yandex, Baidu and TinEye. Search by Image is an open source project made possible thanks to a community of awesome supporters. By purchasing the extension on the App Store, you help support the continued development of the extension. The extension helps journalists and researchers verify the authenticity of images, and assists in the identification of false information on social media. Search by Image is also popular among photographers, helping artists explore how their work is shared on the web, while shoppers find it valuable for discovering similar products at discounted prices. The extension enables you to search for images from the browser menu with the help of a diverse set of reverse image search engines, which can be toggled and reordered from the extension's options. Visit the wiki for the full list of supported search engines. https://github.com/dessant/search-by-image/wiki/Search-engines PRO TIPS: Search with an image by sharing it from Files or Photos. Tap the Share button in the extension modal to extract an image from a web page and share it to other apps, such as Messages or Notes. You may choose to allow the extension to run on every website, or grant access to the current website before a search. When you grant access only to the current website, access must also be granted to each search engine in order to view search results. Images positioned at the selected area are detected regardless of how they were embedded in the page. The extension also supports searching with images from your device, and images from private sites. A handful of search modes are offered that serve different use cases. The search mode can be configured from the extension's options. Search modes: Select URL: select an image on the page and search with the image URL. This is the default search mode. Select image: select an image on the page and search with the image file. This search mode is preferred for sites which do not allow the direct linking of images, such as private sites. Browse: search with an image from your device. Pasting images from the clipboard is also supported. URL: search with an image URL. Reviews are not monitored for bug reports, please visit the support page to report issues and submit feature requests.

1544733335.description: “Nice Skating” 是面向4岁以上儿童的第一个 3D滑冰应用程序。在成为滑冰专业人员的过程 中，我们鼓励孩子们尝试并进行创造性的实验 – 没有失败者！ 有四个不同的花样滑冰运动员可供选择，他们首先穿着有趣的服装和配饰出场。在体育馆里，孩子们可以在冰上画自己所想象的跑道，然后和他们的滑冰明星一起表演最疯狂的花样滑冰技巧。每个孩子都能对游戏进行控制 – 只需简单的手势，该应用程序就非常有趣，即使对这个年龄段里最小的孩子也是如此。 观众对这些艺术壮举有不同的反应 – 但是哪项表演最令人鼓舞？由你自己在参加大型颁奖典礼决定！ 要点： 具有独特技巧的四个不同角色 有趣的服装和配饰可助你大显身手 在冰上画你的滑冰场 为游戏专门创作了四种不同的音乐 音乐可以动态地适应花样滑冰游戏 无需互联网也可播放 关于 Fox & Sheep： 我们是来自柏林的儿童 App 工作室，为 2-8 岁的儿童开发高品质的游戏。 同样身为父母，我们带着对我们产品的热情和心血工作着。我们为我们的 App 选择全世界顶尖的插画师和动画师，为了能开发最美的 App 呈献给孩子们，以及带给我们和你们的孩子更丰富多彩的生活。

1545088229.name: Gordian Seed Tool
1545088229.description: Gordian Seed Tool protects your cryptographic seeds while also making them available for easy use. Using Seed Tool, you can generate seeds and store them securely on your device. You can then derive and share multi-signature signing and verification keys from those seeds or use them to sign PSBTs. Sophisticated backup procedures include printed pages and Sharded Secret Key Reconstruction (SSKR) — which lets you split your seed into pieces and send them to trusted parties, who can send them back to you in an emergency for seed recovery. You can even use an entirely offline device (no internet access) to store your seeds and use QR codes to exchange accounts, descriptors, seeds, keys, or PSBTs with online devices running compatible wallet or signing software. The "seeds" generated and protected by Gordian Seed Tool are long strings of truly random numbers used in cryptography. As the name suggests, seeds are the starting point for other things such as cryptocurrency keys and addresses. To be secure, seeds need to be created and saved safely. NOTE: Gordian Seed Tool is not a cryptocurrency wallet. It does not store or transmit value in any cryptocurrency, but it can be used in conjunction with such tools. Gordian Seed Tool is open-source software from Blockchain Commons, a not-for-profit public-good organization. Find our repository on GitHub and check out the code for yourself!

1545474672.name: Smoov AUv3
1545474672.description: Smoov is a soft, clean and transparent sounding program-dependent AUv3, IAA & standalone compressor. It takes inspiration from hardware compressors of the past, however it focuses on peak detection meaning that it can quickly and effortlessly react to incoming signals and blend them in with the surrounding audio field. When a busy track needs taming, Smoov softly settles your tracks elegantly. The compressor also uses a program-dependent envelope influenced by old hardware, which can soften anything you throw at it. Is a chaotic track starting to get to you? Maybe you should make it a little more ‘Smoov’. Smoov is both a stand-alone application as well as an AUv3 plugin, meaning it works within iOS and iPadOS hosts such as GarageBand.

1545547560.name: Pretty GS1 Barcode Scanner
1545547560.description: Probably the most beautiful pure GS1 Barcode Scanner, with an easy to use, functional design. See all contents of GS1 barcodes and share them with others. The App will show the contents of any GS1 Barcode, like the GTIN, Expiration Date, Lot or Serial Number. These barcodes are often used on products in B2B areas like the healthcare industry. Have a history of all scanned barcodes and share them with other applications or people, by using the Pretty GS1 Scanner. Features: Scan all common Barcode See Details of GS1 Barcodes Save a History of your scans Share Barcodes with other Apps Generates the scanned barcode as an image Export the Barcodes Shows all highlighted Application Identifier and Group Separator in the Raw Barcode Import Barcode from the Gallery Dark Mode Support Works on iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch The app can scan the following barcodes: Code 39, Code 93, Code 128, EAN-8, EAN-13, Data Matrix, UPC-E, Aztec, PDF417, ITF14, Interleaved 2 of 5 codes The following GS1 Application Identifiers are supported: (00) Serial Shipping Container Code (01) GTIN (02) GTIN of contained Trade Items (10) Lot Number (11) Production Date (12) Due Date (13) Packaging Date (15) Best Before Date (17) Expiration Date (20) Product Variant (21) Serial Number (22) Secondary Data Fields (30) Count of Items (37) Number of Units Contained (310) Product Weight in KG (23n) Lot Number of N (240) Additional Product Identification (241) Customer Part Number (242) Made to Order Variation Number (250) Secondary Serial Number (251) Reference to Source Entity (392) Price - Single Monetary Area (393) Price and ISO (395) Price per UOM (422) Country of Origin (714) National Healthcare Reimbursement Number AIM

1545928014.name: Radio Unit
1545928014.description: Discover a world of music with Radio Unit, a sleek and powerful Internet radio player with a built-in Audio Unit (AUv3) plugin. Elevate your listening experience by enhancing streaming audio in real time using your favorite third-party audio processing plugins (not included) within AUv3-compatible hosts like Drambo or GarageBand. Features: Intuitive Interface: Enjoy a clean, user-friendly design for effortless navigation. Song Discovery: Tap to add the currently playing song to your favorites, then open it in the Apple Music app or search for it on Google. Massive Station Library: Access over 35,000 radio stations—search by name, browse by genre or location, and sort by popularity. Favorites Sync: Save stations and songs to your favorites list, seamlessly synced across your devices. AUv3 Integration: Use Radio Unit as a standalone app or as an AUv3 plugin in hosts like Drambo, GarageBand, and more, with support for multiple plugin instances. MIDI Mapping: Control buttons can be triggered by MIDI Note events (C3 to F3). (AUv3 only) Battery Efficient: Stream music without draining your device. The app requires internet connection.

1546170953.name: Cloakasium
1546170953.description: Cloakasium 是一款安全的现代密码管理器，可与 iPhone®、iPad®、Apple Watch® 和 Mac® 配合使用。 概要 Cloakasium 使用现代强加密算法 (AES-256) 安全地保护和管理您的所有密码数据。 Cloakasium 将您的所有密码数据和信息存储在您的设备上，而不是服务器上。 使用 Cloakasium，您只需记住应用的主登录密码，无需费力记住大量密码和用户信息。您还可以使用 Touch ID® 或 Face ID® 进行应用登录。 为了在公共区域使用 Cloakasium 时确保安全，您的数据可以被屏蔽，无论是应用范围的还是单独的。 设计特点 数据以项目形式组织在两个文件夹级别中：组（蓝绿色）和类别（金色）。 项目在其记录和备注中包含您的详细信息，例如用户名、密码和账号。 您可以在单个项目、类别、组或多个组中拥有任意数量的记录。 在编辑模式下，可以创建、修改、重新排序或删除记录。可以重命名项目。可以创建或重新选择组和类别。 管理组、类别和项目。创建、重命名或删除组或类别。将类别移动到另一个组，或将多个项目移动到另一个类别。这是从其他密码管理器应用导入数据后整理数据的绝佳方式。 在共享 iCloud® 帐户的设备之间同步内容 从 Cloakasium 创建加密备份文件，并在任何设备上恢复这些文件。 从其他密码管理器导入 CSV 格式的数据文件：1Password™、BitWarden™、LastPass™、Keeper 或 DataVault。 将应用数据导出到未加密的 CSV 文件。 为信任的人创建第二个密码，以便在忘记主密码或紧急情况下访问 Cloakasium。 在 Apple Watch® 上使用 Cloakasium。

1546174597.name: DroneLab
1546174597.description: DroneLab creates slowly shifting musical soundscapes. Control three continuous audio sources running in parallel, each with its own rate of shifting intensity. Expand the soundscape with unusual sound effects crafted specifically for DroneLab. Get going quickly by selecting one of the included presets. Go further by selecting and customizing the sound sources, and save your own presets to the list. Create soundscapes for your music and video projects: Export a stereo audio file with your current settings, at sample rates up to 96KHz. On newer devices, exports occur faster than real time. Or, you can record in real time, capturing all the changes you make to the sounds as you go. DroneLab is great for improvisation and experimentation: Explore the melodic side of your instrument in a fun, relaxing setting. Warm up before practicing more difficult material. Explore sounds and articulations that aren't part of your usual repertoire. Please visit us at dronelab.app for videos, more information and support.

1546254115.name: The Singing Larynx
1546254115.description: Learn about the structure and function of the human larynx, and make it sing! This interactive educational module guides you through the anatomy and physiology of the organ of vocalization and lets you control the muscles to produce various tones and pitches. Change the mode and key to create different melodies, and make the larynx sing along to a variety of classical pieces. The Singing Larynx is geared towards students of all ages, balancing practical anatomical content with a dynamic interface that highlights the beauty and complexity of the human voice. FEATURES Touch interface that allows you to view the structures of the larynx from every angle; swipe to rotate, pinch to zoom Two distinct learning modalities: hold your device in landscape mode to study anatomy, and rotate to portrait mode to explore function A quick assessment feature to randomly test your knowledge of each anatomical structure Five distinct vocal modes-Major, Minor, Mixolydian, Double Harmonic Major, and Glissando-in all twelve notes of the chromatic scale A scored sing-along mode featuring three classical vocal pieces 3D anatomical models with hand-painted textures Original medical illustrations DEVELOPER Bethea Medical Media, LLC, develops illustrations, animations, and interactive experiences to communicate concepts and discoveries related to the health sciences. Find more information at betheamedicalmedia.com

1546373421.name: Beat Watcher: 心率阈值提醒
1546373421.trackName: Beat Watcher: 心率阈值提醒
1546373421.description: Beat Watcher 帮助你在 Apple Watch 上关注心率，并可为高低 BPM 阈值设置自定义提醒。 Beat Watcher 与健康应用集成，用于读取你的心率数据。 你可以将 Beat Watcher 用于： 在日常习惯中关注身体变化 压力觉察和呼吸练习 冥想和正念 锻炼和自我节奏安排 睡眠或休息时的查看 关注高心率或低心率读数 一些 POTS 或 ME/CFS 用户会将 Beat Watcher 用作自己节奏安排和身体觉察习惯的一部分。Beat Watcher 不是医疗设备，不用于诊断、治疗、预防或管理任何疾病。 在 Apple Watch 上转动 Digital Crown，设置所需的 BPM 阈值。当心率超过阈值时，你会听到声音并感受到振动；当心率回落到你设定的水平以下时，会有不同的声音和振动提示。 在设置中启用低心率提醒，当心率降至你设定的第二个阈值以下时也能收到通知。你可以同时关注高心率和低心率读数。 在 iPhone 上安装免费的 Beat Watcher 配套应用，当心率越过阈值时在手机上收到提醒。开启紧急提醒后，即使 iPhone 处于静音或勿扰模式，也可以播放响亮声音，让你或附近的人在睡眠期间更容易注意到提醒。 iPhone 配套应用还会保留本地提醒历史记录，方便你查看已保存的提醒，添加备注和预设情境标签，并将记录导出为 CSV 文件。 通过共享提醒，拥有完整访问权限的用户可以邀请受信任的联系人。联系人无需付费即可接受邀请、接收共享的高心率或低心率提醒、选择自己的接收偏好，并查看共享提醒历史。高心率和低心率由双方分别控制；只有双方都启用相应类型时，才会发送提醒。共享提醒不是紧急服务或医疗警报服务。 可选开启后台模式，在放下手腕或离开应用后继续获得与心率相关的触感反馈和声音反馈。 启用持续提醒后，只要心率保持在你设定的阈值以上或以下，就会每两秒获得触感反馈和声音反馈。或者，如果你只想连续显示心率而不需要触感和声音反馈，可以完全关闭提醒。 此应用还支持与 Apple Watch 配对的 Bluetooth 胸带心率监测器，例如 Polar H10。这种方式可以在长时间运行后台模式时改善 Apple Watch 的电池续航，因为 Apple Watch 的心率传感器不需要持续运行。此外，即使你没有佩戴 Apple Watch，例如放在充电器上，也可以继续从 Apple Watch 获得音频反馈或在屏幕上查看心率。 注意：后台模式无法与其他应用中启动的体能训练同时运行。例如，如果你在 Beat Watcher 中启动后台模式，然后在内置体能训练应用中开始户外跑步，Beat Watcher 将不会继续在后台运行。 订阅 Beat Watcher 可免费下载。心率提醒、后台模式、创建邀请和发送共享提醒需要完整访问权限。完整访问权限可通过年度订阅及其 1 个月免费试用、一次性购买终身访问权限，或此前购买 Beat Watcher 获得。受信任的联系人可免费接受邀请、接收和管理共享提醒，并查看共享历史。 免费试用结束后，年度订阅会自动续订，除非在当前期限结束前至少 24 小时取消。你可以在设备的设置中通过 Apple ID 管理或取消订阅。 如果你在订阅模式转换之前购买了 Beat Watcher，你将保留所有功能的完整访问权限，无需订阅。 隐私政策和服务条款：https://beatwatcher.app/terms 需要 Apple Watch Series 3 或更新型号。

1546459735.name: Vocala
1546459735.description: Your ears deserve a break. Vocala sits on the table and does the listening for you — showing real-time decibel levels so you can keep meetings focused, classrooms calm, and dinner conversations enjoyable. Vocala only measures sound levels. It never records conversations, stores audio, or sends anything off your device. Ever. Whether you're a teacher managing classroom noise, a team lead running standups, or just someone who notices when restaurants get uncomfortably loud, Vocala gives you the awareness to act before voices strain and headaches start. WHAT VOCALA DOES Place your phone in the centre of the table. Watch the live dB meter and animated visualizer respond to every sound in the room. When noise creeps into the danger zone, Vocala alerts you — so you can bring the volume back down before it affects your focus or your hearing. FEATURES Real-time decibel meter with animated bar visualizer Colour-coded noise bands from Whisper to Too Loud Customisable warning and danger thresholds Haptic alerts when noise gets too high Session recording with peak, average and alert stats Beautiful themes designed for table-top use Keeps screen on — no touching needed Works in portrait and landscape GOOD FOR Meetings and team standups Classrooms and school environments Restaurants, dinners and social gatherings Open offices and co-working spaces Anyone mindful of long-term hearing health PRO Unlock premium themes, session history, and detailed noise analytics with a one-time Pro upgrade. Put it on the table. Let the conversation flow. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

1546607440.name: ImagExif 2 - edit exif data
1546607440.description: This app gives you full control over the EXIF and metadata of your photos! ImagExif 2 focuses on real EXIF data, not just iOS metadata—this sets it apart from most of its competitors. 14 strong arguments why you need this app: 1. No subscription, no trial, no in-app purchases: buy once, use always on iPad and iPhone. 2. Display EXIF, IPTC and other metadata of photos in iOS devices, iCloud Files and iCloud Stream. 3. Edit, remove EXIF & metadata like camera info, photographer info, location & IPTC info and much more - in Apple Photos and also in iCloud Files! Geotagging directly on a map with location search.4. Edit location coordinates completely free without having so select specific places. 5. Save your work by using customizable templates - presets. 6. Batch processing of many photos at the same time. 7. Display EXIF data in an extension directly in the Photos app or in iMessage and many more. 8. Privacy share: protect your privacy and share your photos with your people with or without EXIF data. 9. Display EXIF source text - incl. its export. 10. Copy EXIF data directly to clipboard. 11. Focus on simple workflows and intuitive handling. 12. No collection of personal data like many copy-cat apps in this category. 13. Runs on iPad and iPhone. 14. Is under active development. Real customer testimonials: "Finally - This program is exactly what I was looking for. Easy to use but very effective and comprehensive. And the best: Pay once and good! Thanks to the developer!" "Just good! - Comprehensive and zero effort to use. For me the best app to edit the EXIF data of my photos. The presets are great and finally no in-app purchases! Keep it up!" "IPad version - it is here - Many thanks to the developer. Now I can add location information to photos on iPad. The developer also responds very quickly to requests and suggestions for improvement." "For a long time I was missing a possibility on the iPhone / iPad to store the location data of photos, because I still shoot a lot with "old" DSLRs and they do not have GPS. With this, this also works from Apple's photo app. Without complications. That's how it should be!" The app works with: All photos in your iPhone or iPad photo library. Photos in iCloud (Apple's exclusive file app, locally and in the cloud. Third-party cloud apps are only partially supported because their manufacturers do not fully support Apple's file API – please use with caution!) What the app doesn't do: Changing the filename: EXIF isn't about filenames. Also iOS does not allow the renaming of photos in the Photos Library. Until now it can't edit RAW (will come in a later release) or PNG (see below why). Full support of third-party cloud apps (e.g., GDrive or OneDrive) are only partially supported because their manufacturers do not fully support apples files api. Do you have questions or need help? Write to imagexif@gmail.com, we're happy to help! Question: What is EXIF data? EXIF stands for "Exchangeable Image File Format." When you take or receive a photo with a digital camera, it contains invisible metadata. This is information attached to the photo that describes, for example, certain properties and settings of the camera or even the place where the picture was taken. Services that can read this data are able to collect the circumstances and contexts of the photos and match them with certain other events (e.g. calendar entries, motion profiles, etc.). Question: Why doesn't the app handle PNG? Unfortunately, the Photos API does not allow modification of PNG files, but saves them as JPG. Therefore, to avoid confusion, imagExif cannot edit PNGs.

1547080016.name: 構音好好玩
1547080016.description: 兒童構音異常是學齡前兒童最常出現的語言障礙，研究指出家長參與能夠有效提升構音訓練的成效，但家長時常反映在家不知道怎麼指導兒童發音。遠距療育課程(Telepractice)需求提升；「構音好好玩」構音訓練應用程式就在提升家長參與度以及遠距教學的需求下產生。「構音好好玩」由專業的語言治療師研發，依據構音治療的理論基礎，並採用具EBP(Evidence-based practice)治療策略，提供有趣且專業的構音訓練平台，特點如下： 提供構音篩檢功能：依照學齡前兒童最常出現的錯誤音韻歷程，包括不送氣化、舌尖音化及舌根音化、塞擦音化以及複韻母簡化及聲隨韻母簡化，共六種錯誤音韻歷程，提供給父母作為初步篩檢構音異常及選擇目標音之用。 提供有系統且明確的訓練階層：每一個目標音皆有三個層次的訓練目標，包括詞彙(內含詞首及詞尾)、句子(簡單句及困難具)及類化層次，讓父母可以循序漸進，有簡而難的引導孩童練習。 專業的真人語音示範、可重複的聽能回饋及明確的正確與錯誤回饋：每一個語音訓練層次都有專業的語言治療師提供正確的語音示範，且提供錄音系統幫助孩童及家長透過重複撥放有效聆聽差異，最後透過正確與錯誤回饋按鈕有效建立家長及孩童聽辦能力。 提升訓練動機：為提升小朋友訓練動機，APP設計人物角色換裝功能，以及星星獎勵制度，鼓勵小朋友可以透過不斷練習發音來得到星星。 提供遠距諮詢服務：因應環境之需求及現在科技之便，作者透過建立FACEBOOK之「構音好好玩APP」粉絲專頁及社團，隨時提供家長諮詢及視訊指導服務，讓服務及療育不中斷。

1547114912.trackName: 合成全景照片-全景照片拼接神器
1547114912.description: 全景照片合成可以智能拼接您的图像，它通过拼接全分辨率照片获得卓越的全景照片质量。 主要特点： 简单且直观的用户界面。只需添加照片并点按“拼接”即可 自动剪裁拼接出的照片 可以对全景照片进一步编辑，可以调节对比度、灰度、亮度、色调等 为了保证图像效果，建议每张图片重叠30%， 如果您在使用过程中有任何问题，可以发送邮件到ColorLemonStudio@yeah.net。

1547228500.description: Simple is better. This app is focused on having a simple mobile scene switcher in OBS. In OBS v28 and later it should work out of the box. For earlier versions, it requires the obs-websocket plugin to be installed. You can download it here: https://obsproject.com/forum/resources/obs-websocket-remote-control-obs-studio-from-websockets.466/ Hide scenes that you don't want to accidentally switch to Control your stream, recording or virtual camera output Show/hide individual scene elements Mute audio sources Configure a delay for the commands in case you want to sync scene switches with camera delays

1547241148.name: 古典佛子日历
1547241148.description: 佛子日历是为广大喜欢佛法，修行佛法的朋友专门开发的一款佛教日历软件，同时也适合与佛法有缘的您，除了基本日历农历功能外，具有如下特色功能： 1，精美细致的日历，包含国家节日，农历节日，节气，佛教节日的标注，日历采用双节日排版，让您不会错误每一个节日。 2，寿康宝鉴戒期查询功能。 3，佛经，论典阅读功能，支持手势缩放字体。包含了常用的佛经，日常功课必备拼音佛经，如《金刚经》等，良好的排版，书本感的阅读体验。app还提供了佛经续读功能，让您可以分次阅读完较长的佛经。 4，念佛语音识别，佛号自动计数功能, 使用标准普通话，中等语速能提高计数准确率，并且可以参加共修，查看遍数。 5，供佛功能，可选择佛像，有普陀山陀山紫竹林禅院汉白玉观世音菩萨像，足不出户，朝普陀。您可以用佛号数兑换香、灯、水、花、果、宝、金供品供佛，一边供佛一边播放佛咒。供佛时请放好手机，心诚则灵，时间到了（10分钟），供品自动收掉！ 6，简单易用的记事本和提醒功能，以及简明的天气预报功能，方便生活点滴。 7，打坐计时功能，时间到了，会用引磬提醒，是您个人坐禅的好帮手。 申明：本软件为付费软件，价格费用仅依据您购买时软件开发所附加的代码功能等其他价值服务设定，其中并不包含经书，佛像以及其他文档图片资料在内的价值；软件的推送提醒服务属于免费提供的服务，并非包含于付费价值中，提醒服务的有效性和及时性不做承诺；软件中的本阳历年度对应藏历免费提供，由于不确定性因素，对未来年份的藏历的提供不做承诺，若您购买本软件视为同意本申明。 特别说明：App不再支持iPhone 5 及更早期手机，请勿购买。

1547400422.name: 新版柏林广场1 -欧标A1德语教材
1547400422.trackName: 新版柏林广场1 -欧标A1德语教材
1547400422.description: 《柏林广场(德文)》是一套从德国引进的最新原版教材，专门为想要尽快融入德国日常生活或者参加德福考试和获取欧洲语言证书的德语学习者而编写。 A1教材包含12个单元，每一个单元的主题都取材于德语国家的日常生活场景，内容丰富实用，配图生动有趣，分别从阅读理解、听力理解、书面表达和口语表达四个方面提高德语学习者的德语水平。 《柏林广场》为学习者参加德福考试和获取欧洲语言证书的优秀教材。德福考试对象是以赴德留学为目的的外国学习德语者或一般只想证明自己德语语言水平的人。 ■德语地道。 原版引进，内容未做删减。课文选材选用地道德语，多为实际场景分析。 ■注重听说。 课本每段对话配有原文听力，口语练习让学习者更容易进入对话场景。练习册同样以听力与口语习题为主。 ■实用性强。 柏林广场系列书籍语法讲解部分，更锻炼学生的实际运用能力，而不是以系统学习语法为主。 ■内容新颖，与时俱进。 内容选材为近期社会生活事件，贴近当下实际生活，更能引发学习者学习兴趣。 ■业内认可。 本书于2009年在德国出版，2012年引入中国。在德国经过三年沉淀，书籍得到业界认可，是学习德语不可多得的优秀教材。 无论从学习内容，还是到学习安排，再到整套教材的配套补充材料，内容详实，生动有趣，非常实用。 如果各位想要学地道德语，提升自己的语言实际运用能力，那么该应用可以作为首选。每个单元不仅有语法总结，还有本单元重点日常表达使用总结，非常贴心。 《柏林广场1》内容目录： 1 Hallo! 2 Feste, Freunde, Familie 3 Miteinander leben 4 Wie spait ist es? 5 Was darf's sein? 6 Familienleben 7 Willkommen in Berlin 8 Zimmer, Kuche, Bad 9 Was ist passiert? 10 Ich arbeite bei 11 Gesund und fit 12 Schones Wochenende!

1547418803.name: Incredibox - 好玩的音乐盒
1547418803.description: Incredibox 可让你在一群酷帅的 beatbox 歌手的帮助下打造属于自己的音乐。选择你喜欢的音乐风格，开始创作、录制并分享你的混音作品。尽情享受嘻哈节拍、电波、流行人声、爵士摇摆、巴西节奏等众多美妙的音乐节拍。此外，还可以探索由社区创作的一系列模组。丰富的内容让你沉浸于混音创作数小时，且不含广告，没有微交易。 如游戏般好玩，又如工具般实用，Incredibox 让用户拥有了全新的音频和视觉体验，并迅速受到所有年龄层人士的欢迎。音乐、图像、动画和交互性的完美组合，使 Incredibox 成為每個人的首選。同时，由于 Incredibox 寓教于乐，现在其已在世界各地的学校广泛使用。 如何使用？很简单！只需将图标拖放到人物身上，即可让他们开始演唱，并混合出属于你自己的音乐！找到正确的音乐节奏组合，即可解锁不同的动画合唱来帮助你提高混音技巧。 一旦你对你的作品感到满意，请保存并分享，获取尽可能多的票数。如果你的作品获得足够的票数，那么你可以登上 Top 50 排行榜，从而在 Incredibox 载入史册。准备好露一手了吗？ 在 App 中，你可以将混音作品下载为 MP3 文件，随时聆听和欣赏！ 懒得制作自己的混音作品？没问题，自动模式能为你播放乐曲！ 大声嗨起来 ;) Incredibox 是法国里昂 So Far So Good 工作室的智慧结晶，于 2009 年创建。以网页开始，随后发布手机和平板电脑 App，并立即成为热门话题。它荣获数个奖项，并出现在多个国际媒体上，包括：BBC、Adobe、FWA、Gizmodo、Slate、Konbini、Softonic、Kotaku、Cosmopolitan、PocketGamer、AppAdvice、AppSpy、Vice、Ultralinx 等等。自创建以来，其在线试玩版已吸引了超过一亿访客。

1547579838.name: ZAP短信-AI 短信过滤与智能识别
1547579838.trackName: ZAP短信-AI 短信过滤与智能识别
1547579838.description: ZAP 是一款基于 AI 的短信拦截、来电标识与智能识别工具，帮你告别垃圾短信和骚扰电话，自动提取验证码、快递取件码和银行交易信息。 【AI 智能拦截】 三层过滤引擎：自定义规则 → 用户标记 → CoreML 模型，层层拦截 智能分类：自动识别交易、验证码、推广、公益、快递等短信类型 一键屏蔽：开启后所有短信直接归入垃圾，适合临时免打扰 自定义规则：支持号码规则和关键词规则，精准过滤 智能脱敏：训练样本自动脱敏处理，保护隐私安全 【来电拦截 · 号码标识】 骚扰拦截：基于众包号码库，自动拦截广告推销、诈骗骚扰等来电 陌生号码标识：快递、外卖、中介、保险等类型自动展示，来电即识别 个性化标记：本地保存黑/白名单，仅自己可见，随时覆盖云端标签 提交标记：支持上报号码类型到云端共享库，协作维护社区黑名单 数据本地处理：通讯录不上传，基于 Call Directory Extension 系统级拦截 【智能识别】 AI 识别：CoreML 模型自动判断短信类型，精准提取验证码、取件码和交易信息 快捷指令：收到短信自动触发，后台静默提取，无需打开 App 灵动岛展示：验证码倒计时、取件码地址、交易金额三类场景均支持，三种风格可选 自动复制：提取成功自动复制到剪贴板，粘贴即用 手动添加：支持粘贴短信手动识别，AI 实时标注实体信息 取件码小组件：桌面小组件展示待取快递，一目了然 【交易识别与记账】 银行短信自动识别：五大类型（消费支出 / 收入 / 还款 / 转账 / 退款）智能归类 金额、卡号、商户、余额一键提取，无需手动录入 交易灵动岛：识别到交易后短时展示金额与类型（Pro） 分组折叠展示：按交易类型聚合，支持合计金额一览 财务统计：月度收支概览、支出趋势图、分类占比、银行卡汇总 【取件身份码】 快捷入口：一键跳转淘宝、菜鸟、拼多多取件身份码页面 驿站取件更方便，无需在多个 App 间切换 【iCloud 同步】 配置与规则多设备同步，换机无忧 取码记录云端备份（Pro 功能） 【参与训练】 贡献训练样本，帮助 AI 模型持续进化 样本自动脱敏，保护个人隐私 【隐私优先】 所有过滤在本地完成，短信内容不上传服务器。训练样本经脱敏处理后才进入公共训练库。无第三方 SDK，无广告，无追踪。 【联系我们】 如有问题或建议，欢迎通过应用内「反馈意见」联系我们，也可以通过邮箱 zap@jwapp.top。 【其他】 隐私政策：https://jwapp.top/polocy.html 使用条款(EULA)：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

1548253576.description: Understand electromagnetic induction through interactive 3D simulations. This app shows how a moving magnet induces current in a coil, following Faraday’s and Lenz’s laws. Rotate, zoom, and explore the complete setup to visually grasp every concept. Designed for school and college students, teachers, and physics enthusiasts, the app makes complex EMI concepts simple and engaging. Enjoy smooth animations, clear explanations, and full offline access. Features: 3D model of magnet and coil Interactive induction demonstration Rotate, zoom, and pan for clarity Visual explanation of Faraday’s Law See Lenz’s Law in action Smooth animations Works fully offline Ideal for physics learners and teachers Master magnetic induction with EduTech Era’s easy and visual learning approach!

1548942501.name: 哈特健康 Watcher : 心率、血氧、健康全监测
1548942501.trackName: 哈特健康 Watcher : 心率、血氧、健康全监测
1548942501.description: 健康指标管理快捷无忧！这款Watch App帮助您一目了然地追踪各项健康数据，例如心率，心理压力，血氧，HRV等。精细分析健康指标趋势，随时随地监督健康状况。全方位把握您的健康生活，实现快速高效的健康管理。快来下载这款App，开始您的健康旅程吧！ 集中管理各种健康信息，如心率、心理压力、血氧、HRV等 分析健康指标趋势 简化健康管理 了解个人身体状况 支持健康生活方式 注意： 1. 本 App会通过HealthKit读取你手机上的健康数据，包括：心率、静息心率、活动能量、锻炼等，并利用这些数据分析出您的心率在各种场景下的趋势。 2. 本 App的图表、数据等仅用于心率数据参考。它无法给您专业的健康建议，更不能替代专业医生和仪器。如果您觉得自己的健康存在问题，请务必咨询专业医生。

1548991759.name: Musical Note Recognizer
1548991759.description: Musical Note Recognizer is a professional chromatic tuner with unique algorithms designed for most accurate tuning. It works well for a wide range of instruments and is tested with guitar, violin, flute, ukulele, some woodwind and brass, voice, and more. Musical Note Recognizer - App that Assists Music Learning by Detecting and Processing Musical Characteristics from Microphone in Real-Time This tuning app also works as a pitch pipe and can sound a reference note to tune your instrument. Pitched Tuner displays a traditional tuner needle and dial. It clearly shows the frequency being played as well as the nearest note and error in cents. The dial then allows you to easily track small changes in pitch. A separate volume indicator tells you how clearly the microphone is picking up your instrument sound. Musical Note Recognizer - you just play the sound and the note and frequency are detected. It will let you tune any musical instrument with a very high accurateness and a wide range that covers A0 (27.50 Hz) – C8 (4186.01 Hz). This app can be used for vocal training and do you have little or no singing experience or voice training. Voice Training App plays a note or phrase of notes, and you sing to it. This App showing which note you should sing and which pitch you are correctly singing your note names in Accurate Chromatic Tuner. Musical Note Recognizer Designed in collaboration with The Great And professional singing teacher. User can choose from different note naming systems such as Standard (#) Standard (b) German (#) German (b) Indian Sargam (#) (Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Dha Ni Sa) Indian Sargam (b) (Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Dha Ni Sa) Indian Sargam (#) (सा रे गा माँ पा धा नि) Indian Sargam (b) (सा रे गा माँ पा धा नि) Do Re Mi (#) Do Re Mi (b) Easy to use and innovative must have features are all included. The most accurate chromatic tuner Superfast and simple! One touch Start / stop Automatic note selection Analog like needle Exact frequency display. Wide Detection Range from A0-C8 Clean bright and simple analog like UI High precision tuner Tuning fork, pitch pipe Works in noisy surroundings Adjust the volume sensitivity of the app for quieter instruments and noisy environments. Simple and easy to use No need to record anything, just open the app and sing See at a glance if you're on pitch, sharp or flat, and by how much Real-time pitch detection Notes covered: C0 - B8 Displays note names, cents, and exact pitch frequency in Hz Universal app Works on your iPhone and iPad As a pitch detector the tuner app is capable of working in noisy environment.

1549126927.name: Posture up
1549126927.description: HiPee P1 is a smart, wearable posture corrector that gently vibrates whenever you hunch – training your muscle memory to maintain a healthy spine. But the hardware is only half the story. The POSTURE UP app unlocks the full experience: Personalized setup – calibrates your natural posture Adjustable sensitivity – choose how strict your coach should be Daily tracking – see your progress over hours, days, and weeks Real‑time reminders – without disturbing others One payment. Lifetime access. Unlike other devices that force you into monthly subscriptions, HiPee keeps it honest: $4.99 (limited-time promotional price) Regular price: $19.99 (one-time, not per month) No in-app purchases – what you see is what you get No ads, no hidden fees Why charge for the app? Because maintaining the app – iOS updates, bug fixes, feature improvements – costs us real time and money. This small fee ensures we can keep supporting your device for years。 Disclaimer: The content provided in this app is for informational purposes only and does not constitute medical advice.

1549483364.name: 小学数学二年级培优天天练-数学解题益智游戏
1549483364.trackName: 小学数学二年级培优天天练-数学解题益智游戏
1549483364.description: 我们的研发团队都出自名校。我们深深知道，早期数学思维的训练，对孩子未来的成长，将会起到很大的帮助！而思维的培养，最重要的就是，不断地去引导孩子多思考，多动脑，这就是我们整个APP的设计理念。 为了达到这个目的，APP里每一个练习题，都配有动画语音提示，在孩子不会做的时候，不急着去直接给出答案，而是先给点提示，以此来启发孩子的数学思维，帮助孩子养成热爱思考的习惯。提交答案以后，系统会自动批改，然后给出详细的动画语音解析和完整的正确答案。每次练习的题目，都是根据孩子以前做题的情况，由程序智能选出。没做过的，不会做的或者是做错的，将会优先推送给孩子。并且，每次题目的答案都会随机变化，以方便孩子反复练习。 每次做对题目，系统都会给出金币奖励，孩子可以用获得的金币，去交换“成就证书”，以激励孩子不断挑战。家长可以在统计分析功能区，随时查看到孩子的做题进度，以掌握孩子的学习情况。 衷心地希望我们能帮助您的孩子真正热爱数学！

1549511268.name: BLEASS Omega
1549511268.description: 如果您认为 FM 合成很复杂，那么是时候再考虑一下了！ BLEASS Omega 将 FM 合成的所有闪光、特征、细微差别和动态表现力置于您的指尖，并摒弃了与 FM 经常相关的神秘编程接口。利用 BLEASS 的标志性 GUI 技术，在 Omega 中创建和制作声音不仅比使用其他 FM 合成器更容易，而且很容易 - PERIOD！ FM Synthesis 的所有经典功能都在 BLEASS Omega 中提供——富有表现力的电钢琴、深沉的雷鸣般的贝司、水晶般清晰的垫子、闪闪发光的铃铛和深情的主音。得益于该乐器的模拟式 Waveshaper 和多模式滤波器，BLEASS Omega 可以为那些纯 FM 音调注入强大的模拟风格，提供灼热的滤波器扫描、咆哮的失真和丰富的谐波共振。 位于 BLEASS Omega 核心的四个 FM 操作员可在一个屏幕内同时进行编辑，所有操作员信封和控件都可以通过手指触摸获得。这种令人惊讶的用户友好方法使声音编辑工作变得轻松，并以其他 FM 合成器无法实现的方式鼓励实验和探索。 提供了 11 种 FM 算法，每种算法都提供了一种不同的方式来互连四个运营商以获得完全不同的结果，BLEASS Omega 的声音范围非常广泛。包含的 200 多个专业设计的预设库充分利用了这种多功能性，为您提供了多种多样且鼓舞人心的声音调色板，可用于您的音乐制作和声音设计项目。 无论您喜欢如何创作，BLEASS Omega 都适合您的工作流程和工作室设置。 iOS 版本提供独立版本和 AUv3 版本供 iPad 和 iPhone 使用，而 Windows 和 macOS 桌面版本作为 VST3/AU 插件乐器提供，与所有主要 DAW 兼容。 更多信息、教程和规范，请访问 https://www.bleass.com/omega/

1549630756.name: 围棋师傅S
1549630756.description: 它是一个围棋 AI，具有强大的开源AI神经网络。Leela Zero, ELF OpenGo, PhoenixGo, Minigo, SAI, 和可选的KataGo! 你可以把它当作一个强大的对手，在学习的时候可以当作良师。 iPad Pro的M2处理器，ELF OpenGo weight v1的播放次数超过每秒650次，iPad mini的A15​​ Bionic处理器，每秒播放次数超过200次！均超过笔记本电脑，媲美台式电脑。 iPad Pro，KataGo b18c384nbt 每秒播放超过 250 次！ 其他著名的重量也包括在内。 提示您一下，iPad Pro 9.7英寸型号（A9X处理器）的模拟速度大约是每秒10次，iPhone 6（A8处理器）的模拟速度大约是每秒1次。 我认为即便如此，它也比大多数业余爱好者强，但我很抱歉，这时会增加算错征子的情况。 在考虑购买时请注意。 好好享用！

1549635441.name: 进击吧！卡路里！
1549635441.description: 《进击吧！卡路里！》是一款支持移动设备的AR互动健身应用。应用将AR、跑酷、运动结合在一起，只要环境合适，随时都可以开始自己的健身大计！ 【AR+运动】 使用AR技术，在现实环境中加入障碍跑道，随时开始运动！3D虚拟场景、实景任你切换！ 【多种运动姿态】 通过实际的人体左右移动，跳跃和蹲下，多种方式躲避障碍物吧，感受超真实的跑酷体验。 【充满乐趣】 在跑道中躲避障碍的同时收集金币，可以在商店中解锁更多模式！清新蠢萌的画风，老少咸宜，体验更有趣的运动！ 【卡路里记录，与好友PK】 应用会帮你记录供参考的消耗卡路里数，在数据的支持下你可以更好的制定健身计划！还可以实时查看自己与朋友家人的记录，一起PK，燃烧小宇宙！

1549683587.name: Money Pro
1549683587.description: 轻松做预算。 使用 Money Pro 来削减开支！ Money Pro 提供一站式账单计划、预算管理和账户跟踪。 该应用现已针对 iPad 完全优化！ Money Pro 3.0 新增功能： 可自定义仪表盘 简化的在线预算功能 按类别及子类别进行预算 快速筛选交易记录和选择时间段 功能 日历 在大日历中标出账单到期的日子 设置可自定义周期的重复性账单 通过在日历中选择日期来筛选交易 今日视图 快速查看到期账单 发生交易时快速批准 账单到期通知 全面的提醒系统可以提醒您即将到期的账单 快速重新计划选项可以帮助您处理（明天、3 日内、下周）到期的账单 预算 为收入和支出创建预算条目，并指定每个条目的预算限值 您可以为每个时间段设置不同的预算限值，如果您打算逐月缩减开支，此功能非常有用 开始添加您的每个交易，查看每个类别的发展变化情况和总体发展变化情况 用于监控预算超支的直观指示器 选择要分析的类别并即时查看所生成的预算趋势图 预算转结 您可以设置将当前时间段内的预算结余转结至下一预算时间段 如果您在之前的时间段超支，预算转结可自动限制您的支出 支票明细账 您可以同时设立不限数量的账户（支票、储蓄、信用卡等） 将交易设为经常性交易或一次性交易 结余变化历史 用于管理记录的额外字段，包括收款人、说明、支票号、分类（个人支出/出差支出） 收据照片附件 账户对账 您可以记录交易，并在日后结清（对账） 自动计算可用余额和结清余额 网上银行业务 (GOLD 订阅) 连接银行，然后下载您的数据 导入银行对账单 导入交易历史，使您的账户时刻保持最新状态（.csv） 拆分交易 您可以将交易拆分成多个类别 当您在大型商场购物并同时支付多个产品时，此功能非常有用 计算器和货币换算器 计划预算时计算金额 进行交易输入时可快速换算货币 搜索 可以按金额、类别、说明和收款人等搜索交易 详细报告 收入/开支 现金流 交易 资产/债务（净值） 预计结余 日/周/月/年趋势图 在增强现实中查看报告 许多自定义选项 制定预算和账单计划时可自定义周期（每周、每月等） 可根据需要调整收入/支出类别和子类别的结构 利用 1500 多个内置图标来自定义账户和类别 使用照片来创建您自己独一无二的图标 Money Pro Sync（同步）(PLUS 或 GOLD 订阅) 在不同设备 上和其他用户一起跟踪花销（跨平台和家人同步） 备份数据 Money Pro 可在所有关键时刻自动备份您的数据 您也可以手动创建备份 多个描述文件 您可以设置多个个人资料，并分别跟踪您的个人和家庭财务 更多 打印并可导出为 pdf、csv 格式 密码保护 设定并跟踪财务目标 PLUS 1 年PLUS: $29.99 GOLD 1 年GOLD: $69.99 在所有国家（美国除外），实际费用都将被转换为当地货币。 在确认订购以后，将从iTunes账户中扣除相应的订购费用。除非已在当前订购周期结束前24小时以上关闭自动续订功能，否则将会自动进行续订。在当前订购周期结束前的24小时内关闭，将从账户中扣除续订费用。用户可对订购进行管理，可在购买后通过账户设置关闭自动续订。在已激活的订购周期内，无法取消当前订购。如果用户在免费试用期间进行订购，那么剩余的免费试用时间将被收回。 条款和隐私权 http://ibearsoft.com/privacy.html http://ibearsoft.com/terms.html

1549683926.name: 注册计量师考试总结大全
1549683926.trackName: 注册计量师考试总结大全

1549693927.name: Star Stacker
1549693927.description: Star Stacker allows you to import a sequence of star photos taken throughout the night and turn them into star trail images or a time lapse video. After importing you can create the images and/or a time-lapse video with a few different effects. Full trails - every star at full brightness Faded trails - Stars get brighter as the process runs Shooting star - Like faded trails but the last image is brighter than any previous giving a shooting star effect Javelin - Both ends of the trail are faded Warp mode - zooms into the image stack slowly creating a warped effect. This will also affect the foreground so post processing may be required if the images have the foreground included. You can also choose to save a video of the time-lapse based on the options used for the image stacking. Can import images from your photos app. RAW files that have been recently imported from an SD card reader, may take a few minutes before the full resolution files are available. There are resolution limits depending on the device being used and the memory it has: 6gb - 62mp 5gb - 62mp 4gb - 62mp 3gb - 42mp 2gb - 30mp

1550228040.name: 跆拳道計分器
1550228040.description: 簡介： 可單人單手操作，教練可在對練期間簡便同時完成主副審、計時等工作，做為在對練完畢後勝負的參考。 功能介紹： 一、計分： 1.全部以手動計分，按鈕依照青、紅分成，頭部、身體，技術，正拳，及扣分。 2.按下按鈕有語音可即時朗讀出青或紅方的得分。 3.當有一方扣滿10分，會提示是否宣判比賽結果，或繼續比賽。 二、計時： 1.按下開始按鈕，就會依照事先設定好的競賽時間及回合數來計時。 2.在回合中，開始按鈕會變成暫停按鈕，按下暫停鈕即可暫停比賽計時。 3.在回合中暫停計時狀態下： 3-1.暫停按鈕會變成繼續按鈕，按下繼續，即可繼續回合計時。 3-2.會出現計時按鈕，按下計時按鈕可計時60秒。 3-3.在計時60秒狀態下，按下繼續按鈕，即停止計時，並繼續回合計時。 3-4.回合間休息時間計時無法中斷，但計時完畢後可自行決定下一回合的開始時間。 3-5.最後一回合結束時，可自動按照雙方得分狀況宣判勝方。 三、重置： 1.按下重罝按鈕，會將計分板與計時器還原到原先設定好的比賽開始前狀態。 2.在重置計分狀態前，可自動宣判，或自行選擇勝方，亦可不宣判，也可取消重置。 四、記錄： 1.在計時開始後，只要有計分，就可點選記錄按鈕，可查看雙方得分記錄。 2.若有計分錯誤，可點選單筆得分記錄，取消該筆記錄並修正雙方比數。 3.在回合中按下記錄按鈕，會暫停計時。 五、設定： 1.可設定回合數、每回合時間、休息時間。 2.可選擇判罰種類（預設不開啟，建議當記分員與主審非同一人的狀態下開啟） 3.可關閉語音功能（預設為開啟） 4.訓練模式： 4-1.預設為對練模式，功能專為對練計分所設計。 4-2.選擇訓練模式時，只以計時功能為主，取消各種競賽模擬界面，按下開始按鈕，只會按照所設定的時間及回合數進行計時，並在各時間點進行報時，方便選手自行按照所設定之比賽時間進行相關訓練。 操作模式 一、對練模式有2種操作方式： 1.由主審操作：主審兼任計分員。 2.由計分員操作：主審不計分，由專人操作計分。 二、訓練模式也有2種操作方式： 1.由教練操作： 2.由選手操作：

1550721625.name: JAMMATES
1550721625.description: Real Band Sound, JAMMATES JAMMATES is an app that features backing tracks of over 190 Jazz standards recorded by professional musicians. Stop practicing with robotic, mechanical backing tracks. You can play with a live band every time you want. Every single JAMMATES backing track was recorded by a live-playing trio with thoughtful consideration for the musicians. Try JAMMATES, an unprecedented Jazz backing track app. Features: Wherever you are, that place becomes the stage. Once you download the backing tracks from the app, try playing along a full live band sound with piano, bass, and drums. Play with groovy backing tracks. Move away from repetitive mechanical loops. To enhance your performance, there should be a sense of rhythm on the backing track. Change the tempo according to your style of playing. The songs provided by default have up to 3 different tempo selections, each recorded separately. Various music included in JAMMATES Do you spend time searching online to find backing tracks? Install JAMMATES and search for the jazz standards you want to play along with, then start practicing as if a live band is playing behind you. JAMMATES contains music commonly played in jam sessions and professional performances. Do you have any questions, comments, or suggestions? Please contact us at eve@adup.kr

1550780323.name: 电力烟花
1550780323.description: 烟花源于焰火，焰火源于火药 火药是中国的四大发明之一，发明于公元7世纪（唐朝）。 隋唐之际，火药发展成为供娱乐用的焰火。焰火，也叫烟火、烟花。隋炀帝有诗云："灯树千光照，花焰七枝开"。 在宋朝（公元960-1279年），当时的人们可以在市场上买到各种不同的烟花，也有大型烟花表演，当时"架子烟火"或"盆景烟花"，已具相当规模。每逢元宵佳节，达官巨贾竞相比美。从掌灯后不久直至更残漏尽。词人辛弃疾曾有“东风夜放花千树，更吹落，星如雨”的词句，便是对它生动而形象的描写。 真实世界的烟花，往往是稍纵即逝，但会给人留下一瞬间的美好，这种感觉，就像在漆黑的世界的里，出现一个泛着光晕的信标，熠熠生辉，指引着未来的方向。 前前后后经历一年开发时间，自研了粒子引擎来模拟现实世界的烟花，并在游戏里面加入几十种烟花，之后的更新中也会不断新增烟花的种类，希望能给大家带来美好的体验。 烟花组合搭配效果一览： 净空震击：+1人 连击：+1 人 交叉：+2 人 高低搭配：+1 人 水平二连: +2 爱心 水平三连：+2 爱心 三段击：+2 爱心 加速：200%行走速度 泥泞：50% 行走速度 折返：折返 套索*1：禁锢1人 套索*2 ：禁锢2人 水漫河岸：群体禁锢 -2 爱心 大雨：群体禁锢 -5 爱心 人口分裂：人口 * 2

1551273147.name: Otter - 饮食日记
1551273147.description: 用照片轻松回顾每一餐。 Otter是一款用照片和备注记录日常饮食的简洁日记。拍下食物，需要时再写一句话，就完成了。早餐、午餐、晚餐和零食会排列在清晰的时间线中，帮助你按自己的节奏回顾日常饮食。卡路里计算不是必填项，也不需要搜索复杂的食物数据库或遵循严格的膳食计划。 照片饮食日记 用照片快速保存每天吃过的食物 记录当天的状态、心情、外出用餐或值得记住的一餐 在时间线中一眼查看过去的餐食 回顾自己的日常 快速搜索过去的餐食和备注 查看与记录有关的简洁统计 从多天记录中观察重复出现的习惯 喝水与体重 喝水后轻点一下，记录每日饮水量 记录体重，并按时间查看过去的条目 为长期记录保持简单 支持iCloud同步 没有广告，界面简洁 可爱的水獭陪你轻松记录 Otter不会评价一餐是“好”还是“坏”，也不会要求你把每顿饭都变成数字。你可以把它当作照片餐食记录、饮食习惯备忘，或保存日常生活的小日记。 从今天的一餐开始。平常的食物照片慢慢积累，会成为值得再次翻看的个人记录。 联系我们：OtterDietDiary@gmail.com

1551279815.name: 大家的日语中级1+2册
1551279815.description: 零基础日语教程，全球最畅销中级日语教材工具！ 让学习者在有限的时间内达到掌握基本听说能力为目标！ 本应用精心地设计会话场面和出场人物，并通过大量的、反复的练习培养学习者的语言应用能力。 内容相当充实，对希望在短时期内掌握日语会话的学习者来说是一本十分实用、不可多得的教材工具，在国内外被广泛使用。 学习目标： ■初级到高级，直达N2水平，顺利通过考级。 ■贴近日常生活各类场景，掌握单词5000个，考级重点词汇1000个，语法30条，通过加强听说读写等日语应用能力，达到真正掌握日语。 ■在旅游、留学及定居日本后，能够熟练交流，快速融入日本生活。 课程介绍： 本课程为以大家的日语为基础教材的日语中级课程。 学完日语初级，我们进入到中级阶段的学习，中级课程集中了大部分优秀日语老师，融合大量语言、文化现象，集基础性、实用性和拓展性于一体，旨在让学习者能够使用日语轻松应对日常交际生活和日语考试。 完整包含24课有声教程，12课中级进阶课程和25课中级提高课程。 每册分为12课，每课包括：“文法、練習、話す、聞く、読む、書く、問題”。 课程特点： ■涵盖内容全面，层层深入，符合学习规律。 ■情景融入式教学，场景对话原汁原味。 ■利用科学的学习方法，逐步轻松掌握日语。 适合对象： 1､日语初级基础。 2､希望用外语顺畅表达、交流的程度的日语学习者。 3､喜欢动漫和日剧、对日本文化感兴趣的学员。 4､以后打算到日本旅游、定居、留学的群体。

1551309192.name: Diana Dinosaur Bone
1551309192.description: Play with Diana on fossil dinosaur bone discovery adventure and have minesweeper and amazing bones to find. Hidden bones and dinosaur parts let you find and get ultimate rewards in fossil dig game. The best nervous dinosaur game is here for you to experience exciting dinosaurs from museum history. Search dinosaur codes and create your different dinosaurs in the dig game. Complete the cute baby dino by digging bones and other parts to make dino kids happy with your archeology. Meet fossils and uncover the mysteries of dinosaur games. The classic adventure for little kids is back, diana dinosaur game like never before. Play and become the master of dinosaur fossil archeology games. Jungle Jurassic classic archeology treasure fun and educational game will take you in the battleship to dig fossils. A simple game for toddlers to learn all about dinosaur fossils. Simply rub the screen over the marked points and find your dino bones to make them happy. A collection of discovered baby dinosaurs to color. Archaeologist Dinosaur Discovery Adventure coloring book to teach your little one all about history and museum kings. Dino adventure puzzle makes your little kid the best one who knows all about dinosaurs and has a competition with accurate information. Classic board game fun matching. T-Rex, Pterodactyl, Stegosaurus and so many cute interesting dino images to match and fill in. Play and bring them to your own museum collection with your bone digging game skills. Learn the name of the hidden dinosaurs by scratching it. Fun color game with amazing dinosaur babies. Find a hidden dinosaur image and scratch it to color your favorite dino. Play multiple mini dinosaur fossil dig games and start dinosaur walk. Collect fossils hidden in treasures and allow dinosaur skeletons to advance in bone find game. Enjoy exploration games and make yourself a pro in dino bones T-rex game. Give your best, have fun and complete all fossil collections in Dino Game of Kids.

1551480486.name: IFR Trainer
1551480486.description: Turn your iPad or iPhone into a powerful IFR training tool! The IFR Trainer is a simple yet effective tool designed to enhance your instrument flight training. Practice course and radial tracking on your device, saving valuable time during your actual flight training. The IFR Trainer features an Electronic Horizontal Situation Indicator (EHSI) with a DME reading and two bearing pointers. Use the EHSI to intercept VOR radials or track NDB bearings. Alternatively, switch to a landscape dual-gauge mode, displaying both an HSI and a single-needle ADF Indicator with a manually adjustable compass card. For optimal performance, we recommend using the dark appearance mode, which complies with EASA AMC 25-11. The light appearance mode is ideal for classroom presentations.

1551595310.name: GENKI Kanji for 3rd Ed.
1551595310.description: Learn basic kanji through kanji words: GENKI Kanji for 3rd Ed. is an app that helps users become able to recognize 317 basic kanji by studying more than 1,100 kanji words at their own pace! This is the official iPhone app from the 3rd edition of GENKI: An Integrated Course in Elementary Japanese, a best-selling series of Japanese learning materials boasting more than 3.5 million copies sold. Advantages ◆ Users can view the kanji words as they like, enabling them to study at their own pace. ◆ By repeating a process of memorization and self-checking, learners can master readings of kanji words and recognition of basic kanji. ◆ Audio recordings have been newly added for each kanji word. ◆ Kanji words already mastered are progressively removed from the study set, so users can concentrate on just the kanji that challenge them, making for a more efficient approach to learning. This app will not play audio if your device is in Silent mode (Vibrate mode). To hear the audio, please turn Silent mode off. Study methods and functions This app has three main modes: Study, Check, and List. ◇ “Study” allows users to view the kanji words, their readings, and the target kanji for each word over and over, so they can take their time learning. ・Audio recordings of natural pronunciations by native speakers are provided for all kanji words. ・Basic information on the target kanji is provided with fun illustrations and mnemonic hints, as well as animations of their stroke order. (The illustrations and hints are taken from the very popular learning resource “Kanji Look and Learn.”) ・Users can bookmark the kanji words they like. The bookmarked words are compiled in the Bookmark list in "List." ◇ “Check” helps learners to track their mastery. ・Users check their understanding of the kanji words studied and sort them into those mastered and those not yet retained. ・The kanji words already mastered are taken out of the study set, leaving behind just those that still need to be worked on. ◇ “List” displays various lists of all the words and kanji covered by the app so that users can see their progress and review them. ・In the lists arranged in lesson order, a-i-u-e-o order, or alphabetical order, checkmarks are automatically placed next to words that have been mastered. ・Kanji information on the cards can be displayed from the entries in the On/Kun list. ・Users can search kanji words from their target kanji in the Serial # list. ・The words bookmarked in the Study mode are also listed in the Bookmark list. ・The Study view of kanji words or the target kanji can be displayed from the list entries, enabling quick review. ○This app is based on the kanji list from the third edition of GENKI. ○Ads: The app does not display any ads that might interfere with learning.

1552559653.name: Snapcast Client
1552559653.description: An iOS port of Snapcast: https://github.com/badaix/snapcast This app requires a Snapserver to be installed and running in your local network. It supports both playback and control of other clients. Snapcast is a multiroom client-server audio player, where all clients are time synchronized with the server to play perfectly synced audio. It's not a standalone player, but an extension that turns your existing audio player into a Sonos-like multiroom solution. Audio is captured by the server and routed to the connected clients. Several players can feed audio to the server in parallel and clients can be grouped to play the same audio stream. One of the most generic ways to use Snapcast is in conjunction with the music player daemon (MPD) or Mopidy.

1552568814.name: FAC Drumkit
1552568814.description: 16 Voices Drum Synthesizer and Stereo Sample Player 2 oscillators (16 Waveforms) per voice with filters, Phase and Ring modulation 1 sample player per voice with sample position, filters, phase and stereo control Expressive instrument: velocity amount per Amp and Pitch modulation (MIDI CC) Randomization engine (Drum Synthesizer, Sample Player, Envelopes) Advanced Pitch and Amp envelopes with multi control points and delay Envelope templates, modifiers and copy/paste Mute/Choke groups: reduce overlapping and keep your drums tight Drag and Drop File Support and multi sample loading Mixer: 16 voices (Multi Output - If Supported By HOST) Pad controller: voices triggered by Pad (MIDI OUT and Velocity Sensitive) Includes classic drum machines built in presets for inspiration Library explorer: drums organized by category iOS AuV3 (iPad/iPhone) - Advanced Responsive Design, portrait and landscape views Everyone agrees that the drums are a very important key element of almost every genre out there, they are the foundation of a song. We are all fans of acoustic drums and drum machines, they each have different characters and strengths. FAC Drumkit combines both worlds, samples and synthesis, in order to provide new exciting and unique sounds. As a rule of thumb, the synthesizer section brings the body of the sound, and the sampler the unique character. Both parts are layered together and contain essential parameters to ensure they won't clash and will sit well together. On top of the samples and synthesizer section, FAC Drumkit brings unique Amp and Pitch envelopes with precise control points to modify the curve in a gentle or extreme way. The envelopes play a very important part in the signal path because, thanks to their flexibility, they allow designing very special transition. Indeed, the envelope of a Clap is probably the best one to illustrate the benefit of such envelopes created with points. The burst kind of sound is very hard to replicate with classic ADSR, it's not the case in FAC Drumkit. Needless to say, thanks to the control points the pitch transitions are also more interesting and precise. The value of each control point can also be altered manually, to set the root note of a kick for example. FAC Drumkit is for everyone, as sound designer you will be able to synthesize your own drums in a fun and creative way. On the other hand, if you are looking for instant results, use the provided presets or load your favourite sample pack in the sample section of the 16 voices. The randomization engine makes the creation of new sounds really easy. Define what you want to randomize and you are ready to go. Remember that instrument category plays a role in the randomization process. For example, if you want to design a drum kick set the instrument label to BD (or use the voice index to get a wider sound palette). It's also very interesting to select a sound you like and start the randomization process from there, in a gentle way or not, thanks to the options available in the voice button (page selector). FAC Drumkit is an expressive instrument, the amount of velocity can be set individually for each amplitude envelope, and the pitch envelopes can be modulated by external MIDI control change messages. The pitch modulation applies on control points or on the whole pitch envelopes. Important: The standalone app is a factory version only and you won't be able to save user presets. Use the AuV3. The documentation is available at fredantoncorvest.com/FAC_Drumkit.html

1552580781.description: Watch for Discord lets you use Discord from your wrist on Apple Watch! Stay in the conversation with this must have watch app! 1552670692.description: Unleash your inner ninja in Over The Bridge - the ultimate challenge of timing, precision, and quick reflexes! Tap to build, release to cross! Sounds simple, right? Think again! As the platforms shrink and shift, only the sharpest players will survive. Master 2 game modes across 5 thrilling difficulty levels and see how far your ninja can go! 1552752923.name: Harp Guru
1552752923.description: Building a working knowledge of a harmonica's layout is a real challenge. New players struggle to make sense of basic patterns, and even experienced players can find themselves lost in higher registers or different keys. The Harp Guru gives you interactive visualisations to: Help you understand how your harmonica is laid out Show you the possibilities and limitations of each position Show you the possibilities and limitations of each harmonica Move your licks between registers with confidence Guide you past the discordant tones during improvisations Act as reference in all situations before you have a perfect mental model Then Harp Guru helps you internalise all of this in to a mental model so you can improvise and change key confidently with your eyes closed. There will always be another harmonica layout or position to learn though, and Harp Guru will be able to help, whatever combination you need to work on. Featuring a comprehensive list of scales & tunings, all with the option to add valving setups. Find complete list of features and instructions on how to get the most out of Harp Guru at https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC_uFG-i4MZeFE3JYoFv0R0A

1552897483.name: 数回 专业版
1552897483.description: “Hexa Slitherlink" is a logical action puzzle. HOW TO PLAY? 1. The board consists of a number of numbers and a number of points. Each number represents the number of hexagonal lines around it. 2. Connect points to points in a straight line, making it a loop and only one loop. The number between six points represents the number of lines around its hexagon. 3. Where there are no numbers, there is no limit to the number of underscores, and there can be no underscores around 0. The routes must not cross, nor be forked. We appreciate any feedback you may have and will apply it to future updates and features. With your continued support we'll do our best to turn out quality Apps.

1553055273.name: Chairgun Elite Ballistic Tool
1553055273.description: 这是一款针对远程射手的智能弹道计算器。它可以帮助射击者计算远距离射击所需的保持时间和范围设置。适用于大口径和气枪。 这个应用程序使用温度、高度、湿度、大气压力、到目标的距离、目标速度和方向、科里奥利效应、倾斜角、斜面和您的步枪配置来计算最佳的垂直、水平和铅校正。 特征： 可以使用G1、G2、G5、G6、G7、G8、GA、GC、GI、GL、GS、RA4 甚至自定义弹道拖拽功能（内置编辑器），无需弹道系数即可计算弹道！ 您可以从列表中选择标线（大约 2600 个标线！包括来自 Carl Zeiss、Nightforce Optics、Kahles、Vixen Sport Optics、Premier标线、Primary Arms、Schmidt and Bender、SWFA、US Optics 和 Vortex Optics 的标线）并查看校正在任何放大倍数下（请参阅此处支持的标线列表 http://jet-lab.org/chairgun-reticles） 子弹列表：约4000个子弹数据库，2000多个子弹数据库，约700个G7弹道系数子弹数据库，约500个气枪子弹数据库，包括American Eagle、Barnes、Black Hills、Federal、Fiocchi、Hornady、Lapua、Norma、Nosler 、Remington、Sellier & Bellot 和 Winchester（请参阅此处支持的子弹/弹药筒列表 http://jet-lab.org/chairgun-cartridges）！ 考虑科里奥利效应的校正 考虑粉末的温度（粉末敏感系数） 考虑自旋漂移的校正 考虑侧风垂直偏转的修正 通过速度或弹道系数进行轨迹验证（调整） 考虑陀螺稳定性因素的校正 可以用手机摄像头测量倾斜角度 可以从互联网获取当前位置和世界任何地方的当前天气（包括风速和风向） 支持英制（谷物、英寸、码）和公制单位（克、毫米、米） 高度：Mil-MRAD、MOA、SMOA、咔嗒声、英寸/厘米、炮塔 使用 iPhone/iPad 中的内部气压计获取准确的局部压力 针对当前和零条件（密度海拔或海拔、压力、温度和湿度）的大气条件进行调整 密度高度支持（为世界上任何地方自动确定） 弹道图（射程、高度、风阻、速度、飞行时间、能量） 弹道图（高程、速度、能量） 标线下降图 范围卡 从大目标列表中选择目标类型 目标尺寸预设 第二焦平面范围支持 移动目标线索计算 快速风速/方向调整 与智能传感器集成。轻按一下按钮，您就可以实时校准密度高度、科里奥利、斜面和斜率 无限的设备配置文件（创建自己的步枪和子弹） 所有枪击事件的完整历史记录 瞄准镜转塔校准 测距仪 弹道系数计算器 支持 Kestrel DROP、Kestrel 5x00、WeatherFlow WEATHERmeter、Skywatch BL、Vectronix Rangefinder、Terrapin X 环境数据记录器 空气实验室（空气密度、密度高度、相对空气密度 (RAD)、露点、站压、饱和蒸气压、虚拟温度、实际蒸气压、积云云底高度、干燥空气、干燥空气压力、氧气的体积含量） , 氧气压力) 浅色/深色/灰色主题 内置教程 This is a smart ballistic calculator is aimed towards long range shooters. It helps shooters calculate hold overs, and scope settings necessary for long range shots. Works with large caliber and airguns. This app is using temperature, altitude, humidity, atmospheric pressure, distance to target, target speed and direction, coriolis effect, slope angle, cant and your rifle configuration for calculate optimal vertical, horizontal and lead corrections. Features: Can use G1, G2, G5, G6, G7, G8, GA, GC, GI, GL, GS, RA4 and even custom ballistics drag-functions (built-in editor), and can calculate trajectory without using ballistic coefficient! You can select reticle from the list (around 2600 reticles) List of bullets: around 4000 cartridges database, more than 2000 bullets database, around 700 G7 ballistic coefficient bullets database, around 500 air rifle pellets database Correction taking into account coriolis effect Takes into account temperature of powder (powder sensitivity factor) Correction taking into account spin drift Correction taking into account vertical deflection of crosswind Trajectory validation (truing) by speed or ballistic coefficient Correction taking into account gyroscopic stability factor Can measure incline angle with phone camera Can get current weather (include wind speed and wind direction) from internet Supports Imperial (grain, in, yard) and Metric units (gram, mm, meter) Elevation: Mil-MRAD, MOA, SMOA, Clicks, Inch/Cm, Turret Get accurate local pressure using internal barometer in iPhone/iPad Adjusts for atmospheric conditions for current and zero conditions (Density Altitude or Altitude, Pressure, Temperature and Humidity) Density altitude support Ballistics chart (Range, Elevation, Windage, Velocity, Time Of Flight, Energy) Ballistics graph (Elevation, Velocity, Energy) Reticle Drop Chart Range cards Select target type from big list of targets Target size presets Second focal plane scope support Moving target lead calculation Fast windspeed/direction adjustment Integrated with smart sensors. You can calibrate density altitude, Coriolis, cant and slope in real-time Unlimited equipment profiles (create own rifles and bullets) Full history of all your shootings Scope turret calibration Rangefinder Ballistic coefficient calculator Support Kestrel DROP, Kestrel 5x00, WeatherFlow WEATHERmeter, Skywatch BL, Vectronix Rangefinder, Terrapin X environmental data loggers Light/dark/gray color themes Built-in tutorials

1553676660.name: AUVideoPlayer
1553676660.description: AUVideoPlayer is a video player that works as an Audio Unit v3 (AUv3) instrument plug-in your favorite DAW host apps such as AUM, Cubasis 3, BeatMaker 2, NanoStudio 2, GarageBand, or Audiobus 3. AUVideoPlayer can open video files stored in local, Photos, iCloud Drive, and other 3rd party cloud storage. AUVideoPlayer can output an audio signal and automatically converts the input sample rate to match the sample rate in the host app. AUVideoPlayer can also playback video files with no audio track. By enabling sync mode, AUVideoPlayer can playback a video file with the transport clock in host app for sample accurate synchronization. By running AUVideoPlayer standalone app and syncing with AUVideoPlayer plug-in in host app, you can play a video in Picture in Picture window even while closing the AUVideoPlayer plug-in window in host app. Supported Formats: MP4, MOV, ..., which Apple's Files app supports You can check the development status by following the Twitter account @AUVideoPlayer. Feel free to send your feedback! Support: https://twitter.com/AUVideoPlayer auvideoplayer@gmail.com

1553694602.name: Pig Weight Estimator
1553694602.description: Instead of eyeballing your hogs and wondering whether they’re ready for market try this simple App for estimating weight. By only using a measuring tape to obtain its girth and length and entering the values into the App it calculates an estimated weight. Measures can be entered in inches or centimeters with weight results shown in pounds or kilograms. Shows both live weight and carcass weight (post-slaughter). Results for multiple pigs can be stored and sent via email or text message as required.

1553855327.name: bismark CtrlSlide – MIDI CC
1553855327.description: bismark CtrlSlide is a touch-based MIDI controller that allows you to send Control Change (CC) and Program Change (PC) messages to external MIDI devices or apps. With an intuitive multi-slider interface, CtrlSlide makes it easy to adjust MIDI parameters in real time. Whether you're controlling hardware synthesizers, virtual instruments, or exploring MIDI behavior, this app provides a flexible and reliable control surface at your fingertips. Designed for musicians, producers, and sound designers, CtrlSlide supports various MIDI connection methods including USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and virtual MIDI routing (depending on your device and operating system). Key Features: Send MIDI Control Change (CC) and Program Change (PC) messages Customize multiple sliders for flexible real-time control Connect to external MIDI devices or other apps Supports USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and virtual MIDI Includes predefined CC numbers for quick setup Clean, responsive interface optimized for touch Use CtrlSlide to fine-tune your synths, experiment with sound design, or enhance your live performance setup — all from your iPhone or iPad.

1553926187.description: 您是否曾经梦想过进入彩虹？ 收集您房间中的颜色，或者通过蜜蜂的眼睛看世界如何？ 当你在了解物理和艺术的共性时，探索光和色彩的魔力。 探索光如何产生、如何移动，以及它创造的美（提示：颜色！）。 您可以将颜料和光混合，玩棱镜和透镜，对颜色进行分类，制造彩虹等。 还有——利用AR搜集和识别你周围的颜色。 在Tinybop的获奖科学应用库中，《光与色彩》排名第12位，专为4岁以上好奇心十足的孩子而设计，帮助他们探索奇思妙想。 我们的每个应用都为孩子们介绍重要的科学概念。 孩子们通过游戏、实验、观察、问问题、猜想和寻找答案来学习。 在tinybop.com学习更多知识。 ——探索光的反弹、折射和反射。 ——玩棱镜、镜子和透镜的模型。 ——通过制造风暴制造彩虹。 ——体验不同的光源，包括蜡烛、白炽灯和激光。 一窥雨滴内部，了解彩虹是如何产生的。 混合颜料，创建色盘。 通过混合彩色灯光，探索光的科学。 玩颜色分类块，了解不同的颜色系统。 使用AR收集、捕捉、匹配和命名周围世界内的色彩。 探索不同的生物如何感知周围的世界（人类、患有色盲的人、近视的人、蜜蜂、狗）。 思考您和不同颜色联系起来时的情绪。 使用40多种语言的交互式文本标签教授科学词汇。 与新一代科学标准（NGSS）协调一致。 为全家人带来乐趣——一起玩耍和学习。 无应用内购买。 无第三方广告。 隐私政策 我们非常重视您和您孩子的隐私。我们既不收集或共享有关您或您孩子的信息，也不添加任何第三方广告。我们不会用市场影响手段干扰孩子的使用。 关于 Tinybop Tinybop, Inc. 是一家由设计人员、开发人员和画师组成的工作室，打造成教育性套装应用程序。我们致力于制作有沉浸感的游戏，以鼓励孩子进行探索并引发对话。我们坚信玩耍、实验、假扮和提问是学习的强大力量。\" Tinybop 帮助您引导孩子加深对世界的了解。 对于新闻和新版本 访问我们的网站：https://www.tinybop.com 关注我们：https://twitter.com/tinybop 为我们打“赞”：https://www.facebook.com/tinybop 关注我们：https://instagram.com/tinybop 如果使用效果不如预期，请通过 support@tinybop.com 联系我们。我们倾听用户的反馈意见。

1554431834.description: ◆The new version 2020, DELE exam preparation for smartphones! Improve your Spanish level dramatically by using it in your spare time! ◆Include 6 practice tests of DELE exam [Level A2] You can practice the same format as the actual test on smartphone and check the correct answer immediately by automatic scoring function. ◆Covering the format of new DELE exam which began in 2020! You can use it with confidence as further DELE preparation. ◆ Created by DELE Examiner! All created by multiple DELE Examiners from Spanish native countries, directed by prof. Helder, who has been teaching Spanish for over 20 years in Japan also a DELE Examiner for more than 10 years. ◆ Easy to read and answer! 1555002628.name: 七巧板：儿童空间思维启蒙
1555002628.trackName: 七巧板：儿童空间思维启蒙
1555002628.description: 【应用简介】 《七巧板：儿童空间思维启蒙》是一款旨在为 3-8 岁儿童构建空间几何基础的益智应用。我们剥离了冗余的视觉干扰，专注于最纯粹的图形拼搭过程。通过将七个基础几何板块平移至正确位置，孩子将在“化零为整”的探索中，深度激活大脑的空间感知能力，建立严谨的逻辑秩序。 【核心卖点：空间思维的启蒙基石】 结构化观察能力：引导孩子不仅看整体，更学会拆解。在拼搭过程中，孩子需要理解“局部形状”如何构成了“整体图案”，这是空间思维发展的核心。 空间秩序与位置感：专注于平移与对位，帮助孩子建立对图形坐标、边线对齐、比例协调的直观认知，提升对几何形状在空间中位置关系的把控。 极简视觉，专注思维：摒弃一切繁杂的色彩与动态干扰。在纯净的界面中，孩子能更冷静地思考形状与空隙的匹配，这是训练幼儿专注力与冷静思维的绝佳方案。 由简入繁的思维路径：从基础的单形填充到复杂的动物构型，通过平移归位的逻辑，循序渐进地提升孩子对几何形态的敏感度。 独立逻辑归位：每一个图形都对应特定的空间位置，通过反复尝试与对齐，孩子能自主掌握图形组合的规律，获得深层的成就感。 【为什么要重视空间思维启蒙？】 空间思维是数学学习中几何概念的基石。不同于机械记忆，我们通过手动平移拼搭，让孩子在指尖感受几何美感，在脑海中演练图形逻辑。这不仅是拼图游戏，更是孩子未来理解建筑、设计、工程及抽象几何逻辑的早期思维启蒙课。

1555398807.name: PracticeMeter
1555398807.description: Improve your daily, weekly, and monthly practice habits by tracking your progress each day. Whether you are a practicing musician, athlete, or are learning a new skill, PracticeMeter can help you in organizing and motivating your personal practice. Available on iPhone and Apple Watch. Start a Session Simply press the ‘Start’ button at the beginning of your practice session. A timer will begin. After your practice session press the stop button. PracticeMeter will ask you what you practiced. In addition to tracking the amount of time, you can organize your practice sessions into Fundamentals and Goals. Fundamentals Fundamentals are skills that you want to develop each day. It may include a specific warmup routine with activities that are repeated each day. For a musician, this may include breathing activities, long tones, scales, etc… For an athlete, it may include stretches, breathing, and specific strength training exercises. If you are using PracticeMeter to improve your mindfulness, your Fundamentals may include specific meditation practice. Fundamentals may be archived for future use so that you are only repeating the items that you are currently focused on. Goals Goals are specific projects that you are currently working on. They include a progress bar so that you can self-assess how close you are to reaching your Goal. You will want to work on your Goals each day, seeing the progress toward completion gradually increase. Once you reach 100%, your Goal is cleared off of your daily routine and logged under Completed Goals. Time The default practice time for each day is 120 minutes, but you can set your own practice time goal in settings. Accomplishments As you practice each day, you’re rewarded with accomplishments. Accomplishments may include having a perfect week of practice, where you met your time goal and practiced all of your Fundamentals, and worked toward your Goals each day of the week. PracticeMeter will track your Streaks as well. Accomplishments are available for multiple perfect weeks of practicing your fundamentals and goals, as well as long-term Accomplishments for total practice time. Reports The Reports view logs your practice sessions, organized by day. You can keep notes about your practice sessions and share your statistics via text or email. Reports also provide a weekly view of your practice time. If you forgot to press ‘Start’ when beginning a practice session, you can add practice time to each day of the week. A single tap will add 15 minutes, while a long press on the day of the week will allow you to enter your total practice time for the day. Tap on the total time to toggle between minutes and hours. Widgets In iOS 14, Apple introduced Home Screen Widgets. PracticeMeter Widgets are available in a variety of formats for seeing your ring progress throughout the day. Apple Watch PracticeMeter will sync with your Apple Watch. Use your watch to start practice sessions add or delete fundamentals and goals, set a new practice time goal, and view your accomplishments. To add new fundamentals and goals, long press on the fundamental or goals header. Watch Complications include a simple circular view for keeping track of your daily practice time, as well as a larger rectangular view to see your daily progress of fundamentals, goals, and practice time. I hope you enjoy using PracticeMeter. Let’s get practicing!

1555868958.name: LatinPads
1555868958.description: Brazilloops are proud to present you a drum loop player which seriously delivers the Salsa, Bolero, Guaguanco and Son Montuno styles recorded from the most talented percussionists. Now with RGB style launch pads, you can have this genuine latin beats feeling with four distinct styles, each with 4 tracks. It also comes with a BPM control, so change the speed as you want and match it with your music, dance sessions, instruments, giving you different possibilities to play in a session or mixing in your gig! Very simple and intuitive to use, just press the instrument pad and it will start playing. Pressing other pads will start other instruments playing accordingly in sync. Press again the same instrument and the volume slider will appear, so you can mix them as your taste. Stop anytime any track pressing the white pad below it.
