1584529187.name: ListAI背单词-超级单词表，不背，百词斩，炭炭，奶酪
1584529187.trackName: ListAI背单词-超级单词表，不背，百词斩，炭炭，奶酪
1584529187.description: 当我们背单词的时候常常虎头蛇尾，常常不能背完整个单词库，常常背了前面忘记后面。 这款单词本可以帮助您，首页它可以快速的通过List背单词，让你快速的过第一遍需要背的单词。 产生第一印象之后，我们再通过艾宾浩斯抗遗忘规则，安排复习。有效降低遗忘。 但是List列表背单词的不足在于不能详细有效的了解词义。不能分析单词属性。 我们不能真正的理解单词的正确含义。也不了解单词的正确用法，和文化含义。 举个简单的例子 March 是三月的意思，同时 March 的含义有： v. 行军; 前进; 行走; 迫使…同行 的意思。 如果你知道 这个词来源于 Mars 一个古希腊战神的名字，你就能更好的理解 这个词作为行军的意思也不奇怪了。 如今通过AI工具可以每个单词都给你讲出这个单词的渊源来，帮助您记忆。 AI 还会帮您生成 单词的词义分析，列举例句，词根词缀分析，发展和历史文化背景，单词的多种形态，记忆方法 和 由单词编写的小故事。 单词会进行词根词缀拆分记忆，点击单词音标，拆分单词音标发音。 这是一款个性化的运用艾宾浩斯记忆算法原理，根据个人记忆程度自动安排学习和复习的背单词软件。 它的独特处在于：拥有快捷的List列表形式艾宾浩斯防遗忘算法。可以让你轻松记单词，防遗忘。 功能包括： 音标视频学习 以列表为颗粒度进行智能安排学习 将单词库，分割为若干List，对单词List进行学习和间隔复习。采用打卡的模式，对每日的List 一一学习掌握。用户可调节List单词表的词数，根据自己的学习计划，考试安排来设置最终完成掌握整个单词库的时间。 离线背单词 单词库下载在APP本地，在线读音播放后会缓存在APP本地。可实现利用碎片时间背单词。 自动收藏多次不会的单词。 APP能自动收藏用户多次不会的单词，方便用户主动加强学习，用户也可自主收藏单词，在单独的列表展示。 可导出PDF，打印进行纸质学习 自动生成列表颗粒度的艾宾浩斯防遗忘学习表，可一次性导出全部词库，方便用户线下进行纸质学习。 丰富的单词库 内含最新2023，2024年更新 小学人教单词，初中人教单词，高中教材核心单词，大学四级，大学六级，考研必考词汇，雅思考试核心词汇，托福考试核心词汇。 总词量超5万条。并且在不断更新中。 付费下载无内购。

1584622693.name: 每日英语阅读学习版
1584622693.description: 每天10分钟，英语轻松读！专为英语学习者打造的阅读、词汇提升 App。软件会根据你的英文水平，每天推荐精选趣味短文，更有知识点讲义、词汇智能提示、生词本学习等功能，等你来发现。 【趣味文章，每日更新】 精选短文：由编辑精心挑选的英语文章，只需三分钟，轻松积累实用词汇，学习地道鲜活表达； 考试真题：内置四六级、考研阅读真题，中英双语对照、单词即点击译，助你快速把握文章要点； 演讲精选：TED 、乔布斯、名人高校演讲...双语字幕搭配演讲视频，带你了解语言表达的艺术； 精听党：名著原声朗读，高亮双语字幕，结合干货知识点讲义和课后习题巩固，再也不用担心名著读不懂啦。 【每日外刊，深度专业】 选自主流的英美外刊，美国本土外教纯正发音朗读； 专业英语教师逐字逐句精讲，单词、语法、发音知识一网打尽； 每天2-3道练习题和配套答案详解，助你测评当天学习效果。 【强大功能、高效阅读】 单词查询：与《欧路词典》无缝集成，长按查词，即指即译； 播放调节：8档语速调节、4种译文切换，满足不同阶段的学习需求； 智能提示：重点单词、各大考试（四六级、考研、托福GRE雅思等）的高频词，可在文章中自动标注，单词学习更高效； 生词学习：文章中长按即可查词并加入生词本，更有卡片播放等复习模式助你学习； 统计图表：每天的阅读记录都会通过图表生动展示，记录你一点一滴的坚持与努力； 阅读提醒：同学，今天是不是忘记阅读了？不要紧，软件每天都可以按时提醒你。 【文件阅读，即点即查】 您可以导入需要阅读的文献，支持PDF、ePub及docx格式； 阅读时即点即查，省却查词时复制粘贴的烦恼，阅读效率大大提高； 支持添加批注，随时记录你阅读时的所思所想。 【订阅服务说明】 订阅服务：VIP 连续包季（3个月） 订阅价格：以iAP申请信息为准，VIP 包季服务为58元/季度 付款：用户确认购买并付款后计入iTunes账户 苹果iTunes账户会在到期前24小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺延一个订阅周期 如需取消订阅，请手动打开苹果手机“设置”->进入“iTunes Store与App Store”->点击“Apple ID”，选择“查看Apple ID”，进入“账户设置”页面，点击“订阅”，取消订阅即可。如未在订阅期结束的至少24小时前关闭订阅，此订阅将自动续订。 自动续费规则：https://www.eudic.net/v4/en/home/service 用户使用协议：https://www.eudic.net/v4/home/serviceterms 隐私协议：https://www.eudic.net/v4/home/privacy

1585016910.name: Pause - Video editor & Camera
1585016910.description: Pause video maker is a real time video cut editor. The Pause video maker is easiest way to video while recording. Now, you can video record with the ability to pause and resume your recording. You can get record video inshot, pause and resume recording whenever you want - when you are ready, edit and save your recordings as one completed video to your camera roll and share with friends on your social media accounts ! FEATURES; ● Pause and Resume on your video recording ● Better video quality , 4K support camera ● Video Editor - Trim or Cut your videos ● Zoom in/out with pinch gesture or slide while recording on cam ● Camera change to back/front or Ultra Wide Angle cam ● Export video clips from Pause app after that share on ig, tik tok, youtube with blogger and vloggers ● Change order of your movie clips ● Delete anyone video clips before video final cut process ● Trim on video clips duration like a splice and instagram reels video editor ● Video length without limits ● Video Countdown timer like iPhone camera app ● Supports Remote Controller for Apple Watch. You can control shooting from Apple Watch. ● Target Mode ( Vine ghost mode ) ● Share with AirDrop for your Mac or iPad. ● Share on social networks (Instagram, Youtube, Twitter, Facebook) ● Share on cloud services (Dropbox, iCloud Drive) ● Share via with E-mail, WhatsApp or iMessage on Pause video maker & editor TARGET MODE ( Ghost Mode ) The primary benefit of the ghost feature on Pause app, that helps make capcut clips or video story like that influencer of tiktok, instagram reels and instagram stories, inshot, capcut, like a picsart. This video editor pause the target feature switched on - just tap the little target icon in the bottom-right corner of the app - the end point of your last recording snippet will overlay the "live" scene, as in the pic above. With the target mode on, you will much more easily be able to line up your stop-motion videos, tiktok,instagram reels,instagram story style video shots, without the guesswork that might ruin the finished video. You are become filmmaker and jump cutter !

1585702412.name: Vidimote for Safari
1585702412.description: Control playback, speed (& more) of web videos in Safari - with this clever web extension. The Vidimote upgrades for your video watching experience: SPEEEED: watch videos at up to 2 x original speed, finely adjustable in 5% steps. Save time watching videos - without missing out on any content. Or watch a live stream's recorded part at increased speed - until you're "back to live". CONTROL: jump ±10 seconds, use the position slider and - of course - play and pause. SKIP: quickly skip to the end of a video you don't want to see ACTUAL TIME REMAINING: see how much _actual_ time remains to the end of the video - adjusted to the playback speed. LIVE STREAM CLOCK: see the approximate clock time for your current position in the live stream, making it really easy to find f.ex. the beginning of a show. PICTURE IN PICTURE (PiP): move web videos to picture in picture - and continue watching while using other apps. FULLSCREEN: enlarge web videos to fullscreen. MUTE/UNMUTE: mute and unmute web videos. SUPPORTED WEBSITES Vidimote was written and designed to work with HTML5 web videos everywhere - and in our testing it has, including the websites of Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, TED.com, Udemy, Khan Academy, MagentaTV, Twitter, TikTok, Reddit, Facebook, ownCloud, Nextcloud, Dropbox, Amazon Drive, Google Drive and OneDrive. Given the sheer number of websites out there, however, we can't guarantee that Vidimote works with every single web video out there. If you run into a video where it doesn't work, please let us know via our website's contact/support form.

1585833321.name: Achoo HTML Viewer & Inspector
1585833321.description: Achoo allows you to easily view the HTML for the webpage you're viewing in Safari. It shows the HTML (as well as any inline CSS and JavaScript) with beautiful and fast syntax highlighting. You can share the HTML you're viewing, allowing you to easily inspect it on an external device of your choosing, or send it to a friend, or simply copy it to your clipboard. You can edit the font if you'd like it smaller to display more information, or larger if you'd like to be able to make things out more clearly. You can also choose to edit the contents of the webpage, allowing you to make modifications and preview how they look. Changes are not permanent, simply refresh the page in Safari to return the page to its original state after you're finished previewing your changes. (Note: you're not editing the HTML directly, rather it's a visual editor of the contents of the page) As a bonus, it includes a variety of alternate home screen icons so you can customize the app to your liking beautifully.

1585954051.name: Fuoco
1585954051.description: Fuoco let's you easily edit Portrait Mode photos. With just a tap you can change focus. You have two subjects and the wrong one is in focus? No problem just tap on the other one. Or you want both to be in focus or maybe even none to achieve a cool effect? It's all possible with Fuoco. You can choose to edit them in the Fuoco app or even inside of the Photos app. Features: Tap wherever you want to set the focus Change the aperture (the blurriness of the unfocused areas) Adjust the size/width of the focused area Standalone app and Photos app integration

1586089723.name: URL to QR for Safari
1586089723.description: Hi! I'm developer in Japan. This app is a QR code generator for Safari. With our app, you can effortlessly convert any browsing URL into a QR Code. Whether you want to share it with other devices or with individuals, the process is quick and seamless. To get started, simply enable the extension in Safari's settings. From there, you'll have the ability to generate QR Codes from any webpage you visit, making sharing and transferring URLs a breeze. Experience the convenience and simplicity of our QR Code Generator for Safari today. Download now and discover a whole new way to share and connect!

1586437121.description: 「今天吃什么？」可能是很多人每天都要纠结的事情，然后随便点一份外卖草草了事。 如果把每天吃的东西以日记的方式记录下来，并且可以打分，是不是更加方便以后选择吃什么呢？ 「吃饭打卡」就是这样一款饮食日记本，把每天吃的东西记录下来，可以检查并反省错误的饮食习惯，帮助我们逐渐养成健康的饮食习惯。 我们提供如下几个贴心的功能: 1、记录三餐 这个专门针对有减肥需要的人士 或者喜欢拍照记录三餐的朋友 记录下在外面吃饭的日常 或者自己做饭一日食的美好时刻 2、记录日常 可以把每天珍贵的照片 想记录的事情记录进去 看到的时候总能回想起那天的记忆 3、记录体重 每天餐后记录体重 通过图表分析功能 帮助您更方便的进行身材管理 4、美食打分 每餐后随手给这顿饭打个分 日后可以方便的筛选出自己喜欢的美食

1586760306.name: 世界国歌国旗
1586760306.description: 让我们欣赏世界国歌和国旗! 3D地球直观展现! 包含所有联合国成员国及五个其他地区! LET'S ENJOY THE NATIONAL ANTHEMS ! ALL U.N. MEMBER COUNTRIES PLUS 5 MORE REGIONS ! 旋转轮 - 运用拇指很自然! SPIN THE WHEEL TO EXPLORE It's so easy and natural. 收藏夹 - 可以收藏自己喜欢的国家 ADD TO FAVORITES Save the country you like. 国歌 - 军乐队演奏 NATIONAL ANTHEMS Instrumental. 各个国家的国旗 NATIONAL FLAGS All countries of the world. 3D地球以及其他形式的地球模型 DIFFERENT EARTH MAPS Night Earth, timezone map, terrain. 离线独立APP - 无需互联网 OFF-LINE INDEPENDENT Once downloaded, you don't need internet to use the app. All audios and pictures are integrated within. You can select the country in alphabetical order by clicking “select” in the menu bar. Click "flags" to have a look at the national flag, click the speaker button to hear the national anthem. This app includes the national anthems of all 193 member countries of the United Nations and 5 other regions. They are instrumental music performed by instruments. This app gives you a taste of the different national anthems!

1586848633.name: 物理计算器 - 物理实验室
1586848633.trackName: 物理计算器 - 物理实验室
1586848633.description: 掌握物理学的终极应用程序，专为学生和工程师设计！ 这款应用程序专为物理学、数学和工程学的学生打造，旨在简化复杂的计算并帮助用户深入理解概念。不管你是在学习经典力学、探索量子力学，还是解决现代物理问题，这款应用程序都是你的完美助手！ 功能亮点 经典力学：计算物体运动、力和能量。 牛顿定律：第一、第二和第三定律的简化工具。 抛射运动：轻松计算轨迹、射程和飞行时间。 流体力学：处理压力、浮力和流速计算。 光学计算：包括几何光学和波动光学。 热力学：深入研究热量、能量和效率。 电磁学：电磁波和电路的相关计算。 量子力学：波粒二象性等高级概念的解决方案。 专属功能 综合计算器：轻松完成物理、工程和数学计算。 物理公式与常量：快速访问必备公式与物理常数。 互动模拟：可视化物理原理，增强理解。 工程物理工具：为工程学学生量身打造。 如何使用 只需填写所需的已知变量，留空需要计算的字段，应用程序会自动为您生成结果，快捷又高效！ 适合人群 物理学学生 工程学学生 物理爱好者 正在备考或需要可靠的物理问题解决工具的人群。

1586897675.name: 我的大学：当大学校长
1586897675.description: 欢迎来到《我的大学》！这是一款充满趣味与挑战的模拟经营类游戏。在这里，您将化身校长，主宰校园命运，制定战略方针，规划未来蓝图，投身校园建设、师资招募、课题钻研、学生培育以及突发应对。以智慧和决策，引领学校迈向世界一流！ 游戏操作简单，可随拿随放，非常适合打发无聊时间，快来与众校长同台竞技，体验前所未有的经营乐趣吧！ 【游戏特色】 1、 餐厅：招募厨师，研发菜品、培育厨神，用美食留住学子心。 2、 宿舍：配备多元炫酷设备，打造超燃高科技宿舍。 3、 社团：奇思妙想的社团任务，热血沸腾的竞技比赛，铸就青春别样精彩。 4、 体育中心：挖掘体育精英，组建顶尖战队，角逐奥运赛场，斩获世界殊荣。 5、 实验楼：解锁神秘课题，打开未知领域，承接市场项目，勇攀学术高峰。 6、科学院：谁能更快掌握前沿科技，谁就能主宰世界。 7、图书馆：参与国家评级，开拓数字资源，珍藏稀有典籍，彰显学校底蕴。 8、招生：自由把控录取分数线与学费，钞票还不手到擒来~ 9、专业开设：从基础实用到多元拓展，实现人才培养高质量发展。 10、高校建设：从专科到本科，从211到985，在不断进阶中实现综合实力的跨越。 11、公共建设：网吧、奶茶店、剧本杀店等应有尽有，致我们终将逝去的青春！ 12、随机事件：惊心动魄的随机事件，让游戏永远充满着不确定性和新鲜感。 13、投资：是馅饼还是陷阱？是机遇还是风险？等你来揭晓~ 14、校企合作：培育顶尖人才，推动校企合作，为学校发展助力。 15、学校活动：丰富多彩的大学活动，解锁学校新篇章。 16、校庆：这不仅是一次校庆，更是一次重温青春、寻找初心的奇妙之旅哦~ 【欢迎加入官方qq群】 5群号：850740692 6群号：183436358

1586908983.name: 36计大全

1587330949.name: Assyst – testing and exams
1587330949.description: Assistant 是创建您自己的测试、准备考试、测试、测试您的知识和提高您的记忆力的一种非常方便的方式。 非常适合测试员工、高级培训、招聘前评估候选人、学校和学生测试。 该程序是过时的桌面应用程序 Assistant（Assist）的移动替代品，旨在训练 qst 和 qsz 格式的解决测试，这些格式在 CIS 高等教育机构的教学中得到积极使用 您还可以使用一个或多个答案创建自己的测试。 创建的测试以及现有测试可以通过任何信使、社交或邮件应用程序作为 qst 或 qsz 文件发送。 主要特点 读取qst和qsz两种格式 编译新的和编辑现有的测试 通过互联网链接添加文件 能够在其他应用程序中共享测试 查看包含所有答案选项的测试内容 查看只有正确答案的测试内容 练习测试或考试 能够解决所有问题或一些随机问题 查看总数中正确回答问题的数量 解决测试的时间限制 编写测试 一个问题可以有一个（单选）或多个（复选框）正确答案 可能有些问题需要您输入正确的答案顺序 可能有些问题需要您在文本字段中输入正确答案。 答案可以是文本的也可以是数字的。 一个测验可以有无限数量的问题，一个问题可以有无限数量的答案 可以移动问题和答案 您可以为问题添加提示，回答问题后会显示提示 一个或多个图像可以附加到问题 一张图片可以附加到答案 未来，我们计划发布适用于操作系统为 Windows、MacOS 和 Linux 的计算机的版本。 该应用程序正在积极开发中。 写下评论和电子邮件中发现的所有问题和愿望。 如果您在打开文件时遇到问题，请将它们发送至support@assyst.app进行分析和纠错。

1587944402.name: EasyPack
1587944402.description: EasyPack the perfect checklist for shopping, recipes, and packing for trips! Each list item has three check options: have, bought, or packed. Make a list of items you need to bring, and see if you have it, need to buy it, or have already packed it! When it's time to go, filter your list by "not packed" and make sure you didn't forget anything! Other fun features: Tags let you categorize items, so for a recipe you can only show produce, baking, or other items as you shop. Duplicate lists or quickly uncheck everything to re-use your favorite lists. Lists are synchronized between your iCloud devices

1588019370.name: Safari 搜索引擎
1588019370.description: 第 2 版——全面焕新 Custom Search Engine 2 采用 SwiftUI 从零重建，更快、更简洁，并全新推出 iPhone 和 iPad 原生 iOS 应用。 完全掌控 Safari 的搜索方向。从 29 款内置搜索引擎中选择，或添加自己的引擎。只需点击 Safari 工具栏图标，即可在数秒内启用、停用或切换引擎。 29 款内置搜索引擎 Brave Search、Kagi、DuckDuckGo、Startpage、SearXNG、Perplexity、Google、Bing 及另外 21 款——全部预配置，开箱即用，无需任何设置。 Bang 快捷键 为单次搜索临时切换引擎。输入 k! 搜索 Kagi，d! 搜索 DuckDuckGo，pp! 搜索 Perplexity，y! 搜索 YouTube——无需更改默认设置。支持在搜索词前后使用。 添加自定义搜索引擎 任何搜索引擎均可使用。输入包含 %s 占位符的 URL，指定一个 Bang，即可开始使用。 隐私保护，无妥协 扩展程序仅在 URL 层级工作，从不读取页面内容，不存储任何搜索记录，不发起任何网络请求。 使用方法 1. 在 Safari 设置 → 扩展中启用 2. 点击工具栏图标选择默认引擎 3. 像往常一样搜索，Safari 自动重定向 支持 Mac 及 iPhone 与 iPad。完全免费，无需账号，无订阅，无广告，无追踪。

1588379446.name: Underword
1588379446.description: Underword is a visual editor for subtitles in the WebVTT (.vtt) and SubRip (.srt) file formats with audio transcription capabilities. To unlock the full potential of Underword, select a video or audio to show alongside the editor. If you can open the video in QuickTime, you can open it in Underword. Subtitles will be visualized in real time. (The WebVTT format is interpreted differently by various internet browsers and video players. Please visit the website to learn how they are displayed in Underword.) You can start creating subtitles from scratch or by importing text (e.g. from a movie script) that will be divided into manually adjustable subtitles. You can also transcribe the audio of the opened video or audio file: simply download one of the available AI models by Apple or one of the Whisper models, then let your Mac do the transcription offline, without sharing your data. The timeline view allows you to resize and rearrange subtitles with intuitive gestures. The waveform of the selected video or audio file helps you find the start and end of dialogues. Dragged subtitle boundaries automatically snap to the timeline cursor and at a distance of two empty frames to other subtitles. Menu commands with keyboard shortcuts allow you to set the start or end time of the selected subtitle to the current video time, as well as split a subtitle at a given text position, merge several subtitles, and perform find and replace operations. Precisely control all the subtitle settings with manual text input. Toggle bold, italics and underline for the selected text range. (Custom CSS styling is currently not supported.) If you have any requests, suggestions or bug reports, you're welcome to visit the website through the Support link.

1589419563.description: 打卡7是一款专为用户养成积极健康习惯而设计的应用。 采用极简的页面和操作，帮助你提升自我管理能力。更有效的完成日常任务。 主要功能： 1、定制个性化打卡任务：你可以根据自身需求和目标，在应用中轻松制定个性化打卡计划。 2、打卡功能：你可以根据不同的任务进行打卡，并附上文字和图片。 3、图片墙：我们会为您生成一个图片墙，把你这些打卡图片放到一起展示，效果满满。 4、Weekly：打卡任务标题下方拥有7个小圆圈，展示本周打卡情况，方便你快速了解进度。 5、时间顺序：打卡列表是按照你设定的时间进行排序，方便操作。

1589542148.name: Nova Tuner
1589542148.description: Written for professionals, especially those in the field of Early Music, Nova Tuner is a fully featured, accurate, chromatic tuner with extensive temperament support. A full demonstration of the app is on YouTube: https://youtu.be/egkAFaICdXY?si=peIM6QvGHLqXMqtD Nova Tuner was written by professional fortepianist and harpsichordist, Thomas Foster. MAIN FEATURES Sound Mode (reference pitch) and Auto Mode (detect pitch) Clean and simple interface About 30 built-in temperaments (see www.thomasfoster.org/novatuner for full list) Add/Create new temperaments. Duplicate and edit built-in temperaments Create profiles to quickly set pitch and temperament for frequently used settings. A4 pitch detector to quickly determine an instrument's pitch level. Quick selection of common pitch levels: 392, 415, 430, and 440 Hz (these are customizable). Four waveforms for audible note: Sawtooth, Square, Triangle, Sine. No data is collected, no internet connection is required. INTERFACE All tuner information (pitch level, temperament, etc) clearly visible on main screen. Standard, simple iOS appearance and controls. Large and intuitive adjustment buttons (no fussy scroll wheels). Light and dark mode. Supports portrait and landscape orientations. Note names in English, German, and Neo-Latin (do, re, mi) TEMPERAMENTS Temperaments can be transposed Add, duplicate and edit temperaments Favorite frequently used temperaments Filter by favorited and custom Search entire list of temperaments by name or information (creator, type, year, etc.) Hide unwanted temperaments so they don't appear in the list or search SPECIFICATIONS Transposition range: -11 to +11 semitones Detection range: A0 to C8 Reference tone: C2 to B7 Tuning modes: Sound, Auto, Auto with Sound Back Calibration range: A4=300-500 Hz, 0.1 Hz increments

1590589672.name: Map Redirect for Map Links
1590589672.description: Map Redirect is a Safari Extension to replace all map links on a webpage to be opened with the map app of your choice. You can select your target to always open in Apple Maps, Google Maps, HERE WeGo Maps, Bing Maps, Waze. Map Redirect will automatically redirect you to the maps app of your choice. If you select "Ask Me" a prompt will appear to ask you where to open the link. Works on Google Search pages and any other webpage. No need to copy/paste addresses anymore. Instructions: 1. Download Map Redirect from the App Store 2. Go to Settings -> Safari -> Extensions. Enable Map Redirect as Safari Extension 3. Open Safari. Search for location. For example, type London 4. Click on Context menu (the symbol "aA"). Click on Map Redirect to give it access to the webpage you are visiting. 5. The extension needs to read and alter the web page to change the map links. If asked for access, you may select to allow it for one day or to always allow. 6. In the Map Redirect popup, you can select your target. For example: select Apple Maps 7. Map Redirect will now scan the webpage for map links and convert them to be opened in Apple Maps. 8. Click on any map link 9. Map Redirect will now take you to London in Apple Maps Note: Map links on websites can appear in various forms with different parameters. Map Redirect tries to detect and convert them as much as possible to your desired target. Therefore, Map Redirect requires permission to read and alter the web page to change the map links. If asked for access, you may select to allow it for one day or to always allow. In case Map Redirect does not work on a specific webpage, please contact us and let us know the URL to check and fix it. Thank you for contributing. HERE WeGo deeplinking support is limited to only links with geo-coordinates Bing maps will use Apple Maps on iPhones Waze Deeplinking support is limited to searching from your current location to what is around you Privacy: Map Redirect does not use any trackers of any sort, nor does it keep, track, sell, rent, or share any information on you throughout your use of the app with any third parties. All processing happens locally on the webpage you visit with the extension. No data is transferred to any central server. For any questions, feel free to contact us directly.

Download Map Redirect from the App Store 2. Go to Settings -> Safari -> Extensions. Enable Map Redirect as Safari Extension 3. Open Safari. Search for location. For example, type London 4. Click on Context menu (the symbol "aA"). Click on Map Redirect to give it access to the webpage you are visiting. 5. The extension needs to read and alter the web page to change the map links. If asked for access, you may select to allow it for one day or to always allow. 6. In the Map Redirect popup, you can select your target. For example: select Apple Maps 7. Map Redirect will now scan the webpage for map links and convert them to be opened in Apple Maps. 8. Click on any map link 9. Map Redirect will now take you to London in Apple Maps Note: Map links on websites can appear in various forms with different parameters. Map Redirect tries to detect and convert them as much as possible to your desired target. Therefore, Map Redirect requires permission to read and alter the web page to change the map links. If asked for access, you may select to allow it for one day or to always allow. In case Map Redirect does not work on a specific webpage, please contact us and let us know the URL to check and fix it. Thank you for contributing. HERE WeGo deeplinking support is limited to only links with geo-coordinates Bing maps will use Apple Maps on iPhones Waze Deeplinking support is limited to searching from your current location to what is around you Privacy: Map Redirect does not use any trackers of any sort, nor does it keep, track, sell, rent, or share any information on you throughout your use of the app with any third parties. All processing happens locally on the webpage you visit with the extension. No data is transferred to any central server. For any questions, feel free to contact us directly.

1591303229.description: Vinegar is a Safari extension that replaces the YouTube player with a minimal HTML video tag. It removes ads, restores picture-in-picture, and allows videos to play in the background when set to audio-only quality. Note: The phrase 'can read and alter webpages' in the permissions section is just an unfortunate choice of words. Vinegar needs access to the webpage to find the YouTube player and replace it. It's not doing anything creepy! (Also, do check out Vinegar's companion app, Baking Soda. It's essentially a less powerful version of Vinegar, but it works on all websites except YouTube.)

1591826245.name: Miter Angle Calculator
1591826245.description: The Miter Angle calculator provides exact angles for cutting cross braces for gates or x bracing for the ends of tables. There are 5 board orientation options to choose from. Just enter the width and height of the opening as well as the width of the boards to be used. Both Imperial and Metric measurements are supported. Each board end as well as the intersection of boards in the middle are displayed with the angles for each, based on data input. In addition, the length of the board required to fit the desired space (pre-cuts) is given. A visual representative image of the cross braces displays upon calculation showing exact miter angles and position of angles. Miter Angle takes the guesswork out of miter cuts allowing you to achieve that perfect fit with cross or x end braces.

1592088473.name: Learn R Programming - Mastery
1592088473.description: Learn R Programming: Data Science, Statistics & Machine Learning — All in One App. Master the language that powers the world's top data scientists, biostatisticians, and quantitative analysts. Whether you're a complete beginner or advancing your career, Learn R takes you from your first line of code to building production-ready machine learning models — entirely on your iPhone or iPad. Why Learn R? R is the gold standard for statistical computing, data analysis, and academic research. Used by Harvard, MIT, Pfizer, and the FDA, R opens doors to careers in data science, bioinformatics, finance, geospatial analysis, and AI. Core R Programming: R syntax, data types, vectors, matrices, data frames, and lists Control flow, loops, functions, and object-oriented programming Functional programming with purrr and the apply family Performance optimization, profiling, and Rcpp integration Secure coding best practices and memory management Tidyverse & Data Wrangling: dplyr for lightning-fast data manipulation ggplot2 for publication-quality visualizations tidyr, readr, stringr, forcats, and tibble Modern data pipelines with the pipe operator Data Science & Statistics: Descriptive and inferential statistics Hypothesis testing, regression, ANOVA, and probability End-to-end data science workflows Exploratory data analysis and data cleaning Machine Learning & AI: caret, tidymodels, random forests, SVMs, and clustering Deep learning with Keras, TensorFlow, and Torch for R Natural language processing (NLP) and text mining Time series forecasting with ARIMA and Prophet Reinforcement learning fundamentals Big data with data.table and sparklyr Web, APIs & Deployment: Build interactive dashboards with Shiny and shinydashboard Create REST APIs with Plumber Web scraping with rvest and httr Quarto for reports, presentations, and books Database integration (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite) Domain-Specific Tracks: Bioinformatics: Bioconductor, genomic data, sequence analysis Finance: Quantitative analysis, portfolio modeling, risk management GIS & Spatial: sf, raster, leaflet, and geospatial mapping Career & Ecosystem: Career paths: data scientist, biostatistician, quant analyst, researcher Package development and publishing to CRAN Reproducible research with renv and containers Git & GitHub for version control Complementary skills: Python, SQL, Julia, Docker Run Real R Code Anywhere: Our built-in code compiler lets you write and execute R code instantly. Test dplyr pipelines, plot with ggplot2, build regression models, and debug functions — no laptop required. AI-Powered Learning : Smart Flashcards:AI generates Q&A flashcards from any lesson Quiz Hints: Progressive Socratic hints when you're stuck Daily AI Tips: Personalized coding tips every morning Note Intelligence: Summarize and simplify your notes instantly Quick-Reference Cheat Sheets: 10+ searchable cheat sheets covering R basics, data structures, dplyr, ggplot2, statistics, machine learning, and best practices — always one tap away. Structured for Retention: Bite-sized lessons designed for mobile Daily streaks and progress tracking Bookmark lessons and create personal notes Offline access to all content Learn R Programming today to start your R coding journey: master R data analysis, ggplot2, dplyr, and every R skill you need!

1592301610.name: Carrier Battles
1592301610.description: 航母对决：苦尽甘来（Carrier Battles for Guadalcanal) 这是一款海军兵棋策略游戏，涵盖42至43年间中、南太平洋上一系列航母对决。 重现太平洋海战中美日双方舰队战略，侦察并打击敌方目标，保护己方战略要地并支援己方两栖攻势。 了解更多： 强大的AI保证单人战役也能让您感到酣畅淋漓 通过邮件实现多人对战 11个历史战役：41年12月威克岛保卫战、42年初美军的初次反击、42年3月珊瑚海海战、42年6月中途岛海战、42年8月瞭望塔行动和东所罗门海战、42年10月圣克鲁斯海战、42年12月瓜达尔卡纳尔海战，43年2月瓜达卡纳尔海战、43年3月俾斯麦海海战及43年攻击拉包尔。 巨大的南太平洋地图（每个网格代表30英里） 超过80种各型战机和舰船 颇为真实的情报获取机制，航空侦察、雷达等应有尽有 对敌方目标发动空袭，或让舰炮发出钢铁的制裁 颇为真实的损伤判定 炮击岸上目标以及派遣部队登陆 回合制 附带循序渐进的规则指导帮助玩家上手 目前有英语、法语、中文、西班牙语和日语版本 单人战役时无需连接网络 单次战役耗时约1至3小时 Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy policy: http://cbfg.xooit.org/t536-Data-Privacy.htm#p3416

1592681114.name: タクシーメーターPRO版
1592681114.description: スマートフォンが本格的なタクシーメーターになります。 走行距離を測定し、移動に合わせてタクシー風の料金をリアルタイムに表示できる高機能版です。 タクシーメーターPRO版は、GPSで距離と速度を計測し、 初乗り料金や加算距離、割増設定など、タクシー料金体系を細かく再現できます。 横画面だけでなく縦画面にも対応し、 見やすさと操作性を重視したインターフェースになっています。 自転車、バイク、車、電車、新幹線など、 さまざまな乗り物で「もしタクシーだったらいくら？」を確認できます。 通勤、ドライブ、旅行のシミュレーションにも活用できます。 ■PRO版の主な特徴（Lite版との違い） ・売上の管理 1日ごとの売上を管理できます ・縦画面と横画面の両方に対応 使用シーンに合わせて見やすい向きを選べます ・料金プリセットの保存と切り替え 複数の料金体系をすぐに呼び出せます ・カラーテーマの変更 気分や車内の雰囲気に合わせて配色を調整できます ・料金上がり予告バーの種類変更 見た目や動作を自分好みに設定できます ・貸切モードに対応 用途に合わせてメーター動作を切り替え可能 ・バッテリー残量表示、時計表示のON/OFF、走行距離の表示 必要な情報だけを表示してスッキリ使えます ・広告なしで快適に利用 操作や表示の邪魔になりません ■その他の機能 ・空車、迎車、実車、支払のワンタップ切り替え ・初乗り料金、加算距離、割増、迎車料金などの細かな設定 ・GPSによる距離と速度の測定 ・数字が大きく見やすい表示 ・高速モード ・乗務員表示 ■利用シーン ・ドライブや通勤の料金シミュレーション ・電車や新幹線の距離換算 ・子どもとのタクシー遊び ・地域の距離感の把握 ・撮影や演出用途での表示 ・Lite版からのアップグレード ■注意事項 ・自動ロックが無効になるため、バッテリー消費が増える場合があります。 ・実際の営業用途（白タク行為など）には使用できません。 ・GPS測定の特性上、地下、トンネル、建物内では誤差が生じる場合があります。 ・実際のタクシーメーターとは異なる料金が表示されます。 ■まとめ タクシーメーターPRO版は、 より快適に、より細かい設定でタクシー料金シミュレーションを楽しみたい方向けの高機能アプリです。 Lite版では利用できない便利な機能を備え、 日々の移動やドライブで活躍します。

1592909980.name: Metainfo
1592909980.description: Metainfo is a metadata viewer and it helps you to extract EXIF information from photo files, such as GPS location, camera settings, copyright settings, time and date and so on. Additionally it can open media files to view album cover, ID3 tags if any and shortly about used bitrate and codecs. Features: Support a wide range of media formats, including but not limited to ARW, JP2, PSD, CRW, CR2, CR3, DNG, SR2, RW2, NEF, JPG, TIFF, GIF, PNG, BMP, HEIC, AVI, MP3, OGG, OPUS, M4A, PUBLIC3GPP, ASF, F4V, M2TS, M2V, M4V, MOV, MP4, MPG, MXF, OGV, RM, TS, VOB, WEBM, WMV, WTV, MKV, FLAC, AAC, AC3, AIFF, AU, CAF, APE, DTS, M4R, MP2, OGA, RA, TTA, VOC, WMA, WV, WAV Ability to export metadata and artwork Support dark mode Limitations Metainfo can operate with files opened via Files app. It can't open Galleries and Photoalbums. Metainfo is a viewer only, you are not able to edit or remove any metadata.

1593744258.name: TB Sibalance
1593744258.description: TB Sibalance - the Swiss Army knife de-esser AUv3 plug-in that your vocals deserve TB Sibalance is the perfect AUv3 plugin to remove excess sibilance and harshness from vocals, podcasts and mix busses. It uses advanced perceptual loudness and timbre models to detect excess sibilance. Reduction of excess sibilance is done by spectral processing, resulting in a cleaner and more transparent result compared to conventional de-essers. TB Sibalance provides clear visual feedback to guide your tuning decisions. See what frequencies and sections of your audio signal are modified at the blink of an eye so you can make adjustments quickly and confidently. No more guesswork! 1596327065.name: Audio Frequency Converter
1596327065.description: The Audio Frequency Converter is a small but powerful app for converting music to 432Hz, 528Hz, and custom frequencies. Please contact us if you have questions: https://www.tequnique.com/contact Features Load mp3, wav, m4a (AAC), FLAC, and many other file formats. Supports 24 bit high quality audio (for instance FLAC) input and output. Support for multi-channel (more than two stereo channels) audio. Export converted music to mp3, m4a, FLAC, wav, or the input source format. Built-in default frequencies: 174Hz, 285Hz, 396Hz, 417Hz, 432Hz, 440Hz, 444Hz, 528Hz, 639Hz, 741Hz, 852Hz, 963Hz. Convert to different custom frequencies (up to two decimals). Define the source and target frequencies. Use cases Example use-cases for the app (but no limited to): Music therapy. Esoteric applications (e.g. Solfeggio). 432Hz music listening. 528Hz music listening. Music tuning: Many musicians do not use 440Hz as base frequency. Also classic orchestras usually use their own base frequencies. The app allows you to adjust your music to these frequencies. Well-being and joyfulness.

1596371447.name: AU3FX:Push
1596371447.description: A highly tweakable stereo dynamics processor with noise gate, compressor/expander with external side-chain input, and limiter/clipper. From subtle compression, extreme pumping, to maximum loudness! This app is part of the AU3FX series, a collection of simple and powerful audio unit effect plugins. High quality 32-bit DSP engine. Compressor/expander with optional lookahead buffer. Allows negative ratios for pumping/cancellation effects. Hard or soft knee with adjustable radius. Built-in side-chain low/high cut filters with monitor toggle. External side-chain input. Built-in noise gate. Brick-wall lookahead limiter. Hard/soft clipper. Supports "parallell compression". RMS/Peak envelope followers with attack, release and hold time. Switchable between Linear and Logarithmic mode. Automatic makeup gain. Stereo link on/off. Comes with several bundled presets. Use multiple instances at the same time. Save/load session state in host. External access and control of all parameters from host. User presets shared across hosts (on iOS 13 and later).

1596598462.name: Cryptyo: Crypto Tracker
1596598462.description: Cryptyo keeps crypto rates on your wrist. Open it and prices update live. Glance at your watch face and a complication already has the number. Follow what you care about Build a list of up to 60 pairs and arrange it in any order with the Digital Crown. Every row shows the price, the 24-hour change and a trend line for the last day. Find any coin Search more than a thousand markets by ticker or by full name — BTC or Bitcoin, ETH, DOGE, SHIB, SOL, TON and the rest. Type it, use Scribble, or just dictate. Narrow results to a quote currency with one tap: USDT, USDC, BTC, EUR and more. New listings appear on their own Cryptyo syncs the exchange's market list every day, so coins listed after the last app update are already there, and delisted ones are gone. Charts made for a small screen Six ranges, from one hour to all time. Switch between an area chart and candlesticks, turn volume on or off, and see the range high and low marked. Scrub with your finger or the Digital Crown to read the price at any point. Change over 1H, 24H, 7D and 30D at a glance. Watch face complications Four styles: a single pair as a circle, a corner or an inline label, plus a rectangular one with three favourites and their trend lines. Choose which pair each complication shows, and tap it to open that market. Built to be dependable No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Works without your iPhone. If one exchange is unreachable, Cryptyo switches to another. Offline it shows the last known price along with the time it was taken. Prices follow each market's own precision, so BTC reads 67,412.35 and SHIB reads 0.00002317. Available in English and Russian. Cryptyo shows rates. It never connects to your accounts and cannot trade.

1596728818.name: BLEASS Megalit
1596728818.description: 结合波表合成、经典减法合成振荡器、灵活的滤波与后期处理，以及丰富的高级调制系统，BLEASS Megalit 为声音设计师提供了广阔的音色创作空间。得益于 BLEASS 极其直观的界面设计，即使没有技术背景的音乐人，也能轻松驾驭其完整的声音潜力。 Megalit 拥有众多创新功能，助力您的声音设计： 高级波表振荡器，支持在 130 多个波表中独立调节波表位置和 Fold 参数。 每个振荡器均支持 Unison，可轻松创建丰富且富有层次的声音，无需加载多个合成器实例。 专用噪声发生器，配备独立高通与低通滤波器，轻松打造灵活的非音高声音与声音元素。 谐振高通与低通滤波器，以及内置 Waveshaper 和 Bit Crusher，为声音塑形提供更大的灵活性。 四个 LFO，每个都具备独立的时间曲线与输出平滑，可创建复杂而细腻的调制效果。 高级 Motion Sequencer，可创建复杂且循环重复的调制序列。 每个预设均可保存演奏控制器响应曲线，确保始终获得符合预期的演奏表现。 内置预设随机生成功能，一键即可生成富有灵感且可直接使用的声音。 内置多频段上行/下行压缩器，可精准控制动态、冲击力与存在感。 Megalit 的所有参数、设置与控制均配备直观的可视化反馈，让您随时了解合成器的工作状态。尽管拥有强大的声音处理能力，Megalit 依然保持极高的 CPU 效率，为更多乐器、效果器或更多 Megalit 实例预留充足性能。 BLEASS Megalit 可作为 AUv3 插件或独立应用使用。 同时提供 Windows 和 Mac 版本。 更多信息：https://www.bleass.com/megalit

1596872812.name: SpaceFields
1596872812.description: Loop-based mangler effect to create slowly changing rhythmic sound structures in deep reverb space from any external sources or samples. Great for experimenting and designing ambient and noise backgrounds with rhythmic elements. The principle of the application is quite simple. It is based on a loop recorder with two loops. When one loop is recorded, the second is played back. When the loop recording stops, there is a smooth transition between them. Three separate outputs can playback the recorded loop with different pitches (speeds), each with its own effects and two automation generators. The mix of these outputs is fed to the convolution reverb. The reverb is packed with a set of long and deep sound spaces that create a blurry and ambient sound. But the main feature of this application is its well designed parameters that make it easy to experiment with a huge number of sound options using any source material from live instruments to synthesized sound. With just two parameters you can add complex rhythmic structures based on Euclidean rhythms, and easy-to-use automation generators with a randomize option to add variations to the sound, allowing you to modify parameters like an LFO or based on a given rhythm. The convolution reverb has advanced options with which you can change and extend the original reverb spaces. Even using the randomization options, in almost every case, you will get interesting and various soundscapes and textures. With these options it is very easy to create the basis for new unique presets. It only takes a little tweaking of some parameters to get impressive results. The loop recorder can be started and stopped manually or by input signal, can use fixed length or overwrite the loop while recording, and has the option for crossfade between the end and the beginning of the loop. All this makes it convenient for live use as well as when processing recorded material. As an extended option, you can use a special mode in which the application works as a direct effect, without the loop recorder. The special mode sampler is designed for quickly load samples and easy control of the application when used it live. This panel contains the input and output controls, essential controls of the loop recorder, and a large area with a recording counter, which is also used to start/stop the recorder. You can assign up to nine samples for fast loading into the loop, as well as save a recorded loop as a sample and to an external file. SpaceFields is a universal application for iOS and macOS. It can work on iPhone and iPad as well as Mac / MacBook with M1 chip (and later). SpaceFields works on iPhone and iPad standalone, as an Audio Unit or Inter-App Audio module, with supports Audiobus host app. On MacOS, SpaceFields can works both as a standalone application and as an Audio unit (AUv3) with DAWs and other hosts that support AUv3 plugins. All application features are available on iOS and macOS, including MIDI support (with a MIDI learn option), audio unit parameters and importing samples from any directory on device. SpaceFields has a built-in detailed description of all parameters also available as PDF file on the application site. Demos and previews: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cL1Dis3u0AQ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TpkWkc5I0uE https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=74LyfDM2dQM You can find more information on SpaceFields and other creative audio apps at: https://motion-soundscape.blogspot.com

1597210068.description: 让我们学习湖南话! Let's learn the Hunanese language ! 这款APP帮助您迅速掌握湖南话的语音特点! This app breaks them down stroke by stroke ! 旋转轮 - 运用拇指很自然! SPIN THE WHEEL TO EXPLORE It's so easy and natural. 收藏夹 - 可以收藏自己喜欢的单词 ADD TO FAVORITES Save the word you like for the future use. 真人发音 REAL HUMAN VOICE 英文释意 ENGLISH MEANINGS All of the words have their meanings in English. 湖南话例句和毛泽东演讲音频 LISTEN IN HUNANESE Examples and speeches. 离线独立APP - 无需互联网 OFF-LINE INDEPENDENT Once downloaded, you don't need internet to use the app. All audios and pictures are integrated within. You can select the word in alphabetical order (English meanings) by clicking “select” in the menu bar. Basic everyday Hunanese words! Over 38 million people speak Xiang dialect. 1597963622.name: Plus42
1597963622.description: Plus42 is an advanced scientific programmable calculator, based on Free42. Free42, in turn, is a complete re-implementation of the HP-42S scientific programmable RPN calculator, which was made from 1988 until 1995 by Hewlett-Packard. Free42 is a complete rewrite and contains no HP code whatsoever. Plus42 builds on Free42 and adds: Algebraic expressions modeled after those used on the HP-27S and HP-17B/19B; attached units and unit conversions modeled after those used on the HP-48/49/50 series; directories for more organized storage of programs and variables; a larger display, with 8 rows and 22 columns (131x64 pixels) by default, which the user may resize at will; time value of money and amortization schedules; and two-dimensional plotting of functions, with ability to zoom and pan, and find integrals and roots from points in the plot.

1598709872.name: Bimostitch
1598709872.description: Automatically stitch high quality, high-res panoramas on-device, right in the palm of your hands. KEY FEATURES -- +Stitch hi-res single-row, multi-row, vertical, horizontal, 360° panoramas or photospheres. +Stitch many (2 to 200+) overlapping photos into impressive wide-view panoramas. +Simple and intuitive yet powerful panorama stitcher app. +Share your awesome panos with family and friends via Facebook, Twitter, Flickr, Instagram and many more. +Automatic crop with minimal reduction in resolution. +Automatic exposure balancing. +Automatic straightening of panorama. PRO FEATURES -- + Fast stitching. + High quality output (Maintains quality of source photos). + No ads. + Ultra high output resolution of up to 1 Gigapixels. + Video-to-panorama for converting videos of panning motion into panoramas. + JPEG or PNG output format. + Compress large panoramas to save space on your device. + Auto-color balancing. + Seam detection modes like optimal cuts for high quality output. + Save previews & load them up later + Adjust seam detection quality + Adjust intensity of auto-exposure/color balancing feature + Control the blending intensity + View source images in panorama while in preview mode + Auto-lens calibration for lens distortion compensation when stitching images captured from wide-angle, ultra-wide angle and fisheye lens. HOW IT WORKS? Simply select/get images or a video in the following ways: Press the gallery icon then select photos to open the default photo picker, select the images then press done. Press the gallery icon then select videos to open the video selector, select a video then press done. Use your favourite camera app to snap overlapping photos. Use a drone to capture aerial photos. Bimostitch will then automatically match, align and blend together the selected images or video frames into a wonderful panorama using advanced on-device image stitching algorithms. NOTE: You get multiple outputs at once if more than one set of overlapping photos are detected in your selection. All this takes just a few minutes depending on your choice of maximum output resolution and your device’s computational power. You can visit the apps settings page to change properties such as the output album name, maximum resolution and many more choices to suit your needs. You can also shoot a video while panning about a fixed reference point (the camera lens should be the reference point) then select the video in Bimostitch which will automatically merge the key video frames into a panorama. NOTE: At least 4GB RAM required for 1 GigaPixels. WHY USE THIS APP? – Works with photos from any source such as DSLR cameras, downloaded from the web or drones. – Merge vertical, horizontal, multiple rows or a grid of overlapping photos into awesome panoramic images. – Lightweight on your device and will make high quality panoramic photographs. – Create panos conveniently while on the go like on a tour and get immediate high quality results, no need to carry all that equipment anymore and it’s fully an offline app too, no Internet? no problem. – No gyroscope or special sensors needed. It doesn’t matter whether you are a professional or newbie panoramic photographer, this app will work great for you. Hope you enjoy using this panoramic app and that you will make memorable pano shots with it. Enjoy

1598932852.name: Galaxies: Spectacular
1598932852.description: Galaxies! The most mysterious structures in the universe! Magnificent formations that seem the largest and most inaccessible. They are so far away that they can hardly be seen even with our telescopes. But we have put together images taken by the magnificent telescopes at ESO for you. FEATURES In the "Browse" section, you will be able to quickly browse through hundreds of photos and also read detailed information about them. In the "SlideShow" section, you will be able to browse through hundreds of impressive photos in full-screen size and feel as if you were in there at that moment. If you wish, you will be able to get detailed information about these impressive sights by tapping the Info button. Additionally, you can start auto-play by tapping the Play button on the top right. In the "Gallery" section, you will be able to see all the photos impressively, show what you want in full screen, and when you want to examine them in detail, you can zoom in with the help of your fingers. For those who do not want to be contented with just beautiful photos, there are many videos in the "Videos" section. You will get detailed information about the ESO.

Simply attach the filter to your phone, open Solar Snap, and snap away! Solar Snap also includes an interactive, offline global solar eclipse simulator, with detailed information and times to prepare you for the next eclipse, no matter where you are, where you are going, even if you don't have a signal! Solar Snap can be used with our Solar Snap filter kit available at: https://www.eclipseglasses.com/products/solar-snap-the-eclipse-app. This filter protects your phone camera from damage by the bright sun. You may optionally re-use old eclipse glasses by cutting a pair in half and taping it over your camera lens. Video instructions by Astronomer Doug Duncan included in the app. Total solar eclipses are crossing Europe and the Middle East in 2026 and 2027. Get ready!

1599309647.name: PhonicsPlay - Project Pluto
1599309647.description: A simple fun filled phonics app. Thousands of schools use games from www.phonicsplay.co.uk in their daily phonics teaching. Now, some of that PhonicsPlay fun is available in an app. Alien brothers Obb and Bob guide children through an ongoing sequence of mini-games that rehearse key skills from Phase 2 of the Letters and Sounds programme that is used widely in UK schools. The app is simple to navigate. Children can play independently and can continue playing as long as they like without the game coming to an end. Alternatively, for any parents feeling a bit bemused about phonics and how it is taught these days, this app is a great opportunity for playing and learning together. This app is for children in the early stages of learning phonics and covers: s, a, t, p, i, n, m, d, g, o, c, k, ck, e, u, r, h, b, f, l. This app isn't designed to teach phonics - human beings will always do that job best. Instead it was designed to be a simple and enjoyable way for children to rehearse and build on what they have already learned. As with any new skill, the more you rehearse it, the more automatic it becomes. There is no in-app purchasing in this game. For further information or to find out more about how the app can support phonics learning, please visit: www.phonicsplayapps.co.uk 2,

1599324535.description: Discover AI Reef Cam: The Premier iOS App for Advanced Aquarium Photography and PAR Measurement AI Reef Cam is not just another camera app; it's a revolutionary tool designed exclusively for iPhone users, focusing on the needs of aquarium enthusiasts. With its unique combination of advanced photographic capabilities and essential PAR intensity measurement, AI Reef Cam stands out as an indispensable tool for both casual and serious reef hobbyists. Why Choose AI Reef Cam? Innovative Species Identification: Leverage Apple's Core ML for identifying over 350 marine species, adding educational value to your aquarium experience. Custom Lighting for Perfect Shots: Say goodbye to unflattering, blue-tinted images. Our advanced lighting adjustments capture the true colors of your underwater haven. User Endorsements: “AI Reef Cam not only improved my photography but also my understanding of my aquarium's environment.” Key Features for the Ultimate Aquarium Experience: Real-Time Color Adjustment: Modify blue, red, and green lighting instantly for photos and videos. Versatile Camera Modes: From Macro to Ultra-Wide, every detail of your aquarium is just a click away. Full Manual Control: Adjust brightness, focus, and exposure to your liking, ensuring the highest quality of your captures. PAR Intensity Measurement: A critical feature for reef enthusiasts, AI Reef Cam includes a PAR meter to help you monitor and optimize lighting for the health of your corals and fish. Understand the light levels in different parts of your tank and adjust your lighting setup for the best growth and coloration of your corals. Educational and Practical: AI-Powered Marine Life Identification: Get to know the diverse species in your tank with our smart identification technology. Join Our Growing Community: We are dedicated to improving AI Reef Cam and welcome your feedback and suggestions. 1599604990.description: Workout Live is a user-friendly iOS app that allows you to view real-time workout data (including heart rate, calories, distance) from Apple Watch. Simply open the Workout Live app on both your iPhone and Apple Watch to see live data displayed in an easy-to-read format. Features: Live streaming of heart rate and workout data from your Apple Watch to your iPhone. Dynamic text color adjustments based on your current heart rate zone for easy monitoring, with customizable heart rate zones. Tailor the units to your preferences, whether it's miles or kilometers, calories or joules. All your data is securely stored locally within the Apple Health app, while your workout history is readily accessible through the Apple Fitness app. Rest assured, Workout Live prioritizes your privacy: No collection of personal information. No ads or profile tracking. No need for registration hassles. Upgrade your workout experience with Workout Live today and stay on track with your fitness goals.

1600262501.name: Quanta – Vinyl Companion
1600262501.description: Quanta is your ultimate vinyl companion. By combining the best of analog, physical media, and the features of digital music streaming, Quanta creates a truly magical listening experience. Multi-room AirPlay 2 support: With the right hardware, Quanta enables you to stream vinyl playback to any AirPlay compatible device. Shazam-powered recognition: Instantly identify songs, display track info on your device, and update the Now Playing section. Time-synced live lyrics: Stay in tune with lyrics synced to your current playback position on compatible songs. Last.fm support: Quanta automatically scrobbles your vinyl play history. Apple Music integration: Quanta can sync your vinyl play history with Apple Music recently played so your Replay will stay updated even when listening to physical media. Discogs support: Quanta uses your Discogs library to provide more accurate matches, notify you when it's time to change the side of your vinyl, and allows you to shuffle your collection. Customizable audio settings: 6-band EQ, gain slider, and options for mono or stereo output. Apple TV companion app: Mirror your playback details and lyrics to the big screen. created by indie dev, christian privitelli. i hope you enjoy!

1600593842.description: 作为一家创始于中国，着眼于为全球华人提供私人飞机预定及相关服务的公司，「爱飞嘉iFlyPlus」以“科技创新”与“极致服务”之精神，致力于带给会员以好运、好友以及美好生活。2022年，爱飞嘉再度以新模式、新理念、新技术革新公务机行业发展与市场繁荣。 以私人飞机为价值核心，「爱飞嘉iFlyPlus」2022全新app提供公务机预订、奢华旅行资讯、会员潮流活动、公务机资产服务四大板块内容，引领全新生活方式，筑梦高净值用户完美出行体验，以极致创造奇迹。 「爱飞嘉iFlyPlus」革命性推出自主研发的ARM智能飞行任务管理体系，拥有强大的全球直飞航线查询网络，为全球用户甄选3800多架优质公务机运力，现注册用户遍布全球110多个国家。爱飞嘉App首创一秒报价，一键召唤私人飞机，实现122880多条国内外公务机航线实时搜索和价格评估，实现直连用户与全球私人飞机资源。为用户提供数千种飞行器参数查询，降本、增效、提升服务体验，让“人人皆可私人飞行”成为可能。 爱飞嘉旗下会员俱乐部精选全球8800多种独特、小众、奢华目的地行程方案及顶层社交活动。品牌旗下「FLC狮子会私人飞机俱乐部」被誉为华人俱乐部传奇。 「爱飞嘉iFlyPlus」会员服务中心在服务公司商务包机、高管团建、度假包机、家族旅行、奢侈品牌营销推广、新品宣发、紧急医疗转运等方面经验丰富、出类拨萃。服务用户不乏知名商业领袖、杰出创业者、行业巨头、名人名媛明星、百强企业等等。覆盖全国，布局全球，初心不改，热爱满怀。

1600654269.name: BookTime - 您的阅读计时伴侣
1600654269.trackName: BookTime - 您的阅读计时伴侣
1600654269.description: 专为读书人打造的阅读计时器，当然本款App的作者也是一位爱读书的人。 做一个安静的读书人，总共分三步： 1. 设置目标·添加书籍 2. 横置手机·开始计时 3. 持续阅读·达成目标 这款 App 非常纯粹，无需登录，没有社交，就算是联网功能，也仅是为了iCloud备份数据。所有的一切都只为您回归最本质的阅读体验。 当手机横置时，计时器自动开始，当您一旦拿起手机把玩别的App时，计时也就随之停止，从而督促您心无旁骛专心阅读。 对了，我承诺，本款App永远不会有内购，如果你也讨厌内购、订阅，那真是再好不过了。 关于隐私： 我们不采集您的任何数据，若你要使用iCloud备份数据，则需要授予本App访问网络的权限，包括本App作者在内的任何人都无法读取您备份在iCloud中的数据，您的数据只属于您。当然你可以随时关闭本应用的网络权限，这并不影响它的任何功能。 有任何问题可以联系作者：cheetah_chugs.0g@icloud.com

1600822257.name: 英语阅读与完型填空
1600822257.description: 英语考试的难点和关键点是阅读理解和完型填空, 只有通过不断的练习才能提高。阅读理解与完型填空App精选了大量高考英语阅读理解和完型填空的习题, 通过做题时把陌生的单词词组加入自定义的生词库反复地复习巩固, 从而扩充词汇量, 提升自己的阅读水平。 App还内置了英汉汉英词典，查询单词可随时加入自己的生词库，并可编辑生词加入自定义解释。

1600873673.name: 炭炭背单词｜四六级考研等英语单词学习

1600873673.description: 炭炭背单词，一款基于“艾宾浩斯记忆曲线”，极致简洁高效的背单词软件。 上线一年，全平台累计下载破三百万 荣登 App Store 教育付费榜 No.1，多次获得华为、OPPO 等应用市场官方专题推荐，广受好评 什么时候需要炭炭背单词？ 1. 单词背了忘，忘了背，没有合适的计划安排，没有正确的记忆方法 2. 感觉传统背单词软件复习压力大、效率低、不够自由 3. 喜欢简洁的界面，追求专注高效背单词的体验 4. 希望尝试“艾宾浩斯记忆曲线”来复习单词 为什么要选择炭炭背单词？ 1. 『科学清晰的复习安排』 使用“艾宾浩斯记忆曲线”合理安排复习规划 2. 『简洁高效的学习体验』 千万设计师倾情打造，简约设计与高效学习结合 遮盖/点击/左右滑动，只有简单实用的交互，专注于单词记忆 3. 『海量权威的书籍词库』 权威考纲和专业词书支持，学习更放心 300+ 词库覆盖各段英语水平和学习需求 四六级/考研考博/专四专八/雅思托福GRE/专升本等 可搭配实体单词书使用 4. 『专业精彩的单词内容』 专业词典，支持欧陆/有道/牛津/朗文/剑桥/柯林斯等专业词典查询 炭炭妙记，提供十万条单词助记，谐音/联想/扩展/串记/对比/词根，应有尽有 5. 『全面自由的练习模式』 随身听，支持听写，支持定时关闭 单词拼写，支持拼写拆分/平板手写输入 选择题测试，支持英译汉/汉译英/听音选义 6. 『方便快捷的内容接口』 词库导入，支持外部词库文件导入 PDF导出，支持学习列表一键导出，支持多种样式 7. 『独特有趣的装备系统』 PDF导出/炭炭妙记/炭炭云词库/卷王制造机/炭炭万能钥匙 白嫖炭币，一次解锁，终身使用 8. 支持多端同步，支持跨平台使用 9. 更多有趣功能等待同学发现~ 炭炭背单词的设计理念 1. 简单，less is more。 如无必要，勿增实体。简单是取舍，是优雅，是美。 我们朴素地认为好产品的灵魂应是朴实无华的。最简单，往往最有效。 2. 缝合，三人行，必有我师。 择其善者而从之，其不善者而改之。向好的学习，古人诚不欺我。 新产品的诞生一般会经历“模仿/学习/超越”等阶段，炭炭已经 5.0 啦，我们希望能取得“突破”，为同学们带来更好的体验~ 3. 克制，命运的馈赠早已在暗中标好了价格。 炭炭背单词是我们的第一款产品，我们的商业目标不是赚钱，只要不亏本，我们就很开心啦~ 我们希望有机会能做出更多更妙更有用的 App！ 结语 “知我罪我，其惟春秋”，炭炭一定还有不足之处，但请同学放心，我们想把炭炭做好的初心从未改变，同学们的鼓励与吐槽都会变成鞭策我们继续肝的动力！ 感谢看到这里的你 ~ 祝学习顺利 ~ 若有其他需要帮助的地方，可通过 App 内的 帮助与反馈 进行联系~ 联系我们 欢迎同学们通过以下方式与炭炭联系，同学的支持与建议会给『炭炭背单词』带来无限可能！ App 内 - 设置 - 帮助与反馈 邮箱 support@maiseed.com.cn

1601016809.name: Batch Videos Edit
1601016809.description: Batch Videos Edit – A powerful tool for iPhone and iPad that lets you resize, crop, change the aspect ratio, or rotate your videos and movies in bulk—quickly and easily. With Batch Videos Edit, you can save your data plan and bandwidth since all video processing happens directly on your device. Once resized, you can effortlessly upload your videos to your favorite social media platforms like YouTube, Facebook, Tiktok, Instagram and X. Features: Load multiple videos/clips from your library. Rename or delete videos easily. View detailed video info (name, date, duration, dimensions, and file size). Review and remove videos before proceeding. Preview each video/clip individually. Organized storage – View original and processed videos in separate folders. One-tap cleanup – Clear all videos in a single press. Save all processed videos directly to your Camera Roll. Works seamlessly on both iPhone and iPad. Lightweight, compact app optimized for everyday use. Ad-free and built with privacy in mind. Setting: Set Video Size Original, By Width and Height, By Width, by Height and By percentage. Set Aspect Ratio Original, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, 3:2, 21:9 Set Fill Mode Aspect Fill, Aspect Fit and Scale to fill Set Video Rotation 0, 90, 180 and 270 degree. Quick Guide: 1. Tap the [+] icon and select the videos you want to batch edit. 2. Tap the Settings icon for detailed adjustments. 3. Let's assume we want to resize all videos to 640x320. 4. Tap on W & H (Width and Height). 5. Set the width to 640 and the height to 320. 6. Once finished, tap the Back button. 7. Tap the Run icon and wait for the process to complete. 8. Tap the Process tab at the top to check the processed videos. 9. Tap the Save icon to save all processed videos to the Camera Roll. 10. After saving, clear all videos by tapping the Bin icon. After picking videos from the gallery, you can reselect any videos you missed by tapping the [+] icon again. When selecting videos from the gallery, duplicate videos (videos with the same name) will be skipped. Remember to clear all videos before starting a new process. Batch Videos Edit makes it easy to resize multiple videos at once. It is incredibly fast because your videos are resized directly on your device, without needing to be uploaded or transmitted to any servers. This makes it easier to send and share them with your family and friends. Thanks for your support and do visit nitrio.com for more apps for your iOS devices.

1601451509.name: Flashcards animal games kids
1601451509.description: 动物游戏 - 儿童现场拼图！解开动物的谜题，看看野生动物能做什么！该游戏是由心理学家为了儿童的进步而开发的。 动物游戏的目的是培养儿童以下认知功能： 思考 - 探索物体可能采取的行动。 想象力 - 想象英雄们将如何复活。 注意 - 准确放置物体。 道德品质 - 帮助儿童和动物并喂养他们。 通过自然的声音和习性探索野生动物。 真实的声音和明亮的图形，大量的动画将使游戏更加有趣！ 我们将了解动物。 1.丛林：老虎、熊猫、猴子、鳄鱼、乌龟、鹦鹉、苍蝇、黄蜂。 2.澳大利亚：袋鼠、鸵鸟、考拉、鸭嘴兽、鹰、蛇、针鼹、鹦鹉。 3. 夜间动物：蝙蝠、狼、浣熊、猫头鹰、鹿、刺猬、蜗牛。 4.秋季森林和野餐：松鼠、野猪、乌鸦、刺猬、老鼠、孩子们采集浆果和坚果。 5.森林：狐狸、狼、野兔、刺猬、蝴蝶、啄木鸟、黑嘴鸟、鹧鸪。 6. 稀树草原：大象、斑马、河马、犀牛、长颈鹿、火烈鸟、鸣禽、土拨鼠。 7. 北部：企鹅、海象、海豹、北极熊、鱼、海雀。 8. 有蜜蜂的森林：蜜蜂、熊、山猫、老鼠、带着小鸡的鸟、松鼠、鼹鼠、蜗牛。 9. 河流：海狸、蜻蜓、鸭子、小龙虾、鱼、苍鹭、青蛙。 10.沙漠：狮子、骆驼、羚羊、大猩猩、猫鼬、蜥蜴、鸟类。 11.秋天和河流：麋鹿、鹿、鸭子、女孩和蘑菇、有猫的船。 12.南美洲：美洲虎、美洲狮、树懒、巨嘴鸟、臭鼬、豪猪、鬣蜥。 与有趣的动物一起加入游戏并选择现场拼图！

1601598943.trackName: 恐龙–儿童教育游戏（完整版）
1601598943.description: “4DKid Explorer：恐龙” 将带您进入“全部找到它们”系列中寻找恐龙的探险历程中去。 在3D仿真现实中寻找这些史前巨兽，使用不同工具来了解关于它们的更多信息。 在这款专为5至12岁孩子设计的游戏中，您的孩子可以参与各种活动：拍照或摄像，寻找海洋生物，使用无人机或汽车来更快的找到它们…… 另外，使用无人机的扫描功能可以解锁百科全书中更多相关内容！ 您还可以骑在恐龙背上体验更多欢乐…… 您可以使用VR（虚拟现实）模式来移动，或使用AR（增强现实）模式通过摄像头来观察恐龙。 整款游戏配有真人发音，界面设计完全适合小朋友和成人。 为何名为“4DKid Explorer”？ —— 4D：游戏使用3D并添加VR及AR模式 —— Kid：面向儿童（语音提示，操作简单，家长控制） —— Explorer ：游戏以第一人称进行，目标是探索世界找到各种动物和完成各项任务的工具。 您可以免费体验游戏的10个任务。 完整游戏包含40个任务，您可以在游戏中直接购买，或通过应用商店购买。

1601751171.name: 老子《道德经》诵读
1601751171.description: 《道德经》，春秋时期老子（李耳）的哲学作品，又称《道德真经》、《老子》、《五千言》、《老子五千文》，是中国古代先秦诸子分家前的一部著作，是道家哲学思想的重要来源。道德经分上下两篇，原文上篇《德经》、下篇《道经》，不分章，后改为《道经》37章在前，第38章之后为《德经》，并分为81章。

1602351335.description: Labo圣诞节火车一款全世界小朋友都喜欢的，能够激发儿童想象力释放儿童创造力的圣诞节火车制作游戏应用。 在应用中，小朋友可以通过模版快速创造各种经典火车（从古老的蒸汽火车到强力的内燃机车到现代的高速列车），或者自由拼装，随意搭建各种充满想象力的火车。 制造完成，小朋友还可以驾驶自己的火车在轨道上游戏，游戏提供了7条精致的火车轨道和多款小游戏。 这款应用适合年龄：5～99岁 1、提供了两种火车制造方式:自由模式和模版模式。 2、模版模式提供了大量的火车模版，有古老的蒸汽火车、强力的内燃机火车、现代的高速火车以及充满想象力的奇奇怪怪的火车。 3、提供了大量的多种配色的火车部件、轮子、贴纸和基础形状的积木块，用户可以快速搭建也可以随意发挥。 4、针对小朋友进行了操作优化，对小朋友操作非常友好。 5、提供了多条精美有趣的游戏轨道，内置多款迷你游戏。 6、小朋友可以在线分享自己的火车，也可以浏览下载别人的作品。 关于我们 我们是一个专注于开发提高孩子的创造力和想象力的应用的小团队，我们不收集任何个人信息，我们的应用也不包含任何第三方广告。要了解更多信息，请参阅我们的隐私政策： http://www.labolado.com/apps-privacy-policy.html 。 加入我们的Facebook： https://www.facebook.com/labo.lado.7 关注我们的Twitter ： https://twitter.com/labo_lado 反馈 希望您能在应用商店上评价我们的的应用，您也可以用电子邮件给我们反馈： app@labolado.com 。 需要帮助 有任何问题或意见请联系我们： app@labolado.com 。 Summary 孩子们喜欢的交通工具游戏、汽车游戏以及火车游戏。Labo积木火车是一款数字火车玩具,火车模拟器和儿童火车游戏。这是一款出色的学龄前游戏、儿童游戏、儿童赛车游戏。在应用中您可以自由创建火车头、火车车厢和火车,也可以从模板创造经典车头（乔治.斯蒂芬森的火箭号、新干线高速列车、大男孩、子弹头、概念火车、怪兽火车、地铁、圣诞火车等等）。你可以在铁轨驾驶火车,玩迷你游戏。Labo积木火车是火车迷汽车迷都会喜欢的火车游戏。这款游戏适合5岁以上的男孩,也适合5岁以上的女孩。

1602390396.name: Master-Nav: Colregs
1602390396.description: Master-Nav is a progressive COLREGS learning system developed by a Master Mariner. The COLREGS are notoriously difficult to learn and retain — Master-Nav makes it significantly easier through an interactive system built around how your brain actually works. Instead of guessing through random question banks, Master-Nav guides you step by step through every rule from start to finish. Wrong answers are revisited until the rules stick — properly. Complex regulations are broken down into learnable chunks — bite-sized sections supported by mnemonics, memory aids and interactive visuals designed around how the brain actually retains information. Every incorrect answer is shown graphically alongside the correct one — immediately clear, no confusion. And with a single tap, the relevant COLREGS rule is accessible from any question at any time. Master-Nav covers COLREGS Parts A to D — General, Steering & Sailing, Lights & Shapes and Sound & Light Signals — plus Annex IV Distress Signals. Over 1000 questions in multiple formats, with a dedicated Practice Section that tracks right, wrong and unanswered so you always know where to focus. COLREGS — the easy way.

1602503719.name: Smith Charts
1602503719.description: A great experience of the Smith chart. Also in dark mode. Design matching networks, insert S parameters and convert them, or import from touchstone file. Compute stability circles, equi gain and noise circles. Easy interaction with the Smith chart. This chart can easily replace a physical one, making its use much faster. Smith chart interactivity: Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac (on Apple Silicon). Drag and zoom in the chart. Create multiple Smith Charts and name them. Switch easily between input and output planes. Use a ruler and drag it to obtain the wavelength toward generator of a point on the chart, instantly. Tap the chart to show the coordinates in algebraic notation, you will see also magnitude and phase of that location, and the corresponding impedance. Insert circles by hand; modify the radius dragging a circle to keep the center in place, or press to translate them and modify the radius keeping the opposite side in place. Then use the padlock button to disable interaction of gestures with circles. You can also insert a custom circle and a segment in the input and in the output plane, defining its center and radius in a textfield. Export to file, image or PDF Advanced tools for engineering: Matching networks: Choose electronic components to design a matching network for your device. Available components are: L, C, R, Z and lines (transmission line, parallel or series stub, open or shorted). For each component it is possible to specify the parasites. For transmission lines, it is possible to choose between Z0, K or L, C representations, and converting between the two (also for parasites). Tapping on a component it is added to the network and the impedance seen from your device toward the matching network is shown on the smith chart. You can create a matching network both for input and output planes of the device. Each network has its own termination (source or load), which can be a one port device or a two ports device where you can choose a termination for the second port. Each termination can be defined by network parameters (S, Z, Y or h) and the parameters can be imported from a touchstone file. Components supported: Resistor, Capacitor, Inductor, General impedance (R+jX), Transmission line, Parallel stub, series Stub (both shorted or open). Each component can be cascaded in series or in parallel, no limits of components. You can choose a frequency for the impedance calculation and a frequency span for the plot on the Smith Chart. For S parameters, you can specify a dedicated characteristic impedance, the tool will renormalize the Γ of that termination to be correctly shown on the Smith chart, when the smith chart is defined on a different characteristic impedance. Device analysis: You can insert the following parameters of a device: network parameters (S, Z, Y or h), specifications (Ga, Gp, Gt, NF), noise data (gamma s optimum noise, minimum NF, rn) and the input/output reflection coefficients. You can convert network parameters (S, Z, Y, h), and the port type (Γ, Z, Y). While you are inserting data, you will see the computed results appearing on the chart and on the relative fields. Results representable on the smith chart: input/output stability circles, power gain and noise circles (equiGa, Gp, Gt, NF circles), reflection coefficients towards load and source and optimum power coefficients. Other results: obtained power gains and noise (Ga, Gp, Gt, NF) and stability (D, K, kind of stability). You can display on the Smith chart the input impedance of your component versus frequency (as a function of load impedance) when importing a touchstone file. For S parameters, you can specify a different characteristic impedance and the tool will automatically convert it to the one defined for the Smith chart, it will let you know the new renormalized parameters.

1602765272.name: Note - notes & widget
1602765272.description: Keep notes you really care about in focus with this mini note app & widget. It’s like a pinned note in its own app. The app feels like just 1 note, but you can create up to 8 infinite pages. It features beautiful typefaces. There is extra spacing between lines. You can mark lines with color, italics, or both. Pages can also be given custom names. Each page is saved as a plain text file, either in iCloud Drive or only on your iPhone or iPad. Text and links can be added to a page in the app from within other apps using the Share button. You can add a sticky note widget to your Home Screen and Lock Screen that shows the last line you selected in the app or the line you pinned in the Home Screen widget. A control lets you open the app directly from Control Center or your Lock Screen. You can also assign this control to your iPhone’s Action button. An Apple Watch app and widget show the last line you selected in the app on your paired iPhone or the line you pinned in the app on your watch. App Privacy: There is no sign-in and no data is collected. Your files are encrypted on your device using your passcode when it’s locked or turned off. If iCloud Backup is turned on for the app in the Settings app > [Your Name] > iCloud > Storage > Backups > [Your Device], your app data is uploaded to iCloud. If you want your files in iCloud Drive to be end-to-end encrypted, please turn on Advanced Data Protection in Settings > [Your Name] > iCloud > Advanced Data Protection. If you have Share Analytics turned on in Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements, we receive app analytics from Apple. This does not contain your app data or personally identify you. Other Features: To add a new line, pull down when you are at the top of a page. Easily move lines up ↑ or down ↓. Quickly undo or redo changes above the keyboard. Tap the ⋯ button above the keyboard for more actions, such as adding the date or inserting a line break. Link or move lines to another page using the Quick Actions menu. List markers (like ‘•’) and spaces you type at the start of a line automatically get added to a new line below it. A URL scheme allows you to go directly to a page or to a specific line on a page. Support for Apple’s Writing Tools on compatible devices. Supports multiple windows on iPad. Fully accessible with VoiceOver. Gestures: Swipe left or right on a page while editing to move the insertion point from word to word. To move the insertion point, touch and hold the Space bar on the onscreen keyboard with one finger, then slide your finger around the keyboard. Swipe left with three fingers to undo or right to redo. Tap on a page with three fingers to show a menu with undo, cut, copy, paste, and redo. The use of this app is subject to your agreement to: Apple’s Standard End User License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Apple’s Privacy Policy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/ If you use iCloud with the app, iCloud’s Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/icloud/

1602831030.description: ～～～～～ 这是一只生活在手表里的宠物猫 （不需要手机）～～～～～ 宠物猫玩法详细介绍： 操作技巧： 设置宠物名称：领养宠物之前需要给宠物猫起一个好听的名字 选择宠物猫性别：您可以领养公猫和母猫，不用性别的猫属性不同，从而导致后续情节不同。 宠物猫可以单独在watch中玩耍。 互动： 游戏会自动计算主人陪伴了宠物猫多少天了，并且主人可以与宠物猫互动，宠物会做出各种俏皮动作，并且会响应主人的召唤，每次互动会消耗宠物猫30点体力，主人可以玩游戏为宠物猫增加体力，不同的游戏，增加的体力值不同。 也可以等待宠物猫休息24小时后，自动恢复体力。 游戏厅： 《猜拳》休闲的剪刀石头布游戏，每次胜利会获得一点体力，输了不会有任何损失。 《2048》合成游戏，门槛非常低，合成会奖励大量体力。 目前只有2个游戏，后续会更新。

1603973629.name: Canada RV Parks & Campgrounds
1603973629.description: This app provides complete information about Canada Provinces wise RV Parks and Campgrounds on your pocket. This app listed below Canada Provinces: Alberta British Columbia Manitoba New Brunswick Nova Scotia Ontario Quebec Saskatchewan This is a premier iOS app catering to almost every information about Canada. It features of different modules providing information of Canada like General Info, Facts, Campgrounds, Map, Local Search(Nearest Search). 1. General Info : √ Get the Basic Information about the selected Provinces. √ Information to know how to reach via various means to the destination. √ Important History and time lines of the selected Provinces. 2. Facts : √ Instructions that we need to follow in the selected Provinces to stay safe. √ Know the places around the selected Provinces to have fun. √ Inform Provinces area, population, culture, fast facts etc... 3. Campgrounds : √ App shows available Campgrounds in the selected Provinces in Canada. √ Information, address, amenities, contact details, timings, distance, nearest attractions, hotels, restaurants etc… √ Shows distance from your current location and also it shows directions, landmarks, property location. √ Provide nearby information like Campgrounds, National Parks, Hotels, Parks, Hiking Trails etc... 4. Map : √ Shows map of all Campgrounds in the selected Provinces in Canada. √ GPS facility is enabled to show the directions and route map. 5. Local Search : √ Find list of available Restaurants, Bars, Hospitals, Drug Stores, Banks, ATM's, Shopping malls, Pizza huts, Gas Stations and Railway stations etc… √ Predefined & PointOfInterest(POI) searches are available. It brings your Device one step closer to a full feature GPS system. It has a database pre-populated with more than 1000 PointOfInterest(POI) categories. You can find the places you are looking for without any typing. √ Search also acts as a Guide to help user in finding the directions from one place to another via GPS enabled Map.

1604101048.name: GeoSizer
1604101048.description: Geographic Comparison Made Easy! GeoSizer aims to be the easiest way to compare the actual size and shape of one geographic feature (a country, state, province, etc.) to another. It’s as easy as 3 steps: 1. Select a geographic feature by either tapping on the map, or by using the “GO TO” button 2. Once you’ve selected a feature, press a single button to take that shape and begin moving it around the world 3. When you’ve decided where to place it, press another button to leave the shape there, and view the feature from new angles And near-instantly you’ve got an accurate comparison right in front of you. Discover the true size and shape of landmasses around the world!

1604117694.description: 在iPhone手机或者iPad上一键翻译多种语言的字幕。 (用户需要自行申请翻译引擎帐户。目前支持：百度翻译、Google翻译、微软Azuare翻译） 注意： 首次打开时，用户需要自己配置翻译账号才能正常使用。注册位置在：“偏好设置”->“常规”里选择，“去申请百度翻译账户”。如果有不清楚的，可以点设置里的“？”按钮。 主要功能： 导出的格式是SRT字幕，用户可以再配合使用（ZiMu字幕格式转换器）导出更多的格式。 一键翻译字幕。支持多种语言（英语、日语、韩语、繁体中文、泰国语、法语、德语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、俄语、意大利语、波兰语、希腊语、荷兰语等等） 支持导出双语字幕。（再也不用为制作双语字幕发愁） 支持百度翻译-28种语言。（需要自己申请API） 支持谷歌翻译-109种语言。（需要自己申请API） 支持微软Azure翻译-133种语言。（需要自己申请API） 支持苹果翻译（需 iOS 18+，首次语对可能要下载语言包；无需 API Key） 支持Deepseek翻译。（需要自己申请API） 支持导出TXT。（去除时间线） 支持“向上合并”、“删除当前行”。 支持“智能断句”。 (以英文问号、感叹号等符号分段） 搜索与替换，支持“原文、译文、全部、大小写敏感”等多种方式 支持导入Whisper输出的Txt字幕 支持字幕格式：SRT 如果有疑问点设置->“问题反馈”，或者联系微信公众号：Edge麦客。我们会及时帮助您解决问题。 需要更强大的功能，请使用Mac版本的“SRT翻译君”。

1604225566.name: LISU - 傈僳 - 中文字典
1604225566.trackName: LISU - 傈僳 - 中文字典
1604225566.description: 傈僳语，又称为圣经文字、富能仁文，是一种模仿拉丁字母的文字，专门用来纪录傈僳语。 傈僳族有自己的语言和文字，但由于傈僳族居住分散，故方言很多。但傈僳文圣经的翻译，除了语境较为艰深之外，基本上通用。 本辞典收藏超过13000个词组，并持续增加中。旨在开发一个好用的工具，能够让傈僳文更完善的保存，并帮助人能学会更多新的傈僳词汇。

1604438442.description: “节奏 MIDI”是节奏训练应用的专业版。此版本的应用程序支持 MIDI 控制器，并且可以在不同类型的练习之间切换。 该应用程序专为希望提高节奏感和音乐技能的成年人而设计。 该应用程序的目的是培养节奏感，按照节奏模式准确演奏并使用节拍器。这些练习旨在帮助您逐渐学会识别和演奏节奏模式。 在应用程序设置中，您可以选择任务的难度级别和您演奏的乐器。您可以选择吉他、钢琴、鼓。 使用我们应用程序的专业版，您将能够： 学习阅读音符； 通过节奏模式准确播放节奏； 发展音乐和节奏的听力； 使用 MIDI 控制器； 什么是 MIDI？ MIDI（Musical Instrument Digital Interface）是电子乐器、计算机和其他设备相互通信和同步的标准协议。 MIDI 控制器是每个音乐家的必备工具。使用 MIDI 控制器，您可以演奏虚拟乐器、控制录音软件，甚至操纵效果。 为什么在我们的应用程序中使用 MIDI 控制器？ 您可以在没有 MIDI 控制器的情况下使用该应用程序，但我们建议您使用它。 MIDI 控制器可让您体验应用程序的实时响应。演奏真正的乐器将帮助您更轻松地培养正确的音乐节奏感。 该应用程序适合初学者和专业音乐家。

1605471644.name: toPhonetics IPA Keyboard
1605471644.description: IPA keyboard extension with a twist. Actually, with two! Custom keyboard can be used with any app or text input; Full character set of International Phonetic Alphabet, including diacritics support. On the fly automatic transcription of English text as you type or on word selection, using the same transcription engine as in toPhonetics Converter app. A unique, albeit experimental, IPA-to-Speech feature in the companion app that lets you convert your own API input into actual speech audio and export it as a file. Apart from providing full support for editing texts using International Phonetic Alphabet, toPhonetics IPA Keyboard allows you to type in common English and will convert it into phonemic transcription on the fly. Select one of the offered transcriptions or just keep typing and the first suggestion will be selected automatically. You can also select an English word in your text and transcribe it by tapping on one of the suggestions. For auto-transcription you can switch between British and American dialect. Two other layouts allow you to type detailed narrow phonetic transcriptions for any language or dialect. Certain keys offer quick access to alternative characters via long press or double tap. This keyboard relies on the same engine and dictionary as toPhonetics Converter. The workflow is different though. Specifically, using the keyboard: Auto-transcription for English language offered word by word, not for the entire text, therefore all possible pronunciation of the word are shown as suggestions at once. You can tap on original word in the suggestion list if you don't want to auto-transcribe it, but the keyboard does not offer output with the original line-by-line (which is a feature of toPhonetics Convertor app). You can refine your transcriptions by creating both broad and narrow phonetic transcriptions. You can create transcriptions for any language. Control your cursor position with gestures: 1. Pan horizontally with a finger anywhere on the keyboard to change your cursor position quickly and precisely; 2. Swipe left or right with one finger across the spacebar to move your cursor one character left or right.

1605781081.name: Audio Adventure
1605781081.description: 借助我们的新应用程序"Audio Adventure" (音频冒险)，五岁及五岁以上的儿童可以轻松、直观地制作自己的广播剧。 孩子们可以自己构思最富想象力、最美丽的故事！我们想让他们有机会将这些故事制作成小的广播剧冒险，他们可以编辑并收听，或与朋友一起收听。 孩子们可以用麦克风录制自己的声音、各种音效或音乐，他们可以浏览声音库，寻找合适的声音效果。应用内有不同的音轨相互重叠，可以移动。可以剪切和移动单个声音序列。操作非常简单直观。 亮点： –方便儿童使用 –海量声音库 –提升演讲和听力技能 –无需互联网或无线局域网 –无应用内购买 发现并学习： 通过我们的"Audio Adventure" (音频冒险) 应用程序，孩子们可以在声音的世界里旅行。我们周围有什么声音？暴风雨听起来像什么？还有：当我录制声音时，声音是如何变化的？这是一种提高演讲和听力技能的有趣方式，也是学习口语、阅读和写作的重要前提。 将你的作品作为礼物赠与他人 你自己的广播剧和播客可以很容易地存储并发送给爷爷奶奶或朋友。 下次更新内容包括：音轨淡入淡出效果，以及声音录制的有趣音效。 关于 Fox & Sheep： 我们是来自柏林的儿童 App 工作室，为 2-8 岁的儿童开发高品质的游戏。 同样身为父母，我们带着对我们产品的热情和心血工作着。我们为我们的 App 选择全世界顶尖的插画师和动画师，为了能开发最美的 App 呈献给孩子们，以及带给我们和你们的孩子更丰富多彩的生活。

1605939890.name: 耳穴
1605939890.description: 《中医耳穴》是分布于耳廓上的腧穴。也叫反应点、刺激点。当人体内脏或躯体有病时，往往会在耳廓的一定部位出现局部反应，如压痛、结节、变色、导电性能等。利用这一现象可以作为诊断疾病的参考，或刺激这些反应点（耳穴）来防治疾病。 耳与脏腑经络有着密切的关系。各脏腑组织在耳廓均有相应的反应区（耳穴）。刺激耳穴，对相应的脏腑有一定的调治作用。刺激耳穴的主要方法有：针刺、埋针、放血、耳穴贴压、磁疗、按摩等。 “中医耳穴”包含93个穴位，本应用程序可帮您快速找到并了解学习了解每个耳穴的相关信息。 耳穴包含信息：部位、定位、穴名释义、主治、针法、压疗法等... 耳穴优势：没有副作用、比体针方便、疗效独特且持久、能治病也能防病、能抗衰老和保健。 本应用程序简明、易用、方便快捷可以快速查找收藏穴位。 本应用购买一次终身使用，应用内再无任何付费项目！ 注： 1.此应用程序内部仅作为学习参考使用，用户在使用应用程序包含的信息做医疗诊断之前请咨询专业医生。 2.此程序无广告，不收集任何用户信息

1606038560.name: AnthroPed
1606038560.description: This application calculates and graphically displays the Z-Score and percentile of the main anthropometric indicators across the entire pediatric age range. It also performs a detailed analysis of growth velocity, using days of life as the reference. It was developed and programmed by Gerson Rodríguez, Pediatric Specialist. Main Features 1. Percentile and Z-Score Charts and Calculations (WHO / CDC): Charts and calculations based on WHO and CDC standards, with day-of-life sensitivity, to ensure accurate growth assessment for: Weight / Length Weight / Age Length (Height) / Age BMI / Age Head Circumference / Age 2. Growth Velocity Analysis: Evaluates changes in length, weight, or head circumference, displaying Z-scores, percentiles, and graphs that highlight progress between visits. 2.1 Quantitative deficit or excess analysis: For each indicator, the app calculates the exact difference between the child and each standard deviation curve (–3 to +3 SD). 3. Cerebral Palsy Growth Charts Includes weight, height, and BMI charts for children with Cerebral Palsy, stratified by the Gross Motor Function Classification System (GMFCS I–V), with Level V divided into tube-fed (TF) and non-tube-fed (NT). Based on: Jordan Brooks et al., Pediatrics 128(2): e299–e307. 4. Daily Fluid Requirement Calculation: Calculates daily fluid needs using the Holliday & Segar method or body surface area. 5. Patient Database Management: Create and manage patient records including percentiles, Z-scores, and anthropometric measurements for comprehensive follow-up. 6. Import and Export Data: Easily import and export the patient database for flexible data management. 7. Preterm and Neonatal Growth Charts: Charts and calculations based on the latest FENTON, INTERGROWTH-21st, and OLSEN (2010) references. 8. Down Syndrome Growth Charts: Growth charts specially adapted for children with Down syndrome. All results are based on the LMS model (Cox distribution: Lambda – Mu – Sigma), applied to height, weight, BMI, and head circumference. Access all features with a single purchase, including future updates at no additional cost. No internet connection required — use it anywhere.

1606391393.name: 全景计算器 Pro
1606391393.description: 这款全景应用程序的特点是操作简单。 使用滑块设置焦距和光圈，就能立即读取所需的全景图像及其角度信息。此外，您还可以快速确定焦距极限，在此范围内，单张照片不再有您指定的重叠。 计算器可计算球面或圆柱投影全景。 除了全景角度大小外，计算中还会考虑单张照片的最小重叠度以及全景云台的最小角度步长。 对于全景的最大图像清晰度，还集成了超焦距计算器，它还能告诉您在哪个光圈下会超过衍射模糊的极限。 此外，您还可以指定水平和垂直视角。这样就可以使用特殊镜头进行全景计算。 例如，您还可以确定混淆圈 CoC，这是在一定尺寸和视距下打印输出所需要的。如果客户给您一个固定的 CoC，您也可以使用。 由于相机、镜头、焦距和全景云台组合的设置对结点非常重要，这样前景和背景之间才不会出现视差偏移，从而导致无法拼接全景照片，因此我在此整合了一份相关指南。 由于我也是一名摄影师，而且专门从事虚拟旅游，因此这个全景计算器是在实践中产生的，并已成为我的常备工具。

1606447892.name: Homophone Machine
1606447892.description: The Homophone Machine is an engaging learning tool that lets kids explore those tricky words that sound the same, like their and there. Just type any word, sentence, or paragraph into the Homophone Machine—and have a good laugh at the silly sentences you create! This interactive app features hundreds of homophone pairs and can be used on its own or as a supplemental learning tool along with the All About Homophones workbook or with the All About Reading and All About Spelling language arts curriculum. Benefits for You and Your Child: Build vocabulary by discovering new words, definitions, and synonyms Instantly see and discuss the difference between homophones Reinforce spelling concepts by comparing pairs of homophones Put a new (and silly!) spin on dictation exercises Hone creative writing skills by inventing new tongue twisters or writing homophone poems Reinforce comprehension by looking at homophones in (and out of) context Use as a fun review tool for targeted homophones Take a break from lessons to just have fun with words!

1606687383.name: Yoyo Test Pro
1606687383.description: Advanced testing for you or your group. Record, evaluate, improve! A sophisticated app aimed at group testing and advanced individual testing. Please take some time to examine it -- do a few "dry" runs before going live with it. Yo-Yo Intermittent Pro is an enhanced version of the free Yo-Yo Intermittent Test app. Both help conduct the 4 Yo-Yo Intermittent tests -- Recovery Level 1, 2 and Endurance Level 1, 2 -- as defined by Jens Bangsbo of Copenhagen University In addition to what the free version has to offer, Pro provides the following: Multiple Users Maintain lists of names - save/reload them Import names ... locally, iCloud Edit, save, reload results Graphical analyses -- various Estimates vo2Max (Recovery Level 1, minimum 1000m) View progress ... multiple graph options Training options - skip levels, loop a level Sort Results. Name, Distance or Date Export results for spreadsheets Work out, stay fit, rock on! [Reference: Fitness Training in Football, a scientific approach - by Jens Bangsbo (December 1994)]
