1606900654.description: 锦鲤 - 你的掌上疗愈鱼塘** 在忙碌与喧嚣之间，留一方只属于你的水面。这片水面，就是《锦鲤》——一款沉浸式治愈鱼塘应用。落花轻飘，水波微漾，锦鲤随指尖缓缓游弋。只需片刻停留，就能卸下疲惫，让心慢慢安静。当你想要放松、冥想、发呆，或是在专注前静心，它都能温柔陪伴。 打造专属你的治愈鱼塘** 你可以从4种精美鱼纹中随心挑选，最多6条锦鲤，自由搭配组合。每条鱼的大小都支持单独调整，轻松组合出独一无二的掌上池塘。 会呼吸的动态水景** 3种唯美水池背景，不同花叶自然飘落、铺满水面。落花随波轻荡，意境温柔；鱼群自在穿梭，宛如真实池塘。 指尖互动，灵动治愈** 轻点屏幕，泛起温柔涟漪；滑动指尖，花叶随波散开。鱼儿会被你吸引，跟随指尖轨迹悠游。每一次触碰，都在与这片小世界对话。 放松·静心·情绪疗愈** 它是工作学习间隙的解压小角落，也是睡前安抚情绪的安静陪伴。在焦虑烦躁时给你温柔治愈，只需几分钟，就能找回内心的平静与安稳。 在忙碌与喧嚣之间，留一方只属于你的水面。 《锦鲤》是一款沉浸式治愈鱼塘应用。落花轻飘，水波微漾，锦鲤随指尖缓缓游弋，只需片刻停留，就能卸下疲惫，让心慢慢安静。 当你想要放松、冥想、发呆，或是在专注前静心，它都能温柔陪伴。 为什么你会喜欢它 打造专属你的治愈鱼塘 4 种精美鱼纹随心挑选 最多 6 条锦鲤，自由搭配组合 支持单独调整每条鱼的大小 轻松组合出独一无二的掌上池塘 会呼吸的动态水景 3 种唯美水池背景 不同花叶自然飘落、铺满水面 落花随波轻荡，意境温柔 鱼群自在穿梭，浑然忘却时间 指尖互动，灵动治愈 轻点屏幕，泛起温柔涟漪 滑动指尖，花叶随波散开 鱼儿会被你吸引，跟随轨迹悠游 每一次触碰，都在与这片小世界对话 放松 静心 情绪疗愈 工作学习间隙的解压小角落 睡前安抚情绪的安静陪伴 焦虑烦躁时的温柔治愈 只需几分钟，找回内心的平静与安稳

1607089308.name: SideNotes Mobile
1607089308.description: SideNotes Mobile 是一款适用于 iPhone 和 iPad 的快速笔记应用。 只需几秒即可记录笔记、任务、链接和灵感片段，并通过 iCloud 在多设备之间随时访问。 1.2 版本带来重大升级: 全新支持隐藏 Markdown 标记的编辑器，与 macOS 版 SideNotes 相同 采用 iOS 26 风格重新设计的界面（Liquid Glass 视觉风格） 笔记折叠 笔记与文件夹置顶 简单的拖放排序 全新的上下文菜单 新的格式化选项 为 iPhone 操作按钮新增“添加笔记”操作 新增翻译：简体中文、法语、德语、意大利语、日语、韩语、波兰语和西班牙语 界面打磨、错误修复与整体质量提升 核心功能: iPhone、iPad 与 Mac 之间的 iCloud 同步 通过主题和笔记颜色打造个性化体验 适合日常使用的任务与清单 文件夹组织与快速搜索 便于从其他应用快速打开的笔记和文件夹 URL 文本设置让书写和阅读更舒适 按主版本一次性购买，无订阅。 注意：SideNotes Mobile 是 macOS 版 SideNotes 的配套应用。macOS 版 SideNotes 需单独购买。

1607406089.name: Place Box - Single Player
1607406089.description: Place Box is a single-player game. The goal of the game is to increase focus and reaction time. You have to tap to place boxes on the canvas. Blue boxes are previously placed boxes. The red box is the most recent placed box. As for the white one, it's the indicator where the next box will be placed. Once you tap, it will be placed. Please avoid placing boxes on blue ones, otherwise, the game will be over. Also, you can compete with the whole world through Game Center Leaderboard. Can't wait to see your score.

1607487131.name: Milky Way: Cosmic Playground
1607487131.description: If you're a fan of Solar Smash, Universe Sandbox, Spaceflight Simulator, Solar System Sim; this is your new favorite game! Milky Way: Explore, Simulate, and Discover the Cosmos Unlock the mysteries of the universe with Milky Way, the revolutionary space app that transforms traditional stargazing into an interactive experience. Unlike passive space apps, Milky Way lets you dive into space simulations, manipulate gravity, and experiment with real-time planetary collisions. Perfect for space enthusiasts, students, and anyone with a cosmic curiosity, this app combines stunning visuals with state-of-the-art technology, allowing you to explore the cosmos like never before. Hyper-Realistic Space Simulations Our advanced simulation engine brings space to life with hyper-realistic planetary collisions, gravity simulations, and more. Watch as planetary bodies interact under different forces, create your own sandbox environment, and experiment with different scenarios to better understand how the universe works. This what-if tool lets you test the effects of gravitational forces, simulate planetary impacts, and even alter the course of entire galaxies.

1607656777.name: 大象电耗-电车助手-新能源计算器
1607656777.trackName: 大象电耗-电车助手-新能源计算器
1607656777.description: 极简风格的新能源汽车电耗记录 app。每次充电后花 10 秒记录一下，就能准确了解车辆真实电耗，及时发现电耗变化规律，及早了解车况。 『核心功能』 ▪ 一键记账 输入充电电量和实付金额，单价自动算出。优惠金额、停车费、备注、账单照片，一屏搞定。默认选中你上次充电的站点，10 秒记完一笔。 ▪ 电耗趋势 线性回归自动算 30 天斜率，异常点高亮，配文字诊断——比如"最近电耗上升 12%，可能原因：天气转冷 / 高速多 / 车辆亏电"。让你的车况不再靠感觉。 ▪ 充电站性价比榜 按每度电最终成本（含优惠）排序，快充慢充分开算。哪个站便宜，一目了然。 ▪ 季节性分析 春夏秋冬平均电耗对比，冬夏差距自动诊断。给你的电池表现一份年度体检。 ▪ 油电对比 输入油车百公里油耗和油价，看看你的电车比油车省了多少钱。月均、累计一清二楚。 ▪ 月度支出图 柱状图 + 饼图，看每月充电花了多少，快充慢充比例怎样。 『为什么选大象电耗』 ▪ 纯本地：没有账号，没有服务器，没有登录 ▪ 隐私优先：不收集任何个人信息，无第三方 SDK，无广告 ▪ 可选同步：想跨设备用，一键开启 iCloud 同步；数据存你自己的 iCloud，我们无权访问 ▪ 数据自主：CSV 一键导出，随时清空 ▪ 极简界面：没有花哨功能，只做记账和分析这件事 『适合谁』 ▪ 想清楚了解自家电动车真实电耗的车主 ▪ 关心充电成本、想找性价比高的充电站 ▪ 想看到季节 / 驾驶习惯对电耗影响的数据党 ▪ 讨厌注册账号、讨厌广告的极简主义者

1608038451.name: Ideofit Glasses & sunglasses
1608038451.description: Try on real glasses and sunglasses using your phone camera before making an online purchase and find perfect eyewear for any occasion. Ideofit is powered by a sophisticated augmented reality (AR) technology which allows smooth transitions between models and amazingly quick fitting of glasses to your face. Trying sunglasses prior to buying them in the comfort of your home is no longer impossible. No face scanning. No need for taking photos. Live experience on-screen. FIND Ideofit features more than 100 different frames which will help you discover some shapes you never dared to try or thought they won’t suit you. COMPARE The fast app navigation system allows you to compare glasses and inspect how they fit your face. FIT Whether you wear glasses lower on the nose as mini shades or as full eye cover, Ideofit app allows you to place the frame exactly how you would wear them in real life. SHARE Share your selfies and videos with friends on Instagram, Snapchat and other social media. With Ideofit, you can ask for your friend’s opinion before you purchase a desired model. Here is the simple guide around Ideofit app: Launch the app by tapping on the icon. Allow the camera use. Start trying on our selected models. Adjust the glasses with a simple drag up and down depending on your preferred style of wearing. Add a lens filter to the sunglasses you like to share your daily mood. Take a photo or record a video to share the model with friends on social media. Visit Catalogue which features all models. Sort them by your prefered filter. Proceed to Amazon to purchase your ideal sunglasses or add them to your Shopping List for the next visit. Ideofit uses the Augmented Reality (AR) technology to bring you the ultimate experience of online eyewear shopping. Choose among the iconic eyewear brands such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Gucci, Polaroid, Versace and Vogue Eyewear or try out our affordable models that offer fashionable sunglasses for everyone's pocket.

1608747713.description: 公务员面试90分示范答题给力推荐，内容全面涵盖了公务员考试答题示范大全。十分适合相关人士参考学习。 一、App Store 首屏短钩子文案 公考面试备考周期短，综合分析、组织计划、应急应变题型多，答题容易模板化空洞无落地，开口紧张逻辑混乱，缺少高分作答思路。这款公务员面试大全，高频题型答题框架、真题范例、时政素材、考场避坑指南全套汇总，15 元买断无内购，离线随时翻看积累，摆脱生硬套话，面试从容拿高分！ 二、完整商店爆款长简介 国考、省考进面的考生，大多会遭遇面试备考多重难题。笔试分数突围，却卡在面试环节，备考时间短，从出分到考试往往只有短短几周。结构化面试题型繁杂，综合分析、组织计划、应急应变、人际沟通、情景模拟、岗位自我认知轮番考查。很多考生只会背诵万能模板，答题空话套话堆砌，缺少政府思维，对策脱离基层实际，考官反感模板化作答直接压低分数；面对社会热点、政策理解类题目不会多角度拆解，分析浅薄；应急、人际题目抓不住矛盾核心，处理方式不贴合公职实际工作场景；开口练习容易紧张卡顿，逻辑条理混乱，没有答题思路；线下报班成本高昂，纸质面试资料厚重，通勤、居家碎片化时间不方便翻阅；网上素材零散，真题缺少完整高分示范，时政热点、答题金句四处搜集效率低，笔试高分也容易遭遇面试被逆袭。 《公务员面试大全》贴合国考省考结构化面试考情，一套整合**六大题型高分答题框架、历年面试真题与高分示范、时政热点金句素材库、考场实战避坑指南**四大核心板块，适配短期突击备考，适合进面考生自主复习，一站式解决模板化答题、思路匮乏、内容空洞、考场紧张失分四大备考痛点。 四大核心备考板块全覆盖公考面试高频考点 1. 六大面试题型高分答题框架 梳理结构化全部高频题型，拆解综合分析、计划组织、应急应变、人际沟通、情景模拟、自我认知岗位匹配的答题逻辑。摒弃死板万能模板，讲解如何结合题干搭建作答结构，教会考生找准题目核心矛盾，分析问题、提出落地可行对策，建立公职人员思考视角，告别千篇一律套话，形成属于自己的答题思路。 2. 面试历年真题配套高分示范 收纳国考、各省省考高频面试真题，每道题目配套完整高分作答参考。综合分析类拆解现象、政策、哲理题分析角度；组织计划区分调研、宣传、会议、专项活动作答重点；应急应变梳理矛盾处置优先级；人际沟通理清沟通原则与处理步骤；情景模拟还原沟通口吻与表达逻辑。方便考生对照参考，学一道吃透一类题型。 3. 时政热点与面试金句素材库 整理面试高频社会热点、政策解读、青年基层相关金句、人物案例素材。分类适配综合分析、岗位认知等题型，方便碎片化记忆积累，答题可以灵活化用，丰富作答内容，提升答题深度，避免答题内容干瘪空洞。 4. 考场实战避坑指南专区 汇总考场高频扣分点：答题过度模板化、对策脱离现实、逻辑混乱、口头禅过多、超时把控失误、举止表达细节问题。讲解审题技巧、思考时间分配、考场心态调节、外在礼仪注意事项，提前规避各类隐形扣分陷阱，减少临场发挥失误。 APP 专属实用优势 十五元一次性付费解锁全部答题框架、真题范例、素材、避坑资料永久浏览，全程无任何隐藏内购项目；支持全内容离线缓存，通勤、居家、出行没有网络也可以随时翻看背诵积累；界面纯净无广告，不打断备考节奏；持续更新面试热点素材、新真题范例；适配 iPhone、iPad，字体柔和清晰，长时间阅读不伤眼。 适配人群 国考、省考进入面试的考生，事业单位结构化面试备考人群；答题依赖模板、作答空洞缺少实际对策，开口紧张逻辑差，想要自主备考不想高价报线下班；备考周期短，需要手机随身碎片化积累答题思路、热点素材，摆脱模板套路，冲刺面试高分的考生。 不用囤积厚厚的面试纸质讲义，不用全网到处搜集真题、热点金句素材，一款软件收纳公务员面试全套备考资源，碎片时间梳理答题框架，研读真题范例，积累时政素材，跳出模板化答题误区，构建公职答题思维，从容应对考场提问，守住笔试优势，也可实现面试逆风逆袭。 三、短视频信息流短种草文案 标题公考面试提分神器｜答题框架真题素材避坑指南全套汇总 答题模板化空话多，答题没思路考场容易紧张，备考周期短，15 1608949422.name: Metar-Taf
1608949422.description: Visualized METAR and TAF weather information for all airports in the world. Concise summary of everything you need to know about today's aviation weather. METAR features: Visualized in easy to understand and colourful metrics Weather symbols for significant weather and clouds, like in a non-aviation weather report Crosswind calculations, by combining METAR and runway information Flight rules category: VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR Read out by text-to-speech available, listen to a decoded METAR while doing other things TAF features: TAF broken down and displayed per hour in a table Show sunrise/sunset, minimum and maximum temperature Keeping track: Add your favorite stations to the list, see their weather at a glance Get observations near your location Find stations in the interactive map with weather codes Search airports by ICAO code or name History: Graphs with weather trends today and yesterday: temperature, visibility, wind speed, QNH METAR history for the last hours and link to more on the website Airport information: See information about the airports, like runway directions, elevation, location If the airport doesn't report a METAR, the nearest station used for calculations Calculations: All units are customizable units: speed (knots, km/h, m/s, mph), altitude (meters/feet), visibility (kilometers/miles), temperature (Celcius/Fahrenheit) and air pressure (Hectopascal, Inch Hg) Times are converted to the local time for each airport Sunrise and sunset are calculated based on the airports latitude/longitude General: METAR, TAF and airport data are automatically saved for offline use Available in 6 languages: English, Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French

1609910044.description: 让历史在动态交互的世界地图上 “活” 起来！亲眼见证 5000 年文明进程 —— 帝国兴衰、疆域变迁、战争路线、航海探索，一图看懂历史全貌。 探索世界历史的全新方式： ・滑动时间轴，直观观看疆域与文明的动态变化 ・追踪帝国崛起、扩张与衰落的完整过程 ・一键跳转到任意年份，沉浸式穿越历史 ・查看经典战争路线、航海探险与文明传播路线 ・发现中外各大文明的兴衰故事与历史细节 「史诗征程与关键战争」 ・第一次布匿战争--导致迦太基毁灭 ・第二次布匿战争--汉尼拔越过阿尔比斯山入侵罗马 ・第三次布匿战争--最终摧毁迦太基 ・阿基坦公爵--在法兰克帝国中扮演重要角色 ・荷兰战争（1672~78 年）--法国路易十四为控制西班牙尼德兰而发动的第二次战争 ・第二次北方战争（1700-1721 年）--俄国、丹麦-挪威、波兰和萨克森联合对抗瑞典在波罗的海的霸权。 ・法属印度支那 - 法国在东南亚的殖民地 ・高丽长城 - 日韩称之为"千里长城" ・伊朗长城 - 世界第三长城的故事，200公里，抵御嚈哒人 ・日俄对马海战 - 日俄战争期间的重大海战，日本胜于天时地利 ・鉴真东渡 - 历经挫折，东渡传法 ・玄奘西行 - 过了星星峡差点丧命的玄奘都看到了哪些族群国度 ・法显西行 - 西行求佛第一人 ・郑和七次下西洋 - 详细展示七次路线，途径国家，擒了陈祖义(灭自己啊势力，和西方文明不同)，帮马六甲摆脱满者伯夷独立建国 ・达伽马航海路线 - 欧洲第一次从海上到达印度 ・麦哲伦大航海 - 环球大航海，丢命菲律宾 ・万里茶道 - 清时期欧亚茶贸易路线 ・亚历山大东征 - 欧洲第一次东方大掠夺 ・秦直道 - 秦时期的高速公路，真的是直道 ・土尔扈特东归 - 逃离沙俄死磕哥萨克的土尔扈特，最终扎根新疆 ・金长城 - 金朝的玛奇诺防线 ・哈德良长城 - 罗马帝国对蛮族的防线 ・安东尼长城 - 罗马帝国的又一个防线 ・唐蕃古道 - 唐藏两地的交通大通道 ・更多沉浸式体验历史画面... 「文明兴衰与王国简史」 ・俄罗斯东扩西伯利亚 - 鲜卑利亚，鲜卑人的土地 ・美国建国史 - 国运来了，花小钱办大事 ・诺曼底的历史--诺曼人建立的强大公国 ・准格尔汗国 - 瓦拉后裔崛起于漠西蒙古 ・拉达克的复活 - 喇嘛之地 ・西辽兴衰史 - 辽帝国精英中亚建业成霸，由此中西亚称中国人为契丹人 ・蒙古帝国的衰落 - 瓦剌和鞑靼之争加速了帝国的陨落 ・琉球历史 - 历史悠久，近代才消失的国度 ・唃(gu)厮啰 - 一个夹缝中生存的藏族政权 ・吐谷浑 - 生不逢时，被巅峰的吐蕃频频打击的政权 ・乌克兰 - 1900年以前不存在，历史上斯拉夫民族迁徙大通道 ・汪达尔王国 - 蛮族崛起，洗劫罗马城，被拜占庭帝国摧毁 ・印加帝国 - 一个消失的南美文明 ・乌古斯叶护国 - 突厥二十四部之一 ・三佛齐王国 - 东南亚首次出现强大国家 ・达摩沙耶 - 三佛齐的继承者，东南亚还是受古印度文化影响多 ・昔班家族 - 乌兹别克人的建国史 ・虾夷共和国 - 日本近代寿命最短的政权 ・和硕特汗国 - 独尊格鲁派，开创新时代 ・后百济 - 朝鲜半岛的小政权 ・乌桓 - 东胡人的后裔 ・占城 - 越南古代逐步南侵 ・柔然 - 北魏劲敌，蒙古高原的曾经霸主 ・罗姆苏丹国 - 塞尔柱人驱赶拜占庭建立的塞尔柱分支国家，土耳其人的先祖 ・清朝 - 清帝国的时间线 ・德克萨斯共和国 - 孤星共和国 ・更多文明与王国的历史，等待你逐一探索 「遗迹故事」 ・北魏六镇 - 北魏成也六镇，败也六镇(沃野、怀朔、武川、抚冥、柔玄、怀荒) ・狄道 - 古代狄人居地 ・虎牢关 - 周王圈养老虎之地，古都洛阳东门户 ・居延塞 - 只有在汉代地图上才能看出来美的边塞 ・高阙塞 - 赵长城的西起端点 ・千里石塘 - 自古以来，华夏就巡防南海 ・塞瓦斯托波尔要塞 - 克里米亚战争的焦点 ・... 「交互式地图功能」 ・时间跨度：公元前 3000 年 — 公元 1900 年 ・动态疆域、国界与文明范围变化 ・历史行军路线、航海路线动画展示 ・流畅时间轴，可随意拖动、跳转年份 ・支持缩放、平移，快速查看任意地区 ・适配 iPhone、iPad，界面简洁易用 「即将推出」 ・1900 年至今近现代历史 ・更详细的战役地图与战争过程 ・更丰富的区域历史与文明细节 ・更多学习辅助功能 换一种方式看懂历史。立即下载，指尖穿越 5000 年，直观感受世界文明的起落与变迁。

1610115901.name: 艺术冒险 - 艺术工作室
1610115901.trackName: 艺术冒险 - 艺术工作室
1610115901.description: 通过《艺术冒险》应用程序，孩子们可以创作自己的艺术作品，在你喜欢的地方摆弄形状和颜色。该应用程序鼓励孩子们不要仅仅为了消费而使用智能手机和平板电脑，而是为了创造和尝试创造而使用。 创造一个疯狂的角色，一个有趣的动物，或者整个水下世界？凭借应用程序中的大调色板和各种几何形状，孩子们可以随心所欲地创作。构图、拒绝、重新构图或更改颜色，该应用程序鼓励孩子尝试新事物，不要害怕犯错。 对于水平更高的艺术家，本应用提供更多功能，例如将元素和作品按不同层级分组。这样一来孩子们可以学到一些基本原则，这些原则将使以后处理复杂的图形程序变得更容易。 亮点： 简单，直观，方便儿童使用。 适合年龄的图形、字母和数字。 培养精细运动技能。 使用梵高、康定斯基或莫奈的知名作品 导入您自己的图像作为背景。 无需网络连接。 无应用内购。 探索，玩耍并学习： 在我们的《艺术冒险》应用程序中，孩子们可以深入了解艺术和设计的世界，并轻松获得对结构、层次和轮廓的基本理解。同时，他们对实验的渴望、想象力和创造力也得到了激发。 非常适合课堂教学 凭借其直观、方便儿童的操作，该应用程序非常适合课堂教学——它针对5岁以下的儿童进行了优化，不需要互联网连接，也不收集数据。 用途广泛 存储后，你个人创建的角色和图形可以用于演示、编程项目、漫画等，也可以直接发送给家人和朋友。 关于 Fox & Sheep： 我们是来自柏林的儿童 App 工作室，为 2-8 岁的儿童开发高品质的游戏。 同样身为父母，我们带着对我们产品的热情和心血工作着。我们为我们的 App 选择全世界顶尖的插画师和动画师，为了能开发最美的 App 呈献给孩子们，以及带给我们和你们的孩子更丰富多彩的生活。

1610256963.name: 围堵小猫
1610256963.description: 【 游戏简介 】 还记得曾经火爆朋友圈的“围住小猫”吗？现在它以全新的超高颜值回来啦！ 这是一款随时随地都能掏出来玩两把的休闲烧脑小游戏。规则超级简单：点击屏幕上的圆点放上障碍物，想尽办法把中间那只小猫围起来，千万别让它跑到屏幕边缘逃走哦！ 【 游戏亮点 】 1、画风超好看，手感超解压 全新的深色夜光主题，棋子像发光的玻璃弹珠一样通透，晚上躺被窝里玩也不刺眼。每次点击屏幕还有轻微的震动反馈，手感绝佳，超级解压！ 2、猫咪变聪明了，拒绝无脑 别以为随便点点就能赢！我们给小猫加上了“聪明大脑”，它现在会预判你的动作，甚至会故意绕路。抓到它可是需要动点小脑筋的，抓捕成功绝对让你成就感满满！ 3、手滑点错？后悔药来了 眼看就要围住了，结果手指一滑点错了格子？没关系！新增了“撤销”功能，遇到死局可以时光倒流，拯救你的完美开局。 4、谁才是抓猫大师？ 游戏会自动记录你抓猫用的“最少步数”。快来挑战自己的极限，一键截图发给朋友们，比比看谁用的步数最少！ 不管你是等公交、坐地铁，还是排队无聊，这都是你打发时间、活动大脑的最佳选择。赶紧下载，来挑战这只狡猾的小猫吧！

1610668825.name: FyTube - 没有广告的 YouTube
1610668825.description: 我们的应用程序实时连接到 YouTube，让您可以自由播放任何视频。 以前所未有的方式享受 YouTube！ 无广告、无订阅，还有专为您设计的独家功能。 特殊功能 浮动播放（PIP）：观看视频的同时可使用其他应用。 锁屏模式：在屏幕关闭时继续播放音频。 睡眠定时器：设定自动关闭时间，安心入睡无忧。 循环播放模式：让您最爱的影片无限重复播放。 历史记录：重新观看已看过的视频，向左滑动即可删除。 FyTube 是不想错过任何喜爱主题视频的完美选择。 探索、播放并尽情享受您最爱的内容——无干扰！ 浮动播放 1. 进入全屏模式并点击 PIP 按钮（左上角第二个图标）。 2. 视频会缩小为 FyTube 内的浮动窗口。 3. 从底部上滑退出 FyTube 应用，视频仍会保持可见。 4. 浮动模式已启用！您可以使用任何应用，视频会悬浮播放在屏幕上方。 锁屏播放 1. 启用浮动模式。 2. 当视频悬浮在其他应用上时，锁定屏幕。 3. 完成！音频会在后台继续播放。 非常适合在驾驶或放松时收听音乐、播客或喜爱的节目。 睡眠定时器 安心入睡——应用会自动停止播放！ 启用此功能后，视频会在您设定的时间后自动停止播放。 非常适合睡觉或小憩时使用。 如何启用？ 点击定时器按钮，选择播放时长，就完成了。 放松身心，让应用为您处理一切！ 循环播放模式 让视频不停播放。 启用此功能后，视频会无限循环播放。再次点击

1611006344.description: 开发 BLEASS Omega 为我们提供了深入了解 FM 合成的迷人声音功能的绝佳机会，这引发了一个创新想法：一个可以将频率调制原理应用于几乎任何源材料的插件。 结果是 BLEASS Phase Mutant。 现有的相位失真插件通过使用音频信号对其自身进行调制来产生效果，而 BLEASS Phase Mutant 通过添加可以调制输入信号或被输入信号调制的振荡器将事情提升到一个全新的水平。这使得 BLEASS Phase Mutant 能够充分利用 FM 的能力来创建复杂多彩的谐波失真、极具表现力的音调变化和迷人的音钩。 BLEASS Phase Mutant 的振荡器跟踪输入信号的音高，或者可以设置为该输入音高的一个因子。它还可以产生一系列不同的波形，通过偏移左右声道的相位，所有这些都可以在立体声场中传播。 结合起来，这些能力开辟了一个全新的世界，拥有独特的现代音效，非常适合人声、贝司、琶音和主音。你也会喜欢 BLEASS Phase Mutant 对你的鼓和打击乐部分所做的事情！ BLEASS Phase Mutant 还提供 2 个 LFO、一个包络跟随器和一个具有多个调制目标的动态音序器，您可以轻松地对其进行可视化。 BLEASS Phase Mutant 也可用于 Mac 和 Windows。 在 https://www.bleass.com/phasemutant/ 上查找更多信息和教程

1611411940.name: Flux Pro
1611411940.description: Flux Pro is a multi-FX modulation plugin that transforms your sounds into colourful, characterful and dynamic tracks. Do you want to add graceful stereo waves to your keys, dirty pulsing side-chains to your bass, complex striking filters to your synths or noisy mechanical glitches to your drums? Modulation is king and we're offering you the throne. There are 3 customisable graphs which can perfectly sculpt your sound. Simply set the depth of the controls in the 4 effects slots, from which you can use a variety of 10 modulation effects. Are you in a hurry and need movement quickly? Easily drag 1 of the 48 built-in shapes onto the graph for fast and effective modulation. Key Features 3 custom graphs that can be assigned to any modulation parameter. 10 different effects in four effects slots. 48 drag-able shapes for fast and effective rhythmic sketches. MIDI Triggering; One-Shot & Retrigger. Output graphs as MIDI CC to control other plugins* Control Voltage graph output to send to external hardware. 115 presets to get you started. This feature is not supported by all DAWs. Effects Flux Pro has four effects slots from which you can use; Filter 1, Filter 2, Delay, Delay (Fixed), Width, Phaser, Chorus/Flanger, Rate Modulation, Ring Modulation and Utility. Try shaping the Ring Modulation's frequency and harmonic amount to add mechanical flavours to your bass. Or maybe create some ethereal vocal delays by programming audio reverses an octave up with Fixed Delay's sample control. Then, apply a slow sine to the other Delay's time and feedback controls to create more movement. Perhaps a mix approach, is your piano getting masked by a synth? Setup Flux Pro on the piano track with a boosted high shelf filter, some gentle chorus and additional width. Then, set Flux Pro's MIDI Input to the Synth, so that every time the synth plays the piano is given a little push to stand out in the mix. Not good enough, want to get weird? Vary the formant filters' cutoff and resonance as if your music is flowing through someone's throat. Why not set the Fixed Delay to repeat every other bar at an octave lower so you can moodily duet with yourself on those lonely nights. Lastly, have quick oscillations of Rate Modulation to add percussive texture to your audio, and more importantly, save yourself the humiliation of recording a shaker track. Flux Pro is both a stand-alone application as well as an AUv3 plugin, meaning it works within iOS and iPadOS hosts such as GarageBand.

1611517407.name: A330PDP
1611517407.description: A330 NORMAL AND ABNORMAL PROCEDURES - VERSION 2026. The main goal since the initial APP design was to introduce all important elements from the latest versions of (generic AIRBUS A330) FCOM , FCTM , QRH ,MMEL , CDL and Normal checklist. The app enables the user to study absolutely any SOP of the A320 without any manual. With a simple user-friendly interface, it links the essential information needed for the lessons to the appropriate manual reference and further explanations. Lessons follow a didactic and easy methodology, with supporting graphics and real pictures taken in real simulator sessions . This APP must be used only for training purposes. It has not yet been approved for any Aeronautical Authority , but it is updated with the last Airbus information and new changes constantly. Advantages: It is perfect to prepare screenings and Flight Simulator checks. It helps instructors explain all normal and abnormal procedures to students. It is really good for A330 Pilots to remain updated. Very convenient for cadets to develop understanding on how to find the information in the A330 manuals , as it can be tough at the beginning. Strengths: It stresses the Golden Rules of AIRBUS [FLY, NAV, COM First] for all abnormal SOPs. The sequence of each failure explanation always follows the AIRBUS Golden rules as a key to battle any failure in a safe, professional and efficient manner. THE APP is wide knowledge database of 1300 pages that covers from Normal SOPs to the most complicated ABNORMAL SOPs. It covers all Abnormalities and Emergencies that appear in any simulator check of any airline in the world. The Author is CAPTAIN A320 / A330 / A350 & EASA TRI/TRE and DEVELOPER in the APPLE DEVELOPER PROGRAM. All the new changes introduced in FCOM , QRH , FCTM , NORMAL CHECKLIST will be updated every month automatically. "Should you find any mistake or error, do not hesitate to email me and it will be corrected immediately"

1612783783.name: Learn Rust Programming Offline
1612783783.description: Rust is a modern systems programming language developed by the Mozilla Corporation. It is intended to be a language for highly concurrent and highly secure systems. It compiles to native code; hence, it is blazingly fast like C and C++. This tutorial adopts a simple and practical approach to describe the concepts of Rust programming. This tutorial has been prepared for beginners to help them understand the basic and advanced concepts of Rust. Application programming languages like Java/C# are used to build software, which provide services to the user directly. They help us build business applications like spreadsheets, word processors, web applications or mobile applications. Systems programming languages like C/C++ are used to build software and software platforms. They can be used to build operating systems, game engines, compilers, etc. These programming languages require a great degree of hardware interaction. Systems and application programming languages face two major problems − It is difficult to write secure code. It is difficult to write multi-threaded code. The Rust language was designed for developing highly reliable and fast software in a simple way. Rust can be used to write high-level programs down to hardware-specific programs. Content in this App: Learn rust programming beginners to advance guide Rocket Actix Tide Chrono Rand Hyper PostgreSQL MySQL

1612952507.name: AeroPads - Pads & Soundscapes
1612952507.description: Designed by a musician, AeroPads offers professional and inspiring ambient pads. Elevate your live sound with immersive pads and keep your team locked in time with precise metronome clicks. Trusted by professional musicians– from small stages to sold-out stadiums– AeroPads are the best-sounding pads on the market, widely praised for being harmonically intricate and versatile without sounding boring or stagnant. Ambient pads add depth and dimension to revitalize your mix and eliminate dead space and awkward transitions. AeroPads is a space-inspired ambient pad player designed to accompany and underscore live musical performances of many kinds. Operation is simple: 1. Select a Key. 2. Select a Patch. 3. Play. AeroPads is widely used for weddings, cinematic scores, worship services, songwriting sessions, rehearsals, open mics, studio tracks, and chill ambient arrangements. Ambient pads are often used with acoustic guitar, electric guitar, and piano, but are equally compatible with instruments such as violin, cello, synthesizers, ukulele, harp, and more. AeroPads feature enough harmonic movement and texture to fill out solo performances while remaining restrained enough to accompany full bands. Ambient pads can help you feel more relaxed and prepared on stage, so you can focus on the performance. Designed by Aerospace Audio, AeroPads feature the same sounds and similar features that power the iconic foot-controlled instrument: Atmosphere. Highlighted Features: ∙ Expressive ambient pads in all 12 keys and 3 common tonalities: Major, Minor, and Neutral. ∙ Smooth, adjustable crossfades for seamless transitions. ∙ Built-in metronome clicks with visual and audible cues to keep you in time– and a panic button to ditch the click if your team drifts tempo or skips a beat. ∙ Customizable Patch Slots and Patch Pages so that your favorite presets are always within reach. ∙ Programmable setlists recall each song’s pad selection, key, tonality, tempo, time signature, click sound, and individual level settings. ∙ Independent overall, pad, and click levels and presets provide precise control for rehearsals, recording, and live performance. ∙ Adjustable concert pitch tuning for a variety of reference pitches, including 440 Hz, 432 Hz, 444 Hz, 442 Hz, and more. ∙ AirPlay support. ∙ Independent pad and click routing send pads to the speakers and clicks to in-ear monitors. ∙ Expandable sound library with additional sound packs available for purchase. ∙ Mono, stereo, and split-channel routing options. ∙ Optimized for both iPhone and iPad. Note from Isaac, the designer: "I hope you enjoy using AeroPads as much as I do. I designed AeroPads because most of the available pad players and ambient pads that I tried felt boring and uninspiring. Don’t get me wrong, there’s definitely some cool stuff out there, but I never fell in love with any of it. The apps that I tried were honestly a bit clunky and confusing. And most of the ambient pads that I heard were either repetitive, boring, or just wildly distracting. When I was looking for an ambient pad player, I wanted the interface to inspire me the second I launched the app. I wanted to get lost and feel immersed in the sound the moment an ambient pad cues. I wanted every action to be intuitive and simple. I wanted a tool that pushed me to be more creative, not bore and confuse me. I never found a tool that checked all those boxes, so I decided to create my own. As a musician who has struggled with self-esteem and confidence, AeroPads gave me the confidence I needed to perform more comfortably and professionally. When I use AeroPads live on stage, I immediately feel more relaxed and prepared. When I use AeroPads as a starting primer to compose and write songs, I immediately feel more inspired and creative. If you’re a musician who loves to try new inspiring tools, I hope you love trying AeroPads. Isaac Aerospace Audio ps. Troposphere and Satellite are my favorite patches."

Highlighted Features: ∙ Expressive ambient pads in all 12 keys and 3 common tonalities: Major, Minor, and Neutral. ∙ Smooth, adjustable crossfades for seamless transitions. ∙ Built-in metronome clicks with visual and audible cues to keep you in time– and a panic button to ditch the click if your team drifts tempo or skips a beat. ∙ Customizable Patch Slots and Patch Pages so that your favorite presets are always within reach. ∙ Programmable setlists recall each song’s pad selection, key, tonality, tempo, time signature, click sound, and individual level settings. ∙ Independent overall, pad, and click levels and presets provide precise control for rehearsals, recording, and live performance. ∙ Adjustable concert pitch tuning for a variety of reference pitches, including 440 Hz, 432 Hz, 444 Hz, 442 Hz, and more. ∙ AirPlay support. ∙ Independent pad and click routing send pads to the speakers and clicks to in-ear monitors. ∙ Expandable sound library with additional sound packs available for purchase. ∙ Mono, stereo, and split-channel routing options. ∙ Optimized for both iPhone and iPad. Note from Isaac, the designer: "I hope you enjoy using AeroPads as much as I do. I designed AeroPads because most of the available pad players and ambient pads that I tried felt boring and uninspiring. Don’t get me wrong, there’s definitely some cool stuff out there, but I never fell in love with any of it. The apps that I tried were honestly a bit clunky and confusing. And most of the ambient pads that I heard were either repetitive, boring, or just wildly distracting. When I was looking for an ambient pad player, I wanted the interface to inspire me the second I launched the app. I wanted to get lost and feel immersed in the sound the moment an ambient pad cues. I wanted every action to be intuitive and simple. I wanted a tool that pushed me to be more creative, not bore and confuse me. I never found a tool that checked all those boxes, so I decided to create my own. As a musician who has struggled with self-esteem and confidence, AeroPads gave me the confidence I needed to perform more comfortably and professionally. When I use AeroPads live on stage, I immediately feel more relaxed and prepared. When I use AeroPads as a starting primer to compose and write songs, I immediately feel more inspired and creative. If you’re a musician who loves to try new inspiring tools, I hope you love trying AeroPads. Isaac Aerospace Audio ps. Troposphere and Satellite are my favorite patches."

1614002487.description: ‘Conga Chops Practice Loops - Vol 1’ is a MYXSTEM app release, allowing users to completely control the listening experience. The app features mute, solo, pan and fade capabilities for each individual instrument stem, along with tempo control and looping. By adjusting each stem, users can build the perfect mix to play and study along with, an ideal practice tool for all experience levels. This app also includes PDF transcriptions of all of the percussion instruments you’re hearing on the each loop. Volume 1 includes 19 exclusive Practice Loops from CongaChops.com, featuring Grammy Winning musicians, with tracks in various styles ranging from 60bpm-105bpm. Please see below for the full track listing. 1614080137.name: Hieroglyph FlashCards
1614080137.description: Simply the best, most complete set of Flash Cards for Ancient Egyptian Hieroglyphs! For anyone who enjoys Ancient Egypt: Students, Enthusiasts, and Professionals! There are plenty of challenges at all skill levels! Use this app to learn and reinforce new glyphs every day. 13 Decks of Cards: 22 Egyptian Alphabet cards. Just the consonants to get started! 36 Glyphs with double consonants (common biliterals) 558 Phonetics cards with both Manual de Codage and English pronunciations 50 Deities with cards for both Hieroglyph Names, and with Images 611 Hieroglyph Determinitive cards. Determinatives help specify a word's meaning. 486 Hieroglyph Logograms (where a single hieroglyph represents a word) 237 Pharaohs Cards for Dynasties 1 through 30 237 Pharaoh's Cartouches 53 Phrases from the magical "Offering Formula" 3579 Non-Royal titles and occupations 80 Place Names 46 Nomes (with Alternates) Widgets included for passive learning from Home screens and Lock Screen Designed for off-line use, no internet required! Glyph data based on R. Hannig's Grosses Handwoerterbuch Aegyptisch-Deutsch, Marburger Edition, 2006

1614111467.description: 《俄罗斯方块》的基本规则是移动、旋转和摆放游戏自动输出的各种方块，使之排列成完整的一行或多行并且消除得分。 由小方块组成的不同形状的板块陆续从屏幕上方落下来，玩家通过调整板块的位置和方向，使它们在屏幕底部拼出完整的一条或几条。这些完整的横条会随即消失，给新落下来的板块腾出空间，与此同时，玩家得到分数奖励。没有被消除掉的方块不断堆积起来，一旦堆到屏幕顶端，玩家便告输，游戏结束。

1614558280.name: MorseChat - 安全聊天工具
1614558280.description: MorseChat Messenger is based on open source project Signal. We improve the privacy protection by following approaches: Replace phone number registration with a 'fake' 8-digit phone number Add login password to protect app Use destroy password to delete all content when you are forced to login You can connect to your own private Mooorse server UI layout easier to use Source code: https://github.com/hsa111/Morse-iOS.git

1614581856.name: 像素艺术 像素创作工具 - Pixel Canvas
1614581856.trackName: 像素艺术 像素创作工具 - Pixel Canvas
1614581856.description: Pixel Canvas 是一款简单专注的像素画制作工具，可创作原创像素绘画，并将照片转换为像素风格作品。 从空白像素画布开始，选择画布尺寸、挑选颜色，然后一格一格作画。你可以自定义画布背景色，切换橡皮擦，显示或隐藏网格线，并可反转网格线颜色；需要重新开始时，也可一键清空画板。 你还可以导入照片，立即应用像素特效。提供多种像素密度选项，控制最终效果：从粗犷的复古像素方块到更细致的像素化影像。 作品完成后，可将清晰成品直接导出到照片图库。 功能： 从零开始创作像素艺术 多种画板尺寸可选 使用自定义像素颜色绘制 更改画板背景颜色 使用橡皮擦工具快速修改 显示隐藏或反转网格线 清空画板并重新开始 导入照片并应用像素特效 调整像素密度以适配不同风格 将完成作品保存到照片 Pixel Canvas 旨在支持快速创作时刻，打造复古风格影像、头像艺术、图标与贴纸，以及灵感来自游戏的视觉内容，适合所有喜欢像素艺术干净迷人魅力的人。 订阅详情 付款：购买确认后向你的 iTunes 账户收取费用。 自动续订：除非在当前订阅期结束前至少 24 小时关闭，否则订阅将自动续订。 续订费用：在当前订阅期结束前 24 小时内向你的账户收取续订费用。 管理订阅：购买后，你可在账户设置中管理订阅并关闭自动续订。 取消与退款：由商店直接处理。 免费试用：免费试用的未使用部分在购买后将失效。 使用条款： https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 隐私政策： https://www.kai7.app/p/privacy-policy-no-tracking.html

1614587144.name: DELE B2 Spanish
1614587144.description: ◆The new version 2020, DELE exam preparation for smartphones! Improve your Spanish level dramatically by using it in your spare time! ◆Include 6 practice tests of DELE exam [Level B2] You can practice the same format as the actual test on smartphone and check the correct answer immediately by automatic scoring function. ◆Covering the format of new DELE exam which began in 2020! You can use it with confidence as further DELE preparation. ◆ Created by DELE Examiner! All created by multiple DELE Examiners from Spanish native countries, directed by prof. Helder, who has been teaching Spanish for over 20 years in Japan also a DELE Examiner for more than 10 years. ◆ Easy to read and answer! The layout and font size have been fitted for smartphone screen size to read easier while keeping the original format of the exam. ◆ No need to prepare a CD for audio playback or download separately ◆ You can print as PDF! You can download the writing and oral exam as PDF file and print it after saving on a smartphone device or cloud. ◆ There are examples of the writing tests! ◆Created by: Academia Vega, Spanish language school in Shimokitazawa, Japan https://esvega.com/

1616228106.name: ca-mera+
1616228106.description: The successor of probably the nerdiest camera app ever made, ca-mera+ uses a cellular automaton to interpret the colors of your camera stream. The resulting images are pixelated and contain unique patterns created by cellular automata. The output can be black and white, or one of several retro color palettes (CGA 4 and 16 colors, 1-bit RGB, etc.). This app provides "selfie" and "split" modes, records video, and lets you change the appearance of the pictures by controlling the automaton application direction, its rules, the resolution, the input brightness, and the input fidelity (i.e. to which extent the cellular automaton is allowed to run freely).

1617156451.name: AFV Recognition
1617156451.description: The ultimate Armoured Fighting Vehicle (AFV) recognition guide, now available on your mobile devices. This application is the end product of years of studying military equipment and how to best identify it, with input from serving military and veterans alike. AFV Recognition, or Equipment ID, as it is known in some NATO countries, is the art of identifying what vehicle you see on the battlefield. This information not only allows you to stay safer/employ the right effects, but also informs your command of the formation that is in front of you. This vital information, if accurate, not only wins battles - but wins wars. + Reconnaissance Vehicles (RECCE/RECON) + Main Battle Tanks (MBTs) + Infantry Fighting Vehicles (IFVs) + Armoured Personnel Carriers (APCs) + Anti-tank vehicles + Artillery + Surface to Air Missiles (SAMs) + Command, Intelligence & Electronic Warfare (CIEW) + Engineer (ENG) + Rotary Wing (RW) + Easy to navigate (search functions, favorites and categories) + Works offline (first time opening must have a data connection). + Over 200 armoured vehicles in current database. + Predominantly Russian/Soviet vehicles. + Detailed AFV "cards" displaying vehicle images, descriptions, weapon systems, types of protection, recognising features and countries in service. + Comparison guides to see vehicles side by side. + Quiz to test your AFV knowledge - not for the faint of heart. + New vehicle packs being released each month (Ukraine Pack - June 2022 / Germany Pack - July 2022 / USA Pack - August 2022 / UK Pack - September 2022) + Ongoing project. + Brain child of @afv_recognition - the master of AFV guides. The AFV Recognition app will revolutionise the study & education of this vast subject. A must have for any serving military, aspiring military, military training establishments and all armoured vehicle enthusiasts.

文件，不想让流媒体曲库决定自己能听什么；如果你有一台 NAS，希望在 iPhone、iPad、Apple Watch 和 CarPlay 上随时播放自己的音乐；如果你习惯整理专辑、封面、歌词和播放列表，OnePlayer 可以成为你的私人音乐库。 在家连接电脑或 NAS，通勤时用 Apple Watch 独立播放，开车时通过 CarPlay 浏览曲库，学习和睡前则可以配合倍速播放、跳过片头片尾与睡眠定时器使用。 OnePlayer 不是流媒体 App。你的音乐文件、播放列表、专辑封面和歌词，都由你自己掌控。 【OnePlayer 5.0｜全新播放体验】 OnePlayer 5.0 从播放引擎、声音调节到网络音乐进行了全面升级。 全新播放引擎 全新播放引擎，性能更强，支持更多格式、更多音效， 支持关闭、自动、96 kHz 和 192 kHz 升频播放模式 显示音源、请求和实际输出采样率，音频输出状态更加透明 针对 Hi-Res 音频与 USB DAC 优化输出链路 搭配兼容的 USB DAC，可通过 DoP 输出 DSD，最高支持 DSD512 新增实时音频频谱，让正在播放的声音也能看得见 兼容曲目支持无缝衔接，减少 Live 专辑、古典组曲和连续音乐之间的切歌间隙 全新声音中心 所有声音相关功能集中到一处，输出状态和声音处理链路一目了然。 10 段自定义均衡器与多种 EQ 预设 高通、低通、带通和陷波高级滤波器 按单曲或专辑进行响度均衡 混响和延迟空间效果 黑胶暖声、经典磁带、纯净磁带等声音风格 查看完整音频路径与各声音模块的生效状态 更方便的网络音乐 自动发现局域网内的 SMB 和 WebDAV 设备 支持读取网络歌曲的内嵌封面与歌词 清晰显示连接、加载和播放状态 支持建立远程资料库，将 NAS 音乐加入歌曲、专辑和艺人页面 支持在线播放、离线缓存或批量下载到本地 【本地与无损播放】 支持 MP3、FLAC、AAC、WAV、AIFF、APE、OGG、OPUS、WMA、DSD、DSF、M4A、M4R 等 20 多种音频格式 支持 Hi-Res 音频信息显示 支持倍速播放，适合有声书、播客、课程和学习资料 支持睡眠定时器，可选择倒计时结束后播放完整首歌再停止 支持跳过片头和片尾 支持播放进度记忆 支持多种播放页主题和横屏播放体验 【音乐导入与 NAS 访问】 Wi-Fi 无线传歌 USB 有线导入 文件 App 导入 AirDrop 导入 iTunes / iPod 音乐库同步 连接 SMB 局域网共享、连接 WebDAV、NAS 或电脑共享文件夹 【专业音乐库管理】 按歌曲、专辑、艺人、文件夹和播放列表浏览音乐 创建普通播放列表和智能播放列表 按艺人、专辑、曲风、年份、时长、播放次数、添加时间、评分和比特率等条件自动筛选 支持收藏、搜索、排序和批量管理 编辑标题、艺人、专辑、封面、歌词、曲风、年份、轨道号和评分等信息 使用 AI 辅助匹配专辑封面和歌曲标签 【歌词体验】 支持 LRC 歌词、内嵌歌词和外部歌词文件 支持逐字歌词显示，带来更接近卡拉 OK 的播放体验 支持歌词翻译，更轻松地理解外语歌曲 可直接在 App 内编辑歌词 支持 iOS 26+ 本地 AI 歌词识别，Premium 用户可无限使用 【Apple Watch 独立播放】 将音乐导入 Apple Watch，即使不带 iPhone，也能播放自己的音乐。 管理歌曲、播放列表、专辑和艺人 支持 Apple Watch 扬声器播放，老款手表也可使用 支持倍速播放、睡眠定时器和播放进度记忆 使用 Cover Flow 浏览封面，通过数码表冠切换音乐 Apple Watch 可直接连接 SMB 或 WebDAV 下载音乐 支持搜索、批量操作和创建播放列表 适合跑步、健身、徒步、通勤等不方便携带手机的场景。 【CarPlay、Siri 与小组件】 支持 CarPlay 车载播放 在车机上浏览歌曲、专辑、艺人、文件夹和播放列表 支持 CarPlay 歌词显示 使用 Siri 与快捷指令播放歌曲、专辑或播放列表 可实现连接 CarPlay 后自动播放等自动化 提供歌词、迷你播放器、iPod 和 CD 风格等桌面小组件 支持 iOS 控制中心播放、暂停、上一首和下一首控件 【Last.fm 听歌记录】 自动记录听歌历史 同步喜爱歌曲 查看个人听歌报告 浏览歌曲、专辑和艺人资料 OnePlayer 不提供任何音频或视频流媒体内容，也不提供音乐下载服务。它是一款用于播放和管理用户自行导入或连接的音频文件的本地音乐播放器。 部分功能需要 Premium、兼容的外接设备或较新的系统版本支持。 OnePlayer 提供买断和订阅两种购买方式，价格可能因地区而异。订阅将通过 App Store 账户扣款并自动续订，除非在当前订阅期结束至少 24 小时前取消。购买后可在 App Store 账户设置中管理订阅。 联系我们 oneplayer_app@outlook.com 隐私政策 https://oneplayer.cn/about/privacy.html 使用条款 https://oneplayer.cn/about/terms.html

1617819308.name: 任意三角形 专业的
1617819308.trackName: 任意三角形 专业的
1617819308.description: 计算任意三角形的所有数量的最佳应用。你必须输入一些数量，如两个角和一个长度。该算法搜索所缺数量的公式，显示它们并计算出结果。 小数位的长度可以改变。当四舍五入或错误的数值导致反对意见时，该算法会显示。 支持小数和分数。解决方案会一步步显示出来。所有的计算结果都存储在历史记录中。最终的解决方案可以被分享。 [ 内容 ] 任意三角形的所有重要数量 任意三角形的所有重要量的计算公式 说明该主题的信息图 寻找所需数量的搜索栏 保存输入的历史功能 详细的解决方案 支持正数、小数和分数 无广告！ [使用方法］ 有一些字段可以使用特殊键盘输入数值 按右下角的复选标记按钮，开始计算 如果缺少数值，所有字段将被标记为橙色 如果数值是错误的（如负数），受影响的字段将被标为红色 如果一个数值不是数字，它将以红色突出显示 历史记录中的条目可以被删除或排序 如果你在历史记录中选择一个条目，它将被自动载入计算中 按一个按钮就可以删除整个历史记录 解决方案可以被共享 [数学条件] 每个值必须大于零 每个角度必须小于180° 两边之和必须始终大于第三边的长度

1617928500.name: Color Flash Cards for Kids
1617928500.description: Help your child master color recognition with this simple and engaging educational app. Designed specifically as a preschool app and toddler app, Color Flash Cards offers a calm, ad-free environment for kids to explore colors for preschool and early learning at their own pace. With 80 vibrant flashcards, this app supports learning colors through both alphabetical order learning and random order learning. Whether used in the classroom or at home, it's a great tool for toddler color learning, color identification, and basic reading skills. Each card displays a colorful object along with its color name. Tap the speaker icon and the app will read the color aloud, helping develop both visual and auditory recognition. The intuitive design mirrors the feel of real color flashcards, making it ideal for kids flashcards use without the clutter or wear of paper. We built this flashcard app with simplicity in mind for parents and teachers. There are no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, and no hidden fees—just one lifetime purchase. App Features: 80 color flashcards with bright illustrations and easy-to-read words English audio for each color Tap-to-advance through flashcards Toggle between alphabetical order learning and random order learning Supports colors for kids, colors for toddlers, and colors for preschool age groups Great for classroom or at-home learning No ads, no subscriptions, no interruptions One-time lifetime purchase Built for ages 3 and up Whether you’re a teacher reinforcing classroom lessons or a parent helping your child prepare for school, this kids app makes learning fun and frustration-free. Skip the expensive paper flashcards—this digital version never wears out. Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers, and kindergarten-age children who are just starting to learn and name the colors around them.

1619076934.name: TB VoicePitcher
1619076934.description: Make vocals stand out! Add 3D richness, texture and harmony with this AUv3 plugin. TB VoicePitcher is a dual voice pitch shifter with creative freeze effect. Help vocals stand out by adding one or more virtual tracks, with LFO-driven dynamic pitch shift and delay for a more natural doubling effect than a chorus or conventional doublers. The unique freeze option can freeze vowels instantly for creative effects. The snapshot selector allows you to quickly change and recall settings for dynamic switching, real-time performance effects and easy automation. Features: Two independent pitch shifters Pitch shift output equaliser LFO with dozens of waveforms to modulate delay and/or pitch in variable amounts for more natural effects Unique 'freeze' function to freeze vowels or consonants Formant control to improve the naturalness of pitch shifting Unique snapshot system to quickly recall, automate and change settings on the fly AUv3 with resizable UI and dozens of color themes to choose from Preset management including import and export options Undo, redo, A/B switching What you should know: Licenses acquired for this platform are not compatible with other platforms. Audio Unit (AUv3) extensions require an iPad mini 2, iPad 4 or later models.

1619241039.name: History Book - Browse & Search
1619241039.description: History Book automatically saves your browsing history for searching later. By default, it only auto-saves pages that contain an article, so you don’t have to worry about it saving your sensitive data. If you want, you can configure it to auto-save every webpage. If you are feeling paranoid, you can disable auto-save entirely. You can also exclude websites that you never want to auto-save. You can use it as a read-it-later app, but I mostly use it as a search app. For privacy reasons, History Book stores your browsing history in iCloud. Apart from the iCloud sync, History Book does not collect, store, or transmit any personal information. History Book has no in-app purchases, no ads, and no tracking. It’s a universal purchase, so you only have to buy it once to use it on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Caveat: The app uses readability.js to check whether a webpage is readable. It is likely to produce both false positives and false negatives. The app is written in SwiftUI, which means there are some not-quite-standard behaviors and UI bugs that I can’t fix. The app uses iCloud for syncing. Note: The “can read and alter webpages” text in the permission section is just unfortunate wording. History Book needs access to the web page to save the content. It’s not doing anything creepy!

1619441235.name: Steel Guitar PRO
1619441235.description: Steel Guitar PRO is a highly advanced guitar processor that combines cutting-edge realtime audio generation with a truly expressive control interface. It provides many unique guitar models, built-in amps & FX processing, MIDI control, AUv3, and wide-ranging customizability. :: Control Surface :: Steel Guitar PRO features a powerful yet familiar control interface. Simply touch the strings to “pick,” and drag the slide bar to modulate pitch. By enabling enhanced slide control, you can even use multiple touches to tilt the slide bar, or dampen the strings. Fretboard dimension, string spacing, and pick guard size are all configurable. A high level of resolution enables minute pitch control and realistic vibrato. Settings let you vary guitar tone, sustain and release times, touch behavior, slide bar auxiliary control, handedness, and more. :: Guitars :: Steel Guitar PRO provides you with an arsenal of guitars to choose from: unique examples of humbuckers, single coils, P90s, and more. Instruments include many 6 string guitars, as well as 8- and 10-string steel guitar variants. Each family of instruments comes with many tuning to choose from, but you can also create and save your own. In addition, you have up to seven virtual “pedals” to bend individual or collections of string — much like a pedal steel. The pedals can be actuated by slightly tilting the device, or via MIDI, or even with the fretting touch. All of this is configurable by the user. :: Built-In FX Processing :: Steel Guitar PRO incorporates a virtual signal chain where you can put amps and FX in any combination. The included dozen amps and 20 FX are all custom tuned to evoke the best tones from the guitar processor. Each amp or effect features multiple parameters to precisely modify its tone and feel. These parameters are MIDI-mappable, so that you can control them via an external device. The amp collection covers a broad spectrum from bell-like cleans to thick overdrive. The FX include many analog inspired “pedals” that range from overdrives, distortions, mods, delays, reverbs, to beyond. :: AUv3 & MIDI :: Steel Guitar PRO can also be used as an AUv3 MIDI plugin. We developed a custom MIDI sub-protocol so that Steel Guitar PRO and its powerful control interface can run seamlessly inside an AUv3 host. You can also use a traditional MIDI keyboard or device to play Steel Guitar PRO, which readily accommodates MIDI pitch & mod wheels, and key velocity as well. :: Useful Features :: Steel Guitar PRO includes a comprehensive preset management system that allows you to save, modify, and share any number of your “rigs.” The standalone app also includes a handy “tape deck” where you can record, play, loop and import/export audio. MIDI learn feature is easy and intuitive to use, but also offers deeper customization. All audio processing is done in the highest resolution, natively and without resampling at rates up to 96kHz. The fluid user interface integrates readily with many different AUv3 hosts.

1620376768.name: 记点——轻量高效记忆神器
1620376768.trackName: 记点——轻量高效记忆神器
1620376768.description: 「记点」是一款轻量高效的记事APP，设计理念源自“念念不忘，必有回响”，您的每一份记忆，都可在此珍藏。 不忘：记录九类经常会遗忘的事件 通用卡，可用于记录工作、学习中的重要事项，完成时可勾选，可极大提升效率； 购物卡，可用于每次购物前，列出购物清单，购物时可勾选，以便遗忘购物某物； 备物卡，可用于每次出行（出差、旅游）前，列出所备物品，以便忘记携带某物； 储物卡，可用于记录重要物品所存放的位置，以便下次使用该物时，快速找到它； 纪念卡，可用于记录重要日子，可清楚了解过去时间，及距离下次纪念日的时间； 生日卡，可用于记录重要亲人、朋友的生日，让你再也不会遗忘任何亲人的生日； 借记卡，可用于记录每一笔借钱记录，包括记录你向别借钱，或者别人向你借钱； 药物卡，可用于记录某人每天用药量，强大的提醒功能，让你再也不会忘记吃药； 菜谱卡，可用于记录每一道菜的配料，让你每次做这道菜前，都不需再寻找菜谱； 回响：可显示最近一周和最近一月需要做的事件，让你再也不会遗忘任何事情。 「不忘•回响」同时还拥有iCloud云同步、FaceID解锁、自定义深浅模式、桌面小组件等人性化功能。 如有问题或建议，请联系开发者 微博：PoPoem开发者 微信：YandeNie 邮箱：yande18@126.com 感谢支持，生活愉快。

1620569987.name: MobileSheets®
1620569987.description: MobileSheets 是专为 iPad 打造的终极乐谱阅读器。它让您不必再携带厚重的书本和活页夹，并能在几秒内访问乐谱库中的任何一份乐谱。它也提供多项专为音乐人打造的强大功能，包括： 可连接到任何平台上运行 MobileSheets 的其他设备，轻松分享歌曲与曲目单。 可通过 WiFi、蓝牙或云端同步设备上的乐谱库。 多种操作模式，包含双页并排、半页翻页与垂直卷动页面。 可通过任何蓝牙或 USB 设备（包含双踏板和四踏板型号）进行免持翻页，也可使用自动卷动功能。 用于标记乐谱的注释功能，支持自由绘制、基本图形、文字与图章。 通过 WiFi 或蓝牙连接多部平板电脑，以书本模式同时显示两页乐谱。 自订音频播放器，可与乐谱同步播放音轨。音频播放器支持 A-B 循环播放与多种尺寸显示。 可自订页面顺序，让您轻松移除不必要的页面、重复页面或变更页面顺序，而不影响原始文件。 具备多种显示模式与音效的节拍器。 书签功能，方便快速访问乐谱中的特定段落。 提供链接点功能，可处理反复记号并快速在页面间跳转。 智能按钮，可放置在乐谱上，按下时会触发可设置的动作。 支持多种文件类型，包含图片、PDF、文本文件与 ChordPro 文件。 支持导入 CSV 索引文件，以分割大型的 PDF 乐谱集。 支持通过 USB、蓝牙和 WiFi 与 MIDI 设备通信，以加载歌曲或触发动作。 支持对文本文件与 ChordPro 文件中的和弦进行移调。 支持手动与自动裁切，可彻底去除不必要的边界留白。 支持曲目单和收藏集功能，可高效地将歌曲分组以供演奏。 强大的乐谱库管理功能，支持大量元数据字段，让您能完整掌控乐谱库中的数据。 提供免费的 PC 辅助应用程序，让您轻松建立与编辑歌曲。 立即试用 MobileSheets，只需轻点一下，即可体验自由访问所有乐谱的便利性。 注意事项：此应用程序不包含任何乐谱，您必须提供自己的乐谱文件。此应用程序无法播放 PDF、图片、文本文件或 ChordPro 文件，仅能显示这些文件，并播放音频文件。 适用于 PC 的辅助应用程序未包含在此应用程序中，您可在此免费下载：https://www.zubersoft.com/mobilesheets/companion.php 隐私权政策：https://zubersoft.com/mobilesheets/privacy_policy_ios.html 使用条款：https://zubersoft.com/mobilesheets/terms_and_conditions_ios.html

1620745523.name: aRDP Pro - RDP Remote Desktop
1620745523.description: Thank you for supporting my work and GPL open-source software by buying aRDP Pro! If you are unhappy, please don't give us a bad review, instead, request a refund and get in touch by email support _at_ morpheusly _dot_ com: https://support.apple.com/en-ca/118223 Need a VNC app for controlling your Mac remotely? https://apps.apple.com/app/bvnc-pro/id1506461202 Need a SPICE or Proxmox or oVirt client for controlling virtual machines remotely? https://apps.apple.com/app/aspice-pro/id1560593107 If aRDP doesn't work for you or you're unhappy, please do not ask for help in a review but do post your question in the forum: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/bvnc-ardp-aspice-opaque-remote-desktop-clients Windows Instructions Enabling Remote Desktop on Windows: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/remote/remote-desktop-services/clients/remote-desktop-allow-access Optionally, for much improved security aRDP Pro supports SSH tunnelling. To enable OpenSSH on Windows: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/openssh/openssh_install_firstuse Linux Instructions Requires Ubuntu 22.04+ NOTE: If failing to connect, try disabling "Request Remote Resolution Requests" from Advanced Settings https://help.ubuntu.com/stable/ubuntu-help/sharing-desktop.html Xrdp on any supported Linux Distribution https://www.digitalocean.com/community/tutorials/how-to-enable-remote-desktop-protocol-using-xrdp-on-ubuntu-22-04 Report bugs: https://github.com/iiordanov/remote-desktop-clients/issues aRDP is a secure, SSH capable, open source RDP protocol client that uses FreeRDP open-source library. Its features include: Remote control of Windows and Linux computers using the RDP protocol Support for Ubuntu and Kubuntu 22.04+ Simulated Touchpad and two Direct input touch modes to choose from RDP Gateway support RDP Config File support (.rdp extension) Custom Scaling Audio support External keyboard support External mouse support Magic Trackpad support Multi-language support Multi-keyboard layout support - choose your keyboard layout while setting up the connection Multi-touch control over the remote mouse. One finger tap left-clicks, two-finger tap right-clicks, and three-finger tap middle-clicks Right and middle-dragging if you don't lift the first finger that tapped Scrolling with a two-finger drag Pinch-zooming SSH tunnelling for added security or to reach machines behind a firewall. SSH public/private (pubkey) support Full rotation support. Use the central lock rotation on your device to disable rotation Full desktop visibility even with soft keyboard extended Dynamic resolution changes, allowing you to reconfigure your desktop while connected UI Optimizations for different screen sizes (for tablets and smartphones) On-screen Ctrl, Alt, Tab, Super, Shift, Del, PageUp, PageDown, Function and Arrow keys Available on-device help on creating a new connection in the Menu when setting up connections Clipboard integration for copy/pasting from your device Various RDP Session customization options GPL source code here: https://gitlab.com/iiordanov/remote-desktop-clients-ios

1620993644.name: GPS Logger Plus
1620993644.description: GPS Logger is device sensor log tool that enables you to record your position and your path. The data record includes GPS coordinates, attitude, speed, distance and device heading. You are able to preview the GPS Log data after recording. Features : Record the GPS coordinate data of your iOS Devices, which are: Device GPS coordinate. Device Orientation to North. Device Altitude. Device Speed. Device Distance traveled. Plus the Time and Date of recording start. Show Altitude Stats such as minimum altitude, average altitude and maximum altitude. Show Speed Stats such as minimum speed, average speed and maximum speed. Able to set Metric or Imperial units. Lightweight, battery efficient GPS Logger. No integrated maps while recording for power saving. Ability to turn off screen while recording for power saving. Rename/Delete GPS log file. Preview recorded GPS data in detail, including map plotting and graph mode. Works seamlessly on both iPhone and iPad. Lightweight, compact app optimized for everyday use. Ad-free and built with privacy in mind. GPS Log Files : All the GPS log files can be accessed in [Files] app, [GPS Logger] Folder. The GPS log files can be open via normal text editor. The data array includes altitude [in Meter], compass orientation [0-360 Degree], distance traveled [in Meter], GPS Coordinates and Speed [in Meter/Second]. The GPS data are recorded with 1.0 sec interval. You can share GPS log files to another device via Airdrop, Messages or Mail. To load GPS log files that share by others, simply place the GPS log files into [GPS Logger] Folder via [Files] app. Usage: Record the track of your walking or running. Remember the best places you've seen. Use for long walk, hike or flight ride. Record the trips while riding and analyse the speed, altitude or distance. Share your tracks with your family and friends. For OpenStreetMap map editing. And many more depend on your imagination. Note: Turn off screen while recording for power saving, tap on the same location again to bring the screen back. Thanks for your support and do visit nitrio.com for more apps for your iOS devices.

1620996505.description: QRCode 是一款全新的二维码扫码和生成软件，集快速扫码和个性化二维码制作于一体。 主要功能： 1 快捷入口：长按App图标，即可快速导航至创建、扫码或批量创建二维码页面。 2 多类型二维码生成：支持文本、网址、电话号码、联系人等类型的二维码生成，未来将添加更多类型。 3 二维码美化：生成二维码后，我们提供了一个美化界面，内置数十种精美颜色和80多个常见的社交媒体Logo。 3.1 选择美观的背景色、前景色和背景图片。 3.2 添加自定义Logo图片。 3.3 添加精美的边框。 3.4 调整二维码的布局点。 4 分享与保存：保存图片后，您可以将其分享给朋友和家人，让他们扫描您创建的有趣二维码。 5 模板二维码：内置多种二维码模板，点击并输入内容即可生成对应样式的二维码，方便高效。 6 高速扫码：采用最新的扫码技术，扫码速度优于系统自带功能，更快速获取二维码结果。 7 扫码结果处理： 7.1 若为网页地址，可直接打开。 7.2 可以复制地址。 7.3 分享扫码结果。 7.4 再次美化二维码。 8 多码识别：支持从图片中同时识别多个二维码，选择相册中的图片即可一次识别多个二维码，极其方便。 9 批量创建：支持一次创建多个二维码，每行生成一个二维码，可输入多行内容进行生成。 10 历史记录：提供扫码记录和创建记录，便于分享、美化和复制内容等操作。 11 精美设计：对App进行了大量美化，提供四种精心设计的配色方案，每一种都进行了细致的颜色适配。 12 丰富的Logo选项：为了满足不同用户的需求，我们提供了多种颜色和样式的Logo。 13 自定义设置：在设置中，您可以调整图片导出格式、大小以及二维码生成时的容错等级。 特别注意： 本App最低支持iOS 13.0。 在二维码美化步骤中，如需更改二维码边框颜色，该功能仅支持iOS 15.0及以上系统，低于iOS 15.0的系统无法使用。 如果您喜欢我们的App，请在App Store给我们好评，我们将非常感激！如果您有任何意见或建议，欢迎反馈，非常感谢！

1621055260.name: 百分之一
1621055260.description: 【开发者的话】 游戏诚实自我介绍： 1.游戏评分是“虚高”，不能代表游戏真实水平，全靠每周直播大家的用爱充当游戏水军。 2.游戏玩法很普通，只是传承了十几年的经典三消+卡牌，休闲养肝不“刺激”。 3.游戏剧情藏太深，只是普通的拯救世界加了点“meta”元素。 4.游戏福利被骂傻了，你见过送钻送多了也被骂送最稀有的卡也被骂的吗？原因竟然是因为人人都有的稀有卡就不是稀有卡，每天送钻钻石就不值钱了...呜呜呜，好有道理的说~。从此之后只好冒着被骂的风险给大家发福利，生怕发多了又被骂~ 5.相信之前知道这款游戏的玩家是通过“玩游戏送实体卡”这个噱头了解到这款游戏的。游戏之前是可以通过看广告送实体卡牌的，但是现在不敢看广告送，只能付费送了~你问我为啥，无他，努力过，坚持过，奋斗过，不被理解过，虽被最后现实打败，但也不曾后悔。 6.实体卡材质是PVC哑光卡（和银行卡材质一样，厚度一样），印刷效果肯定没有纸卡清晰，同时也很有可能在运输过程中产生轻微划痕（正面无法看清，侧面找光线会看到那种，参考放久的银行卡上面的划痕），经常收集纸卡的玩家可能不太习惯，请见谅。 7.重构前的决斗王打牌玩法依然在。没有初始解锁此玩法主要是TCG上手不易，一方面是怕新玩家一来就接触多个玩法会显得游戏过于杂乱。另一方面是因为这个玩法bug太多也正在单独功能重构中，无法承担过多玩家同时在线，还请大家理解。 8.游戏已重构，玩法已精简，初心已回归。感谢大家付出了时间，而我们也付出了一口气，希望为一直等待的所有新老玩家争口气！ 9.每周六晚直播依然会在公测后坚持（每次直播前会游戏里发公告），持续为大家进行服务，直到做到我们自己心目中的百分之一。 【游戏特色】 1.游戏中分两种模式，三消剧情模式和tcg模式，tcg模式可以通过敲击游戏主页面决斗王大门开启。（tcg模式难度过高，切记不要过早开启，建议优先跟随主线剧情玩三消模式） 2.游戏中高星卡牌不代表强弱，上百张卡牌尝试各式Build玩法是乐趣所在 3.独特的像素风格过程剧情 4.有趣的模拟手机桌面 5.游戏中所有卡牌都能靠肝出来 6.游戏里获得的所有卡牌都能邮寄出对应实体卡 【联系我们】 QQ群：663048091 公众号：百分之一手游

1621210753.name: NotesHub: Notes, Kanban Boards
1621210753.description: Fully cross-platform, vendor-agnostic, Markdown-based note-taking app plus Kanban and whiteboarding tool. You can sync your data with GitHub, your own Git server, or iCloud Drive. Use the power of Markdown to format your notes, and create tables, lists, images, diagrams, etc. Markdown will help to keep your notes in the same style regardless of whether you copied text from the internet or wrote from scratch. Use Kanban boards as a tool to visualize your work and maximize your efficiency. This will help you to organize your time, focus on what matters, and achieve more. If you need quickly visualize your idea, our whiteboarding feature will be handy for you. Add different shapes, make connections between them, add hand-drawn notes, or add reusable elements from the library. KEY FEATURES Offline-first approach No vendor lock-in Periodic sync of data Fully cross-platform Different notebook providers: Git, GitHub, iCloud Drive Seamless GitHub integration Advanced search Notes printing Export notes to PDF Auto-generated table of contents (TOC) Kanban boards Whiteboards (based on Excalidraw) Dark and light themes (with accent color picker) Markdown preview with scroll sync Extended Markdown syntax: Mermaid diagrams, math expressions (MathJax), callouts, ABC musical notation, etc. Syntax highlighting for code blocks File attachments Convert HTML content to Markdown on paste Editor toolbar with all necessary commands (bold, list, table, etc.) Markdown syntax guidance Automatic merge conflict resolution FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Q: Why should I write my notes in Markdown? A: Markdown is a widely popular open format with support in many applications. By choosing Markdown you can be confident if you decide to switch to a different application you can easily move all of your data without any conversion needed. Also, Markdown is incredibly easy to understand even in raw view as it's just plain text content with human-readable syntax. 1621531549.description: Adblocker For YouTube Videos 可以删除所有 YouTube™ 视频和文字广告。轻巧安全，所需权限最少。 此应用程序有助于删除所有广告：前置视频广告、文字和横幅广告。通过停止那些无用的广告来节省时间。 此广告拦截器会自动拦截 YouTube™ 上的所有广告，包括前置视频广告、文字和横幅广告。 通过停止那些无用的广告来节省您的时间。简而言之，通过安装此扩展程序，所有 YouTube 广告都将被隐藏。 特征 1. 支持 1080p & 音频播放 youtube 视频 2. YouTube 视频画中画 3.支持后台继续播放视频 4. 阻止所有网站上的所有前置 YouTube™ 视频广告 5. 阻止整个 YouTube™ 中的横幅/文字广告 6.超快加上非常轻便，不会减慢你的速度 7. 客户改变视频速度或快退和前进 YouTube 广告拦截优势 提高浏览器速度 提高页面加载速度 减少内存/CPU 使用率 减少带宽 权限和隐私 与所有广告拦截扩展程序一样，我们确实需要每个网站的默认权限才能删除广告或弹出窗口，例如嵌入式 Youtube 视频。 任何视频广告拦截检测都发生在您的计算机上，我们不会看到或跟踪。 安装后，请重新加载所有 YouTube 选项卡以使扩展生效。 如何设置 -- 1. 请打开应用程序并单击欢迎屏幕上的按钮。这将带您进入“设置”屏幕。然后点击 Safari（对于 iPad，检查左窗格）> 扩展 > Adblocker For YouTube，然后点击开关将其打开。 2：在同一屏幕上，点击所有网站 > 允许以授予在所有网站的 Safari 上运行 Adblocker For YouTube 扩展程序的权限。现在你已经准备好了！当您在 Safari 上观看视频时，您应该会看到 Adblocker For YouTube 的叠加菜单。 注意：您可以点击 Safari 地址栏中的“管理扩展程序”图标来访问 Adblocker For YouTube 设置。 注意：在 iPhone 上，当您的视频以全屏模式播放时，您无法访问覆盖菜单。 注意：Safari 可能会显示一条通知，说明该扩展程序可以读取您的敏感信息和浏览历史记录。这是每次分机都会出现的一般性提醒。 Adblocker For YouTube 绝不会读取或收集您的任何个人信息，例如密码或信用卡号。使用起来绝对安全。你有我的话！ 该扩展适用于 iOS/iPadOS 版本 15.0 及更高版本的 Safari。 笔记 Youtube™ 和 YouTube 徽标是 Google Inc. 的商标。使用这些商标需获得 Google 许可。此扩展不是由谷歌公司创建或认可的。

1621835605.name: Learn TypeScript Programming
1621835605.description: Learn TypeScript Programming is a complete learning app designed for beginners, students, web developers, and JavaScript programmers who want to build strong modern development skills with TypeScript. Whether you are starting with TypeScript, improving your JavaScript knowledge, preparing for interviews, or learning modern web development, this app gives you a clear and structured path to follow. The app explains TypeScript concepts in a simple and practical way, helping you understand how typed JavaScript works and how to write cleaner, safer, and more scalable code. TypeScript is an open-source, object-oriented programing language, which is developed and maintained by MS under the Apache 2 license. It was introduced by Anders Hejlsberg, a core member of the development team of C# language. TypeScript is a strongly typed superset of JavaScript which compiles to plain JavaScript. It is a language for application-scale JavaScript development, which can be executed on any browser, any Host, and any Operating System. TypeScript is not directly run on the browser. It needs a compiler to compile and generate in JavaScript file. TypeScript is the ES6 version of JavaScript with some additional features. This app includes all the topics which help to learn TypeScript. These are Introduction of TypeScript, Features of TypeScript, Components of TypeScript, TypeScript first program, TypeScript Types, TypeScript Variables, TypeScript Operators, TypeScript Decision-making, TypeScript Loops, Functions, Classes, Arrays, Namespace, Module, Ambient, and many more. TypeScript cannot run directly on the browser. It needs a compiler to compile the file and generate it in JavaScript file, which can run directly on the browser. The TypeScript source file is in ".ts" extension. We can use any valid ".js" file by renaming it to ".ts" file. TypeScript uses TSC (TypeScript Compiler) compiler, which convert Typescript code (.ts file) to JavaScript (.js file). What you will learn TypeScript basics and syntax Variables and data types Type annotations Interfaces and types Functions Classes and objects Object oriented programming Union and intersection types Generics Enums Modules Arrays and tuples Type narrowing Advanced TypeScript concepts Error handling TypeScript with JavaScript Common interview questions Practical coding examples Why choose this app Step by step TypeScript lessons Beginner friendly explanations Clean and simple learning experience Practical code examples Quizzes to test your knowledge Progress tracking for your learning journey Useful for students and self learners Helpful for interview preparation Great for JavaScript developers Perfect for quick revision TypeScript is widely used in modern web development, frontend frameworks, backend development, large scale applications, and professional software projects. With this app, you can build a strong foundation and improve your coding confidence. Learn at your own pace and master TypeScript anytime. Start learning TypeScript today and take your programming skills to the next level.

1622109293.name: 时间计算器++ P
1622109293.description: 这个应用程序允许你计算时间（小时和分钟）。 你可以计算出1:30+0:50这样的事情。 当你输入一个数字时，该应用程序会自动插入一个": "来分隔小时和分钟，因此你可以快速计算。 它对计算总的工作时间、做日常差事的时间、旅行时间等很有用。 你可以加、减、乘、除。 你的计算历史会被自动保存，所以你可以在以后检查。 一个记忆键允许你保存你的小计。 经常用于计算的分钟（15分钟、30分钟等）可以被注册并用于一键添加。 包括一个添加24小时的按钮，用于跨日计算。 有一系列颜色，包括橙色、绿色、青色、粉色和黑色，你可以选择自己喜欢的颜色。 [功能列表] 你可以计算小时和分钟或分钟和秒。 你可以查看计算历史，触摸历史中显示的答案，在计算中重新使用它。 记忆键可以用来存储、添加和减去时间。 预设键让你只需轻轻一按就能使用最常用的时间（分钟）进行计算。 你可以选择应用程序的颜色。

1622138166.name: Change Video Speed for Safari
1622138166.description: 在 Safari 中轻松控制 HTML5 视频和音频在各网站上的播放速度。 此 Safari 扩展提供快捷操作面板、丰富的自定义选项以及方便的键盘快捷键。 主要功能 操作面板：通过滑块、+/- 按钮以及可自定义的预设按钮，即时调整播放速度 可自定义滑块：自由设置最小值、最大值和步进值，实现精细的速度控制（0.1 倍速至 16 倍速） 初始速度选项：可选择自动应用上次使用的速度、自定义默认速度或以正常速度开始播放 键盘快捷键（仅限 macOS）：可将速度增加、减少或直接切换到特定速度的功能分配给任意按键。速度值与按键设置均可完全自定义 限制说明 仅支持 HTML5 格式的视频与音频 部分网站可能会阻止或限制速度调整（例如：最高限制为 2 倍速） 对于嵌入式视频，可能需要打开原始来源页面 由于网站种类繁多，无法保证在每个网站上均能正常运行。如需确认某一特定网站的兼容性，可在安装前联系我们 如有功能建议、问题或错误报告，请访问我们的支持页面： https://www.wide-apps.com

1622262960.name: Chill：自我关怀庇护所
1622262960.description: 认识你的日常呵护最佳伴侣！Chill是一款专注于放松身心的应用，帮助你每一刻都能感受到平静与宁静，只需几分钟，就能让自己焕发新活力！丰富多样的个性化养生练习伴你同行，还有一只可爱的小鸟温柔引导，陪你轻松入眠。 每日最佳健康辅助利器 感到压力山大、焦虑不安，或是缺乏动力？觉得自我关怀变成了负担？Chill让放松变得轻松又充满乐趣，真正让你感受到“放松的同时获得收获”。完成简短的练习，不仅能看到成效、解锁奖励，还能显著改善你的心理健康！面对压力、睡眠问题和冥想难题，许多用户发现——在Chill中照顾自己，从未如此简单！ 用户好评 — “帮我摆脱了焦虑发作——这个应用支持离线使用，呼吸练习设计得非常贴心，还能自定义背景音乐的数量和层次，简直比其他应用更用心。用得越久，越能感受到用户的关怀，真是耳目一新！太感谢了！” — “超级喜欢这款放松应用，音乐和自然声搭配得刚刚好，帮我放松心情，感受自然的力量，非常感谢！” 快速自我充电 — 早晨用一场快速心情检测与引导呼吸，开启美好的一天！丰富多样的小仪式，从习惯追踪到简短的呼吸练习，应有尽有。 — 晚安时刻，用Chill带你平静片刻，释放心中压力，回顾感受，为一个安稳的夜晚做准备。 正念练习 用Chill的练习，增强你的心理韧性，培育平静与感恩！坚持你的仪式，养成健康习惯，按自己的节奏前行！ — 呼吸：引导你调节神经系统，集中注意力，恢复能量或帮助你入睡。 — 心情追踪：记录你的情绪变化，分析趋势，找到激励或影响你的因素。结合AI分析，呈现个性化健康洞察。 — 舒缓音乐与自然声：用雨声、海浪、壁炉声等，营造理想的放松氛围。 — 睡眠：追踪你的睡眠状况，借助引导 Rituals 改善夜间习惯。 — AI 聆听伙伴：一个随时倾诉、表达思绪、感受到被理解的安全空间。 — 小习惯：建立并坚持有益的小仪式，无压力、稳定养成。 — 任务与等级：让你的健康之路充满趣味，有经验值、宝石和奖杯，变每日为冒险！ — 格言：阅读鼓舞人心的话语，提升心情、开拓视野。 — Apple Watch 支持：在手腕上便捷访问核心功能，随时随地关怀自己。 健康数据集成 Chill与Apple Health无缝连接，自动记录你的正念练习、冥想和更多健康数据，让你的自我照顾更全面更科学。 隐私政策与服务条款请见： 服务条款：https://getchill.app/terms-conditions 隐私政策：https://getchill.app/privacy-policy

1622378712.name: DTNet浏览器-电脑版网页看高清图片和视频
1622378712.trackName: DTNet浏览器-电脑版网页看高清图片和视频
1622378712.description: DTNet是一款的浏览器，主要功能有油猴脚本、一键抓取Cookies、下载图片、嗅探音乐和视频资源文件链接、抓取网页中js网络请求Fetch/XHR等。另外app无需任何设置默认就能支持电脑版网页。电脑版网页不仅图片和视频更高清，更重要的是没有很多手机端的限制（强制你去使用app），甚至还有一些高端功能，比如某音的自动连播功能。当然您也可以修改浏览器标识为iPhone或iPad。 一键抓图: 集成了图片类型和宽高过滤器 一键抓取网页内所有视频文件链接 一键抓取网页内所有音乐文件链接 油猴脚本 自动跳过油管youtube广告 Picture in Picture (PiP画中画) 抓取网页中的JS网路请求，包括Fetch/XHR请求。轻松查看URL、Method、Header、Cookies、Response，其中对json格式数据做了样式和链接识别处理，长按json中的链接可以快速预览。另外如果您想调试可以通过curl按钮一键获取curl链接。 iOS原生播放器: 可以跳过、修改倍速、选择分辨率（油管和推特等） 多标签 无痕模式. 禁用浏览器的历史记录功能 用户标识: 默认是Mac的Safari，你可以在设置里改成 iPhone 或 iPad 画中画后台播放 (iOS 14+). 深色浅色模式自由切换 目前支持的tampermonkey油猴接口如下 (iOS13+) unsafeWindow GM_getValue GM_setValue GM_deleteValue GM_log GM_addElement GM_addStyle GM_openInTab GM_xmlhttpRequest 你可以从greasyfork.org找到很多实用的tampermonkey油猴脚本 注意，某音视频自动连播功能需要在网页底部点击开启开关：自动连播

1622598042.name: TV Launcher - Live UK Channels
1622598042.description: TV Launcher brings many live British & Irish TV channels that you know and love into one convenient launcher across Apple platforms. As the perfect app for cord-cutters, it’s never been easier to start watching live channels. As featured on iMore & 9to5Mac * Appleʼs TV app makes it easy to track programmes that have already been on but for the occasions where you want to watch live, it’s not so straightforward. You’ll have to open the app, find where the channels list is within the app, locate the channel you want to watch and the press play. TV Launcher takes away that pain by combining live channels from across multiple streaming apps into one location. 1623038041.name: Quartet 1
1623038041.description: Practice and perform jazz standards on another level with Quartet. And with a host of brand-new features, the top-selling jazz play along apps just got even better. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. Volume 1 includes 150 stunning jazz standards recorded exclusively by 7 of the world’s best jazz musicians. All ‘live’ studio recordings with intros, endings and top line solos. Whether you play jazz piano, guitar, saxophone, trumpet, bass, drums…simply mute your instrument from the Quartet for the ultimate jazz play along. And for jazz singers too, each edition of Quartet is an unrivalled collection of jazz backing tracks powerful enough to gig with. Change key on the fly. Speed up or slow down the audio seamlessly. Loop sections and slow them right down for practice. Select the number of repeats. Choose from preset mixes or create your own custom mix using the new onboard mixer. Arrange each song exactly the way you want it with the new ‘Arranger’ feature. Add a touch of reverb and you’re good to go. Improve your skills with full screen animated chord diagrams for Piano, Guitar and Ukulele. Search the entire Quartet song library (650 songs) by composer, style, BPM, associated artist and more. Build and share multi-app playlists and easily export PDF chord charts for every song. Export your stereo mix or export the multitrack if you want to develop the high quality separated parts in GarageBand or whatever DAW you use. Either way, all recordings are offered to you royalty-free giving you endless creative possibilities. The 150 jazz standards in Quartet Volume 1 include improvisations in the style of… ‘All Blues’, ‘All of Me’, ‘All The Things You Are’, ‘Autumn Leaves’, ‘Beautiful Love’, ‘Blue Bossa’, ‘Body and Soul’, ‘Caravan’, ‘Cherokee’, ‘Cry Me a River’, ‘Georgia on my Mind’, ‘Giant Steps’, ‘Girl From Ipanema’, ‘Have You Met Miss Jones?’, ‘Love for Sale’, ‘Rhythm Changes’, ‘Satin Doll’, ‘Someday My Prince Will Come’, ‘Stella By Starlight’, ‘Summertime’…and 130 more. Install Quartet on all of your iOS devices plus your Mac devices (M series only) at no extra cost. Ready to take your jazz standards to another level? Hear more at www.quartetapp.com Featured artists Saxophones and Flutes Graeme Blevins Recording and performing credits include Phil Collins, Robbie Williams, Kylie Minogue, Kyle Eastwood, Mark Knopfler, Quincy Jones, Mark Ronson, Tom Jones, Taylor Swift, Martha Reeves, The Royal Philharmonic Orchestra Andy Panayi Credits - Shirley Bassey, Jessye Norman, Paul McCartney, Seth MacFarlane, Elaine Paige, Salena Jones, Elvis Costello, Georgie Fame, Irene Reed, Elaine Delmar, Helen Shapiro, Madeline Bell, Patty Austin, Freddie Hubbard, Wynton Marsalis, Joe Lovano, Roy Hargrove Dave O’Higgins Credits - Joey Calderazzo, Joe Locke, Dave Kikoski, Eric Alexander, Grant Stewart, Max Ionata, Phil Dwyer, Adam Nussbaum, Joe Lovano, Phil Woods, Jimmy Smith, Nancy Wilson, Peggy Lee, Kurt Elling, Wayne Shorter, Eddie Gomez, Jamie Cullum, Stephane Grappelli, Michel Legrand Piano Graham Harvey Credits - Incognito (MD), Stacey Kent, George Benson, M People, Hamish Stuart, Will Lee, The Jones Girls, Philip Bailey, Chaka Khan, The BBC Big Band, Omar, Madeline Bell, Jocelyn Brown, Mica Paris, Kenny Thomas, Sir Cliff Richard Bass Geoff Gascoyne Credits - Jamie Cullum (MD), Sting, Van Morrison, Bill Bruford, Mari Wilson, Paloma Faith, Georgie Fame, Gloria Estefan, Guy Barker, Charlie Watts, Chris Standring, Everything But The Girl, Benny Golson, Jacqui Dankworth, Bob Dorough, John Martyn, Claire Martin, Eartha Kitt Drums Sebastiaan de Krom Credits - Herbie Hancock, John Scofield, Phil Woods, Dave Holland, Jamie Cullum, Guy Barker, Wynton Marsalis, Clark Terry, Tim Garland’s Big Band Rod Youngs Credits - Gil Scott-Heron, Lee Konitz, Sia, Courtney Pine, Jon Hendricks, Hugh Masekela, Natalie Cole, Mica Paris, Denys Baptiste, Juliet Roberts, BBC Concert Orchestra, Ronnie Laws, Jocelyn Brown

1623246775.name: HVAC ToolKit
1623246775.description: The HVAC ToolKit is an easy-to-use app that has been created to assist HVAC engineers in checking their designs and making quick calculations and estimations. The app includes helpful calculation tools for calculating friction losses in ducting, pipe sizing, parking ventilation, staircase pressurization, and estimating heat loads, pump head, fan ESP, among others, where the user is able to enter the required inputs and is given the calculated output. Each tool also includes instructions and abbreviated formulas that have been used to calculate the results. The app can be set to metric or imperial units and/or to the English or Arabic language. Users are expected to have some knowledge and understanding of HVAC engineering in order to use the tools properly. Users are also expected to check that the results are within an acceptable range for their respective projects. If you come across any inconsistencies while using the app or have any recommendations for additional inclusions, please contact us.

1623609206.name: Head Study
1623609206.description: Artists have always needed a quick and easy reference to help them understand the anatomy & forms of their portrait models. The Head Study App, is that resource. These portrait models were created to make the study of portraiture easier, but also to enhance your knowledge of the human form. The appearance of the face can be understood best by studying what is underneath the surface. The simplified planar head and the skull in this app are made with the same proportion to make this comparison as clear as possible. FEATURES: + Simplified “planes of the head” model + Anatomically correct male skull model + Tumble and zoom the 3D model from 360 degrees + Adjust the position & strength of multiple lighting situations + Switch between simplified planes, skull, and muscular views + Toggle an informational overlay indicating, key structural features, or anatomical insights + Adjustable background value This app was developed to go along with the lessons on my Patreon page. If you have interest in learning to draw and paint portraits better you can find all of my lessons at: patreon.com/StephenBaumanArtwork Any questions? Contact us at: stephenbaumanartwork@gmail.com

1624267817.name: 力学计算器-单跨梁
1624267817.description: 单跨梁是梁的一种较为简单和基本的结构形式，就是两端各有一个位移约束点的梁，应用非常广泛。单跨梁主要有5种形式，即悬臂梁、简支梁、一端简支一端固定梁、两端固定梁和伸臂梁。 单跨梁主要承受弯矩，属于弯效结构，故尽量减小单跨梁的竖向弯矩是单跨梁研究的主要问题。合理的造型能够减小梁的弯矩，使其充分发挥其材料性能。 《力学计算器—简支梁》是力学计算器APP系列中的一款计算器，可用于一般的工程师结构力学计算，或者材料力学等学习时参考求解，有如下特点： 1.按上述5种类型，收录了50多种典型、常用的单跨梁结构 2.可以按梁的结构形式输入所需参数，自动计算出结果 3.每种梁的结构形式精心录入对应的计算公式、参数说明和力及变形正负号说明，便于对照学习

1624360340.description: 你好！研色是一款专业的图片取色与制作色卡的工具应用， 专为各位设计师、色彩/手帐/美学等达人博主而设计。 工欲善其事，必先利其器。-《论语·卫灵公》 好的工具，真的事半功倍！ 研色的主要功能： ◎ 随时发现好配色 >> 随手拍照，秒级速度快捷提取色彩； ◎ 手机相册图片库 >> 目录缩略图即可预览色卡，浏览非常方便； ◎ 深入查看色彩值 >> 智能分析展示色值与配色比例，一目了然； ◎ 复制色值去使用 >> 一键复制文本，且可切换色值格式； ◎ 制作色卡素材图 >> 直接生成多个样式，且可编辑标题与版权署名； ◎ 回头找取色记录 >> 可自动保存取色历史 ，长期维护便是本价值不凡的色彩笔记哦； 研色的主要特色： ◎ 简洁轻便：简单的设计交互，容易上手。 ◎ 配色百分比：不止读色彩，更可全面分析一张图的配色搭配比例； ◎ 色卡素材制作：多种样式，可自定色卡的标题与署名，保护自己版权； ◎ 分析场景广泛：摄影作品、平面设计、艺术绘画，还可以电影、花艺、服装搭配、彩妆、室内设计...还还可以品牌设计、APP截屏... 研色会持续优化，满足你的多种取色配色场景～ 如有任何问题和建议，欢迎联系客服微信：lentowow

1624460253.name: AI Lecture Note Taker
1624460253.description: AI Lecture Note Taker uses powerful smart AI to record, transcribe, and summarize your speech live in multiple languages. Designed for iPhone and iPad, it is the perfect tool for taking minutes during meetings or capturing every detail of a lecture. Our voice-to-text technology works entirely offline, so you can save every memo without needing an internet connection. Transcription & Recording Live transcribe audio in real-time across multiple languages. Import recordings from your library to transcribe any audio or video file. Offline access for seamless recording and transcribing anywhere, anytime. AI-Powered Features AI Summary generation to extract key points and action items instantly. AI Chat assistant to answer specific questions about your transcripts. AI Study tools to auto-generate flashcards and quizzes from your notes. Smart Editing & Management Audio seek functionality: tap any word to play back that exact moment. Keyword search to find and replay specific segments in seconds. Text editing and translation tools to polish your notes after transcription. Multi-format export options including PDF, RTF, and plain text. Audio trimmer to edit and share specific clips of your recordings.

1624721528.name: 闪电短信 - 垃圾短信拦截
1624721528.trackName: 闪电短信 - 垃圾短信拦截
1624721528.description: 每天都在被垃圾短信打扰？ 闪电短信使用 AI 自动识别并分类诈骗、广告和骚扰短信，让重要信息更容易被看见。 短信识别与分类在设备本地完成，不上传短信内容，隐私更安心。 【智能分类】 短信自动归入四大类别： 正常信息：重要通知 垃圾信息：广告与骚扰 推广信息：促销与优惠 交易信息：订单与物流 同时支持更细致的分类： 财务 订单 提醒 公共服务 天气 运营商 【按类别拦截】 按需选择需要拦截的分类，灵活处理不同类型的短信。 【持续更新模型】 在线更新识别模型，持续适配新的诈骗、广告和骚扰短信。 【自定义规则】 支持个性化规则配置： 号码规则：精确匹配、前缀匹配、包含匹配、正则表达式 关键词规则：精确匹配、包含匹配、正则表达式 【一键防轰炸】 开启防轰炸模式，识别并处理短时间内大量相似短信，减少连续信息带来的干扰。 【样本提交】 发现分类有误？你可以自愿提交样本，帮助我们持续改进识别模型。 提交样本时，收集的数据包括： 经脱敏处理的短信文本 你标注的短信分类结果 样本仅用于模型训练与产品改进，不会分享给第三方或用于其他用途。 【隐私保护】 我们高度重视你的隐私： 不上传短信内容 短信识别与分类在设备本地完成 除非你主动提交样本，否则不会收集短信文本 模型更新和样本提交需要联网，但不会上传未主动提交的短信内容。 【隐私政策】 https://smshelper.pingstack.cn/privacy.html 【使用条款】 https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

1624825714.name: SyllablesTrainer
1624825714.description: This speech tool can be used to teach children or adults with dyslexia, auditory processing disorders, or visual processing disorders to identify and pronounce words. It can also be used to learn new languages by customizing and sharing words. Additionally, it can serve as a speech pathology tool. Main Features Prompt words with random combinations of built-in "initial," "medial," and "final" syllables. prompt syllables of actual words. Freeze syllables for drilling. Edit, add, or delete syllables and words. Listen to suggested syllable and word pronunciations. Basic Usage A tutor/parent/student can use the app to test a student's pronunciation of generated syllables or words. They indicate correct pronunciation by pressing [Correct] or [Wrong], which advances to the next syllable/word prompt, and records the result. Students can use the app independently by pronouncing syllables/words and pressing [Voice word] to hear a suggested pronunciation. Users can review their score at the end of each session.

1625239819.name: Object Detection Cam
1625239819.description: Object Detection Cam enables you to detect objects in real time using your iPhone or iPad with custom-trained machine learning models. The app includes a built-in model, YOLOv3Tiny.mlmodel, a lightweight neural network optimized for fast object detection across 80 object classes. Object Detection Cam Features: Load and run custom machine learning models from the built-in library Rename or delete models directly within the app Capture photos and save them instantly to the Photos library Enable sound alerts when an object is detected Choose from different sound tones for object detection feedback View all class labels supported by the active machine learning model Adding Custom Models: You can download pre-trained .mlmodel files and add them via AirDrop to the following directory in the Files app: [OD Cam] You may also train your own object detection models using tools such as CreateML or TensorFlow (conversion to .mlmodel required) Custom Model Tips: For instance, if you train a model to detect 5 dog breeds—Husky, Bulldog, Golden Retriever, German Shepherd, and Beagle—it will recognize these accurately. However, detecting a breed like Boxer (not in the model) may yield incorrect results (e.g., identified as Bulldog). To improve accuracy, include as many relevant object classes as possible during training. Usage Examples: Detect plant species in a jungle environment Identify dog breeds using a trained model Detect various animal or insect species Monitor item status (e.g., identify defective items) And many more use cases—powered by your creativity Quick Start Guide: 1. AirDrop your .mlmodel file (e.g., DogBreedsModel.mlmodel) into the [OD Cam] folder in the Files app 2. Launch Object Detection Cam 3. Go to the Library tab and tap your custom model 4. The camera will now detect objects based on the model’s class labels 5. When an object is detected, a bounding box and label will appear on screen 6. Tap the shutter button to save a photo to your camera roll [＊] Ensure your model is specifically trained for object detection (not image classification or other model types) What is Object Detection? Object detection uses machine learning or deep learning algorithms to identify and locate objects within images or video. While image classification assigns a label to an entire image, object detection involves localizing one or more objects with bounding boxes and assigning them class labels. Thanks for your support! 1625289361.description: 你尽管投，我们陪你「傻」 此刻你正拿着手机，工作学习、无聊放空甚至居家静默 有多久没有冲到球场，享受肆意流汗的快乐了？ 第一次或第一万次，无声无息，不知不觉间 你又一次自然而然地调动肩膀，抬起手臂，左手辅助，右手压腕 极致柔和地对着空气潇洒出手 你投的不是篮球，是一去不复返的青春和情怀 你大概，从未期待过什么回应 但这一次 那颗并不存在的「球」，虚拟地旋转三周半划过7.24米后，准确地空心入网 全世界第二美妙的声音，老朋友般坚定而温暖的响起—— 「唰」~ 这一刻，你浑身疲惫的血液瞬间被点燃 你知道你不是一个人，这个世界有人「懂你」 是的，我们把「空气投篮」做成真的了！ 轻巧无感的动作识别，配合精妙绝伦的空间音频模拟， 融汇成直击灵魂的信仰之音。 篮球，每个男人拿起了，就再也放不下。 念念不忘，必有回响。 从今天起，每一个忙忙碌碌负重前行的日子里， 你抬手，我们永远给你，骄傲的理由。 只要信仰在，每个人都可以做自己的 MVP。 致敬每一个，不负热爱的你。 —————————————— 【功能玩法】 根据提示佩戴手表，识别投篮手势动作，模拟真实的空心入网的空间音效 1、一定概率出现「打铁」砸框声音彩蛋，制造「意外」惊喜； 2、左轮、鞭子……更多体感模拟声效随时更新，更多玩法等你体验；

1625569339.name: 口算100分 - 数学小天才系列
1625569339.trackName: 口算100分 - 数学小天才系列
1625569339.description: 开学季限免！即日起至9月10日。一年仅此一次。 《口算100分》是数学小天才系列的第一款软件，也是纯粹的口算和计算练习软件，没有游戏，更没有广告等干扰使用的内容，旨在帮助学生提高口算速度和准确性。 除了基础的加、减、乘、除外，《口算100分》还提供【连加】、【连减】、【加减混合】、【加减乘】、【乘除混合】、【加减乘除】、【乘法口诀】、【除法口诀】共计8种题目类型，不仅可以出【普通题】，还可以出【填空题】，并支持最大1000以内的计算，满足学生提高水平的需求。 软件特色： 1. 针对1~3年级学生开发，能够满足1~3年级课程大纲的大部分练习需求。 2. 题目随机生成，一款软件就相当于数百本口算练习册，便宜又好用。 3. 三大模式助力学生提高计算准确性、速度和信心。 4. 操作简单，答题时使用常见的计算器界面，简单明了。 5. 画面清新，音乐治愈，缓解练习时的紧张和焦虑。 6. 答题后提供错题回顾功能，可以发现常错类型，以此巩固学习成果。 模式介绍： 1. 【专注模式】。该模式旨在提供一个沉浸式的答题环境，学生在答题过程中，软件不会立刻对答题结果做出反应，以免学生因为错误产生负面情绪。在所有题目完成后，学生可以通过错题回顾来查看哪些题目错了。 2. 【竞速模式】。该模式中，学生需要在限定时间内答题。答对可以赢得更多时间，答错则会减少时间。并有“学霸”难度，对学生的计算和反应能力进行终极考验。竞速模式也可以用于亲子活动中，家长可以和学生一人一局，比赛谁答得多，谁答得快。 3. 【题目生成器】。家长和老师可以通过题目生成器来生成计算题试卷，并分享或打印这些题目，让学生用传统的“试卷模式”来进行计算练习。生成题目的同时，也会生成答案，方便核对。 联系我们： 关注微信公众号“好美味游戏”，参与口算打卡等活动。

1625628315.name: Probability Calculator Plus
1625628315.description: 使用 Probability Calculator 掌握概率与统计-这是面向学生、教师和数据爱好者的最完整概率计算工具。 无论你是在备考、教学，还是解决现实世界的统计问题，ProbCalc 都能为你提供即时答案，并附带完整的逐步解题过程，让你真正理解数学原理。 概率计算 - 基础概率 - 根据有利结果和总结果计算 P(A) 条件概率 - 求解 P(A|B) = P(A∩B) / P(B) 独立事件 - 多个事件概率相乘 相关事件 - P(A∩B) = P(A) × P(B|A) 维恩图计算器 - 输入 P(A) 和 P(B)，即可获得 P(A∩B)、P(A∪B)、P(A XOR B) 以及 N 次试验中的发生概率，并附带可视化维恩图 自定义计算器 - 支持分数、小数或百分比输入 统计分布 - 二项分布 - P(X=k)、均值、方差和标准差 正态分布 - P(a ≤ X ≤ b)，包含 z 分数计算和累积分布函数（CDF） 泊松分布 - P(X=k)，含 λ 参数、均值和方差 随机实验模拟器 - 掷骰子、抛硬币、抽卡牌-全部配有真实概率图表： 骰子：D4、D6、D8、D10、D12、D20（最多同时掷 6 个） 硬币：一次可抛 1–10 枚 扑克牌：从标准 52 张牌组中抽取 每次试验都会实时更新频率图表 逐步解题过程 - 每个计算都展示完整步骤-公式、代入和结果。非常适合检查作业、备考或深入学习概率原理。 计算历史 - 所有结果自动保存。可搜索、查看和复制任何历史计算。滑动删除，点击查看完整步骤。 参考指南 - 内置参考包括： 完整概率与分布公式 标准正态分布 Z 表（z = −3.0 到 +3.0） 组合 C(n,r) 与排列 P(n,r) 计算器 为所有人设计 - 简洁无干扰界面，支持深色模式。点击任意结果即可复制。支持 iPhone 和 iPad。 无广告，无订阅，无需联网。 适用于： 高中和大学统计课程 AP 统计、IB 数学、A-Level、SAT/ACT 备考 大学概率与统计课程 教师备课与示例讲解 数据分析师和商业专业人士 概率是衡量事件发生可能性的指标。概率用 0 到 1 之间的数值表示，其中 0 表示不可能，1 表示必然发生。 概率公式总结： 两个事件同时发生的概率 P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B)。 至少一个事件发生的概率 P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B)。 条件概率 P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B)。 条件概率 P(B | A) = P(A ∩ B) / P(A)。 互斥或（异或）概率 P(A XOR B) = P(A) + P(B) - 2 × P(A ∩ B)。 概率论广泛应用于数学、统计、金融、博彩、科学（尤其是物理）、人工智能/机器学习、计算机科学、博弈论和哲学等领域，例如用于推断事件的期望发生频率。 概率论在日常生活中用于风险评估和建模。保险行业和市场利用精算科学进行定价和决策。政府在环境监管、福利分析（可靠性与寿命理论）以及金融监管中也应用概率方法。 感谢您的支持，也欢迎访问 nitrio.com，获取更多适用于 iOS 设备的应用。

1626047122.name: 幽灵事务所2：查利
1626047122.description: 生者？幽灵？两者本应毫无交集，但却机缘巧合地在人界和阴间的间隙之处，幽灵事务所，彼此产生了联系。 被解除封印的查利，从一片混沌之中睁开了眼睛。 除了自己的名字，查利记不起来任何事，而唯一与自己有联系的信物——剪刀，也被博斯拿走了。 为了拿回剪刀和恢复记忆，查利答应担任尤金的助手，并帮助他解决一系列事件。 但这个过程并没有查利想象的简单，更糟的是，事情似乎朝着崩溃的边缘发展！ 海登，琼恩，瑞凡，博斯……他们生前到底经历过什么。 来吧，在这里，你将与查利一起， 见证幽灵们前世今生的离奇故事。
